Then, the SOGDD representations of these two corner models were derived separately, and many characteristics of high-resolution corners were discovered, which enabled us to demonstrate how to select Gaussian filtering scales to obtain intensity variation information from images, accurately depicting adjacent corners. In addition, a new high-resolution corner detection method for images has been proposed for the first time, which can accurately detect adjacent corner points. The experimental results have verified that the proposed method outperforms state-of-the-art methods in terms of localization error, robustness to image blur transformation, image matching, and 3D reconstruction.

</details>


### [125] [Noise-Adaptive Regularization for Robust Multi-Label Remote Sensing Image Classification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2601.08446)
*Tom Burgert,Julia Henkel,Begüm Demir*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出NAR，一种噪声自适应正则化方法，通过在半监督学习框架下显式区分加性噪声和减性噪声，采用基于置信度的标签处理机制动态保留、停用或纠正标签条目，并结合早期学习正则化(ELR)稳定训练，在遥感多标签分类中有效提升对标签噪声的鲁棒性，尤其在减性和混合噪声场景下表现突出。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 遥感多标签分类中，标注过程依赖主题产品或众包流程，虽降低成本但引入多标签噪声（加性、减性、混合噪声）。现有方法忽视不同噪声类型的区别，缺乏显式适配不同噪声类型的学习机制。

Method: 提出NAR方法，在半监督学习框架下显式区分加性和减性噪声；采用置信度标签处理机制：高置信度保留、中等置信度暂时停用、低置信度翻转纠正；结合早期学习正则化(ELR)稳定训练、减轻对损坏标签的过拟合。

Result: 在加性、减性和混合噪声场景下，NAR相比现有方法一致提升了鲁棒性，在减性和混合噪声下性能提升最为显著。

Conclusion: 自适应抑制和选择性纠正噪声监督是RS MLC中实现噪声鲁棒学习的有效策略。

Abstract: The development of reliable methods for multi-label classification (MLC) has become a prominent research direction in remote sensing (RS). As the scale of RS data continues to expand, annotation procedures increasingly rely on thematic products or crowdsourced procedures to reduce the cost of manual annotation. While cost-effective, these strategies often introduce multi-label noise in the form of partially incorrect annotations. In MLC, label noise arises as additive noise, subtractive noise, or a combination of both in the form of mixed noise. Previous work has largely overlooked this distinction and commonly treats noisy annotations as supervised signals, lacking mechanisms that explicitly adapt learning behavior to different noise types. To address this limitation, we propose NAR, a noise-adaptive regularization method that explicitly distinguishes between additive and subtractive noise within a semi-supervised learning framework. NAR employs a confidence-based label handling mechanism that dynamically retains label entries with high confidence, temporarily deactivates entries with moderate confidence, and corrects low confidence entries via flipping. This selective attenuation of supervision is integrated with early-learning regularization (ELR) to stabilize training and mitigate overfitting to corrupted labels. Experiments across additive, subtractive, and mixed noise scenarios demonstrate that NAR consistently improves robustness compared with existing methods. Performance improvements are most pronounced under subtractive and mixed noise, indicating that adaptive suppression and selective correction of noisy supervision provide an effective strategy for noise robust learning in RS MLC.

</details>


### [126] [UnHype: CLIP-Guided Hypernetworks for Dynamic LoRA Unlearning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.03410)
*Piotr Wójcik,Maksym Petrenko,Wojciech Gromski,Przemysław Spurek,Maciej Zieba*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: UnHype框架通过将超网络集成到LoRA训练中，在单概念和多概念场景下实现动态、可扩展的机器遗忘，适用于Stable Diffusion和基于流的文本到图像模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于LoRA的机器遗忘方法存在三个主要局限：(1)对概念语义的适应性有限；(2)难以平衡移除紧密相关概念与保持更广泛泛化能力；(3)多概念同时擦除时面临可扩展性挑战。

Method: UnHype框架将超网络(hypernetwork)集成到单概念和多概念LoRA训练中。在推理阶段，超网络根据CLIP嵌入动态生成自适应的LoRA权重，实现上下文感知的遗忘。该架构可直接插入Stable Diffusion和基于流的文本到图像模型。

Result: 在物体擦除、名人擦除和不当内容移除等多项具有挑战性的任务上进行了评估，验证了UnHype的有效性和通用性，且训练行为稳定。

Conclusion: UnHype通过超网络动态生成LoRA权重，实现了更上下文感知和可扩展的机器遗忘，解决了现有LoRA方法在概念语义适应性和多概念可扩展性方面的不足。

Abstract: Recent advances in large-scale diffusion models have intensified concerns about their potential misuse, particularly in generating realistic yet harmful or socially disruptive content. This challenge has spurred growing interest in effective machine unlearning, the process of selectively removing specific knowledge or concepts from a model without compromising its overall generative capabilities. Among various approaches, Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) has emerged as an effective and efficient method for fine-tuning models toward targeted unlearning. However, LoRA-based methods often exhibit limited adaptability to concept semantics and struggle to balance removing closely related concepts with maintaining generalization across broader meanings. Moreover, these methods face scalability challenges when multiple concepts must be erased simultaneously. To address these limitations, we introduce UnHype, a framework that incorporates hypernetworks into single- and multi-concept LoRA training. The proposed architecture can be directly plugged into Stable Diffusion as well as modern flow-based text-to-image models, where it demonstrates stable training behavior and effective concept control. During inference, the hypernetwork dynamically generates adaptive LoRA weights based on the CLIP embedding, enabling more context-aware, scalable unlearning. We evaluate UnHype across several challenging tasks, including object erasure, celebrity erasure, and explicit content removal, demonstrating its effectiveness and versatility. See the code on GitHub: https://github.com/gmum/UnHype.

</details>


### [127] [4DPC$^2$hat: Towards Dynamic Point Cloud Understanding with Failure-Aware Bootstrapping](https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.03890)
*Xindan Zhang,Weilong Yan,Yufei Shi,Xuerui Qiu,Tao He,Ying Li,Ming Li,Hehe Fan*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出4DPC²hat，首个面向动态点云序列理解的多模态大语言模型，通过构建大规模跨模态数据集4DPC²hat-200K（含44K动态序列、700K点云帧、200K QA对），引入Mamba增强时序推理机制和失败感知自举学习策略，显著提升了动态点云的动作理解与时序推理能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有方法主要关注静态点云对象，对动态点云序列的理解仍未被探索，主要受限于缺乏大规模跨模态数据集以及难以在时空上下文中建模运动。

Method: 1) 构建大规模跨模态数据集4DPC²hat-200K，采用拓扑一致4D点构建和两级标注两阶段流程；2) 提出Mamba增强的时序推理MLLM，捕捉点云序列中的长程依赖和动态模式；3) 提出失败感知自举学习策略，迭代识别模型缺陷并生成针对性QA监督以强化推理能力。

Result: 4DPC²hat在动作理解和时序推理任务上相比现有模型取得显著提升，为4D动态点云理解建立了坚实基础。

Conclusion: 本文首次将MLLM拓展至动态点云序列理解，通过数据集构建、时序建模和自举学习的有机结合，有效解决了动态点云理解的挑战。

Abstract: Point clouds provide a compact and expressive representation of 3D objects, and have recently been integrated into multimodal large language models (MLLMs). However, existing methods primarily focus on static objects, while understanding dynamic point cloud sequences remains largely unexplored. This limitation is mainly caused by the lack of large-scale cross-modal datasets and the difficulty of modeling motions in spatio-temporal contexts. To bridge this gap, we present 4DPC$^2$hat, the first MLLM tailored for dynamic point cloud understanding. To this end, we construct a large-scale cross-modal dataset 4DPC$^2$hat-200K via a meticulous two-stage pipeline consisting of topology-consistent 4D point construction and two-level captioning. The dataset contains over 44K dynamic object sequences, 700K point cloud frames, and 200K curated question-answer (QA) pairs, supporting inquiries about counting, temporal relationship, action, spatial relationship, and appearance. At the core of the framework, we introduce a Mamba-enhanced temporal reasoning MLLM to capture long-range dependencies and dynamic patterns among a point cloud sequence. Furthermore, we propose a failure-aware bootstrapping learning strategy that iteratively identifies model deficiencies and generates targeted QA supervision to continuously strengthen corresponding reasoning capabilities. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our 4DPC$^2$hat significantly improves action understanding and temporal reasoning compared with existing models, establishing a strong foundation for 4D dynamic point cloud understanding.

</details>


### [128] [Learning Self-Correction in Vision-Language Models via Rollout Augmentation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.08503)
*Yi Ding,Ziliang Qiu,Bolian Li,Ruqi Zhang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出Octopus框架，通过重组现有rollout合成密集的自纠正样本，结合响应掩码策略解耦自纠正与直接推理，解决了VLM中RL学习自纠正行为的稀疏奖励问题，实现了可控的自纠正能力，在7个基准上取得开源VLM最佳性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有强化学习方法难以让VLM学会自纠正行为，因为有效的自纠正示例出现频率极低，导致学习信号极其稀疏。

Method: 1）提出correction-specific rollouts（Octopus），通过重组现有rollout合成密集的自纠正样本，提升样本效率并稳定RL优化；2）引入响应掩码策略，解耦自纠正与直接推理，避免信号冲突。

Result: Octopus-8B在7个基准上取得开源VLM最先进性能，优于最佳RLVR基线1.0分，且训练时间仅为每步0.72倍。

Conclusion: 通过rollout重组增强和响应掩码解耦，有效解决了VLM自纠正学习的稀疏奖励问题，实现了可控的自纠正推理能力。

Abstract: Self-correction is essential for solving complex reasoning problems in vision-language models (VLMs). However, existing reinforcement learning (RL) methods struggle to learn it, as effective self-correction behaviors emerge only rarely, making learning signals extremely sparse. To address this challenge, we propose correction-specific rollouts (Octopus), an RL rollout augmentation framework that synthesizes dense self-correction examples by recombining existing rollouts. This augmentation simultaneously improves sample efficiency due to rollout reuse and stabilizes RL optimization through balanced supervision. Furthermore, we introduce a response-masking strategy that decouples self-correction from direct reasoning, avoiding signal conflicts and enabling both behaviors to be learned effectively. Building on this, we introduce Octopus-8B, a reasoning VLM with controllable self-correction capability. Across 7 benchmarks, it achieves SoTA performance among open-source VLMs, outperforming the best RLVR baseline by 1.0 score while requiring only $0.72\times$ training time per step.

</details>


### [129] [Shifting the Breaking Point of Flow Matching for Multi-Instance Editing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.08749)
*Carmine Zaccagnino,Fabio Quattrini,Enis Simsar,Marta Tintoré Gazulla,Rita Cucchiara,Alessio Tonioni,Silvia Cascianelli*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出了实例解耦注意力机制，通过分割联合注意力操作，实现多实例场景下的独立编辑，解决全局条件速度场和联合注意力机制导致的编辑纠缠问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于流的图像编辑方法主要支持全局编辑或单指令编辑，在多实例场景下，参考输入的多个部分需要独立编辑时会出现语义干扰，这是由于全局条件速度场和联合注意力机制导致编辑纠缠。

Method: 提出Instance-Disentangled Attention（实例解耦注意力），通过分割联合注意力操作，在速度场估计过程中强制绑定实例特定的文本指令与对应空间区域。

Result: 在自然图像编辑和新引入的文本密集信息图表基准测试上，该方法促进了编辑解耦和局部性，同时保持全局输出一致性，实现了单次前向传播的实例级编辑。

Conclusion: 实例解耦注意力机制有效解决了多实例编辑中的语义干扰问题，实现了高效、解耦的局部编辑。

Abstract: Flow matching models have recently emerged as an efficient alternative to diffusion, especially for text-guided image generation and editing, offering faster inference through continuous-time dynamics. However, existing flow-based editors predominantly support global or single-instruction edits and struggle with multi-instance scenarios, where multiple parts of a reference input must be edited independently without semantic interference. We identify this limitation as a consequence of globally conditioned velocity fields and joint attention mechanisms, which entangle concurrent edits. To address this issue, we introduce Instance-Disentangled Attention, a mechanism that partitions joint attention operations, enforcing binding between instance-specific textual instructions and spatial regions during velocity field estimation. We evaluate our approach on both natural image editing and a newly introduced benchmark of text-dense infographics with region-level editing instructions. Experimental results demonstrate that our approach promotes edit disentanglement and locality while preserving global output coherence, enabling single-pass, instance-level editing.

</details>


### [130] [Toward Trustworthy Portrait Editing: Evaluation of Demographic Misrepresentation in I2I Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.16149)
*Huichan Seo,Minki Hong,Sieun Choi,Jihie Kim,Jean Oh*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文系统研究了指令引导的图像编辑系统中存在的身份保留失败问题，发现62-71%的输出存在肤色变浅现象，且非白人群体受影响更严重（72-75% vs 44%），提出了可控审计协议用于公平性评估。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 图像编辑系统在消费和专业视觉工作流中应用日益广泛，其可信度不仅取决于指令遵从性，还取决于对身份相关属性的公平保留。现有研究缺乏对身份保留失败的系统性量化评估，特别是其人口统计学分布不均衡问题。

Method: 形式化了两种失败模式（Soft Erasure软擦除和Stereotype Replacement刻板印象替换），基于5,040张编辑肖像的控制基准，使用视觉语言模型评分和人工评估，对三个最新的开源编辑模型进行评测。

Result: 62-71%的输出呈现肤色变浅；印度和黑人源肖像受影响比例为72-75%，白人源肖像为44%；提示层级的外观约束可将非白人源肖像的种族变化评分降低最多1.48分，而对白人源肖像影响不大。

Conclusion: 身份保留不是I2I肖像编辑系统的统一属性，而是分布不均的可信度失败，具有直接的社会后果。大规模的静默扭曲会塑造AI中介的自我表征并强化表征性差异。研究提出了用于生成编辑系统公平性评估与治理的可控审计协议。

Abstract: Instruction-guided image-to-image (I2I) editors are increasingly used in consumer and professional visual workflows, where trustworthiness depends not only on prompt compliance but also on equitable preservation of identity-relevant attributes. We formalize two failure modes: Soft Erasure, where requested edits are weakly realized or silently suppressed, and Stereotype Replacement, where edits introduce unrequested, stereotype-consistent demographic attributes. Using a controlled benchmark of 5,040 edited portraits, we evaluate these failures across three recent open-weight editors with vision-language model scoring and human evaluation. Our results show that identity-preservation failures are pervasive and demographically uneven. In particular, 62--71% of outputs exhibit skin lightening, with Indian and Black source portraits affected at 72--75%, compared with 44% for White source portraits, indicating output-level drift toward lighter or more White-presenting appearances when identity constraints are underspecified. In a mitigation case study, prompt-level appearance constraints reduce race-change scores for non-White source portraits by up to 1.48 points, while leaving White source portraits largely unchanged, without modifying model weights. These findings show that identity preservation is not a uniform property of I2I portrait editing systems, but an unevenly distributed trustworthiness failure with direct social consequences. At deployment scale, such silent distortions can shape AI-mediated self-representation and reinforce representational disparities. We introduce a controlled audit protocol for fairness-aware evaluation and governance of generative editing systems. Project page: https://seochan99.github.io/i2i-demographic-bias

</details>


### [131] [FUSAR-GPT : A Spatiotemporal Feature-Embedded and Two-Stage Decoupled Visual Language Model for SAR Imagery](https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.19190)
*Xiaokun Zhang,Yi Yang,Ziqi Ye,Baiyun,Xiaorong Guo,Qingchen Fang,Ruyi Zhang,Xinpeng Zhou,Haipeng Wang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 针对SAR图像在视觉语言模型中表现受限的问题，本文构建了首个SAR图像-文本-AlphaEarth特征三元组数据集，并开发了专用于SAR的视觉语言模型FUSAR-GPT。该模型创新性地引入地理空间基线模型作为"世界知识"先验，通过"时空锚点"嵌入多源遥感时序特征，并设计了双阶段SFT策略解耦大模型的知识注入与任务执行，在多项遥感视觉语言基准测试中取得SOTA性能，显著超越主流基线模型超10%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 视觉语言模型在RGB图像上表现出色，但由于SAR成像机制复杂、散射特征敏感及高质量文本语料稀缺，直接应用VLMs于SAR领域效果严重受限。为此，亟需构建专用于SAR的视觉语言模型以解决上述挑战。

Method: 1）构建首个SAR图像-文本-AlphaEarth特征三元组数据集；2）提出FUSAR-GPT模型，引入地理空间基线模型作为世界知识先验；3）通过"时空锚点"将多源遥感时序特征嵌入视觉骨干，动态补偿SAR图像中目标的稀疏表示；4）设计双阶段SFT策略，解耦大模型的知识注入与任务执行。

Result: 在多项典型遥感视觉语言基准测试中取得SOTA性能，显著超越主流基线模型超过10%。

Conclusion: 时空特征嵌入与双阶段解耦范式有效提升了SAR领域视觉语言模型的表现，为全时全天候SAR智能解译提供了可行方案。

Abstract: Research on the intelligent interpretation of all-weather, all-time Synthetic Aperture Radar (SAR) is crucial for advancing remote sensing applications. In recent years, although Visual Language Models (VLMs) have demonstrated strong open-world understanding capabilities on RGB images, their performance is severely limited when directly applied to the SAR field due to the complexity of the imaging mechanism, sensitivity to scattering features, and the scarcity of high-quality text corpora. To systematically address this issue, we constructed the inaugural SAR Image-Text-AlphaEarth feature triplet dataset and developed FUSAR-GPT, a VLM specifically for SAR. FUSAR-GPT innovatively introduces a geospatial baseline model as a 'world knowledge' prior and embeds multi-source remote-sensing temporal features into the model's visual backbone via 'spatiotemporal anchors', enabling dynamic compensation for the sparse representation of targets in SAR images. Furthermore, we designed a two-stage SFT strategy to decouple the knowledge injection and task execution of large models. The spatiotemporal feature embedding and the two-stage decoupling paradigm enable FUSAR-GPT to achieve state-of-the-art performance across several typical remote sensing visual-language benchmark tests, significantly outperforming mainstream baseline models by over 10%.

</details>


### [132] [MAviS: A Multimodal Conversational Assistant For Avian Species](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.07294)
*Yevheniia Kryklyvets,Mohammed Irfan Kurpath,Sahal Shaji Mullappilly,Jinxing Zhou,Fahad Shabzan Khan,Rao Anwer,Salman Khan,Hisham Cholakkal*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出了一个面向鸟类物种的多模态大模型系统MAviS，包含大规模多模态数据集MAviS-Dataset（覆盖1000+物种的图像、音频、文本）、多模态对话模型MAviS-Chat以及评估基准MAviS-Bench（25000+QA对），实验表明MAviS-Chat显著优于基线模型MiniCPM-o-2.6，证明了领域自适应多模态大模型在生态应用中的必要性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有通用多模态大模型在鸟类等专业领域缺乏细粒度理解和物种级别的多模态问答能力，无法提供准确且上下文相关的信息，限制了生物多样性保护和生态监测的应用。

Method: 构建大规模多模态鸟类数据集MAviS-Dataset（含预训练和指令微调子集），基于该数据集训练支持图像、音频、文本三种模态的多模态大模型MAviS-Chat，并设计包含25000+QA对的基准MAviS-Bench进行定量评估。

Result: MAviS-Chat在鸟类物种级感知和推理能力上大幅超越基线模型MiniCPM-o-2.6，达到开源模型最优水平，验证了指令微调数据集的有效性。

Conclusion: 面向生态应用的领域自适应多模态大模型是必要的，MAviS系列工作为生物多样性保护提供了有效的技术支撑。

Abstract: Fine-grained understanding and species-specific multimodal question answering are vital for advancing biodiversity conservation and ecological monitoring. However, existing multimodal large language models face challenges when it comes to specialized topics like avian species, making it harder to provide accurate and contextually relevant information in these areas. To address this limitation, we introduce the MAviS-Dataset, a large-scale multimodal avian species dataset that integrates image, audio, and text modalities for over 1,000 bird species, comprising both pretraining and instruction-tuning subsets enriched with structured question-answer pairs. Building on the MAviS-Dataset, we introduce MAviS-Chat, a multimodal LLM that supports audio, vision, and text and is designed for fine-grained species understanding, multimodal question answering, and scene-specific description generation. Finally, for quantitative evaluation, we present MAviS-Bench, a benchmark of over 25,000 QA pairs designed to assess avian species-specific perceptual and reasoning abilities across modalities. Experimental results show that MAviS-Chat outperforms the baseline MiniCPM-o-2.6 by a large margin, achieving state-of-the-art open-source results and demonstrating the effectiveness of our instruction-tuned MAviS-Dataset. Our findings highlight the necessity of domain-adaptive multimodal LLMs for ecological applications.

</details>


### [133] [Global Cross-Modal Geo-Localization: A Million-Scale Dataset and a Physical Consistency Learning Framework](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.08491)
*Yutong Hu,Jinhui Chen,Chaoqiang Xu,Yuan Kou,Sili Zhou,Shaocheng Yan,Pengcheng Shi,Qingwu Hu,Jiayuan Li*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出了CORE——首个百万级全球跨模态地理定位数据集，包含来自六大洲225个区域的超过100万张跨视角图像，并设计了物理定律感知网络PLANET，通过新型对比学习范式引导文本表示捕捉卫星图像的内在物理特征，在全局地理定位任务上显著超越现有方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有跨模态地理定位研究受限于狭窄的地理覆盖范围和简单的场景多样性，无法反映全球建筑风格和地形特征的巨大空间异质性，缺乏能够支撑普适定位的大规模数据集。

Method: 1) 构建CORE数据集：包含1,034,786张跨视角图像，覆盖六大洲225个地理区域；2) 利用大规模视觉语言模型的零样本推理能力合成高质量场景描述；3) 提出PLANET网络，引入物理定律感知的对比学习范式，引导文本表示捕捉卫星图像的固有物理特征。

Result: 在多个不同地理区域的广泛实验表明，PLANET显著优于现有最先进方法，建立了面向鲁棒全局地理定位的新基准。

Conclusion: CORE数据集和PLANET网络有效弥补了全球尺度跨模态地理定位的数据和方法缺口，为行人导航和应急响应等应用提供了有力支撑。

Abstract: Cross-modal Geo-localization (CMGL) matches ground-level text descriptions with geo-tagged aerial imagery, which is crucial for pedestrian navigation and emergency response. However, existing studies are constrained by narrow geographic coverage and simplistic scene diversity, failing to reflect the immense spatial heterogeneity of global architectural styles and topographic features. To bridge this gap and facilitate universal positioning, we introduce CORE, the first million-scale dataset dedicated to global CMGL. CORE comprises 1,034,786 cross-view images sampled from 225 distinct geographic regions across six continents, offering an unprecedented variety of perspectives in varying environmental conditions and urban layouts. We leverage the zero-shot reasoning of Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs) to synthesize high-quality scene descriptions rich in discriminative cues. Furthermore, we propose a physical-law-aware network (PLANET) for cross-modal geo-localization. PLANET introduces a novel contrastive learning paradigm to guide textual representations in capturing the intrinsic physical signatures of satellite imagery. Extensive experiments across varied geographic regions demonstrate that PLANET significantly outperforms state-of-the-art methods, establishing a new benchmark for robust, global-scale geo-localization. The dataset and source code will be released at https://github.com/YtH0823/CORE.

</details>


### [134] [Efficient Brood Cell Detection in Layer Trap Nests for Bees and Wasps: Balancing Labeling Effort and Species Coverage](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.16652)
*Chenchang Liu,Felix Fornoff,Annika Grasreiner,Patrick Maeder,Henri Greil,Marco Seeland*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出了一种基于深度学习的CFPL损失函数策略，用于在巢穴陷阱中高效检测和分类野生蜜蜂与黄蜂的育雏室，以减少标注工作量并缓解类别不平衡问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 人工评估巢穴陷阱中育雏室的检测与分类工作劳动密集且耗时，同时存在密集排列导致标注困难、常见种与稀有种类别分布严重不平衡、完全标注成本高而部分标注会损害模型性能等问题。

Method: 提出了一种约束假阳性损失（Constrained False Positive Loss, CFPL）策略，通过动态屏蔽未标注数据的预测结果，防止其对训练过程中的分类损失产生干扰。

Result: 实验结果表明，该方法提升了检测性能，在模型准确度和标注工作量之间取得了更好的平衡，同时有效缓解了类别不平衡问题。

Conclusion: CFPL策略能够在不增加标注负担的情况下，有效利用未标注数据，提升巢穴陷阱中育雏室的检测与分类效果。

Abstract: Monitoring cavity-nesting wild bees and wasps is vital for biodiversity research and conservation. Layer trap nests (LTNs) are emerging as a valuable tool to study the abundance and species richness of these insects, offering insights into their nesting activities and ecological needs. However, manually evaluating LTNs to detect and classify brood cells is labor-intensive and time-consuming.
  To address this, we propose a deep learning based approach for efficient brood cell detection and classification in LTNs. LTNs present additional challenges due to densely packed brood cells, leading to a high labeling effort per image. Moreover, we observe a significant imbalance in class distribution, with common species having notably more occurrences than rare species. Comprehensive labeling of common species is time-consuming and exacerbates data imbalance, while partial labeling introduces data incompleteness which degrades model performance.
  To reduce labeling effort and mitigate the impact of unlabeled data, we introduce a novel Constrained False Positive Loss (CFPL) strategy. CFPL dynamically masks predictions from unlabeled data, preventing them from interfering with the classification loss during training.
  Experimental results demonstrate that our method improves detection performance, balances model accuracy and labeling effort, while also mitigating class imbalance.

</details>


### [135] [Attention, May I Have Your Decision? Localizing Generative Choices in Diffusion Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.06052)
*Katarzyna Zaleska,Łukasz Popek,Monika Wysoczańska,Kamil Deja*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出ICM方法，通过探针定位自注意力层中处理隐式决策的关键层，并针对这些层进行精准干预，实现优于现有方法的去偏效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 文本到图像扩散模型在处理非完全描述性提示时，需要隐式地决定未明确指定的细节，但这一决策过程的内部机制尚不透明，且现有定位技术主要关注显式条件干预，未区分隐式决策。

Method: 提出基于探针的定位技术，通过测量概念属性可分性来识别关键层；发现自注意力层是解决模糊概念的主要场所；基于此提出ICM方法，仅对少量自注意力层进行针对性干预。

Result: 对特定自注意力层进行干预，在去偏性能上优于现有最先进方法，且产生的伪影更少。

Conclusion: 自注意力层是控制隐式决策（如去偏）的最有效干预点，精准的层级别干预比广泛干预效果更好。

Abstract: Text-to-image diffusion models exhibit remarkable generative capabilities, yet their internal operations remain opaque, particularly when handling prompts that are not fully descriptive. In such scenarios, models must make implicit decisions to generate details not explicitly specified in the text. This work investigates the hypothesis that this decision-making process is not diffuse but is computationally localized within the model's architecture. While existing localization techniques focus on prompt-related interventions, we notice that such explicit conditioning may differ from implicit decisions. Therefore, we introduce a probing-based localization technique to identify the layers with the highest attribute separability for concepts. Our findings indicate that the resolution of ambiguous concepts is governed principally by self-attention layers, identifying them as the most effective point for intervention. Based on this discovery, we propose ICM (Implicit Choice-Modification) - a precise steering method that applies targeted interventions to a small subset of layers. Extensive experiments confirm that intervening on these specific self-attention layers yields superior debiasing performance compared to existing state-of-the-art methods, minimizing artifacts common to less precise approaches. The code is available at https://github.com/kzaleskaa/icm.

</details>


### [136] [BareBones: Benchmarking Zero-Shot Geometric Comprehension in VLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.10528)
*Aaditya Baranwal,Vishal Yadav,Abhishek Rajora*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: BareBones 是一个零样本基准测试，通过去除RGB纹理信息、仅保留纯几何轮廓来评估视觉语言模型（VLM）对几何结构的真实理解能力。测试26个主流VLM发现，在去除纹理后模型性能严重崩溃，称之为"纹理偏差悬崖"现象，揭示了模型普遍存在几何结构盲点。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有VLM在零样本多模态任务中表现优异，但其是否真正理解几何结构，还是仅依赖RGB纹理和上下文先验作为统计捷径，这一问题尚未明确。现有评估无法隔离这一机制，混淆了语义推理与纹理映射，且依赖的标注不精确，会无意中泄露环境线索。

Method: 构建BareBones零样本基准测试，使用像素级轮廓（silhouettes）作为输入，去除所有RGB纹理信息。数据集来源包括ImageNet-S、DIS5K、ThinObject5K、PASCAL VOC、CUB-200五个现有分割数据集，以及新构建的WTP-Bench旗舰数据集。WTP-Bench是一个极端细粒度的视觉谜题，要求模型仅通过边界轮廓识别几何概念。共评估26个主流开源和闭源VLM。

Result: 在去除RGB纹理后，所有26个测试的VLM（包括GPT-4.1、Gemini、Claude Sonnet 4.5、LLaVA等）均出现一致的、严重的性能崩溃现象，作者将其命名为"纹理偏差悬崖"（Texture Bias Cliff）。

Conclusion: BareBones揭示了VLM普遍存在的结构性几何盲点，证明了当前模型严重依赖纹理特征而非真正的几何理解，为检验几何结构理解能力建立了严格的基准。

Abstract: While Vision-Language Models (VLMs) demonstrate remarkable zero-shot recognition capabilities across a diverse spectrum of multimodal tasks, it yet remains an open question whether these architectures genuinely comprehend geometric structure or merely exploit RGB textures and contextual priors as statistical shortcuts. Existing evaluations fail to isolate this mechanism, conflating semantic reasoning with texture mapping and relying on imprecise annotations that inadvertently leak environmental cues. To address this gap, we introduce $\textbf{BareBones}$, a zero-shot benchmark designed to stress-test pure geometric shape comprehension. We curate pixel-level silhouettes of geometrically distinct classes across six datasets: five established segmentation sources (ImageNet-S, DIS5K, ThinObject5K, PASCAL VOC, CUB-200) and our novel flagship collection, WTP-Bench, establishing a noise-free geometric taxonomy. WTP-Bench is an extreme, fine-grained visual puzzle that forces models to identify inter-class geometric concepts from boundary contours alone. Our evaluation of 26 state-of-the-art proprietary and open-weight VLMs (eg. GPT-4.1, Gemini, Claude Sonnet 4.5, LLaVA) reveals a consistent, severe performance collapse under RGB deprivation, a phenomenon we term the $\textit{Texture Bias Cliff}$. By documenting universal structural blindspots, BareBones establishes a rigorous yardstick for genuine geometric grounding. Project Page: https://eternal-f1ame.github.io/WTP-Bench/

</details>


### [137] [Topology-Aware Layer Pruning for Large Vision-Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.16502)
*Pengcheng Zheng,Chaoning Zhang,Ya Wen,Wang Liu,Qigan Sun,Jiarong Mo,Jiaquan Zhang,Jewon Lee,Tae-Ho Kim,Kuien Liu,Tianyu Li,Caiyan Qin,Yang Yang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出了一种基于拓扑感知的层剪枝框架TopoVLM，利用持续同调理论量化层间拓扑一致性，在保持关键表示转换的同时实现自适应剪枝，优于现有方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有层剪枝方法依赖局部相似性度量或静态代理信号，无法捕捉跨模型深度的全局和动态表示演化，容易移除关键过渡层，导致LVLMs在资源受限场景下部署困难。

Method: 将层的隐藏状态表示为点云，利用单纯复形建模其演化过程，通过zigzag持续同调量化层间拓扑一致性，实现自适应剪枝以保留关键表示过渡层。

Result: 在多种多模态基准测试上，该方法在不同稀疏比下均优于现有剪枝方法。

Conclusion: 拓扑感知的层剪枝框架能有效识别和保留关键表示过渡层，显著提升LVLMs在资源受限场景下的部署效率。

Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) have demonstrated strong capabilities in natural language understanding and reasoning, while recent extensions that incorporate visual inputs enable them to process multimodal information. Despite these advances, Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs) incur substantial computational and memory costs, hindering deployment in resource-constrained scenarios. Existing layer pruning methods typically rely on local similarity metrics or static proxy signals, failing to capture the global and dynamic evolution of representations across model depth, which often leads to the removal of transition-critical layers. To address this limitation, we propose a topology-aware layer pruning framework for LVLMs. Specifically, we represent layer wise hidden states as point clouds and models their evolution using \textit{simplicial complexes}. By leveraging \textit{zigzag persistent homology}, we quantify inter-layer topological consistency and enable adaptive pruning that preserves critical representational transitions. Extensive experiments on diverse multimodal benchmarks demonstrate that the proposed framework consistently outperforms existing pruning methods across a wide range of sparsity ratios. Our code is available at https://github.com/zpc456/TopoVLM.

</details>


### [138] [CityRAG: Stepping Into a City via Spatially-Grounded Video Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.19741)
*Gene Chou,Charles Herrmann,Kyle Genova,Boyang Deng,Songyou Peng,Bharath Hariharan,Jason Y. Zhang,Noah Snavely,Philipp Henzler*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: CityRAG是一种视频生成模型，利用地理注册数据作为上下文，生成与真实物理场景一致的3D可导航环境，支持任意天气条件和动态物体配置，能够生成数分钟长、物理 grounded 的视频序列。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有视频生成模型（T2V/I2V）能生成合理的序列，但无法在任意天气条件和动态物体配置下重建真实世界，这对于自动驾驶和机器人仿真等下游应用至关重要。

Method: CityRAG利用大规模地理注册语料库作为上下文，将生成结果锚定到物理场景；采用时间上不对齐的训练数据，使模型在语义上将底层场景与其瞬态属性解耦。

Result: 能够生成数分钟长、物理 grounded 的视频序列；在数千帧中保持天气和光照条件一致性；实现闭环；在复杂轨迹下重建真实世界地理。

Conclusion: CityRAG通过地理上下文注入和场景-瞬态属性解耦，实现了对真实物理世界的高保真、长时间、可导航的视频重建，为自动驾驶和机器人仿真提供了可行的解决方案。

Abstract: We address the problem of generating a 3D-consistent, navigable environment that is spatially grounded: a simulation of a real location. Existing video generative models can produce a plausible sequence that is consistent with a text (T2V) or image (I2V) prompt. However, the capability to reconstruct the real world under arbitrary weather conditions and dynamic object configurations is essential for downstream applications including autonomous driving and robotics simulation. To this end, we present CityRAG, a video generative model that leverages large corpora of geo-registered data as context to ground generation to the physical scene, while maintaining learned priors for complex motion and appearance changes. CityRAG relies on temporally unaligned training data, which teaches the model to semantically disentangle the underlying scene from its transient attributes. Our experiments demonstrate that CityRAG can generate coherent minutes-long, physically grounded video sequences, maintain weather and lighting conditions over thousands of frames, achieve loop closure, and navigate complex trajectories to reconstruct real-world geography.

</details>


### [139] [Image Generators are Generalist Vision Learners](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.20329)
*Valentin Gabeur,Shangbang Long,Songyou Peng,Paul Voigtlaender,Shuyang Sun,Yanan Bao,Karen Truong,Zhicheng Wang,Wenlei Zhou,Jonathan T. Barron,Kyle Genova,Nithish Kannen,Sherry Ben,Yandong Li,Mandy Guo,Suhas Yogin,Yiming Gu,Huizhong Chen,Oliver Wang,Saining Xie,Howard Zhou,Kaiming He,Thomas Funkhouser,Jean-Baptiste Alayrac,Radu Soricut*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出Vision Banana模型，通过对Nano Banana Pro进行指令微调，将视觉任务输出空间参数化为RGB图像，证明了图像生成预训练可以像LLM预训练一样学习到强大的通用视觉表征，在多种2D/3D视觉理解任务上达到SOTA性能，表明图像生成可作为视觉任务的统一接口。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 探索图像生成预训练是否能够像LLM的语言生成预训练一样，赋予模型强大的视觉理解能力，并验证生成式训练是否可以作为构建通用视觉基础模型的范式。

Method: 基于Nano Banana Pro（NBP）模型，通过指令微调混合原始训练数据和少量视觉任务数据构建Vision Banana；将视觉任务的输出空间参数化为RGB图像，将感知任务重新框定为图像生成问题。

Result: Vision Banana在多种2D和3D视觉理解任务上达到SOTA，击败或匹敌零样本领域专精模型（如SAM 3在分割任务、Depth Anything系列在度量深度估计），且轻量级指令微调未牺牲基础模型的图像生成能力。

Conclusion: 图像生成预训练是一种通用视觉学习器，图像生成可作为视觉任务的统一通用接口（类似于文本生成在语言理解中的作用），可能标志着计算机视觉范式的重大转变——生成式视觉预训练将在构建视觉基础和生成理解双功能的基础模型中发挥核心作用。

Abstract: Recent works show that image and video generators exhibit zero-shot visual understanding behaviors, in a way reminiscent of how LLMs develop emergent capabilities of language understanding and reasoning from generative pretraining. While it has long been conjectured that the ability to create visual content implies an ability to understand it, there has been limited evidence that generative vision models have developed strong understanding capabilities. In this work, we demonstrate that image generation training serves a role similar to LLM pretraining, and lets models learn powerful and general visual representations that enable SOTA performance on various vision tasks. We introduce Vision Banana, a generalist model built by instruction-tuning Nano Banana Pro (NBP) on a mixture of its original training data alongside a small amount of vision task data. By parameterizing the output space of vision tasks as RGB images, we seamlessly reframe perception as image generation. Our generalist model, Vision Banana, achieves SOTA results on a variety of vision tasks involving both 2D and 3D understanding, beating or rivaling zero-shot domain-specialists, including Segment Anything Model 3 on segmentation tasks, and the Depth Anything series on metric depth estimation. We show that these results can be achieved with lightweight instruction-tuning without sacrificing the base model's image generation capabilities. The superior results suggest that image generation pretraining is a generalist vision learner. It also shows that image generation serves as a unified and universal interface for vision tasks, similar to text generation's role in language understanding and reasoning. We could be witnessing a major paradigm shift for computer vision, where generative vision pretraining takes a central role in building Foundational Vision Models for both generation and understanding.

</details>


### [140] [JI-ADF: Joint-Individual Learning with Adaptive Decision Fusion for Multimodal Skin Lesion Classification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.27343)
*Phan Nguyen,Dat Cao,Hien Kha,Hien Chu,Minh Le,Trang Pham,Nguyen Quoc Khanh Le*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: JI-ADF是一个三模态深度学习框架，通过联合表示学习、辅助监督和自适应决策融合，整合皮肤镜图像、临床照片和结构化患者元数据，在MILK10k基准上实现了鲁棒且平衡的皮肤病变分类性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有计算机辅助系统主要依赖皮肤镜图像，未能充分利用临床实践中常规可用的多模态证据（临床照片和患者元数据），导致诊断能力受限。

Method: 提出JI-ADF三模态框架，包含：1）联合多模态表示学习；2）模态特异性辅助监督；3）自适应决策融合机制（逐样本动态校准模态贡献）；4）多模态融合注意力（MMFA）模块以增强跨模态推理并保留模态特异性证据。

Result: 在MILK10k基准上，JI-ADF在各类别上表现出色且均衡，提升了敏感性和Dice分数，同时保持高特异性和良好的校准性能。消融实验、校准评估和Grad-CAM可视化验证了模型的鲁棒性和临床合理性。

Conclusion: JI-ADF为真实临床环境下的多模态皮肤病变分类提供了可靠且实用的基础，具有重要的临床转化价值。

Abstract: Skin lesion classification is essential for early dermatological diagnosis, yet many existing computer-aided systems rely primarily on dermoscopic images and underutilize the multimodal evidence routinely available in clinical practice. To address this gap, we propose \textbf{JI-ADF}, a trimodal deep learning framework that integrates dermoscopic images, clinical photographs, and structured patient metadata for clinically grounded skin lesion classification. The proposed architecture combines joint multimodal representation learning with modality-specific auxiliary supervision and an adaptive decision fusion mechanism that dynamically calibrates modality contributions on a per-sample basis. To enhance cross-modal reasoning while preserving modality-specific evidence, we further introduce a multimodal fusion attention (MMFA) module. We evaluate JI-ADF on the large-scale MILK10k benchmark, which reflects real-world clinical acquisition conditions and severe class imbalance. The proposed method demonstrates strong and well-balanced performance across lesion categories, improving sensitivity and Dice score while maintaining high specificity and good calibration. Extensive analyses, including modality ablation, calibration evaluation, and Grad-CAM visualization, further confirm the robustness and clinically meaningful behavior of the model. These results indicate that JI-ADF provides a reliable and practical foundation for multimodal skin lesion classification in real-world clinical settings.

</details>


### [141] [Tamaththul3D: High-Fidelity 3D Saudi Sign Language Avatars from Monocular Video](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.05367)
*Eyad Alghamdi,Sattam Altuuaim,Obay Ghulam,Abdulrahman Qutah,Yousef Basoodan*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 首个面向阿拉伯手语（沙特手语Ishara-500）的SMPL-X参数化标注数据集发布，并提出Tamaththul3D管线，通过几何逆运动学对齐手部和身体估计，在前臂链和2D监督肩部优化下，实现手部误差降低32%、速度提升32倍，且无需数据集适配即可泛化至五种不同手语。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有3D手语虚拟人重建方法仅针对西方手语开发，阿拉伯手语数据集缺乏3D参数化标注，阻碍了面向阿拉伯聋人社区的虚拟人无障碍应用开发。

Method: 提出Tamaththul3D重建管线，通过前臂链的几何逆运动学对齐手部和身体估计，结合2D监督的肩部优化；手部与身体估计器可任意替换（SMPL-X兼容身体估计器 + MANO兼容手估计器），实现闭式解集成与模块解耦。

Result: 手部误差比现有方法降低最高32%，运行速度比最强基线快32倍，在五种不同手语上无需数据集特定适配即可泛化。

Conclusion: 填补了阿拉伯手语3D参数化标注的空白，Tamaththul3D在效率和泛化性上显著优于现有方法，为阿拉伯聋人社区的虚拟人应用铺平了道路。

Abstract: Existing 3D sign language avatar reconstruction methods are developed and evaluated exclusively on Western sign languages, and no 3D parametric annotations exist for any Arabic Sign Language dataset, a gap that blocks the development of avatar-based accessibility applications for the Arab Deaf community. We release the first SMPL-X parametric annotations for the Ishara-500 Saudi Sign Language dataset, enabling quantitative evaluation and downstream sign language generation for Arabic Sign Language. We introduce Tamaththul3D, a reconstruction pipeline that aligns hand and body estimates through geometric inverse kinematics on the forearm chain followed by 2D-supervised shoulder refinement. The closed-form integration is decoupled from the specific choice of body and hand estimators: any SMPL-X-compatible body estimator and any MANO-compatible hand estimator can be substituted, as we demonstrate by swapping each module independently. Tamaththul3D achieves up to 32% lower hand error than prior methods, runs 32x faster than the strongest baseline, and generalizes across five typologically distinct sign languages without dataset-specific adaptation.

</details>


### [142] [Unified Pix Token And Word Token Generative Language Model](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.14028)
*Haun Leung,ZiNan Wang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种统一像素令牌和词令牌的新模型，通过为图像每个像素分配独立令牌嵌入、颜色折叠、全局条件注意力近似及无监督预训练等方法，解决当前ViT（如CLIP/SigLIP）在视觉细节理解（如小文本/数字识别）上的不足。实验表明，即使在小模型和有限数据下，该模型也表现良好，并符合缩放定律。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前基于ViT的多模态模型（使用CLIP或SigLIP方法）在视觉细节理解上存在局限，尤其是难以识别图像中的小文本或数字，亟需一种能够更精细捕获像素级信息的视觉编码方法。

Method: 提出统一像素令牌和词令牌的生成式语言模型，核心设计包括：1) 每个图像像素拥有独立的令牌嵌入；2) 颜色折叠（color folding）机制；3) 全局条件注意力近似；4) 图像无监督预训练。

Result: 在图像无监督预训练实验中，即使模型规模较小且训练数据有限，该模型仍取得了良好的性能表现。

Conclusion: 该模型符合缩放定律，随着模型参数和训练数据的增加，性能将持续提升。

Abstract: Since the emergence of Vision Transformer (ViT), it has been widely used in generative language model and generative visual model. Especially in the current state-of-art open source multimodal models, ViT obtained by CLIP or SigLIP method serves as the vision encoder backbone to help them acquire visual understanding capabilities. But this method leads to limitations in visual understanding for details, such as difficulty in recognizing small text or numbers in images. To address these issues, we propose a new model to unify pix token and word token into the generative language model. The new model also features with each pix of image having its own token embedding, color folding, global conditional attention approximation and image unsupervised pretraining. We conducted image unsupervised pretraining experiments using our new model to explore its potential. The experimental results show that it has good performance even in small model and with limited training data. We believe our model also conforms to the scaling law, as long as model parameters and training data increased, its performance will continue to improve.

</details>


### [143] [MAVEN A Multi-Agent Framework for Multicultural Text-to-Video Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.16716)
*Shuowei Li,Yuming Zhao,Parth Bhalerao,Oana Ignat*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: MAVEN是一个多智能体提示优化框架，通过将提示分解为人物、动作和地点三个维度，由专门智能体并行或串行处理，显著提升文本到视频生成在单文化和跨文化场景中的文化保真度。研究贡献了包含3种文化、243个提示和972个视频的基准数据集，实验表明并行专业化策略在保持视觉质量和时序一致性的同时，有效提升了文化相关性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前T2V生成在视觉保真度方面取得了快速进展，但其在单个提示中忠实呈现多种文化的能力尚未得到充分探索，即存在文化保真度不足的问题。

Method: 提出MAVEN多智能体提示优化框架，将提示分解为人物(person)、动作(action)和地点(location)三个维度，由专门智能体并行或串行处理。构建了涵盖中国、美国、罗马尼亚三种文化、三种动作类别、包含单文化和跨文化场景的243个提示和972个视频的基准数据集。

Result: 基于CLIP指标、VLM-as-judge评估和视频质量测量的实验表明，多智能体优化（尤其是并行专业化）在保持视觉质量和时序一致性的同时，显著提升了文化相关性和保真度。

Conclusion: MAVEN框架通过结构化提示分解和专业化多智能体协作，有效增强了T2V生成的文化保真度，为跨文化视频生成提供了可行的解决方案。

Abstract: Text-to-video (T2V) generation has rapidly progressed in visual fidelity, yet its ability to faithfully represent multiple cultures within a single prompt remains underexplored. We introduce MAVEN, a multi-agent prompt refinement framework designed to improve cultural fidelity in both mono-cultural and cross-cultural T2V generation. MAVEN decomposes prompts into person, action, and location dimensions, handled by specialized agents operating in parallel or sequentially. To support systematic evaluation, we contribute a new benchmark of 243 culturally grounded prompts and 972 corresponding videos, spanning three cultures (Chinese, American, Romanian), three action categories, and both mono-cultural and cross-cultural scenarios. Evaluations combining CLIP-based metrics, VLM-as-judge assessments, and videoquality measures show that multi-agent refinement, particularly parallel specialization, significantly improves cultural relevance while preserving visual quality and temporal consistency. The dataset and code are available at https://github.com/AIM-SCU/MAVEN

</details>


### [144] [When Preference Labels Fall Short: Aligning Diffusion Models from Real Data](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.19839)
*Weiyan Chen,Weijian Deng,Yao Xiao,Weijie Tu,ZiYi Dong,Ibrahim Radwan,Liang Lin,Pengxu Wei*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出利用真实数据替代人工标注偏好对来对齐扩散模型，通过将真实图像与生成/扰动样本对比构建偏好信号，无需人工标注即可达到与现有偏好对齐方法相当的性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有偏好对齐方法依赖模型生成图像构建的偏好对，这种监督信号是相对且模糊的——当两个样本都存在伪影或视觉质量有限时，难以推断真正理想的输出是什么。本文探究能否用真实数据作为偏好对齐的替代监督源。

Method: 采用数据为中心的视角，设计了一种数据策展策略：将真实图像作为参考点，通过对比真实图像与生成或扰动样本构建偏好信号，无需人工标注的偏好对。

Result: 基于真实数据的监督信号能为扩散模型对齐提供有效指导，性能与现有基于偏好的方法相当。

Conclusion: 真实数据为偏好对齐提供了一种实用且互补的监督源，为标签高效的对齐策略指明了方向。

Abstract: Preference alignment aims to guide generative models by learning from comparisons between preferred and non-preferred samples. In practice, most existing approaches rely on preference pairs constructed from model-generated images. Such supervision is inherently relative and can be ambiguous when both samples exhibit artifacts or limited visual quality, making it difficult to infer what constitutes a truly desirable output. In this work, we investigate whether real data can serve as an alternative source of supervision for preference alignment. We adopt a data-centric perspective and study a curation strategy that treats real images as reference points and constructs preference signals by contrasting them with generated or perturbed samples, without requiring manually annotated preference pairs. Through empirical analysis, we show that real-data-based supervision provides effective guidance for aligning diffusion models and achieves performance comparable to existing preference-based methods. Our results suggest that real data offers a practical and complementary source of supervision for preference alignment and highlight directions of label-efficient alignment strategies. Code and models are available at https://cwyxx.github.io/RealAlign.

</details>


### [145] [TempRet: Temporal Enhancement and Two-Stage Reranking for CVPR 2026 EPIC-KITCHENS-100 Multi-Instance Retrieval Challenge](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.24470)
*Zixu Li,Yupeng Hu,Zhiwei Chen,Zhiheng Fu,Xiaowei Zhu,Weili Guan,Liqiang Nie*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出TempRet方法，针对第一人称视频中的多实例检索问题，在CLIP双编码器基础上引入时序Transformer建模帧间依赖，并采用两阶段重排序管道进行跨模态精细化，在EPIC-KITCHENS-100 MIR基准上达到67.97%平均mAP和82.92%平均nDCG。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有视频-文本检索方法继承自图像-文本检索的逐帧处理假设，忽略了第一人称视频中的时序动态特性；同时EPIC-KITCHENS-100 MIR挑战引入软标签相关性矩阵，需要模型能够解决跨模态的渐进语义对应问题。

Method: 基于CLIP双编码器骨干，提出两个关键组件：(1) 时序Transformer，仅在视频端运行，通过可学习位置编码和帧级CLIP特征上的多头自注意力建模帧间依赖；(2) 两阶段重排序管道，先用双编码器检索Top-K候选，再用配备图像-文本匹配头的交叉编码器优化分数。整体采用对称多相似性损失训练以利用软标签相关性矩阵。

Result: 在EPIC-KITCHENS-100 MIR基准上达到67.97%平均mAP和82.92%平均nDCG。

Conclusion: 时序建模和跨模态精细化对于第一人称视频检索任务有效，TempRet方法在该挑战中取得了优异性能。

Abstract: Video-text retrieval has witnessed remarkable progress driven by large-scale vision-language pretraining, yet most existing approaches inherit an implicit assumption from image-text retrieval: that visual semantics can be captured frame-by-frame. This assumption overlooks the temporal dynamics of egocentric videos. The EPIC-KITCHENS-100 Multi-Instance Retrieval (MIR) challenge further raises the bar by providing soft-label relevance matrices rather than binary labels, demanding models that can resolve graded semantic correspondences across modalities. In this report, we present our solution, termed TempRet, to the CVPR 2026 EPIC-KITCHENS-100 MIR challenge. Our approach builds upon a CLIP-based dual-encoder backbone and introduces two key components to address the temporal and cross-modal challenges. First, a temporal transformer operates exclusively on the video side, modeling inter-frame dependencies through learnable positional encodings and multi-head self-attention over frame-level CLIP features. Second, a two-stage reranking pipeline first retrieves Top-K candidates via the dual-encoder, then refines their scores using a cross-encoder equipped with an Image-Text Matching (ITM) head. The entire system is trained with Symmetric Multi-Similarity Loss to exploit the soft-label relevance matrices provided by the challenge. Our method achieves 67.97% average mAP and 82.92% average nDCG on the EK-100 MIR benchmark, demonstrating the effectiveness of temporal modeling and cross-modal refinement for egocentric video retrieval.

</details>


### [146] [OmniEgo-R$^2$: A Routed Reasoning Framework for the 1st Cross-Domain EgoCross Challenge at CVPR 2026](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.24481)
*Zixu Li,Zhiwei Chen,Zhiheng Fu,Wenbo Wang,Yupeng Hu,Weili Guan,Liqiang Nie*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出OmniEgo-R²，一种统一的路由推理管道，用于跨领域自我中心视频推理。该方法在EgoCross挑战赛（CVPR 2026）中，在Source-Limited和Open-Source两个赛道均获得第二名。核心贡献包括：识别了跨域视频推理的三个关键挑战（时间边界模糊、跨域语义粒度不匹配、近似选项下的决策不稳定），并提出了包含时间证据归一化、域无关能力路由、结构化感知-动态-决策推理、边界感知选项验证和防御性答案校准的解决方案。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 将跨域自我中心视频问答（EgoCross）重新定义为鲁棒的跨域具身视频推理问题，而非简单的多选视觉问答任务。旨在解决多模态大模型在手术、工业、极限运动和动物视角等多样化自我中心视频领域中进行推理时面临的独特挑战。

Method: 提出OmniEgo-R²（Omnidomain Egocentric Routed Reasoning），一种统一的路由推理管道，包含五个模块：时间证据归一化、域无关能力路由、结构化感知-动态-决策推理、边界感知选项验证和防御性答案校准。使用Qwen3-VL-4B-SFT检查点作为视觉语言骨干，并封装轻量级测试时推理和解析程序。

Result: 在Source-Limited赛道达到66.35%总体准确率，在Open-Source赛道达到66.77%总体准确率，在两个赛道均排名第二。

Conclusion: 提出的方法有效解决了跨域自我中心视频推理中的时间边界模糊、语义粒度不匹配和决策不稳定问题，验证了结构化路由推理管道在多样化自我中心视频域中的有效性。

Abstract: The 1st Cross-Domain EgoCross Challenge at EgoVis, CVPR 2026 evaluates whether multimodal large language models can reason over egocentric videos across surgery, industry, extreme sports, and animal perspective. We achieved second place in both the Source-Limited and Open-Source tracks. In this report, we formulate EgoCross as a robust cross-domain embodied video reasoning problem rather than a simple multiple-choice visual question answering task. We identify three key challenges: (C1) temporal boundary ambiguity, where critical state transitions are sparsely sampled and often occur between frames; (C2) cross-domain semantic granularity mismatch, where the same capability requires different domain-specific visual grammar; and (C3) decision instability under close options, where long multimodal reasoning can select unsupported distractors or produce malformed outputs. To address them, we propose OmniEgo-R$^2$ (Omnidomain Egocentric Routed Reasoning), a unified routed reasoning pipeline consisting of temporal-evidence normalization, domain-agnostic capability routing, structured perception--dynamics--decision reasoning, boundary-aware option verification, and defensive answer calibration. OmniEgo-R$^2$ uses the Qwen3-VL-4B-SFT checkpoints on each EgoCross domain as the visual-language backbone, and wraps them with lightweight test-time reasoning and parsing programs. Our final submissions obtain 66.35% overall accuracy in the Source-Limited track and 66.77% in the Open-Source track, ranking second in both leaderboards. The codes are available on https://github.com/Lee-zixu/OmniEgo-R2

</details>


### [147] [EgoAction: Egocentric Action Composition with Reliability-Aware Temporal Fusion for the EPIC-KITCHENS Action Detection Challenge at CVPR 2026](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.24496)
*Zhiheng Fu,Zixu Li,Zhiwei Chen,Fangxu Liu,Yupeng Hu,Weili Guan,Liqiang Nie*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出了EgoAction，一种基于可靠性感知时间融合的解耦检测与融合流水线，用于EPIC-KITCHENS-100动作检测任务。核心创新是动态加权融合（DWF），根据动词和名词分类置信度动态调整边界融合权重，取代了传统的固定均值融合。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 动词和名词检测流在不同场景下的失效模式不同：动词分数对运动过渡敏感，名词分数对手-物可见性和物体杂乱敏感。固定算术均值融合会在一流退化时放大定位误差，因此需要一种自适应融合策略。

Method: 1) 使用EPIC微调的VideoMAE-L提取特征；2) 分别训练具有因果时间建模的名词和动词时间检测器；3) 从Top名词-动词对组合动作假设；4) 提出动态加权融合（DWF），将最大名词/动词分类置信度归一化为边界权重，线性组合两个时间区间；5) 结合滑动窗口推理、Top-K动作组合和类别Soft-NMS。

Result: 在EPIC-KITCHENS-100动作检测挑战中取得了具有竞争力的结果，DWF相比固定均值融合减少了因单一流退化导致的定位误差。

Conclusion: DWF作为一种轻量级张量算子，在保持解耦动作评分机制的同时，将边界决策权转移给更可靠的流，构建了一个紧凑且可复现的自我中心时间动作检测系统。

Abstract: The EPIC-KITCHENS-100 Action Detection challenge evaluates whether a model can localize the start and end of each action in long untrimmed egocentric videos and assign the corresponding verb--noun action label. In this report, we formulate our submission as EgoAction (Egocentric Action Composition with Reliability-Aware Temporal Fusion), a unified decoupled detection and fusion pipeline. The pipeline uses EPIC-finetuned VideoMAE-L features, trains separate noun and verb temporal detectors with causal temporal modeling, composes action hypotheses from top noun--verb pairs, and introduces a confidence-adaptive boundary fusion rule at post-processing time. The key observation is that verb and noun streams often fail differently: verb scores are sensitive to motion transitions, whereas noun scores are sensitive to hand-object visibility and object clutter. A fixed arithmetic mean of their predicted boundaries can therefore amplify localization errors when one stream degenerates. We replace this hard-coded mean with Dynamic Weighted Fusion (DWF), which normalizes the maximum noun and verb classification confidences into proposal-wise boundary weights and linearly combines the two intervals. This lightweight tensor-only operator shifts boundary authority toward the more reliable stream while preserving the decoupled action scoring mechanism. Together with sliding-window inference, top-K noun--verb action composition, and class-wise Soft-NMS, EgoAction provides a compact and reproducible system for egocentric temporal action detection.

</details>


### [148] [EgoAdapt: A Multi-Scene Egocentric Adaptation Method for CVPR 2026 HD-EPIC VQA Challenge](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.24500)
*Zhiwei Chen,Yupeng Hu,Zixu Li,Zhiheng Fu,Guozhi Qiu,Weili Guan,Liqiang Nie*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出EgoAdapt方法，通过类别条件路由、校准选项评分和测试时一致性适应三个推理阶段组件，解决第一人称厨房视频VQA任务中异构时空语义结构的挑战，显著超越HD-EPIC基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: HD-EPIC基准测试包含7个宏观类别的26K多选题，但单一通用推理模板无法有效处理视频中异构的时间、空间和语义结构（如短时手-物交互、长程食谱轨迹、空间关系、注视线索等），模型容量并非唯一瓶颈。

Method: EgoAdapt包含三个推理阶段组件：(1) 类别条件路由：为每类问题设计专用提示、帧预算和采样率；(2) 校准选项评分：利用字母标记似然和生成一致性评估所有候选答案，而非仅依赖直接生成；(3) 测试时一致性适应：对模糊案例聚合选项排列和验证式提示的预测结果。

Result: 在HD-EPIC基准上显著优于现有基线方法。

Conclusion: 针对异构视频问答任务，推理阶段的类别自适应、校准评分和一致性聚合能有效弥补模型与任务结构之间的不匹配，无需重新训练即可大幅提升性能。

Abstract: This technical report presents our solution, EgoAdapt (Egocentric Adaptation via Category, Calibration, and Consistency), to the CVPR 2026 HD-EPIC VQA challenge. HD-EPIC evaluates whether a vision-language model can reason over realistic first-person kitchen videos, where the evidence for an answer may be a short hand-object interaction, a long recipe trajectory, a spatial relation to a fixture, or a subtle gaze cue. The benchmark contains 26K multiple-choice questions across seven macro-categories: recipe, ingredient, nutrition, fine-grained action, 3D perception, object motion, and gaze. We observe that the main difficulty is not only model capacity, but also the mismatch between a single generic inference recipe and the heterogeneous temporal, spatial, and semantic structure of the benchmark. Our method, EgoAdapt, introduces three inference-time components: (1) category-conditioned routing with per-category prompts, frame budgets, and sampling rates; (2) calibrated option scoring that evaluates all candidate answers with letter-token likelihoods and generation agreement instead of relying only on direct generation; and (3) test-time consistency adaptation that aggregates predictions across option permutations and verification-style prompts for ambiguous cases. This design substantially improves over the available HD-EPIC baselines.

</details>


### [149] [RAPTOR+: A Visually Grounded Vision-Language Framework to Improve Clinical Trust and Auditability in Automated Cancer Referral Processing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.25956)
*Sofiat Abioye,Ufaq Khan,Shazad Ashraf,Anusha Jose,Adam Byfield,Lukman Akanbi,Muhammad Bilal*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: RAPTOR+ 提出多模态扩展，使用视觉语言模型（VLM）实现结直肠癌紧急转诊表单的端到端理解，通过微调 Qwen3-VL-8B 在提取准确率（96.1%）和证据定位（严格安全性 60.6%）上显著优于零样本商用模型（Gemini 2.5 Flash 准确率 92.6% 但严格安全性仅 1.2%），证明了任务特异性微调对于可靠、可审计的临床文档理解至关重要。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 原有 RAPTOR 系统依赖独立的 OCR 阶段进行结构化提取，易受手写、布局变化影响且丢失视觉证据链接；紧急 CRC 转诊操作瓶颈亟需更可靠、可审计的端到端理解方案。

Method: 提出 RAPTOR+ 多模态扩展，使用 VLM 进行端到端转诊理解；基于 223 份临床整理的 CRC 紧急转诊表单，评估微调 VLM、商用/开源零样本 VLM 及原 OCR 基线；引入基于定位（grounding）的评估框架，同时度量提取准确性和证据定位。

Result: 微调 Qwen3-VL-8B 实现 96.1% 读取准确率与 60.6% 严格安全性；零样本 Gemini 2.5 Flash 读取准确率 92.6% 但严格安全性仅 1.2%，存在显著定位差距（grounding gap）。

Conclusion: 任务特异性微调对于实现可靠、可审计的临床文档理解必不可少；RAPTOR+ 可将提取的转诊决策链接到视觉证据，支持更安全高效的癌症转诊分诊。

Abstract: Urgent suspected colorectal cancer (CRC) referrals create operational bottlenecks because semi-structured clinical documents often require manual review and transcription. The original RAPTOR system used Large Language Models for structured extraction but relied on a separate OCR stage, making it vulnerable to handwriting, layout variation, and loss of visual evidence linkage. We present RAPTOR+, a multimodal extension that uses Vision-Language Models (VLMs) for end-to-end referral understanding. We evaluate fine-tuned VLMs, commercial and open-source zero-shot VLMs, and the original OCR-based pipeline on 223 clinically curated CRC urgent referral forms. We also introduce a grounding-aware evaluation framework that measures both extraction accuracy and evidence localisation. Results show a clear grounding gap in zero-shot models. Gemini 2.5 Flash achieved 92.6% Reading Accuracy but only 1.2% Strict Safety. In contrast, fine-tuned Qwen3-VL-8B achieved 96.1% Reading Accuracy and 60.6% Strict Safety, substantially improving verifiable evidence grounding. These findings show that task-specific fine-tuning is essential for reliable, auditable clinical document understanding. RAPTOR+ enables extracted referral decisions to be linked to visual evidence, supporting safer and more efficient cancer referral triage.

</details>


### [150] [PathWISE: Multi-Agent Cancer Pathway Triaging Ontology Learning from Clinical Flowcharts](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.25970)
*Sofiat Abioye,Ufaq Khan,Shazad Ashraf,Mohammed Adil Butt,Andrew D. Beggs,Adam Byfield,Anusha Jose,Junaid Qadir,Muhammad Bilal*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: PathWISE是一个五阶段流水线，结合四个LLM智能体、确定性深度优先搜索审计器和Java编译器，将临床路径流程图自动转化为可执行的HL7 CQL库，并在五种NHS癌症路径上实现了100%的语法编译成功率和零术语幻觉。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 临床路径以视觉流程图形式呈现，其空间拓扑、箭头方向、颜色编码和字体粗细等关键分诊逻辑无法被计算系统访问和处理，导致这些重要的临床知识无法被计算机化利用。

Method: 提出PathWISE五阶段流水线：(1) 四个LLM智能体提取流程图结构为类型有向图；(2) 确定性深度优先搜索进行路径枚举；(3) 结构化语义审计每个节点的可计算性；(4) 生成受术语约束的CQL定义并通过官方Java CQL-to-ELM编译器验证；(5) 生成覆盖100%枚举患者旅程的路由逻辑。

Result: 在五种NHS癌症路径上，审计最多183个节点，识别544个结构化治理发现，实现100%语法编译成功，不可计算节点使用假占位符保持可编译性，为零术语幻觉代码。

Conclusion: PathWISE将非确定性LLM推理限制在知识提取阶段，而确定性图数学和标准编译器支撑所有验证步骤，实现了从不可计算的视觉流程图到可执行CQL库的可靠转换。

Abstract: Clinical pathways are disseminated as visual flowcharts where spatial topology, arrow direction, colour coding, and font weight encode critical triage logic that remains inaccessible to computational systems. We present PathWISE, a five-phase pipeline combining four LLM-based agents with a deterministic depth-first search auditor and a Java compiler critic, transforming these non-computable artefacts into validated, executable HL7 Clinical Quality Language (CQL) libraries deployable as FHIR CDS Hooks services. Purpose-built agents extract flowchart structure into a typed directed graph, perform deterministic path enumeration, conduct a structured semantic audit of every node's computability, generate terminology-constrained CQL definitions verified by the official Java CQL-to-ELM compiler, and produce routing logic covering 100% of enumerated patient journeys. Demonstrated across five UK NHS cancer pathways (colorectal, lung, skin, upper GI, and breast), PathWISE audits up to 183 nodes (182 under the Hybrid configuration), identifies 544 structured governance findings across four issue categories, achieves 100% syntactic compilation success, with UNCOMPUTABLE nodes receiving false placeholders that preserve compilability while surfacing governance gaps for clinical review, and produces zero hallucinated terminology codes for dictionary-covered concepts. Critically, PathWISE confines non-deterministic LLM inference to knowledge extraction while deterministic graph mathematics and a standard compiler underpin every verification step.

</details>


### [151] [DuoGesture: Neuro-Inspired and Biomechanically Informed Dual-Stream Co-Speech Gesture Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.26236)
*Ferdinand Paar,Lanmiao Liu,Aslı Özyürek,Serge Thill,Esam Ghaleb*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: DuoGesture提出了一种神经启发且符合生物力学原理的双流方法，将共语手势生成分解为语义流和节拍流，通过语义变分信息瓶颈、运动接地语义条件化和惯性节拍先验三个关键组件，在语义表达和节拍律动之间取得更好平衡，优于整体式基线模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有整体式手势模型将词汇驱动的语义手势与韵律对齐的节拍手势混为一谈，导致语义接地性不足、语音-运动对齐不佳以及运动学平滑度较差。

Method: 提出双流架构：1) 语义变分信息瓶颈作为随机帧级门控，学习何时语义手势应覆盖节拍运动；2) 运动接地语义条件化，用运动-语言表征替代纯语言词嵌入；3) 惯性节拍先验，基于人体测量加权的臂链模块减少抖动、改善韵律一致性。

Result: 客观评估和主观实验表明DuoGesture优于强整体式基线，消融实验证实了语义接地、随机流选择和生物力学正则化的互补作用。

Conclusion: 双流分解策略能有效解耦手势生成中语义与节拍成分，运动接地和生物力学正则化对提升生成质量至关重要。

Abstract: Co-speech gesture generation requires both semantic expressivity and biomechanically plausible rhythmic motion. Existing holistic gesture models mix lexically grounded semantic gestures with frequent prosody-aligned beat gestures. This limits semantic grounding, speech-motion alignment, and kinematic smoothness. We propose \emph{DuoGesture}, a neuro-inspired and biomechanically informed dual-stream approach that decomposes co-speech gesture synthesis into coupled semantic and beat streams. The two streams are coordinated by a \emph{Semantic Variational Information Bottleneck}, a stochastic frame-level gate that learns when semantic gestures should override rhythmic beat motion. The semantic stream is controlled by \emph{Motion-Grounded Semantic Conditioning}, which replaces purely linguistic word embeddings with motion-language representations to provide motion-aligned semantic priors for long-tailed lexical triggers of gestures. The beat stream is further regularised by an \emph{Inertial Beat Prior}, an anthropometry-weighted arm-chain module that reduces jitter and improves rhythmic consistency without constraining semantic frames. Objective evaluations and subjective experiments show that DuoGesture outperforms strong holistic baselines, while component ablations confirm the complementary roles of semantic grounding, stochastic stream selection, and biomechanical regularisation.

</details>


### [152] [Once-For-All: A Train-Once and Select-Anytime Framework for Multimodal Instruction Tuning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.26761)
*Mingkang Dong,Hongyi Cai,Xiwen Lei,Jie Li,Tao Zhang,Muxin Pu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出OFA框架，仅需一次训练即可复用的多模态指令数据选择器，通过CLIP聚类和伪标签训练轻量选择器，选取最不确信样本作为高信息量数据，跨数据集和模型规模迁移无需重新计算。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有数据选择方法依赖于特定模型或数据集，当目标模型或候选池变化时需从头重新计算，成本高昂。需要一种可复用的数据选择方案，解耦选择过程与目标模型/数据集。

Method: (1) 在冻结的CLIP空间中对多模态指令进行聚类；(2) 从聚类结构中推导伪标签；(3) 训练轻量级选择器仅数个epoch；(4) 选取选择器最不确信的样本作为高信息量数据。选择器训练一次后冻结，直接跨数据集和模型规模迁移。

Result: 在LLaVA-665K上仅选15%数据即达到全数据98.3%性能；迁移到未见过的Vision-Flan-186K上超越全数据训练10.6%；同一子集适用于Qwen2.5-VL-3B和LLaVA-v1.5-7B无需重新计算。

Conclusion: 单个可迁移的选择器能够提供有效且可复用的多模态指令微调数据选择方案，真正实现选择过程与目标模型和数据集的解耦。

Abstract: Multimodal instruction tuning is the de facto recipe for adapting vision language models (VLMs), yet instruction data are highly redundant, making data selection critical for training efficiency. Existing methods derive selection signals from a specific model or dataset, so whenever the target model or candidate pool changes, the criteria must be recomputed from scratch at substantial cost. To address this, we propose OFA, a data selection framework that trains a reusable selector once and applies it to any dataset or model without recomputation. OFA clusters multimodal instructions in a frozen CLIP space, derives pseudo labels from the cluster structure, and trains a lightweight selector for only a few epochs; samples on which this selector is least confident are selected as the most informative. Once trained, the frozen selector transfers directly across datasets and model scales. The selector is trained once on LLaVA-665K and applied both to LLaVA-665K itself and, without any retraining, to the unseen Vision-Flan-186K. Selecting only 15% of the data, OFA achieves 98.3% of full data performance across 10 downstream benchmarks; on the smaller Vision-Flan-186K, the transferred selector surpasses full data training by 10.6%, confirming that the learned signal generalizes to datasets never seen during selector training. The same selected subsets benefit VLMs at both Qwen2.5-VL-3B and LLaVA-v1.5-7B without per model recomputation, decoupling selection from the target model. These results demonstrate that a single, transferable selector provides an effective and reusable solution for efficient multimodal instruction tuning.

</details>


### [153] [SalsaAgent: A multimodal embodied language model for interactive dance generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.29219)
*Payam Jome Yazdian,Zoe Stanley,Angelica Lim*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出SalsaAgent，一个基于大语言模型的系统，能够生成与人类领舞者和音乐背景同步的全身萨尔萨舞蹈动作。通过将交互建模为非语言运动令牌传递，扩展LLM词汇表以处理离散运动令牌、成对关系令牌和音频，并采用两阶段令牌到扩散的生成管道。实验表明该方法在动作质量、音乐和搭档协调性方面显著优于基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 实现社交感知机器人及交互式虚拟代理，使其能够进行双向、非语言的实时反应、协调和同步，弥合人机交互中非语言沟通的鸿沟。

Method: 1) 将人机交互形式化为非语言运动令牌传递；2) 扩展LLM词汇表以处理离散运动令牌、成对关系令牌和音频；3) 引入全身运动和关系的新令牌；4) 利用自动推导的骨架动力学文本描述进行令牌接地，微调LLM；5) 设计两阶段令牌到扩散的生成管道。

Result: 在动作质量、音乐和搭档协调性、一致的双人空间行为方面显著优于基线方法，主观和客观评估均验证了有效性。

Conclusion: 基于LLM的非语言运动令牌传递方法可以有效生成与人类领舞者和音乐同步的社交舞蹈动作，为人机交互中的非语言协调提供了新的范式。

Abstract: Interaction between humanoids involves bidirectional and nonverbal reactivity, coordination and synchrony. Toward socially aware robots and interactive virtual agents, we present SalsaAgent, a language model that generates expressive, full-body salsa dance motions in reaction to a human leader and against a contextual music backdrop. We formulate interaction as nonverbal motion token passing, extending the vocabulary of a large language model (LLM) to process discrete motion tokens, pairwise relation tokens, and audio. Our contributions include new tokens for full-body and motion relations, LLM fine-tuning using automatically derived text descriptions of skeleton dynamics for token grounding, and a two-stage token-to-diffusion pipeline. Subjective and objective evaluations demonstrate the effectiveness of our approach in terms of motion quality, music and partner coordination, and consistent two-person spatial behavior, with significant improvements over baselines.

</details>


### [154] [Clustering Guided Domain-Specific Pretrained Foundation Model for Very High-Resolution Arctic Remote Sensing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.30467)
*Amal S. Perera,Chandi Witharana,Elias Manos,Michael Pimenta,Anna K. Liljedahl*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种面向北极地区的遥感基础模型（RSFM），通过多样性感知的区域级图像筛选策略从267 TB Vantor VHSR影像中精选约300万张图像块，并结合掩码自编码器（MAE）自监督预训练ViT-Large编码器。在下游四个北极数据集上，该模型相比ImageNet预训练基线在F1分数上提升5-8个百分点，相比通用地球观测基础模型Prithvi-EO-2.0提升至少15个百分点，证明区域级领域特定的预训练数据分布优化可产生更可迁移的北极域编码器。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有遥感基础模型多基于全球尺度或通用地球观测数据预训练，缺乏针对北极地区极高频空间分辨率（VHSR）影像的领域特定模型，导致在北极精细尺度制图任务中表征迁移能力不足。

Method: 1）使用光谱和采集元数据描述符，通过可扩展的亲和传播聚类从267 TB Vantor VHSR影像中精选约300万张图像块，减少视觉重复和低信息区域；2）基于领域适应的MAE重构目标预训练ViT-Large编码器，生成北极特定Transformer权重；3）将预训练编码器集成到位置感知检测与分割框架中，在四个手工标注北极数据集上评估。

Result: 在基础设施、IWP、RTS和TCNs四个数据集上，北极MAE预训练相比ImageNet初始化基线的前景平均F1分数分别达到0.87、0.72、0.93和0.87，提升约5-8个百分点；相比Prithvi-EO-2.0至少提升15个百分点。

Conclusion: 在固定架构和MAE预训练目标的前提下，优化区域尺度的预训练数据分布可以产生可复用的北极域编码器，领域特定的自监督预训练比通用地球观测基础模型在精细尺度北极制图任务中提供更可迁移的表征。

Abstract: This study introduces a novel Arctic-focused remote sensing foundation model (RSFM) by combining diversity-aware regional-scale image curation with masked autoencoder (MAE) self-supervised pretraining of a Vision Transformer (ViT) encoder for very-high-spatial-resolution (VHSR) satellite image analysis. Spectral and acquisition-metadata descriptors were used in a scalable affinity-propagation clustering workflow to select approximately 3 million chips from 267 TB of Vantor VHSR imagery This curation strategy was designed to reduce oversampling of visually repetitive or low-information areas while preserving broad scene diversity across the study domain. We pretrained a ViT-Large encoder on the curated corpus using a domain-adapted MAE reconstruction objective, producing Arctic-specific transformer weights for downstream feature mapping. The pretrained encoder was integrated into an existing location-aware detection and segmentation framework and evaluated across four hand-labeled Arctic datasets. Compared to ImageNet-initialized ViT-Large baseline, Arctic MAE pretraining produced consistent improvements in foreground mean F1 scores of 0.87, 0.72, 0.93, and 0.87, for infrastructure, IWP, RTS, and TCNs, with approximately 5-8 percentage increase. The proposed model also outperformed Prithvi-EO-2.0 in all downstream comparisons, with the smallest gain corresponding to at least a 15 percentage improvement mean F1, suggesting that domain-specific self-supervised pretraining on curated Arctic VHSR imagery provides more transferable representations for fine-scale Arctic mapping than a general-purpose Earth observation foundation model. These results demonstrate that optimizing the pretraining data distribution at regional scale, while keeping the architecture and MAE objective fixed, can produce a reusable Arctic-domain encoder for multiple VHSR remote sensing applications.

</details>


### [155] [A Trajectory-Driven Spatio-Temporal Refinement Solution for CVPR 2026 8th UG2+ Challenge Track 3: DOST](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.00522)
*Hongzhen Li,Miao Yu,Leilei Cao,Youwei Pan,Yingfang Zhu,Fengjie Zhu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种针对CVPR 2026 UG2+挑战赛Track 3（动态物体分割）的解决方案，基于SegAnyMo框架，通过数据驱动的域适应策略（引入DAVIS和DOST数据集并施加模拟大气扰动）和时空后处理模块（去除伪前景和噪声，保留真实小目标及标签一致性），最终获得比赛第二名。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在严重大气湍流导致的几何畸变下，现有的动态物体分割方法性能显著下降，亟需提升模型对复杂大气扰动的鲁棒性。

Method: 基于SegAnyMo基线框架，提出两项改进：1）数据驱动域适应策略：从DAVIS和DOST数据集中选取序列，施加模拟大气波动退化来增强模型对几何畸变的鲁棒性；2）时空后处理模块：去除边界连接伪前景和短时碎片噪声，同时保留真实小目标并维持各帧的原始标签一致性。

Result: 在UG2+挑战赛Track 3中取得第二名。

Conclusion: 数据增强加后处理的方式能有效提升大气湍流下的动态物体分割性能，且不丢失小目标与标签一致性。

Abstract: In this work, we present our solution for the 8th UG2+ Challenge (CVPR 2026) Track 3: Dynamic Object Segmentation in Turbulence (DOST). Our method is built upon the strong baseline framework Segment Any Motion (SegAnyMo), which provides powerful mask generation and motion tracking capabilities. To further boost the segmentation performance under severe atmospheric distortions, we propose two key improvements. First, we employ a data-centric domain adaptation strategy. We significantly expand our training data by incorporating selected sequences from the DAVIS dataset alongside a subset of the DOST dataset, and apply simulated atmospheric fluctuation degradations to enhance the model's robustness against complex geometric distortions. Second, we introduce a spatio-temporal post-processing module. This refinement step effectively removes persistent boundary-connected false foregrounds and short-lived fragmented noise, while strictly preserving genuine small targets and maintaining original individual labels across frames. With these combined strategies, our proposed method ranks the 2st place in the challenge.

</details>


### [156] [Pause and Think: A Dataset and Benchmark for Video-Grounded Assistive Action Suggestion](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.00616)
*Shivam Singh,Saptarshi Majumder,Pratik Prabhanjan Brahma,Zicheng Liu,Emad Barsoum*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出pause-and-think-T推理训练数据集，用于提升视觉语言模型在视频中的接地推理、时间一致性和上下文感知规划能力。基于该数据集微调的4B参数模型在pause-and-think-B基准上达到58.0%准确率，以59倍更少参数接近Qwen3-VL-235B（58.9%），并在场景理解上匹配GPT-5.2、超越GPT-4o，同时在EgoThink和TempCompass等分布外任务上表现优异。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有视觉语言模型在视频理解中缺乏接地推理、时间一致性和上下文感知规划能力，难以提供类似人类的、基于场景的可操作指导。

Method: 构建pause-and-think-T推理中心训练数据集，鼓励模型在生成答案前进行结构化推理；基于该数据集微调4B参数紧凑模型。

Result: 4B模型在pause-and-think-B基准上达58.0%准确率，以59倍更少参数接近Qwen3-VL-235B（58.9%）；场景理解匹配GPT-5.2、超越GPT-4o；在EgoThink和TempCompass上展示强分布外泛化能力，在可操作性、辅助、属性识别、情景推理和时间顺序上有显著提升。

Conclusion: 定向推理监督使紧凑模型能够提供可操作的、基于视觉的指导，并在未见数据上泛化，无需大规模模型扩展即可达到接近超大模型的效果。

Abstract: Recent Vision-Language Models (VLMs) struggle with grounded reasoning, temporal consistency, and context aware planning in videos. We introduce pause-and-think-T, a reasoning-centric training dataset that encourages models to pause, reason over visual evidence, and produce concise, actionable responses. The dataset promotes structured reasoning prior to answer generation, guiding models toward human-like, scene-grounded assistance. We fine-tune a compact 4B-parameter model and evaluate it on our pause-and-think-B benchmark targeting contextual understanding and goal planning tasks. The model achieves 58.0% accuracy at 59x fewer parameters than Qwen3-VL-235B (58.9%), matching GPT-5.2 on scene understanding and surpassing GPT-4o. Beyond our benchmark, it also shows strong out-of-distribution performance on EgoThink and TempCompass, with substantial gains in affordance, assistance, attribution recognition, situated reasoning, and temporal order, without benchmark-specific training. Our results indicate that targeted reasoning supervision enables compact models to deliver actionable, visually grounded guidance while generalizing beyond training data, without requiring large-scale model expansion.

</details>


### [157] [R^3: Composed Video Retrieval via Reasoning-Guided Recalling and Re-ranking](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.01113)
*Zixu Li,Yupeng Hu,Zhiheng Fu,Zhiwei Chen,Weili Guan,Liqiang Nie*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出R³方法，通过将源视频+编辑指令转化为推理引导的检索程序，结合推理增强查询、一致性门控残差融合和重排器验证，实现零样本组合视频检索。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 组合视频检索（CoVR-R）中，查询由源视频和文本编辑指令共同定义，现有嵌入模型难以表达目标视频中的状态变化、动作替换等细节，而穷举重排在计算上不可行。

Method: R³管道包含三个步骤：(1) 生成描述目标视频的推理轨迹；(2) 将推理轨迹与源视频编码为推理增强查询，通过一致性门控残差规则与基础组合查询融合；(3) 使用源-候选直接比较的重排器验证召回候选。

Result: 实验证明了该方法在组合视频检索挑战中的有效性。

Conclusion: 将编辑查询转化为推理引导的检索程序，结合召回和重排，能有效提升零样本组合视频检索性能。

Abstract: The CoVR-R challenge evaluates composed video retrieval, where a system must retrieve a target video from a large gallery given a reference video and a textual edit instruction. This setting is not a standard video-text retrieval problem: the query is defined by both the visual evidence in the source video and the transformation implied by the edit. A strong embedding model can provide scalable candidate recall, but it may under-express target-side consequences such as state changes, action replacement, object preservation, or temporal consistency. A pairwise multimodal reranker can verify such details more directly, but exhaustive reranking over the full gallery is computationally infeasible. We present $\mathbb{R}^3$, a zero-shot composed video retrieval pipeline built around Reasoning-guided Recalling and Reranking. The core idea is to turn the source-edit query into a reasoning-grounded retrieval program rather than treating the edit text as a short caption. First, the model generates a reasoning trace that describes the expected target video after applying the edit. Then the trace is encoded together with the source video as a reasoning-augmented query, and its retrieval score is fused with the base composed query through an agreement-gated residual rule. At last, a re-ranker verifies the recalled candidates with direct source-candidate comparison. Experiments have demonstrated the effectiveness of our method in addressing this challenge. Codes are available on https://github.com/Lee-zixu/R-3.

</details>


### [158] [Hierarchically Decoupled Mixture-of-Experts for Robust Traffic Sign Recognition in Complex Driving Scenarios](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.01822)
*Mingxiao Wang,Xiaozhen Qu,Bolin Gao,Tong Wang,Lei He*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出CBDES MoE TSR框架，采用异构混合专家（MoE）架构替代传统的全局共享参数范式，通过轻量级门控网络实现图像级动态路由，在复合交通标志数据集上以76.8% mAP50-95超越基线（74.5%），同时降低约39.4%的计算开销。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有交通标志检测器依赖静态推理和全局共享参数，难以同时应对清晰近处样本与远处小目标、恶劣天气等复杂场景，缺乏场景自适应能力。

Method: 提出分层解耦的异构MoE框架，包含异构YOLO专家池和轻量级门控网络，根据输入图像的语义特征动态选择最适合的专家模型，实现从固定参数拟合到按需动态表征的转变。

Result: 在复合交通标志数据集上，mAP50-95达76.8%，较基线（74.5%）提升2.3%，同时计算开销降低约39.4%。

Conclusion: 验证了异构MoE动态路由机制在交通标志识别任务中的有效性，在检测精度与效率之间取得了显著平衡。

Abstract: Traffic sign detection is a fundamental component of environmental perception in autonomous driving and intelligent transportation systems. However, most existing detectors rely on static inference with globally shared parameters, limiting their ability to adapt to diverse and unstructured traffic scenarios. As a result, a single static model often struggles to simultaneously handle both clear near-range samples and challenging conditions such as distant small targets or adverse weather environments. To address this limitation, we propose CBDES MoE TSR, a hierarchically decoupled heterogeneous mixture-of-experts(MoE) framework for traffic sign recognition. The proposed framework departs from the conventional globally shared parameter paradigm by introducing a heterogeneous You Only Look Once (YOLO) expert pool together with a lightweight gating network, enabling an image-level dynamic routing mechanism. Based on the semantic characteristics of the input image, the gating module selectively activates the most suitable expert model from the expert pool, enabling a shift from fixed parameter fitting to on-demand dynamic representation. This design enhances feature extraction capability for specific scenarios while maintaining controlled inference overhead. Experimental results demonstrate that the proposed method achieves a remarkable balance between detection accuracy and efficiency on the composite traffic sign dataset. Specifically, our method attains an mAP50-95 of 76.8%, yielding a 2.3% improvement over the baseline method (74.5%) while simultaneously reducing computational overhead by approximately 39.4%. These findings robustly validate the effectiveness of the proposed approach.

</details>


### [159] [Unified Driving Tokens: Representation- and Geometry-Guided Discrete Tokenizer for Driving World Models and Planning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.01935)
*Ziyang Yao,Zeyu Zhu,YunCheng Jiang,Zibin Guo,Huijing Zhao*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种结合表示引导与几何增强的离散视觉分词器，通过联合监督（特征解码、RGB重建、深度与相对位姿约束）学习紧致的离散token，在NAVSIM上展现了更优的重建质量、表征一致性和规划性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有从图像生成继承来的分词器主要优化像素重建，导致容易生成的token与对驾驶决策有用的token之间存在差距，缺乏对驾驶任务关键信息的对齐。

Method: 1) 特征解码：对齐离散瓶颈与冻结的DINO特征空间；2) RGB重建：结合感知损失和对抗损失保持外观；3) 几何增强：引入相邻帧深度和相对位姿监督；4) 多码本量化稳定联合训练目标。

Result: 在NAVSIM上，该方法提升了重建保真度和表示一致性；在固定解码器下取得有竞争力的规划性能；在相同设置下生成质量更优。

Conclusion: 通过联合视觉特征与几何线索的监督，离散视觉token能更好地服务于自动驾驶中的世界建模和规划任务。

Abstract: Discrete visual tokens should provide a compact representation for both token-based world modeling and planning in autonomous driving. However, most tokenizers are inherited from image generation and are optimized mainly for pixel reconstruction, which may leave a gap between what is easy to generate and what is useful to decode for driving decisions. We present a representation-guided and geometry-enhanced tokenizer that learns discrete tokens under joint supervision. The tokenizer aligns its discrete bottleneck with a frozen DINO feature space through feature decoding, while preserving appearance via RGB reconstruction with perceptual and adversarial losses. To inject geometric state-related cues, we add adjacent-frame depth and relative-pose supervision during training and stabilize joint objectives with multi-codebook quantization. We evaluate the same learned tokens with a lightweight planning readout and a GPT-style next-token world model. Experiments on NAVSIM show improved reconstruction fidelity and representation consistency, competitive planning performance under a fixed decoder, and better generative quality under matched settings.

</details>


### [160] [Pixel Cube: Diffusion-based Portrait Video Relighting Through Realistic Lighting Reproduction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.02919)
*Yufan Zhang,Yu Ji,Ayo Ajiboye,Rundi Wu,Yu Guo,Changxi Zheng,Jinwei Ye*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于扩散模型的动态人物视频重光照方法，利用混合训练数据集（真实拍摄+渲染数据）和HDR环境图控制，实现了高真实感、时间一致性且身份保持的视频重光照，在照片真实感、光照和谐性和时间一致性上达到SOTA性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有动态人物视频重光照方法在处理复杂光照变化时往往缺乏真实感和时间一致性，难以同时保留人物的精细面部特征和身份信息。为此，作者提出构建LED光照系统采集真实重光照数据，并结合预训练视频扩散模型的图像先验，以提升重光照的真实感和时序稳定性。

Method: 1）构建LED光照系统实现高速度视频重光照数据采集；2）构建包含真实拍摄和渲染数据的混合训练数据集；3）利用预训练视频扩散模型作为骨干，以每帧HDR环境图作为光照控制信号；4）引入合成背景图像以控制相机曝光与色调，从而实现重光照场景的和谐融合。

Result: 模型在未见过的数据（新人物、新动作、新光照）上具有良好的泛化能力，能够忠实保留表情、肤色、皱纹和胡须等精细面部特征。在真实世界视频与各种环境图的重光照实验中，该方法在照片真实感、光照和谐性及时间一致性上均达到当前最优水平。

Conclusion: 本文证明混合数据训练结合预训练视频扩散模型与HDR环境图控制，能够有效解决动态人物视频重光照中的真实感、身份保持和时间一致性难题，并展示了在人物摄影中的实际应用价值。

Abstract: We present a diffusion-based method for relighting dynamic portrait videos with photorealism and temporal consistency. Our method is fueled by a hybrid training dataset that consists of real-captured and rendered dynamic portrait videos with diverse subject appearances, facial motions, head poses, and known lighting conditions. Specifically, we construct an LED-based lighting system for realistic lighting emulation and high-speed video relighting data acquisition.
