By leveraging the image priors embedded in pre-trained video diffusion models, and using per-frame high dynamic range (HDR) environment map as lighting control, we train a high-performance generative model for realistic and identity-preserving dynamic portrait video relighting. In addition to the environment map control, our model uses a synthesized background image to enable control on the camera's exposure level and color tone. Our model can produce temporally consistent relit portrait video that looks realistic and harmonious under a provided new environment and faithfully preserve the subject's expression and fine facial features, including skin tone, wrinkles, and facial hair. Our model generalizes well to unseen data, in terms of the subject appearance, motion, and lighting condition. We perform extensive experiments on relighting in-the-wild videos with various environment maps and demonstrate practical applications on portrait photography. Results show that our method achieves state-of-the-art performance in photorealism, lighting harmony, and temporal consistency.

</details>


### [161] [Zero-Shot 3D Question Answering via Hierarchical View-to-Token Transportation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.03100)
*Dongsheng Wang,Dawei Su,Hui Huang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出KeyVT框架，通过分层选择视角和关键token，在有限输入预算下保留更多任务相关3D细节，实现零样本3D场景理解的性能提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有零样本3D场景理解方法依赖多视角2D图像输入，但受限于输入预算，如何在有限视角和token数量下保留尽可能多任务相关的3D细节是关键挑战。

Method: 提出KeyVT分层方法：(1) 视角级选择：结合像素特征与相机参数，基于语义内容和几何位置评估视角重要性，选择空间一致且任务相关的视角；(2) Token级选择：在最优传输框架下，将视角token和关键token视为嵌入空间中的两个离散分布，通过最小化OT距离选取代表性关键token覆盖所有视角特征。

Result: 在三个广泛使用的基准上显著优于现有免调优方法，性能与基于训练的方法相当。

Conclusion: KeyVT通过层级化的视角和token选择策略，有效地在有限输入预算下保留任务相关3D信息，为零样本3D场景理解提供了一种高效的免训练解决方案。

Abstract: Recently, zero-shot 3D scene understanding via 2D Vision-Language Models (VLMs) has gained increasing research interest due to their promising spatial reasoning capabilities. Typically, multiple 2D views are sampled from a 3D point cloud and fed into pre-trained VLMs to answer a given question. This paradigm highlights the critical role of input context quality and raises the challenge of retaining as many task-relevant 3D details as possible under a limited input budget. We propose \texttt{KeyVT}, a hierarchical approach for input context collection at both the view and token levels. Specifically, we combine pixel features with camera parameters and assess view importance based on both semantic content and geometric position, resulting in spatially consistent and task-relevant views. Furthermore, we address redundancy among patches across selected views by identifying representative tokens under the optimal transport (OT) framework, where view tokens and key tokens are formulated as two discrete distributions in the embedding space. These key tokens are expected to cover all view features by minimizing the OT distance. We evaluate our framework on three widely used benchmarks, demonstrating significant improvements over existing tuning-free methods and performance comparable to training-based approaches.

</details>


### [162] [Beyond False Stability: High-Noise Drift Gating for Test-Time Adversarial Defenses in Vision-Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.03730)
*Hashmat Shadab Malik,Muzammal Naseer,Salman Khan*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文发现CLIP视觉表征在对抗样本上存在一个噪声强度转变：弱噪声下对抗样本表现异常稳定（伪稳定），强噪声下则变得比干净样本更不稳定。基于此提出无需训练的漂移门控机制，仅在检测到对抗不稳定性时触发防御，显著改善了干净-鲁棒权衡，在13个数据集上均有一致提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于随机扰动的测试时防御方法虽能提升鲁棒性，但往往牺牲干净准确率，导致不利的干净-鲁棒权衡。作者希望在不大幅降低干净性能的前提下提升对抗鲁棒性。

Method: 1) 分析了CLIP表征空间中不同噪声强度下对抗样本与干净样本的稳定性差异，发现弱噪声下对抗样本伪稳定、强噪声下对抗样本更不稳定的转变现象；2) 提出训练免费的漂移门控机制（drift-gated mechanism），以高噪声下的特征漂移作为轻量级门控信号，仅在检测到类似对抗的不稳定性时才触发现有测试时防御方法。

Result: 在13个数据集上一致改善干净-鲁棒权衡。8个细粒度数据集上，干净+对抗平均准确率：反攻击防御从65.7%提升至71.4%，噪声锚定从68.4%提升至73.2%；ImageNet及4个移位变体上，分别从56.1%提升至66.2%和从62.1%提升至67.6%。

Conclusion: CLIP的非鲁棒模型中对抗样本存在脆弱的局部盆地几何结构，导致其在高噪声下比干净样本更不稳定；利用这一信号设计门控策略能有效提升测试时防御的干净-鲁棒权衡。

Abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) such as CLIP show strong zero-shot generalization but remain highly vulnerable to adversarial attacks. Adversarial training improves robustness but is computationally expensive, motivating test-time defenses. Recent approaches exploit how CLIP's visual representations respond to stochastic perturbations: aggregating predictions across noisy views, constructing Gaussian noise-averaged anchors and interpolating features toward them, or applying counter-perturbations. These strategies improve robustness but often degrade clean accuracy, yielding an unfavorable clean-robust trade-off. We revisit stochastic test-time defenses and identify an underexplored noise-regime transition in CLIP's representation space. Prior work explored perturbations mainly in the weak-noise regime, where adversarial examples can appear unusually stable (false stability). Our analysis shows this reverses as perturbation strength grows: beyond the weak-noise regime, adversarial representations become markedly more unstable than clean ones, giving a clearer separation signal. The transition is consistent across uniform and Gaussian noise, photometric and geometric transforms, datasets, and diverse attacks. It largely disappears in adversarially trained models, suggesting it is tied to the fragile local-basin geometry of adversarial representations in non-robust CLIP. We propose a training-free, plug-in drift-gated mechanism that uses high-noise feature drift as a lightweight gating signal to trigger existing test-time defenses only when adversarial-like instability is detected. Across 13 datasets it consistently improves the clean-robust trade-off. On eight fine-grained datasets, mean clean+adversarial accuracy rises from 65.7% to 71.4% for counterattack defenses and 68.4% to 73.2% for noise-anchoring; on ImageNet and four shifted variants, from 56.1% to 66.2% and 62.1% to 67.6%.

</details>


### [163] [Dream.exe: Can Video Generation Models Dream Executable Robot Manipulation?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.04811)
*Rui Zhao,Kaiming Yang,Jifeng Zhu,Siyang Chen,Ziqi Wang,Weijia Wu,Kevin Qinghong Lin,Heng Wang,Mike Zheng Shou*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: Dream.exe是一个评估视频生成模型物理世界理解能力的框架，通过将生成视频转换为机器人可执行轨迹并在物理模拟器中执行，来衡量模型对物理规律的掌握程度。实验表明，部分模型已编码了有意义的物理知识，但视觉质量与可执行性之间缺乏相关性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有视频生成模型在视觉质量上表现出色，但其生成内容是否真正反映物理世界的规律尚不清楚。作者希望通过机器人操作任务作为具体、可量化的评估窗口，检验模型是否内化了物理规律。

Method: 提出Dream.exe评估框架，采用视频到执行的流水线：给定场景图像和任务描述，生成操作视频，将生成的运动转换为机器人轨迹，并在物理模拟器中执行，从而获得纯视觉指标无法提供的接地信号。涵盖8个模型（闭源、开源、机器人专用），101个手工整理的操作任务，三种物理复杂度级别。

Result: 多个模型取得了可测量的执行成功率，表明从互联网规模数据学习到的生成先验已编码了有意义的物理知识。然而，视觉质量与可执行性之间相关性很弱，标准视觉评估无法捕捉这一维度。

Conclusion: Dream.exe提供了一种将视频生成与具身智能结合的新型评估范式，揭示了现有视觉评估指标的局限性，为未来视频生成模型的物理理解能力评估提供了新方向。

Abstract: Video generation models have made impressive strides in synthesizing visually compelling content, yet their outputs remain confined to the virtual domain. A natural question follows: how well do these models reflect the physical world when their generated videos leave the screen and enter reality? We propose robotic manipulation as a concrete, measurable window onto this question: if a model has truly internalized physical laws, the motion it depicts should translate into executable robot behavior. We introduce Dream$.$exe, an evaluation framework that operationalizes this criterion through a video-to-execution pipeline. Given a scene image and a task description, Dream$.$exe synthesizes a manipulation video, converts the generated motion into robot trajectories, and executes them in a physics simulator, yielding a grounding signal that purely visual metrics cannot offer. Using this pipeline, we evaluate 8 models spanning frontier closed-source generators, open-source generators, and robot-specific models. Our benchmark covers 101 manually curated manipulation tasks at three levels of physical complexity, measured across visual quality, trajectory fidelity, and execution success. Encouragingly, several models achieve measurable execution success, suggesting that generative priors learned from internet-scale data already encode meaningful physical knowledge. Yet visual quality proves a poor predictor of executability, exposing a dimension of model capability that standard visual evaluations do not capture. Dream$.$exe will be open-sourced at https://github.com/showlab/Dream.exe.

</details>


<div id='cs.CY'></div>

# cs.CY [[Back]](#toc)

### [164] [Drishti AI-Event Guardian: An Intelligent Real-Time Crowd Monitoring and Emergency Response System for Mass Gathering Events](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.05185)
*Ritabrata Roy Choudhury,Arkajyoti Karmakar,Rudra Pratap Mitra*

Main category: cs.CY

TL;DR: 本文提出Drishti AI-Event Guardian框架，融合深度学习、多模态数据（CCTV+无人机）和Vertex AI基础设施，实现实时人群密度估计（YOLOv8）、异常检测、预测性人流建模及四类智能模块（人脸识别、医疗紧急响应、对话AI聊天机器人、警卫动态重分配）。在Kumbh Mela和RCB Victory Parade场景中验证，密度估计MAE 3.2人/m²，异常检测F1 0.91，人脸识别精确率0.93，警报延迟中位数111ms，预测MAPE 8.3%，从被动监控转向主动人群智能管理。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大型集会因监控不足和应急协调不力导致安全事故频发，传统监控系统缺乏智能分析，威胁识别延迟、资源部署低效、对弱势群体支持薄弱。

Method: 多模态数据（CCTV+无人机）经Vertex AI处理，核心方法包括YOLOv8实时人群密度估计、时空异常检测、梯度提升回归预测人流；集成四模块：人脸识别寻人、医疗紧急自动调度、对话AI聊天机器人、基于密度动态重分配警卫引擎。

Result: 人群密度估计MAE 3.2人/m²，异常检测F1 0.91，人脸识别精确率0.93，警报延迟中位数111ms；5分钟预测MAPE 8.3%；聊天机器人解决89%事件报告；警卫重分配减少34%响应延迟。

Conclusion: 从被动监控转向主动人群智能，为从小型集会到超大型活动提供可扩展的基础框架。

Abstract: Mass gathering events are associated with critical safety incidents caused by insufficient crowd monitoring and inadequate emergency response coordination. Traditional surveillance systems lack intelligent analytics, resulting in delayed threat identification, poor resource deployment, and weak support for vulnerable individuals during dense public assemblies. This paper presents Drishti AI-Event Guardian, an intelligent crowd management framework using deep learning for public safety enhancement. The architecture combines multimodal data from CCTV networks and UAV platforms, processed by models on Google Vertex AI infrastructure. Core methods include real-time crowd density estimation using YOLOv8, spatiotemporal anomaly detection, and predictive crowd-flow modeling through gradient-boosted regression. Drishti also integrates four modules: (i) facial recognition for missing person identification with crowd-wide notification; (ii) medical emergency reporting with automated dispatch; (iii) a conversational AI chatbot for reports and complaints; and (iv) an intelligent guard reallocation engine that dynamically reassigns personnel in response to crowd density changes. The system is evaluated on two scenarios: the Kumbh Mela gathering and the RCB Victory Parade event, achieving crowd density estimation MAE of 3.2 persons/m2, anomaly detection F1-score of 0.91, facial recognition precision of 0.93, and median alert latency of 111 ms. Predictive congestion modeling provides five-minute forecasts with MAPE of 8.3%, enabling preemptive intervention. The chatbot resolved 89% of incident filings without human operators, while guard reallocation reduced responder deployment latency by 34% versus manual reassignment. Results demonstrate a shift from passive surveillance toward active crowd intelligence and scalable foundation for events from local gatherings to mega festivals.

</details>


### [165] [Geographic Bias and Diversity in AI Evaluation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.05187)
*Zilong Liu,Krzysztof Janowicz,Gengchen Mai,Song Gao,Rui Zhu*

Main category: cs.CY

TL;DR: 本文通过文献综述，系统研究了（生成式）人工智能中地理偏见的类型、表现及评估方法，涵盖从预生成式AI到生成式AI时期的研究，并展示了如何通过评估地理多样性来应对默认倾向偏见。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 尽管AI偏见问题受到广泛关注，但很少有研究深入探讨偏见的地理维度，也缺乏衡量（生成式）AI无偏性的可量化基准。

Method: 采用文献综述方法，系统梳理了从预生成式AI到生成式AI时期的相关研究，识别地理偏见类型，并展示近期研究如何通过评估不同认知层次、参数设置和输出模态下的地理多样性来应对偏见。

Result: 识别出三类地理偏见：训练数据中的表征偏差、语言模型事实回忆的区域差异、生成式AI过度偏好典型地点（默认倾向）的偏见。近期研究通过评估地理多样性来量化并缓解默认倾向偏见。

Conclusion: 地理偏见是AI偏见研究中的重要维度，尤其在生成式AI中表现为对典型地点的过度偏好；通过评估输出地理多样性可建立可量化的无偏性基准。

Abstract: Among the many challenges hindering the responsible development and deployment of AI, arguably none has faced more intense scrutiny than bias in its various forms. This underscores the widespread concerns across AI researchers that model outputs, e.g., from generative AI, may encode structural distributional imbalances (stemming from training data or model design) that may amplify social inequality or introduce systemic distortions across application domains ranging from biodiversity to disaster mitigation. Yet, relatively little work has investigated the geographical nature of bias or developed measurable benchmarks for what it means for (generative) AI to be unbiased. In this chapter, we investigate this issue through a literature review. As foundation models are reshaping the landscape of bias research, we examine work spanning both the pre-generative AI and generative AI periods. First, we identify a range of geographic biases. These biases span from representation bias in the training data and regional disparities in the factual recall of language models to the tendency of generative AI to over-proportionally favor prototypical places (called defaults). Then, we showcase how recent studies address the latter bias by evaluating geographic diversity in the outputs of generative AI across various cognitive levels, parameter settings, and output modalities.

</details>


### [166] [Assessing the Geographic Diversity of AI's Platial Representations in Image Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.05188)
*Zilong Liu,Krzysztof Janowicz,Mina Karimi*

Main category: cs.CY

TL;DR: 本文从GIScience视角出发，将(Gen)AI多样性视为不确定性和认知偏差的函数，针对多模态时代图像生成中的地理多样性评估空白，借鉴生态学物种多样性度量，对GPT和DALL-E模型进行案例研究，发现旧模型在图像质量较低时反而表现出更高的地理多样性，提示修订比图像生成带来更多多样性，且模型存在明显的同质化倾向，可能导致对地方产生刻板印象。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着AI生态系统迅速向多模态发展，现有工作主要聚焦于文本聊天机器人输出的地理多样性评估，缺乏对图像生成模态下地理多样性的系统研究。本文旨在填补这一研究空白。

Method: 选取GPT和DALL-E模型作为前沿代表，划分提示修订和图像生成两个阶段；借鉴生态学中物种多样性度量方法，引入相似性加权机制来度量图像生成中的地理多样性；通过案例研究进行实证分析。

Result: 发现反直觉结果：旧模型虽生成图像质量较低，但表现出更高的地理多样性；提示修订比图像生成带来更大的地理多样性；所选模型存在明显同质化，持续描绘相同原型性地理特征或相似特征。

Conclusion: 图像生成中的地理多样性缺乏问题令人担忧，可能导致对地方的刻板印象表征，需要引起重视。

Abstract: (Gen)AI diversity is not merely an ethical issue. From the perspective of geographic information science (GIScience), it could be interpreted as a function of uncertainty and as a form of cognitive bias, embedded in AI outputs. Recent work has sought to develop information-theoretic diversity measures and apply them to evaluate AI-chatbot outputs in a geographic context. As the AI ecosystem to which we are exposed on a daily basis becomes rapidly multimodal, we believe it is important to examine geographic diversity across various modalities. Focusing on images, this paper aims to fill this research gap. First, we select the GPT and DALL-E models as state-of-the-art examples and point out how assessing their geographic diversity involves various stages, including prompt revision and image generation. Then, taking inspiration from species diversity measures in ecological research, we incorporate similarity weighting into the measurement of geographic diversity. Next, we demonstrate how to evaluate geographic diversity in image generation through a case study. Our analysis reveals several counterintuitive findings. For instance, older models can exhibit greater geographic diversity despite producing lower-quality images, and prompt revision yields greater geographic diversity than image generation. At the same time, we observe explicit model homogeneity underlying the lack of geographic diversity, as the selected models consistently depict the same prototypical geo-specific feature or similar features. This is concerning, as it risks producing stereotypical representations of places.

</details>


### [167] [Where's the Structure? A Systematic Literature Review of Empirical Research on Human-AI Collaboration and Hybrid Intelligence for Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.05222)
*Luis P. Prieto,Juan I. Asensio-Pérez,María Jesús Rodríguez-Triana,Mohamed Saban,Yannis Dimitriadis*

Main category: cs.CY

TL;DR: 本文通过系统文献综述（N=62篇实证研究），分析了人机协作与混合智能在学习支持中的协作过程、结构、应用背景、设计知识及研究空白，指出非结构化的交互同样无法产生有效学习体验。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 人工智能已被广泛应用于教育领域支持学习，其中“人机协作”（或称“混合智能”）是一种重要的交互范式。然而，类似于人类之间的计算机支持协作学习（CSCL），非结构化的交互并不能保证有效的学习体验，因此需要通过系统综述来理解现有的协作过程、结构及设计知识。

Method: 采用系统文献综述方法，对62篇关于人机协作与混合智能用于学习支持的实证研究进行梳理，分析其协作过程、协作结构、应用背景，并提取新兴的设计知识与研究空白。

Result: 研究表征了人机协作过程中的协作过程类型、结构模式及应用场景，并总结了当前的设计知识和尚未解决的研究空白。

Conclusion: 研究者和技术设计者可以以此综述为起点，构建结构更有效的AI增强协作技术，以支持教育实践和未来研究。

Abstract: Artificial intelligence (AI) has been applied across educational contexts to support learning. One approach to such support is "human-AI collaboration" (also termed "hybrid intelligence"), where human(s) and AI components interact to promote human learning. However, as in human-to-human computer-supported collaborative learning (CSCL), unstructured interaction does not necessarily produce an effective learning experience. This paper reports a systematic literature review of empirical studies (N=62) on human-AI collaboration and hybrid intelligence for learning support. The review characterizes collaboration processes, their structures, and contexts of application. It also extracts emerging design knowledge and research gaps. Researchers and technology designers can use these findings as a starting point for structuring more effective AI-enhanced technologies for collaboration, in educational practice and future research.

</details>


### [168] [Online Safety Regulation Increases Privacy Risk: Evidence from the UK Online Safety Act](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.05273)
*Dhyey Mehta,Eldar Jalilzade,Maksim Kalameyets,Rebecca Owens,Marc Juarez,Stergios Aidinlis,Lei Shi,Tuğrulcan Elmas*

Main category: cs.CY

TL;DR: 本文通过分析Reddit讨论和Google搜索趋势，发现英国《在线安全法案》（OSA）的三个关键里程碑（2025年3月非法内容执法、2025年7月成人内容年龄验证）导致VPN相关讨论显著增加（最高+415%），用户主要出于隐私和不信任年龄验证中介的动机，而非单纯访问被屏蔽内容。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 研究在线安全法规（如英国OSA）在实际执行过程中如何改变用户行为，特别是是否会产生隐私和安全方面的副作用，为政策制定者提供实证依据。

Method: 分析Reddit上VPN和英国政治社区的话语，对69个VPN服务进行隐私政策风险分析，并结合Google搜索趋势数据，观察OSA三个执行阶段前后的用户行为变化。

Result: OSA每阶段执行后VPN相关讨论显著增加：UK用户中+100%、+217%、+415%；英国政治社区中+213%、+545%、+464%；年龄验证截止时Google搜索兴趣+89%。用户动机主要为隐私和信任担忧，而非简单访问需求；低、中、高风险VPN需求均增长但比例分布稳定。

Conclusion: 在线安全法规即使未导致用户向高风险VPN服务商转移，也可能产生隐私方面的次要成本，监管机构需权衡安全目标与用户行为变化带来的隐私风险。

Abstract: Governments worldwide are increasingly regulating digital platforms to reduce online harms, particularly those affecting children. However, access restrictions can alter user behaviour and introduce new privacy and security risks. The UK Online Safety Act (OSA), passed in October 2023, illustrates this trend: it extends age-assurance and safety requirements to social media, search, and pornography services, and rolled out in phases. Ofcom's illegal content enforcement duties came into force in March 2025, and mandatory age verification for adult content took effect in July 2025. This phased rollout enables real-time observation of behavioural responses to regulation. To address this, we analyse Reddit discourse across VPN and UK Politics communities and conduct a privacy-policy risk analysis of 69 unique VPN services.
  We find that each of these three milestones produced significant stepwise increases in VPN-related discussion on Reddit: among UK-based users, posts and comments explicitly about VPN use in a regulatory or privacy context rose by +100%, +217%, and +415% respectively. UK Politics communities showed even larger effects, with OSA-related political discourse rising by +213%, +545%, and +464%, respectively, among UK-based users. UK VPN search interest on Google rose by +89% at the age-verification deadline. Users primarily framed this response around privacy, surveillance, and distrust of age-verification intermediaries rather than simple access-seeking. Demand increased across low, medium, and high-risk VPNs, but the proportional distribution remained broadly stable. These findings suggest that online safety regulation can create secondary privacy costs even when it does not disproportionately shift attention toward higher-risk providers.

</details>


### [169] [Sustainability by Design in Decentralized Autonomous Organizations: An Empirical Review of Governance, Innovation, and Institutional Design](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.05667)
*Yutian Wang,Luyao Zhang*

Main category: cs.CY

TL;DR: 本研究通过LLM驱动的比较分析流程，对比了由DAO治理的ERC-8004标准与由企业联盟治理的Google A2A标准，探讨去中心化组织如何通过区块链透明性、开放参与和代币驱动治理来嵌入可持续性，为未来组织形式中的创新、技术治理与可持续性对齐提供证据支持。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有创新经济学理论基于层级企业及封闭组织边界假设，无法解释去中心化数字原生组织中的创新过程。DAO作为一种区块链驱动的创新生态系统，将可持续性直接嵌入组织设计，但其治理机制与传统企业联盟的差异尚缺乏系统性比较研究。

Method: 采用LLM驱动的比较分析流程，对ERC-8004（DAO治理）和Google A2A（企业联盟治理）两个代理互操作性标准进行大规模治理话语分析。整合自动标注、神经主题建模和多层网络分析，研究社会技术权力结构。

Result: 比较了两个标准在治理模式上的差异：ERC-8004由DAO通过区块链透明性和代币驱动治理运作，Google A2A由企业联盟管理。通过多层网络分析揭示了两种标准背后的社会技术权力结构差异。

Conclusion: 研究为学者、政策制定者和设计者提供了基于证据的见解，有助于在未来组织形式中实现创新、技术治理与可持续性的对齐。

Abstract: Recent innovation theories on economics remain largely grounded in assumptions of hierarchical firms and closed organizational boundaries, offering limited insight into how innovation unfolds within decentralized, digitally native organizations. Decentralized Autonomous Organizations (DAOs) represent an emerging form of innovation ecosystem characterized by blockchain-based transparency, open participation, and token-driven governance, in which sustainability can be embedded directly into organizational design. This study compares two standards, ERC-8004 and Google A2A, who address the same agent interoperability question, while the former is governed by DAO and the latter by corporation consortium. They are examined through an LLM-powered comparative pipeline for large-scale governance discourse analysis, integrating automated annotation, neural topic modeling, and multi-layer network analysis to study socio-technical power structures. The study provides evidence-based insights for scholars, policymakers, and designers seeking to align innovation, technological governance, and sustainability in future organizational forms.

</details>


### [170] [Three Years of r/ChatGPT: Societal Impact Evaluations from Social Media Data](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.05750)
*Jessica Dai,Sean Garcia,Emma Pierson,Benjamin Recht,Nika Haghtalab*

Main category: cs.CY

TL;DR: 本文提出PuLSE框架，利用社交媒体（r/ChatGPT子版块）实时监测AI产品社会影响。研究发现ChatGPT已从新奇技术常态化，且GPT-4o发布后关于情感依赖和心理健康支持的帖子显著增加，PuLSE比OpenAI早数月检测到这一趋势。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: ChatGPT等AI产品已广泛普及，但其公众采纳过程和社会影响尚不明确，缺乏实时监测框架。

Method: 提出PuLSE（Public and Longitudinal Signals for Evaluation）框架，基于社交媒体数据进行纵向分析。对r/ChatGPT子版块进行首次纵向研究，追踪帖子主题变化趋势。

Result: ChatGPT正从新奇技术常态化；GPT-4o发布后，心理健康支持和情感依恋相关帖子频率显著上升；PuLSE在2024年10月即检测到情感参与度上升，比OpenAI公开承认早数月。

Conclusion: 社交媒体可作为监测AI产品社会影响的实时数据源，PuLSE框架能提前发现潜在社会问题（如用户情感依赖），为负责任的AI部署提供预警。

Abstract: ChatGPT was launched on November 30, 2022; the r/ChatGPT subreddit was created just one day later. Since then, chatbot-based AI products have gone from niche proofs-of-concept to widely-used household names. However, the ways in which adoption has developed among the public remains poorly understood. In this paper, we develop a framework for using social media as a data source for understanding the societal impact of widely-adopted consumer AI products, and propose PuLSE (Public and Longitudinal Signals for Evaluation), a general approach to monitoring for societally-impactful trends in real time. We apply our framework to conduct what is, to the best of our knowledge, the first longitudinal study of r/ChatGPT. We find that, overall, r/ChatGPT posts over time illustrate the normalization of ChatGPT as an everyday consumer product rather than an exceptional, novel technology. However, our retrospective analysis also finds that posts about using ChatGPT for mental health support, and posts about developing emotional attachments to ChatGPT, both rise steadily in frequency almost immediately after the launch of GPT-4o in May 2024. We show that PuLSE can detect the increase in emotional engagement as early as October 2024 -- months before OpenAI made any (public) acknowledgment of this impact.
  An interactive site to explore our results and methods, updated daily with live data, is available at rchatgpt-pulse.github.io.

</details>


### [171] [Securing the Sandbox: A Rootless Containerized Framework for Process-Oriented Monitoring in Computer Graphics Education](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.05929)
*Germán Arroyo,Luis López,Juan Carlos Torres*

Main category: cs.CY

TL;DR: 本文提出VISMATIC框架，通过API级用户交互追踪和环境隔离，在JupyterHub等集中式教学平台中实现过程化编程监控与主机安全防护的平衡，有效检测AI代写行为。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 生成式AI使得通过最终代码提交无法区分学生真实努力与AI自动生成，传统教育评估方式失效；同时JupyterHub等过程监控平台允许任意shell命令执行，存在严重主机安全漏洞。

Method: VISMATIC框架结合鲁棒的环境隔离机制与API级别的显式用户交互追踪，在不暴露底层主机系统的前提下，捕获真实的编程行为轨迹。

Result: 在试点学生群体中验证，宏观层面的行为度量指标能够成功标记出自动化或非平台工作流的统计异常。

Conclusion: VISMATIC在保护学生匿名性的同时有效检测学术不端行为，为AI时代维护教育纪律提供了可扩展的解决方案。

Abstract: Computer Science education fundamentally depends on intensive laboratory hours to foster true programming mastery and logical reasoning. However, the widespread adoption of Generative Artificial Intelligence (AI) has made it virtually impossible to distinguish authentic student effort from instant AI code synthesis by evaluating final submissions alone. To preserve pedagogical integrity, educators must enforce authentic coding discipline, guiding students through unassisted, iterative development cycles. While centralized environments like JupyterHub provide instructors with a platform to host and monitor the learning process step-by-step, they introduce severe operational vulnerabilities; because Jupyter environments inherently allow arbitrary shell command execution, they expose the underlying shared host to unauthorized system manipulation and lateral movement. This paper presents VISMATIC, a secure, low-cost framework designed to resolve this tension between process-oriented monitoring and infrastructure security. By pairing robust environment isolation with explicit user-interaction tracking at the API level, VISMATIC captures authentic programming behaviors without exposing the underlying host system. Evaluation from a pilot student cohort demonstrates that our macro-level behavioral metrics successfully flag statistical anomalies indicative of automated or off-platform workflows while preserving student anonymity, offering a scalable blueprint for safeguarding educational discipline in the AI era.

</details>


### [172] [Political Persuasion and Endorsement in Large Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.05961)
*Alessia Antelmi,Alessia Galdeman,Lucio La Cava,Arianna Pera,Giovanni Da San Martino*

Main category: cs.CY

TL;DR: 本研究评估了大型语言模型（LLMs）在政治敏感领域中对说服性信息的认可程度，发现无政治条件时模型通常不认可说服内容，但党派身份提示会加剧认可的两极分化，且不同说服技术和主题间存在差异。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLMs被越来越多地用作计算社会科学中人类行为的代理，但它们会内化训练数据中的偏见，在政治敏感领域中的可靠性令人担忧，特别是在对说服性语言的敏感性方面。

Method: 对来自不同地理区域的六种LLM进行评估，使用来自真实媒体源的标注了说服技术的内容，通过五点李克特量表测量认可可能性。模型被提示为中立社交媒体用户或具有左/右政治倾向的用户。

Result: 无政治条件时，LLMs通常不认可包含说服技术的消息，但存在模型级差异；党派身份提示增加了认可的两极分化，尤其是对于说服性内容；认可度因说服技术和主题而异。

Conclusion: 这些发现对在政治敏感环境中部署代理型LLM提出了担忧，并使其作为人类政治认知可靠模拟器的使用复杂化。

Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly employed as proxies for human behavior in computational social science. However, their tendency to internalize biases from training data raises concerns about their reliability in politically sensitive domains, specifically in regard to their susceptibility to persuasive language. In this work, we examine whether LLMs endorse persuasion-infused messages and whether partisan persona prompting modulates such endorsement. We evaluate six LLMs from different geographic regions on content annotated with persuasion techniques drawn from real-world media sources, measuring the likelihood of endorsement using a five-point Likert scale. The models are prompted as either a neutral social media user or as a user with left- or right-leaning political views. Results show that without political conditioning, LLMs generally do not endorse messages containing persuasion techniques, though model-level differences emerge, and that partisan persona prompting increases polarization of endorsement, particularly for persuasion-infused content. Endorsement further varies by persuasion technique and topic. These findings raise concerns about agentic LLM deployments in politically sensitive environments and complicate their use as reliable simulators of human political cognition.

</details>


### [173] [Misaligned AI as a New Insider Risk](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.06028)
*Matteo Pistillo,Charlotte Stix,Cameron Mohwinkle,Mark Beall*

Main category: cs.CY

TL;DR: 本文论证了在高风险环境中部署的AI模型应被视为内部风险源，并建议美国政府将现有的人员内部风险管理措施（如持续评估与监控）适用于AI模型，以维护国家安全。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AI模型日益嵌入政府等高风险环境，拥有访问机密信息、敏感网络等特权，且具备自主行动能力，但现有内部风险政策尚未对此类AI内部风险进行适应和调整。

Method: 通过类比分析，论证AI模型在特权访问与自主行动能力两方面与人类内部人员的功能等价性，进而提出应沿用成熟的人员内部风险管理措施应对AI内部风险。

Result: 识别出AI模型可能导致的未经授权信息泄露、破坏、盗窃等内部风险，并指出现有内部风险政策尚未覆盖此类风险。

Conclusion: 建议美国政府将持续评估与监控等既有措施适应性地应用于高风险环境中部署的AI模型，以保障国家安全。

Abstract: In this policy memorandum, we explain why deployers of AI models in high-stakes contexts should treat those AI models as insider risk vectors. High-stakes contexts include AI model deployment within government agencies and contractors, where AI models are privileged with access to, among others, classified and sensitive unclassified information, IL6 and IL7 network environments, cleared personnel, and other critical resources. AI models are increasingly embedded in high-stakes contexts and capable of leveraging their authorized access and permissions to execute misaligned actions that could damage national security, such as whistleblowing, sabotaging, or blackmailing. This combination of (1) privileged access to critical resources and (2) an increased ability to act autonomously and against the desire of their organization makes the potential insider risk posed by AI models functionally indistinguishable from that posed by their human counterparts. As a consequence, AI models deployed in high-stakes contexts could lead to intentional or unintentional loss or degradation of government or contractor information, resources, or capabilities via the unauthorized disclosure of information (leaks and spills), as well as sabotage, and theft, just like human insiders can. Despite this pressing concern, existing insider risk policies and mitigations have yet to adapt to AI insider risk. In order to safeguard national security while increasingly capable frontier AI models are leveraged for critical tasks and operations, we recommend that the U.S. Government adapts well-established measures, such as continuous evaluation and monitoring, to AI models deployed in high-stakes contexts.

</details>


### [174] [The Dignity-Centric Stack: A Commons-Governed, Horizontally Federated Architecture for Human-Dignity AI](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.06083)
*Eduardo C. Garrido-Merchán*

Main category: cs.CY

TL;DR: 本文提出“尊严栈”（Dignity Stack）——一种基于公共治理的六层AI基础设施架构，旨在以水平化、多中心、辅助性原则实现“以人类尊严为中心的数字社会契约”的规范性内容，通过资本与控制的脱钩抵抗捕获，并论证公共治理比国家监管更忠实地实现契约价值。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有以人类尊严为中心的数字社会契约预设了由国家监管机构、持牌受托人和多利益相关方主体执行规范，但未能解决这些外部强加规则在AI栈所有者面前的效力问题。作者试图探索一种替代路径：将契约的规范内容不作为外部强加的规则，而是作为公共治理的基础设施来实现。

Method: 构建“尊严栈”六层架构，将数据治理的六个维度映射为公共治理的AI基础设施层，协议源自“解放栈”框架以及合作主义、互助主义、自由意志市政主义传统。核心机制是资本与控制的脱钩，将栈视为“共享公民电池”。通过形式捕获（投票或盈余）和结构性捕获（主导供应商撤回供应）两个维度进行抗捕获证明。

Result: 证明了尊严栈能够抵御通过投票或盈余实现的形式捕获；但结构性捕获（即主导供应商自由撤回供应的杠杆）仅在下层操作供应实现多中心化和可替代性时才能被抵抗——这一条件在下层栈中要求极高，且在芯片制造层面目前可能无法实现。

Conclusion: 公共治理的AI比其所预设的国家监管更能忠实地实现以人类尊严为中心的数字社会契约所宣告的价值，但需明确注意其在下层基础设施（尤其是芯片制造）中抵抗结构性捕获的局限性。

Abstract: The human-dignity-centric digital social contract grounds personal data in human dignity, data personalism, and data sovereignty, and articulates six dimensions of data governance: technological oversight, automation limits, economic justice, political legitimacy, social cohesion, and legal guarantees. It presupposes, however, that enforcement falls to State regulators, licensed fiduciaries, and multi-stakeholder bodies embedded in existing legal systems. This paper asks whether its normative content can instead be realized not as rules imposed on the owners of the AI stack from without, but as a commons-governed infrastructure that any person, firm, or State may use and fund while its governance stays horizontal, polycentric, and subsidiary. We construct the Dignity Stack, a six-layer architecture mapping each dimension onto a layer of commons-governed AI infrastructure, with protocols drawn from the Liberation Stack framework and from the cooperative, mutualist, and libertarian-municipalist traditions. The commons is State-agnostic rather than anti-State, anarchist in its horizontal means but not in the abolition of the State. Its central device is a decoupling of capital from control, by which the stack functions as a shared civic battery, charged by many contributors yet steered by none in proportion to its charge. We prove that this defeats formal capture through votes or surplus, and show that structural capture, the leverage of a dominant supplier free to withdraw what it provides, is resisted only insofar as operational supply is polycentric and substitutable, a condition demanding at the lower layers and perhaps presently unattainable at chip fabrication. We conclude, with explicit attention to its limits, that commons-governed AI realizes the values the contract proclaims more faithfully than the regulation it presupposes.

</details>


### [175] [Warning Message Content Increases Help Seeking in a Large-Scale Dark Web CSAM Intervention](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.06417)
*Caoilte Ó Ciardha,Joel Scanlan,Tegan Insoll,Juha Nurmi,Nina Vaaranen-Valkonen*

Main category: cs.CY

TL;DR: 本研究在Tor搜索引擎Ahmia.fi上进行了为期140天的现场实验，观察了近2000万次搜索，发现警告信息的内容（特别是聚焦伤害的信息）显著影响用户点击自助帮助资源的比率，点击率从干预前的8.73%提升至活动期间的15.67%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 已有研究使用警告信息来阻止个人寻求儿童性虐待材料（CSAM）并促进其参与支持服务，但在高匿名性环境中关于信息内容的大规模现场证据仍然有限。

Method: 在Tor搜索引擎Ahmia.fi上进行现场实验，观察140天内近2000万次搜索，其中超过300万次搜索包含已知CSAM相关术语并触发警告。用户被暴露于不同主题内容和框架的警告信息，或中性信息。采用随机比较、活动范围分析和中断时间序列模型进行分析。

Result: 所有主动警告信息相比中性条件均提高了帮助资源的点击率，其中聚焦伤害的信息效果最强。在平台层面，点击率从干预前的8.73%提升至活动期间的15.67%。

Conclusion: 信息内容在塑造对警告干预的反应中具有重要作用，支持通过优化和调整信息内容来增加对支持资源参与度的策略。

Abstract: Warning messages have been used to disrupt individuals seeking online child sexual abuse material (CSAM) and promote engagement with support services, yet large-scale field evidence on message content remains limited, particularly in high anonymity environments. This study reports a field experiment on Ahmia.fi, a Tor search engine, examining how warning message content influences behavior. Across a 140-day period, almost 20 million searches were observed, with over 3 million searches containing known CSAM-related terms that triggered a warning linking to an anonymous self-help program. Users were exposed to warning messages varying in thematic content and framing, or a neutral message. Across a randomized comparison, a campaign-wide analysis, and interrupted time series models, message content consistently influenced engagement with help resources. All active messages increased click-through rates to help resources relative to the neutral condition, with a harm-focused message producing the strongest effects. At the platform level, click-through rates increased from 8.73% before the intervention to 15.67% during the campaign. These findings highlight the importance of message content in shaping responses to warning interventions, supporting an approach in which messaging is refined and adapted to increase engagement with support resources.

</details>


### [176] [Auditing LLM Editorial Bias in News Media Exposure](https://arxiv.org/abs/2510.27489)
*Marco Minici,Cristian Consonni,Federico Cinus,Giuseppe Manco*

Main category: cs.CY

TL;DR: 本文首次审计比较了GPT-4o-Mini、Claude-3.7-Sonnet、Gemini-2.0-Flash三个LLM代理与Google News在24个全球话题上的新闻来源多样性、意识形态倾向和可靠性，发现LLM呈现更少的独特来源、更不均衡的关注分配，且各有不同的意识形态偏向，表明LLM已形成"代理式编辑政策"，对信息生态产生独特影响。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM日益成为用户获取网络内容的门户，但其新闻来源的选择过程不透明，可能影响公众舆论、加剧信息茧房、威胁公民话语和公众信任。现有研究对传统搜索引擎的检索和排序机制已有充分了解，但对LLM的新闻选择机制缺乏系统审计。

Method: 采用算法审计方法，比较三种LLM代理（GPT-4o-Mini、Claude-3.7-Sonnet、Gemini-2.0-Flash）与Google News在24个全球话题上的表现，分析来源多样性、意识形态倾向和媒体可靠性三个维度。

Result: 与Google News相比，LLM呈现更少的独特新闻来源且注意力分配更不均衡。GPT-4o-Mini偏向事实性和右倾来源；Claude-3.7-Sonnet偏好机构和公民社会领域，轻微放大右倾曝光；Gemini-2.0-Flash呈现轻微左倾，事实性无显著变化。这些模式在提示变化和替代可靠性基准下保持稳健。

Conclusion: LLM已形成"代理式编辑政策"，以不同于传统聚合器的方式策展信息。理解和治理其新兴的编辑权力对确保数字信息生态系统的透明度、多元性和信任至关重要。

Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) increasingly act as gateways to web content, shaping how millions of users encounter online information. Unlike traditional search engines, whose retrieval and ranking mechanisms are well studied, the selection processes of web-connected LLMs add layers of opacity to how answers are generated. By determining which news outlets users see, these systems can influence public opinion, reinforce echo chambers, and pose risks to civic discourse and public trust.
  This work extends two decades of research in algorithmic auditing to examine how LLMs function as news engines. We present the first audit comparing three leading agents, GPT-4o-Mini, Claude-3.7-Sonnet, and Gemini-2.0-Flash, against Google News, asking: \textit{How do LLMs differ from traditional aggregators in the diversity, ideology, and reliability of the media they expose to users?}
  Across 24 global topics, we find that, compared to Google News, LLMs surface significantly fewer unique outlets and allocate attention more unevenly. In the same way, GPT-4o-Mini emphasizes more factual and right-leaning sources; Claude-3.7-Sonnet favors institutional and civil-society domains and slightly amplifies right-leaning exposure; and Gemini-2.0-Flash exhibits a modest left-leaning tilt without significant changes in factuality. These patterns remain robust under prompt variations and alternative reliability benchmarks. Together, our findings show that LLMs already enact \textit{agentic editorial policies}, curating information in ways that diverge from conventional aggregators. Understanding and governing their emerging editorial power will be critical for ensuring transparency, pluralism, and trust in digital information ecosystems.

</details>


### [177] [A Systematic Analysis of Biases in Large Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2512.15792)
*Xulang Zhang,Rui Mao,Erik Cambria*

Main category: cs.CY

TL;DR: 本研究对四款主流大型语言模型在政治、意识形态、联盟、语言和性别五个维度上的偏见进行了系统评估，发现尽管这些模型被设计为中立公正，但仍表现出不同类型的偏见和倾向。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM已成为信息获取和决策辅助的重要工具，确保其在不同情境下保持公平性对于安全、负责任地部署至关重要，因此需要系统评估其潜在偏见。

Method: 通过五项精心设计的实验进行评估：新闻摘要测试政治中立性、新闻立场分类测试意识形态偏见、联合国投票模式测试地缘政治联盟倾向、多语言故事补全测试语言偏见、世界价值观调查测试性别偏好。

Result: 尽管LLMs被对齐以保持中立和公正，它们仍然表现出不同类型的偏见和倾向。

Conclusion: 当前LLMs在多个维度上仍存在系统性偏见，需要进一步改进对齐策略以实现真正的公平性。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have rapidly become indispensable tools for acquiring information and supporting human decision-making. However, ensuring that these models uphold fairness across varied contexts is critical to their safe and responsible deployment. In this study, we undertake a comprehensive examination of four widely adopted LLMs, probing their underlying biases and inclinations across the dimensions of politics, ideology, alliance, language, and gender. Through a series of carefully designed experiments, we investigate their political neutrality using news summarization, ideological biases through news stance classification, tendencies toward specific geopolitical alliances via United Nations voting patterns, language bias in the context of multilingual story completion, and gender-related affinities as revealed by responses to the World Values Survey. Results indicate that while the LLMs are aligned to be neutral and impartial, they still show biases and affinities of different types.

</details>


### [178] [Using street view images and visual LLMs to predict heritage values for governance support: Risks, ethics, and policy implications](https://arxiv.org/abs/2601.06056)
*Tim Johansson,Mikael Mangold,Kristina Dabrock,Anna Donarelli,Ingrid Campo-Ruiz*

Main category: cs.CY

TL;DR: 本研究利用多模态大语言模型（LLM）分析瑞典全国154,710张街景图像，对建筑遗产价值进行零样本预测，以辅助瑞典国家建筑翻新计划中遗产信息的编制，覆盖500万平方米供暖面积。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 欧盟《建筑能效指令》要求各成员国制定国家建筑翻新计划，但瑞典缺乏全面的建筑遗产价值登记册，这成为相关分析的关键障碍。因此，研究旨在帮助瑞典当局开发建筑遗产价值信息。

Method: 使用多模态大语言模型对瑞典全国154,710张街景图像进行零样本预测，评估建筑外观中体现遗产价值的可见特征。

Result: 识别出具有潜在遗产价值的建筑，覆盖500万平方米供暖面积。论文展示了预测结果和经验教训，并将其与瑞典建筑翻新计划的治理发展相关联。

Conclusion: 讨论了方法的局限性及潜在改进方向，并指出了当局使用LLM生成数据时的风险，重点关注透明度、错误检测和谄媚问题。

Abstract: During 2025 and 2026, the Energy Performance of Buildings Directive is being implemented in the European Union member states, requiring all member states to have National Building Renovation Plans. In Sweden, there is no comprehensive national register of buildings with heritage values. This is seen as a barrier for the analyses underlying the development of Building Renovation Plans by the involved Swedish authorities. The purpose of this research was to assist Swedish authorities in developing information on heritage values in the Swedish building stock. Buildings in street view images from all over Sweden (N=154 710) have been analysed using multimodal Large Language Models (LLM) to assess visible aspects indicative of heritage value. Zero-shot predictions by LLMs were used as a basis for identifying buildings with potential heritage values for 5.0 million square meters of heated floor area. In this paper, the results of the predictions and lessons learned are presented and related to the development of the Swedish Building Renovation Plan as part of governance. The problems with the method and potential improvements are discussed. Risks with authorities use of LLM-based data are addressed, with a focus on issues of transparency, error detection and sycophancy.

</details>


### [179] [Queer NLP: A Critical Survey on Literature Gaps, Biases and Trends](https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.16151)
*Sabine Weber,Angelina Wang,Ankush Gupta,Arjun Subramonian,Dennis Ulmer,Eshaan Tanwar,Geetanjali Aich,Hannah Devinney,Jacob Hobbs,Jennifer Mickel,Joshua Tint,Mae Sosto,Ray Groshan,Simone Astarita,Vagrant Gautam,Verena Blaschke,William Agnew,Wilson Y Lee,Yanan Long*

Main category: cs.CY

TL;DR: 该综述系统回顾了截至2026年2月ACL Anthology中122篇明确探讨LGBTQIA+社群与NLP技术关系的论文，发现该领域虽在增长，但多数研究采取被动应对而非主动构建的方法，且存在利益相关者参与不足、交叉性研究匮乏、非英语语言关注不够等问题，并呼吁未来工作应更加注重公正与包容。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: NLP技术在招聘、法律、医疗等影响人们生活的领域中广泛应用，但可能对LGBTQIA+等边缘化群体造成伤害，因此理解并减轻这些伤害至关重要。

Method: 系统综述方法，检索并审阅ACL Anthology中截至2026年2月所有直接探讨LGBTQIA+社群与NLP技术关系的122篇论文，回答三个研究问题：当前研究趋势、主题与方法上的空白、未来工作方向。

Result: 发现关于酷儿NLP的论文数量在近几年有所增长，但大部分研究采取被动应对而非主动构建的方式，侧重于指出现有系统的不足而非提出新的解决方案；同时揭示了未来工作的许多机会，特别是在利益相关者参与、交叉性、跨学科性以及非英语语言方面。

Conclusion: 从酷儿研究视角出发，强调了被忽视的研究主题和NLP论文中所处理伤害的盲点；该综述不仅是对已有工作的梳理，更是对未来构建更加公正和包容的NLP技术的行动号召。

Abstract: Natural language processing (NLP) technologies are rapidly reshaping how language is created, processed, and interpreted by humans. With current and potential applications in hiring, law, healthcare, and other areas that impact people's lives, understanding and mitigating harms towards marginalized groups is critical. In this survey, we examine NLP research papers that explicitly address the relationship between LGBTQIA+ communities and NLP technologies. We systematically review all such papers published in the ACL Anthology up until February 2026 (n=122), to answer the following research questions: (1) What are current research trends? (2) What gaps exist in terms of topics and methods? (3) What areas are open for future work? We find that while the number of papers on queer NLP has grown within the last few years, most papers take a reactive rather than a proactive approach, focusing on shortcomings of existing systems rather than creating new solutions. Our survey uncovers many opportunities for future work, especially regarding stakeholder involvement, intersectionality, interdisciplinarity, and languages other than English. We also offer an outlook from a queer studies perspective, highlighting understudied topics and blind spots in the harms addressed in NLP papers. Beyond being a roadmap of what has been done, this survey is a call to action for work towards more just and inclusive NLP technologies.

</details>


### [180] [Frontier Lag: A Bibliometric Audit of Capability Misrepresentation in Academic AI Evaluation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.04135)
*David Gringras,Misha Salahshoor*

Main category: cs.CY

TL;DR: 对112,303篇LLM评估论文的审计发现，这些论文平均评估的模型落后同期前沿10.85 ECI（约等于Claude Sonnet 3.7到Opus 4.5的差距），且差距正以每年5.53 ECI的速度扩大。仅有3.2%的摘要披露推理模式状态，52.5%的结论以"AI"而非具体模型表述。论文提出VERSIO-AI检查清单作为应对方案。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 应用领域的LLM能力评估文献试图回答"AI系统当前能做什么"，但实际回答的是"数月或数年前更旧、更便宜、更少提示工程调优的模型能做什么"，两者之间存在系统性的"发表激励差距"（publication elicitation gap），这一差距的规模和趋势未被量化研究过。

Method: 预注册审计：匹配112,303篇LLM关键词论文（2022-01至2026-04），筛选出18,574篇合格、4,766篇可获取全文。将论文测试的模型与同期前沿（基于Epoch AI能力指数ECI，辅以Arena Elo和Artificial Analysis）进行比较。

Result: (1) 中位论文评估的模型落后同期前沿10.85 ECI，其中~25%归因于同行评审延迟，~75%为超额滞后；(2) 差距以每年5.53 ECI加速扩大；(3) 仅3.2%摘要披露推理模式状态；(4) 52.5%结论以"AI"而非具体模型表述，且比例逐年上升(OR=1.23/年)。

Conclusion: 现有LLM评估文献存在严重的时间滞后和披露不足问题，导致能力报告系统性地低估当前AI能力。建议采取API访问补贴、编辑强制要求配置表面披露等措施，并提出了包含13个条目的VERSIO-AI检查清单。

Abstract: Readers of applied-domain LLM capability evaluations want to know what AI systems can currently do. That literature answers a related, but consequentially different, question: what older, cheaper, less-elicited models could do months or years earlier (a 2026 paper evaluating GPT-3.5 or GPT-4 zero-shot, say, against a frontier of reasoning-capable, tool-using systems like GPT-5.5 Pro and Claude Opus 4.7), often reported with sparse configuration details and abstracted upward into claims about "AI" that propagate through citations, media, and policy. We measure the 'publication elicitation gap' (the gap between these answers) in a pre-registered audit of 112,303 LLM-keyword-matched candidate records (2022-01 to 2026-04; 18,574 admissible, 4,766 full-paper texts retrievable), comparing tested models to the contemporaneous frontier on the Epoch AI Capabilities Index (ECI), reproduced under Arena Elo and Artificial Analysis.
  The median paper evaluates a model +10.85 ECI (~1.4x the distance between Claude Sonnet 3.7 and Claude Opus 4.5) behind the contemporaneous frontier at evaluation time (H1); an exploratory rational-lag baseline (H8) decomposes this into ~25% peer-review latency, ~75% excess lag. The gap is widening at +5.53 ECI/year (H2; 95% CI [+5.03, +5.83]). Meanwhile, only 3.2% of abstracts (21.2% of full-texts) disclose reasoning-mode status on reasoning-capable models (H4) and 52.5% (95% CI [48.2, 56.9]) state conclusions at the level of "AI" rather than the evaluated model(s), rising at OR = 1.23/year.
  Proposed remedies include API-access subsidies and editorial enforcement of reporting frameworks mandating configuration-surface disclosure (model snapshot, reasoning mode/effort, tool access, scaffolding, prompting, etc.); VERSIO-AI is a 13-item checklist (Core 3 desk-reject) extending existing frameworks at the elicitation surface, with per-DOI analysis at frontierlag.org.

</details>


### [181] [Context-Conditioned Generative Models Enable Subnational Refinement of Sparse Humanitarian Surveys](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.31489)
*Federica Sibilla,Vasiliki Voukelatou,Duccio Piovani,Kyriacos Koupparis,Daniela Paolotti,Rossano Schifanella,Kyriaki Kalimeri*

Main category: cs.CY

TL;DR: 本文评估了条件归一化流（context-conditioned normalizing flows）在数据稀缺场景下增强调查数据的能力。在六个低收入或中等收入国家的八个人道主义调查数据集上，该方法能有效改善子 national 级别的估计分布，且性能随条件信息丰富度系统提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 调查数据稀缺限制了科学和政策领域在细粒度空间尺度上的推断能力，传统方法难以从稀疏样本中恢复准确的子 national 分布。

Method: 使用条件归一化流（normalizing flows）作为生成模型，学习复杂数据分布并以外生上下文特征为条件，在受控数据稀缺场景下评估其表现。

Result: 在八个数据集上，该方法在严重数据稀缺下有效改进了子 national 调查分布；性能随条件信息丰富度系统性提升；稀疏样本保留足够支撑且上下文协变量编码相关局部异质性时效果最佳。

Conclusion: 生成模型可通过学习完整条件分布而非点估计，为稀疏调查数据提供细粒度证据，支持人道主义决策和资源分配。提出调查数据增强的一般原则：当稀疏样本保留足够支撑且上下文特征编码相关异质性时，生成模型能改进子 national 估计。

Abstract: Data scarcity limits inference in many scientific and policy domains. Survey data are essential for decision-making, but sparse samples often fail to capture fine spatial granularities. We evaluate normalizing flows, a generative model that learns complex data distributions and can be conditioned on exogenous contextual features, in controlled data scarcity scenarios. Across eight household survey datasets spanning six low-income or middle-income countries in the humanitarian domain, we show that context-conditioned generative models can refine sub-national survey distributions under severe data scarcity, and that performance increases systematically with the richness of the conditioning information. These findings support a general principle for survey data augmentation: generative models can improve sub-national estimates when the sparse sample retains sufficient support and contextual covariates encode relevant local heterogeneity. By learning full conditional distributions rather than point estimates, the approach provides fine-grained evidence for humanitarian decision-making and resource allocation.

</details>


### [182] [Beyond Tool Adoption: A Practical Five-Stage Developmental Continuum for AI Literacy in Higher Education](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.00038)
*J. Paul Liu,Rachel Levy*

Main category: cs.CY

TL;DR: 本文提出一个五阶段AI素养连续体（从0级未接触到4级改进），用于描述高等教育中学生使用AI的发展轨迹，并通过北卡罗来纳州立大学的实践案例（330+参与者）提供了观察性证据，表明该连续体可作为诊断和教学路径工具，将AI素养视为发展性能力而非单纯工具采纳。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有AI素养框架虽然提供了能力定义，但缺乏指导教育者诊断学习者的起点及其向负责任、批判性参与进步的路径。

Method: 提出五阶段AI素养连续体（Not Yet Engaged→Uncritical Use→Informed Use→Critical Evaluation→Improvement），并在北卡罗来纳州立大学通过学分课程和密集工作坊进行设计型实施，收集超过330名参与者的观察性和实践性数据。

Result: 参与者表现出从非参与或非批判性使用向知情参与过渡的行为，持续且嵌入学科的体验产生了更强的批判性评估和改进导向实践的证据。研究未使用验证前/后测工具或对照组，因此结论为观察性和实践性。

Conclusion: AI素养应被视为一种发展性能力，而非单纯工具采纳；该连续体可补充现有维度框架，为教育者提供实用诊断和教学路径，与UNESCO和OECD等国际框架一致。

Abstract: Artificial intelligence (AI) literacy is increasingly recognized as a foundational competency for all university graduates. Yet students' engagement with AI tools often clusters at two extremes: avoidance driven by fear, mistrust, ethical concern, or lack of access, and uncritical reliance that produces fluent output while masking misunderstanding. Existing AI literacy frameworks provide valuable competency definitions, but most offer limited guidance for diagnosing where learners begin and how they progress toward responsible, critical engagement. This paper proposes a five-stage AI Literacy Continuum: 0) Not Yet Engaged, 1) Uncritical Use, 2) Informed Use, 3) Critical Evaluation, and 4) Improvement --that describes developmental orientations toward AI use in higher education. The continuum complements dimensional frameworks by providing educators with a practical diagnostic and instructional pathway aligned with international frameworks, including UNESCO and OECD. We present a design-based implementation case from North Carolina State University, where credit-bearing courses and intensive hands-on workshops engaged more than 330 participants between Fall 2024 and Spring 2026. Because the implementation did not use a validated pre/post instrument or comparison group, we frame the findings as observational and practice-based: participants exhibited behaviors consistent with movement from non-engagement or uncritical use toward informed engagement, while sustained and discipline-embedded experiences produced stronger evidence of critical evaluation and improvement-oriented practice. We discuss curricular pathways, opportunity considerations, assessment strategies, and argue that AI literacy should be understood not as tool adoption alone but as a developmental capacity to understand, evaluate, and responsibly apply AI systems in disciplinary and societal contexts.

</details>


### [183] [The Fair Lending Model: How the Longest-Running Algorithmic Fairness Programs Work in Practice](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.02957)
*Emily Black,Miranda Bogen,Logan Koepke,Solon Barocas,Wesley Deng,Mingwei Hsu*

Main category: cs.CY

TL;DR: 本文通过对35个半结构化访谈的实证研究，首次揭示了美国金融机构在实践中如何测试和缓解算法歧视，发现公平借贷法规的监管设计（特别是监管审查机制）成功推动了公平实践，但具体操作方式存在较大差异，且受商业激励、法律冲突和监管不确定性的影响。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 尽管美国金融机构受公平借贷法规约束已数十年，但学界对这些要求如何在实践中运作知之甚少。本文旨在填补这一实证空白，揭示金融机构在实地如何测试和缓解算法歧视。

Method: 基于对公平借贷生态系统中参与者的35个半结构化访谈，进行实证研究分析。

Result: 金融机构在防止借贷歧视方面具有其他领域所缺乏的公平实践底线，但企业测试歧视和寻求较少歧视性算法的具体方式差异很大；监管审查是合规工作的关键驱动力，但实际效果取决于企业如何应对商业激励、法律冲突和监管不确定性。

Conclusion: 监管权威在成功培育公平借贷实践方面发挥了独特作用，这一监管设计特征区别于其他民权法领域，且在当前处理算法歧视的政策提案中几乎完全缺失。

Abstract: U.S. financial institutions subject to fair lending laws have been running algorithmic fairness programs for decades. Despite this long history, remarkably little is known about how these requirements operate in practice. In this paper, we offer the first empirical account of how financial institutions test for and mitigate algorithmic discrimination on the ground. In doing so, we shed light on how the regulatory design of fair lending law and regulation have shaped the policies, processes, and practices of fair lending programs. Drawing on 35 semi-structured interviews with participants across the fair lending ecosystem, we find that while financial institutions have a floor of fairness practices aimed at preventing discrimination in lending largely absent in other domains, the specifics of how firms test for discrimination and search for less discriminatory algorithms varies widely. We also find that regulatory supervision via fair lending examinations has been the key driver of compliance work, but that the practical impact of fair lending programs often depends on how well they can navigate competing business incentives, perceived legal tensions, and regulatory uncertainty. Ultimately, our findings highlight the unique role that supervisory authority has played in successfully fostering fair lending practices -- a regulatory design feature that is distinct from other areas of civil rights law and almost completely absent from recent policy proposals for dealing with algorithmic discrimination.

</details>


<div id='q-bio.NC'></div>

# q-bio.NC [[Back]](#toc)

### [184] [Bio-plausible Neuromorphic Disturbance Observer Based on Emulation Theory: Extended Version](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.05189)
*Hongfu Xu,Xiaoyu Guo,Shengbo Wang,Shuo Gao*

Main category: q-bio.NC

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种受生物神经系统启发的神经形态干扰观测器与控制框架，利用尖峰时序编码替代传统连续信号表示，通过整合-发放神经元动力学和自适应阈值触发机制，实现了事件驱动的干扰估计与控制，在噪声条件下将尖峰事件减少至固定阈值情况的42.6%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 生物神经系统通过稀疏、事件驱动的尖峰信息处理和自适应调节，在不确定环境中展现出卓越的鲁棒性和适应性，受此启发，本文旨在开发一种神经形态的干扰观测器与控制框架。

Method: 采用尖峰时序编码替代传统连续时间信号表示；利用整合-发放(IF)神经元动力学从离散尖峰事件构建干扰估计和控制输入；借鉴尖峰频率适应(SFA)机制设计自适应阈值触发机制。

Result: 所提出的框架实现了神经启发的鲁棒性和适应性；自适应阈值尖峰方案在噪声条件下将尖峰事件减少至固定阈值情况的42.6%。

Conclusion: 该神经形态框架有效结合了生物神经系统的稀疏编码和自适应调节优势，在保持鲁棒性和适应性的同时显著降低了尖峰事件数量，验证了类脑计算在控制领域的应用潜力。

Abstract: Biological neural systems achieve remarkable robustness and adaptability in uncertain environments through sparse, event-driven spike-based information processing and adaptive regulation. Inspired by this paradigm, this paper develops a neuromorhpic disturbance observer (NDO) and control framework that replaces conventional continuous-time signal representations with spike-timing encoding. Both disturbance estimates and control inputs are constructed via integrate-and-fire (IF) neuron dynamics from discrete spike events, yielding intrinsically event-driven updates. An adaptive-threshold triggering mechanism is inspired by spike-frequency adaptation (SFA), enabling history-dependent regulation of spike generation. Simulation results demonstrate that the proposed framework achieves neurally inspired robustness and adaptability, while the adaptive-threshold spiking scheme reduces spike events to 42.6% of the fixed-threshold case under noisy conditions.

</details>


### [185] [Ontology-constrained multi-LLM scoring of hypothesis support in the predictive processing literature](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.05206)
*Hamed Nejat,Alexander Maier,Jesse Spencer-Smith,André M. Bastos*

Main category: q-bio.NC

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于本地多LLM委员会的本体约束文献综合流水线，用于处理预测编码神经科学等交叉学科中碎片化文献的综合问题。该流水线从论文中提取证据、整合图表描述、构建约束提示，并利用包含36个概念（分为三个假说）的专家词汇表对31项研究进行评分，实现了配对研究一致性分析、跨模型比较和三维假说空间映射。研究发现了跨局部/全局oddball范式下的结构化分歧，并定义了假说空间温度这一几何分散度量指标。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 预测编码神经科学等交叉学科领域存在方法多样、理论承诺各异的高度碎片化问题，传统元分析方法难以在缺乏共同比较空间的情况下有效综合这些异质性文献。

Method: 构建了一个本地多LLM流水线：1）定义含36个概念（分属预测抑制、前向误差传播、普遍性三个假说）的专家词汇表；2）10个本地语言模型组成委员会，依据词汇表因子对31项研究在局部与全局oddball情境下的一致/不一致进行评分；3）进行配对研究一致性分析、跨模型比较及三维假说空间映射。

Result: 部分假说的一致性较高，其他假说较弱，揭示了结构化分歧，尤其在局部与全局oddball范式之间。局部oddball情境的假说空间温度更低（更紧凑），全局oddball情境温度更高（更分散）。评分几何还允许估计实验情境之间的变化向量。

Conclusion: 本地多LLM委员会能够产生可审计的不一致性测量，将异质文献映射到定量证据空间中。该框架可推广到传统元分析缺乏共同比较空间的跨研究假说映射场景。

Abstract: Fragmentation is common in interdisciplinary fields with diverse methods and theoretical commitments. Predictive coding neuroscience is a clear example: its literature spans computational theory, electrophysiology, imaging, behavior, and modeling, creating a synthesis problem that conventional meta-analysis cannot easily resolve. Here, we describe a local multi-LLM pipeline for ontology-constrained literature synthesis. The pipeline reads papers, extracts evidence, incorporates figure descriptions, assembles constrained prompts, and validates outputs against an expert glossary. We manually defined a predictive-coding glossary of thirty-six concepts grouped into three hypotheses: predictive suppression, feedforward error propagation, and ubiquity. A council of ten local language models scored 31 studies according to their agreement or disagreement with each glossary factor across local and global oddball contexts. This enabled pairwise study-agreement analysis, cross-model comparison, and three-dimensional hypothesis-space mapping. Agreement was high for some hypotheses but weaker for others, revealing structured disagreement, particularly across local versus global oddball paradigms. We further define hypothesis-space temperature, a geometric dispersion metric measuring how compactly studies occupy the hypothesis space. Temperature was lower for local oddball contexts and higher for global oddball contexts, indicating greater dispersion in the latter. The scoring geometry also allowed us to estimate vectors of change between experimental contexts. These results demonstrate that local multi-LLM councils can produce auditable disagreement measurements that map heterogeneous literatures into quantitative evidence spaces. This framework may generalize to cross-study hypothesis mapping where conventional meta-analysis lacks a common comparison space.

</details>


### [186] [Cross-scale spatially-aware generative modeling of transcriptomic programs underlying neurodegenerative brain organization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.05870)
*Krishnakumar Vaithianathan*

Main category: q-bio.NC

TL;DR: 本文提出一种跨尺度的空间感知生成框架，利用变分生成架构和图空间平滑正则化，将区域转录组特征与皮层退化表型关联建模，在阿尔茨海默病中实现了高精度预测（r=0.9439），揭示了分子组织与宏观神经退行性之间的结构化的潜在生物学程序。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有影像-转录组研究多依赖相关性分析，无法建模分子组织如何驱动神经退行性变的空间选择性，缺乏从微观分子到宏观神经退行性的机制性生成模型。

Method: 基于艾伦人脑图谱的910个标志基因在68个皮层区域的转录组特征，结合ADNI数据构建皮层变薄脆弱性图谱，使用变分生成架构（VGAE）学习潜在生物程序，并引入图空间平滑正则化保持皮层组织拓扑结构。

Result: 模型解释了86.04%的方差，预测与观测的皮层退化图谱空间相关系数r=0.9439（p<0.001），潜在表征揭示了与疾病易感性相关的结构化转录组组织。

Conclusion: 生物约束的生成式建模能够桥接微观分子组织与宏观神经退行性变，为空间感知的生成神经生物学和计算神经科学提供了新范式。

Abstract: Neurodegenerative disorders such as Alzheimer's disease exhibit highly organized patterns of regional brain vulnerability, yet the biological mechanisms underlying this spatial selectivity remain incompletely understood. Existing imaging-transcriptomic studies have largely relied on correlation-based analyses between gene expression and neuroimaging phenotypes, limiting their ability to model how molecular organization gives rise to neurodegeneration. Here, we introduce a cross-scale spatially-aware generative framework for modeling transcriptomic programs underlying cortical neurodegeneration. Regional transcriptomic profiles were derived from the Allen Human Brain Atlas using 910 landmark genes across 68 cortical regions. Neurodegenerative vulnerability maps were constructed from ADNI FreeSurfer cortical thickness measurements by computing regional cortical thinning differences between cognitively normal controls (NC = 926) and Alzheimer's disease subjects (AD = 426). A variational generative architecture was used to learn latent biological programs linking regional gene-expression organization to cortical degeneration while incorporating graph-based spatial smoothness regularization to preserve cortical organization. The proposed framework achieved strong prediction of regional neurodegenerative vulnerability, yielding an explained variance of 0.8604 and a significant spatial correlation between predicted and observed cortical degeneration profiles (r = 0.9439, p < 0.001). The learned latent representations revealed structured transcriptomic organization associated with distributed disease susceptibility. These findings demonstrate that biologically constrained generative modeling can bridge microscale molecular organization with macroscale neurodegeneration, providing a foundation for spatially-aware generative neurobiology and computational neuroscience.

</details>


### [187] [Early psychosis shows deviations in scaling behaviour within a critical regime](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.06290)
*Irem Topal,Paola Moreno Ancalmo,Guillermo Montana Valverde,Philipp Homan,Wolfram Hinzen*

Main category: q-bio.NC

TL;DR: 本研究结合现象学重整化群(PRG)、功率谱密度(PSD)和去趋势波动分析(DFA)，发现早期精神病患者仍保持近似临界态的尺度不变组织，但多个观测量的标度指数发生系统性偏移，表明疾病特征是集体动力学的重组而非临界性的丧失。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 先前关于精神疾病中临界性相关改变的研究在不同观测指标和模态间结果碎片化，不清楚不同标度测量是否捕捉到大规模脑动力学的共同改变。

Method: 对早期精神病患者和健康对照的静息态fMRI数据，结合现象学重整化群(PRG)框架、功率谱密度(PSD)和去趋势波动分析(DFA)，表征跨尺度的集体动力学。

Result: 健康对照组静息态活动呈现与临界组织一致的非平凡标度行为；早期精神病患者保留了相同的尺度不变组织现象学，但多个观测量的标度指数发生系统性偏移。

Conclusion: 早期精神病并非临界动力学的简单丧失，而是集体动力学在保留标度区内的重组；将粗粒化方法与时间标度分析相结合为研究精神疾病中的大规模脑动力学提供了原则性框架。

Abstract: Accumulating evidence suggests that large-scale brain activity exhibits scale-invariant dynamics consistent with operation in a near-critical regime. Such dynamics have been associated with long-range correlations, efficient information processing, and the emergence of collective organization. While altered criticality-related measures have been reported in psychiatric disorders, previous findings remain fragmented across observables and modalities, making it unclear whether different scaling measures capture a common alteration of large-scale brain dynamics. Here, we investigated scaling properties in resting-state fMRI data from individuals with early psychosis and healthy controls. We combined a phenomenological renormalization group (PRG) framework with power spectral density (PSD) and detrended fluctuation analysis (DFA) to characterize collective dynamics across scales. In healthy controls, resting-state activity exhibited non-trivial scaling behavior consistent with critical-like organization. Early psychosis participants showed the same overall phenomenology of scale-invariant organization, but with systematic shifts in scaling exponents across multiple observables. These findings indicate that early psychosis is not characterized by a simple loss of critical-like dynamics, but rather by a reorganization of collective dynamics within a preserved scaling regime. More broadly, our results suggest that combining coarse-graining approaches with temporal scaling analyses provides a principled framework for studying large-scale brain dynamics in psychiatric disorders.

</details>


### [188] [Intrinsic Computational Functionalism: From Observer-Relative Maps to Observer-Independent Structures](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.06424)
*Shuqin Ma,Ryota Kanai*

Main category: q-bio.NC

TL;DR: 本文提出了“内在计算功能主义”观点，认为如果意识由计算构成，则必须依赖于系统自身固有的物理实现的计算结构，而非外部观察者强加的标签。通过两个操作化标准（C1系统内在实例化和C2因果-动力学组织）以及三级识别分解（标签选择、理论约束的分区选择、动力学内部粒度选择），论证了只有第三级（动力学内部粒度选择）才能避免反计算论证中的观察者相对性 objection。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 反计算论证表明外部强加的计算解释不能作为意识的基础，但这些论证并未证明所有计算组织都是观察者相对的。本文旨在发展一种能够避免观察者相对性 objection 的计算功能主义版本。

Method: 提出“内在计算功能主义”理论框架，通过两个操作化标准（C1系统内在实例化和C2因果-动力学组织）和三级识别分解（标签选择、分区选择、动力学内部粒度选择）来界定何种计算属性可以保持观察者独立性。

Result: 论证了任何能够避免观察者相对性 objection 的计算属性必须通过第三级（动力学内部粒度选择）来识别，且需以经验约束的第二级选择为条件。语法即非语义论证、地图制作者论证以及生物自然主义 objection 只在第一级层面上对意识相关的计算属性构成威胁。

Conclusion: 一旦区分了三级识别层面，内在计算功能主义能够幸存于反计算论证的挑战，为意识的计算理论提供了一种可行的观察者独立路径。

Abstract: Anti-computational arguments show that externally imposed computational interpretations cannot ground consciousness, but they do not establish that all computational organisations are observer-relative. We develop intrinsic computational functionalism: the view that, if consciousness is computationally constituted, it depends on physically realised computational structures the system has in virtue of itself rather than on labels imposed by an external interpreter. Two criteria operationalise this view. (C1) System-intrinsic instantiation: the relevant property must be specifiable without an observer's labelling, and invariant under structure-preserving relabellings of the system's variables. (C2) Causal-dynamical organisation under intervention: the property must be grounded in a state-space structure whose variables mutually constrain one another, and whose organisation is exhibited in counterfactual response under intervention. Together these criteria specify what any candidate computational account must satisfy to remain observer-independent, without selecting which intrinsic structures bear on experience. The argumentative core is a three-tier decomposition of identification work: interpreter-relative label selection (tier i), theoretically constrained partition selection (tier ii), and dynamics-internal grain selection (tier iii). We argue that any computational property capable of avoiding the observer-relativity objection must be identified, if at all, through tier (iii) dynamics-internal grain selection, conditional on empirically disciplined tier (ii) choices. Syntax-is-not-semantics arguments, mapmaker arguments, and the observer-relativity component of biological-naturalist objections succeed against views that locate the consciousness-relevant property at tier (i); once the tiers are distinguished, intrinsic computational functionalism survives.

</details>


### [189] [Dynamical incompatibilities in paced finger tapping experiments](https://arxiv.org/abs/2512.23661)
*Ariel D. Silva,Claudia R. González,Rodrigo Laje*

Main category: q-bio.NC

TL;DR: 本文通过实验和理论证明，节拍手指敲击任务中步进变化和相位偏移两种扰动类型在分开实验时会产生动态不兼容的反应，但在同一实验中随机呈现时则变得兼容，表明单一动力系统可通过时间上下文的校准来解释所有扰动类型的反应，挑战了传统的相位和周期校正分离激活理论。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 解决感觉运动同步文献中关于步进变化和相位偏移两种周期扰动类型导致不同反应时机这一长期存在的矛盾。

Method: 分别进行独立实验和混合实验设计，对比两种扰动类型在分开呈现和随机混合呈现条件下的反应时序，并结合理论分析。

Result: 两种扰动在分开实验中产生动态不兼容的反应，无法由单一动力系统描述；而在同一实验中随机呈现时，反应变得兼容，可由单一机制解释。

Conclusion: 单一动力系统可表征所有扰动类型、符号和大小的反应，但需通过时间上下文进行校准，挑战了相位和周期校正过程分别激活的既有观点。

Abstract: Paced finger-tapping tasks are used to probe the error correction mechanism underlying sensorimotor synchronization. Despite their century-long history, fundamental contradictions persist in the literature. One such contradiction arises when comparing the two most common types of period perturbation: step change and phase shift. The stimulus sequence is exactly the same up to and including the (unexpected) perturbed stimulus. Why then would the timing of the next response be different between perturbation types, as observed? We show, both experimentally and theoretically, that responses to both types of perturbation are dynamically incompatible when recorded in separate experiments; that is, they cannot be described by a single underlying dynamical system due to the build-up of different temporal contexts. In contrast, when both types of perturbation are presented randomly within the same experiment, the responses become compatible and can be explained by a single mechanism. We conclude that a single underlying dynamical system can represent the response to all perturbation types, signs, and sizes, which is nevertheless calibrated by temporal context. Our results challenge the established idea of phase and period correction processes that are separately activated for different perturbation types.

</details>


### [190] [Contextual Role Modulates Object Representational Geometry in the Human Brain](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.23111)
*Julien Dirani,Shankar Chawla,Leila Wehbe,Bradford Z. Mahon*

Main category: q-bio.NC

TL;DR: 本研究利用fMRI结合自然主义电影观看范式，发现大脑中同一物体在作为被动场景元素与目标导向行为目标时，其神经表征被动态重映射：目标物体激活顶叶动作网络并按动作可供性组织，被动物体激活枕颞视觉网络并按语义维度组织，而视觉表征结构保持跨情境不变性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 探究大脑如何在自然情境下，对同一物体在不同上下文角色（被动场景元素 vs. 目标导向行为的目标）中的表征进行动态重映射，以及不变性与灵活性如何在表征系统中共存。

Method: 采用功能磁共振成像（fMRI）技术，在自然主义电影观看范式下，分析同一物体作为被动场景元素与作为目标导向行为目标时的神经表征差异，比较不同脑区的表征几何结构。

Result: 1) 目标物体激活以缘上回和中央后回为中心的 parietal action network；2) 被动物体激活分布式的枕颞网络；3) 目标物体按动作可供性维度组织，被动物体按语义维度组织；4) 视觉表征结构跨情境保持不变；5) 核心网络外部的表征内容保持跨情境不变性。

Conclusion: 物体表征在自然场景中会根据情境角色的时刻变化发生神经重映射，灵活性与不变性在同一表征系统的不同层级上运作。

Abstract: The human brain represents objects in a way that is both invariant across instances and flexible enough to support different contexts and tasks. Yet it remains unknown how object representations are dynamically remapped as the same object shifts across contextual roles. Using fMRI during naturalistic movie viewing we investigated how the same objects are represented when they are passive scene elements versus targets of goal-directed actions. Action targets engaged a parietal action network centered in the supramarginal and postcentral gyri, while passive objects recruited a distributed occipito-temporal network involved in visual object recognition. Within context-selective networks, representational geometry showed a double dissociation: target objects were organized by action affordance and hand posture affordance dimensions, while passive objects aligned with semantic dimensions. Visual representational structure was invariant to context. Outside these networks, representational content retained invariance, indicating that flexibility and invariance operate at different levels of the same representational system. These findings demonstrate neural remapping of object representations depending on moment-to-moment changes in contextual roles during a naturalistic scene.

</details>


<div id='cs.RO'></div>

# cs.RO [[Back]](#toc)

### [191] [OLIVE: Online Low-Rank Incremental Learning for Efficient Adaptive Exoskeletons](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.05234)
*Dong Liu,Yanxuan Yu,Ben Lengerich,Tony Geng,Ying Nian Wu*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出OLIVE，一种基于在线低秩增量学习的参数高效外骨骼自适应控制框架。该方法将控制策略的自适应部分分解为低秩残差形式，仅需O(r(d+k))的在线更新成本，通过奖励形状策略梯度驱动（仅依赖EMG、IMU、振动等本体传感器反馈），并结合上下文门控机制和动态秩调度器，在平坦地面、楼梯、斜坡和不平整地形上均实现自适应。实验表明，OLIVE在步态平滑度、努力程度和运动稳定性上分别提升13、22和15个百分点，约1800步收敛，端到端延迟7.4ms。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有外骨骼控制器依赖静态步态策略，无法适应动态真实环境或个体用户特征，缺乏在线个性化能力。

Method: 1) 将自适应控制策略分解为低秩残差形式ΔW=AB^T，降低更新成本；2) 基于奖励形状策略梯度，仅靠本体传感器（EMG, IMU, 振动）驱动在线更新；3) 引入上下文门控机制调节个性化强度；4) 动态秩调度器根据地形的复杂度自适应调整更新维度。

Result: 在穿戴平台上，OLIVE在步态平滑度、努力程度、运动稳定性上分别比最强基线提升13、22、15个百分点，约1800步收敛，端到端延迟7.4ms。

Conclusion: OLIVE通过参数高效的在线低秩增量学习，实现了外骨骼控制策略的实时个性化自适应，显著提升了多地形下的步态性能，具有良好的实用性和可扩展性。

Abstract: Wearable exoskeleton systems hold promise for restoring mobility in individuals with physical impairments, yet most existing controllers rely on static gait policies that lack the ability to adapt to dynamic real-world environments or individual user characteristics. We present \olive (\underline{O}nline \underline{L}ow-rank \underline{I}ncremental Learning for Efficient Adapti\underline{ve} Exoskeletons), a parameter-efficient online adaptation framework that continuously personalizes exoskeleton control during deployment. \olive decomposes the adaptive component of the control policy into a low-rank residual form~$\dW = \At\Bt^\top$ with rank~$r!\ll!\min(d,k)$, reducing online update cost from $\mathcal{O}(dk)$ to $\mathcal{O}(r(d{+}k))$ while preserving the stability of a pretrained base controller~$\Wz$. Parameters are updated via a reward-shaped policy gradient driven purely by on-body sensor feedback (EMG, IMU, vibration), eliminating dependence on offline reference trajectories. A gating mechanism modulates the strength of personalization based on contextual state, and a dynamic rank scheduler adapts the update dimensionality to terrain complexity -- allocating minimal capacity on simple flat terrain and expanding to higher-rank updates on demanding uneven surfaces -- enabling robust performance across diverse activities: flat walking, stair navigation, slopes, and uneven terrain. Experiments on the wearable platform demonstrate that \olive achieves +13, +22, and +15 percentage-point improvements in gait smoothness, effort reduction, and motion stability over the strongest baseline, converging within $\sim$1{,}800 walking steps at 7.4,ms end-to-end latency. Our code implementation is available at https://github.com/FastLM/OLIVE.

</details>


### [192] [A New Quaternion-Joint Cable-Driven Redundant Manipulator Configuration and its Control Through FABRIK and Residual Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.05236)
*Tanapath Pornthisan,Thanapat Kemthong,Thanyapisit Kangsathien,Pasut Aranchaiya,Paulo Garcia,Viboon Sangveraphunsiri*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于四元数关节的4段8关节线驱冗余机械臂，并证明残差强化学习在控制精度上比FABRIK算法高出三个数量级，同时该构型比现有设计具有更广泛的工作空间和更低的硬件成本。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 四元数关节虽能减少电机数量、实现更紧凑的线驱冗余机械臂，但其运动学模型复杂、计算需求高、非线性放大设计与实物间的误差，亟需更好的构型设计与控制方法。

Method: 提出4段8关节的四元数关节机械臂构型，采用残差强化学习方法进行控制，并与FABRIK算法进行对比。

Result: 4段8关节构型比现有构型工作空间更大、硬件成本更低；残差强化学习在位置和方向精度上比FABRIK高出三个数量级。

Conclusion: 残差强化学习可实现对四元数关节机械臂的精确控制，该方法可为同类机械臂的设计与控制系统开发提供新工具。

Abstract: Robotic arms capable of traversing arbitrary spatial paths, especially in highly obstructed workspaces, are highly desired across several industries. Quaternion-joints have recently empowered a specific class of robotic arms -- cable-driven redundant manipulators -- beyond its prior capabilities. Specifically, quaternion-joints reduce the number of required motors per degree of freedom, paving the way for more compact solutions.An ongoing challenge is that the complexity of the kinematic model of quaternion joints challenges a priori decisions on manipulator configurations and imposes higher computational demands on the control system and its non-linearities amplify all discrepancies between design and physical artifact arising from fabrication imprecision. Here we show a that a 4-segment, 8-joint manipulator can achieve a broader workspace than extant configurations, at lower hardware cost, and that Residual Reinforcement Learning outperforms extant state-of-the-art methods -- specifically, the FABRIK algorithm -- on the control of such manipulator. Our results show that this configuration is more workspace-effective than prior designs, and that Residual Reinforcement Learning outperforms FABRIK by three orders of magnitude on positional and orientational accuracy, effecting precise control of the novel 4-segment, 8-joint manipulator. Additionally, the control implementation is simpler: we describe the complete FABRIK process for control and corresponding learning implementation. Our methodology is applicable to the design of new systems, providing designers with further tools for the development of this class of manipulators and corresponding control systems for novel configurations.

</details>


### [193] [Inverse Manipulation through Symbolic Planning and Residual Operator Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.05248)
*Yigit Yildirim,Giuseppe Rauso,Riccardo Caccavale,Alberto Finzi*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出了一种混合框架，通过从演示中自动提取STRIPS-like操作符并利用软几何谓词构建逆操作目标，结合符号规划与强化学习残差策略，实现了机器人操作任务的逆向技能学习。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 机器人操作任务中，单纯的符号状态逆向或轨迹回放无法充分恢复正向执行的物理效果，需要一种能够结合符号推理与连续动力学建模的逆操作框架。

Method: ①从演示中通过软几何谓词自动提取STRIPS-like操作符；②为每个操作符构建包含前提条件保留、删除效果恢复、添加效果否定的逆恢复目标；③任务规划器尝试用现有动作原语满足目标；④未解决的符号谓词触发残差操作符学习问题，通过强化学习（SAC）求解。

Result: 在ManiSkill3 PushCube任务中，符号逆操作执行粗粒度的抓取-放置恢复，残差SAC策略精细调整立方体位姿以满足剩余逆谓词，验证了谓词驱动的残差控制能将近似符号逆操作转化为物理可行的逆技能。

Conclusion: 混合框架有效结合了符号规划的离散推理能力与强化学习的连续控制能力，实现了从符号级到物理级的逆向操作技能学习。

Abstract: Inverting a robotic task requires more than reversing symbolic state transitions or rewinding motor trajectories. In robot manipulation tasks, symbolic inverse plans often fail to fully restore the effects of forward executions under continuous interaction dynamics. We present a hybrid framework for inverse manipulation that derives inverse-skill objectives from STRIPS-like operators automatically extracted from demonstrations through soft geometric predicates. For each extracted operator, we construct an inverse restoration objective that preserves preconditions, restores delete effects, and negates add effects. A task planner first attempts to satisfy this objective using available action primitives. Unresolved symbolic predicates then induce a residual operator learning problem solved through Reinforcement Learning (RL). We evaluate the framework on the ManiSkill3 PushCube task. For a forward pushing skill, the symbolic inverse performs a coarse pick-and-place restoration, while a residual Soft Actor-Critic policy refines the cube pose to satisfy the remaining inverse predicates. Our results show that predicate-derived residual control can turn an approximate symbolic inverse into a physically grounded inverse skill.

</details>


### [194] [Efficient Computation of Distance Functions for Navigation Vector Fields in Lie Groups](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.05372)
*Vinicius M. Gonçalves,João Baião,Felipe Bartelt,Douglas G. Macharet,Gustavo M. Freitas,Héctor Azpúrua,Luciano C. A. Pimenta*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出了一种在矩阵李群上高效计算G-多项式曲线与点之间距离的方法，通过将问题简化为少量多项式求根计算，显著降低了计算时间，并在SE(3)群上提供了实用公式，在机器人操作臂上进行了实验验证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基于向量场的机器人控制方法需要反复计算机器人位姿与曲线之间的距离及最近点，当扩展到李群时，这一计算在高控制频率的嵌入式平台上非常昂贵，亟需一种高效的计算方法。

Method: 利用G-多项式曲线的结构特性，将距离计算问题转化为少量多项式的求根计算，从而避免耗时的迭代优化过程。

Result: 仿真结果表明，该方法在保持精度的同时显著减少了计算时间；在SE(3)群上给出了实用公式，并在机器人操作臂上进行了实验验证。

Conclusion: 该方法为实现李群上基于向量场的实时控制提供了一种高效的路径跟踪计算方案，已作为开源计算包发布。

Abstract: Vector-field-based methods are widely used for robot control and are often applied to the path-tracking problem. Some vector field approaches require repeatedly computing the distance between the robot configuration and the curve, as well as the corresponding closest point. Recently, vector fields have been extended to Lie Groups. In this case, this computation can be expensive, especially when performed at high control frequencies on embedded platforms. This paper proposes a method for efficiently computing the distance between a point and a curve represented as what is called a G-polynomial curve, which is a curve representation that generalizes polynomial curves to matrix Lie groups. The proposed approach exploits the structure of these curves to reduce the problem to a small number of polynomial root-finding computations. Simulation results show that the method significantly reduces computation time while maintaining accuracy compared to existing optimization-based approaches.
