Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出RadiusFPS，一种基于球形体素剪枝的FPS加速框架，通过保守几何界和坐标级点跳过测试减少冗余距离计算，并设计了GPU级别实现RadiusFPS-G，在保持标准FPS更新规则的同时实现最高2.5倍加速和约一半GPU内存占用，适用于实时机器人视觉系统。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 经典Farthest Point Sampling (FPS)的时间复杂度与点云规模呈二次关系，无法适应现代3D传感器每秒百万点的采集速率，成为实时机器人系统中显著的延迟瓶颈，且与有限的机载计算预算冲突。

Method: 提出RadiusFPS框架：1) 利用球形体素对点云建立索引，推导保守几何界以剪枝每轮迭代中的冗余距离计算；2) 补充坐标级点跳过测试以消除剩余冗余更新；3) 提出RadiusFPS-G，实现warp级别的GPU内核，融合体素选择、剪枝和距离更新为内存合并的内核，消除全局内存往返开销。

Result: 在室内(S3DIS, ScanNet)和室外LiDAR(SemanticKITTI)基准测试中，RadiusFPS-G相比GPU-FPS实现最高2.5倍加速，在评估方法中性能匹配或超过QuickFPS，同时仅使用约一半GPU内存，分割精度相当。与学习型FastPoint采样器结合时，端到端推理速度最快。

Conclusion: RadiusFPS使高质量FPS风格采样在延迟和内存受限的机器人视觉场景中变得实用，为实时3D感知系统提供了高效的解决方案。

Abstract: Point clouds are a primary sensory representation for robotic perception, underpinning LiDAR-based autonomous driving, simultaneous localization and mapping (SLAM), and navigation. Within these pipelines, Farthest Point Sampling (FPS) is the most well-known downsampling operator, as its uniform coverage preserves the geometric structure on which downstream perception relies. However, the large time complexity of classical FPS scales poorly with the million-point-per-second rates of modern 3D sensors, making it a dominant latency bottleneck that conflicts with the real-time and limited onboard compute budgets of robotic systems. Therefore, we propose RadiusFPS, an FPS acceleration framework based on spherical voxel pruning that preserves the standard FPS update rule under the same initialization and tie-breaking policy. By indexing the point cloud with spherical voxels, RadiusFPS derives a conservative geometric bound that prunes redundant distance computations in each iteration, complemented by a coordinate-wise point-skip test that removes residual updates. We further introduce RadiusFPS-G, a warp-level GPU implementation that fuses voxel selection, pruning, and distance update into memory-coalesced kernels, eliminating costly global-memory round-trips. On indoor (S3DIS, ScanNet) and outdoor LiDAR (SemanticKITTI) benchmarks, RadiusFPS-G attains up to 2.5x speedup over GPU-based FPS and matches or exceeds QuickFPS among the evaluated methods while using roughly half its GPU memory, with comparable segmentation accuracy. When coupled with the learning-based FastPoint sampler, the resulting pipeline achieves the fastest End-to-End inference among all evaluated configurations. These properties make high-quality FPS-style sampling practical for latency- and memory-constrained robotic vision.

</details>


### [232] [Multi-Resolution Tactile Imitation Learning for Contact-Rich Robotic Manipulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.06281)
*Rickmer Krohn,Erik Helmut,Niklas Funk,Jan Peters,Vignesh Prasad,Georgia Chalvatzaki*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出多分辨率触觉感知框架MiTaS，通过融合RGB相机、GelSight Mini视觉触觉传感器和Evetac高频事件触觉传感器，结合模态专用卷积层与基于Transformer的融合架构，利用流匹配策略解决复杂接触式操作任务。实验表明该方法在五项任务中平均成功率达80%，远超视觉基线（31%）和视觉-触觉基线（54%），且多触觉数据协同训练可提升超10%性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有触觉传感器种类繁多，但如何异构多类触觉传感器的融合以提升操作学习效果仍未被充分探索。

Method: 提出MiTaS框架，包含模态专用卷积茎（处理RGB、GelSight Mini、Evetac三种模态），基于Transformer的融合模块，以及流匹配策略（Flow-Matching Policy）用于下游任务求解。

Result: 五项接触式操作任务上平均成功率80%，视觉基线31%，视觉-触觉基线54%。多触觉数据协同训练可使视觉-触觉模型性能提升超10%，且推理时无需Evetac传感器。

Conclusion: 多分辨率触觉感知有效提升复杂操作任务学习性能，传感器读取与注意力分析验证了不同传感器在任务执行中的重要性。

Abstract: Touch sensing is beneficial for solving a wide variety of manipulation tasks. While there exists a wide range of tactile sensors with different properties, exploiting the fusion of multiple heterogeneous tactile sensors to improve manipulation learning remains underexplored. We present Multi-Resolution Tactile Sensing (MiTaS), a representation framework that leverages multiple tactile sensors operating at different temporal resolutions in order to solve complex contact-rich manipulation tasks. We propose a novel architecture using modality-specific convolutional stems and transformer-based fusion that effectively fuses information from an RGB camera stream, a vision-based GelSight Mini sensor and a high-frequency event-based Evetac sensor. This multi-sensor representation then conditions a flow-matching policy for solving downstream tasks. Experimental results across five contact-rich manipulation tasks demonstrate the effectiveness of multi-resolution tactile features in imitation learning. MiTaS achieves an average success rate of 80 %, while vision-only (31 %) and visual-tactile (54 %) baselines cannot solve the task reliably. Co-training a visuo-tactile model with multi-tactile data boosts performance by over 10 \% in certain tasks, without having access to the Evetac sensor during policy evaluation. A detailed sensor-reading and attention analysis reveals the importance of different sensors throughout task execution, validating our multi-resolution tactile sensing approach. Project Page: http://mitas-touch.github.io.

</details>


### [233] [Attitude-Aided Linear Calibration of Triaxial Accelerometers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.06308)
*Yongqiang Yu,Tian Huang,Yipeng Yang*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出了一种面向三轴MEMS加速度计的姿态辅助线性校准方法（ALAC），利用方向信息构建统一误差模型，通过线性最小二乘和约束齐次最小二乘实现闭环标定，仅需5次任意方向测量，支持在线/离线模式，在机器人平台和公开IMU数据集上优于现有基线方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有MEMS加速度计校准方法要么依赖昂贵的参考设备，要么采用非线性迭代优化，效率低且难以适用于低成本或自校准系统。

Method: ALAC利用任何能提供姿态信息的平台（转台、机械臂、IMU等）构建组合误差矩阵（CEM），将传感器误差纳入统一校准模型，通过线性最小二乘估计偏置和重力矢量（隐式处理平台未对准），再通过矩阵分解恢复刻度、非正交性和对准旋转参数。静态重力下转化为约束齐次最小二乘（CHLS）问题，用标准线性代数闭式求解；只需5次任意方向测量，且支持递归扩展实现在线/现场校准。

Result: 在静止机器人搭载的加速度计和准静态公共IMU轨迹上，ALAC的离线和在线模式在精度和对噪声鲁棒性上均优于基于参考的基线和在线基线；在相同数据集上，滤波条件下匹配迭代自校准，在原始测量上超越所有基线。

Conclusion: ALAC是一种鲁棒且实用的MEMS惯性平台校准方案，尤其适用于低成本IMU和在线校准场景。

Abstract: Triaxial MEMS accelerometers are widely used for inertial sensing, navigation, and sensor fusion, but existing calibration methods often rely on costly reference setups or nonlinear iterative optimization, limiting their efficiency and applicability to low-cost or self-calibrating systems. We present attitude-aided linear accelerometer calibration (ALAC), a method that operates on any platform providing orientation information, such as turntables, robotic arms, or inertial measurement units. ALAC constructs a combined error matrix (CEM) to represent sensor errors in a unified calibration model and enables linear least-squares estimation. The bias and gravity vector are jointly estimated, implicitly accounting for platform misalignment, and matrix decomposition of the CEM recovers scale, non-orthogonality, and alignment rotation parameters. Under static gravity, calibration is formulated as a constrained homogeneous least-squares (CHLS) problem and solved in closed form using standard linear algebra. Only five arbitrarily oriented measurements are required, and a recursive extension supports online or in-field calibration. Experiments on a stationary robot-mounted accelerometer and a quasi-static public IMU trajectory show that ALAC, in both offline and online modes, outperforms reference-based and online baselines in accuracy and robustness to sensor noise. On the same dataset, it matches iterative self-calibration under filtered conditions and surpasses all evaluated baselines on raw measurements. These results demonstrate a robust and practical calibration scheme for MEMS-based inertial platforms, especially low-cost IMUs and online calibration scenarios.

</details>


### [234] [Meridian: Metric-Semantic Primitive Matching for Cross-View Geo-Localization Beyond Urban Environments](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.06312)
*Mason Peterson,Qingyuan Li,Yixuan Jia,Fernando Cladera,Carlos Nieto-Granda,Camillo Jose Taylor,Jonathan P. How*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: Meridian提出了一种利用度量-语义基元匹配航拍图像与地面机器人RGB-D数据的方法，实现无需特定环境训练或微调的全局定位，在多样化环境（包括城市、公园、野外）中平均轨迹误差2.4米，覆盖19公里地面遍历。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: GNSS拒止环境下的可靠全局定位仍是一个开放问题；现有航拍定位方法主要针对结构化城市环境，难以处理自然非结构化地形中的重复几何结构和无特征景观，且依赖针对特定环境训练的模型。

Method: 提出Meridian方法：在航拍图像与地面机器人RGB-D数据之间匹配高层度量-语义基元；设计新颖的一致性度量指标来估计机器人子图位姿的分布；在鲁棒位姿图优化步骤中剔除异常假设，实现精确的机器人轨迹估计。

Result: 在多个环境（自动驾驶数据集、公园与校园区域、野外营地）中进行评估，19公里地面遍历的平均优化轨迹误差为2.4米。

Conclusion: Meridian无需针对特定区域的数据进行训练或算法微调，即可在多样化环境中实现精确的全局定位，具有良好的泛化能力。

Abstract: Successful robot automation requires accurate global localization to support repeatability, task planning, goal specification, and safe operation. However, reliable localization in GNSS-denied environments remains an open problem. Overhead aerial imagery offers a promising solution, but existing approaches primarily target structured urban environments and have been rarely demonstrated in unstructured natural terrain. Limitations of the state-of-the-art include a reliance on models trained for specific environments, as well as difficulty handling repetitive geometries and featureless landscapes commonly found in natural outdoor areas. To overcome these challenges, we present Meridian, a method for matching high-level metric-semantic primitives across aerial images and ground robot RGB-D camera data that achieves accurate global localization and generalizes well across diverse environments, all without any training or algorithmic fine-tuning on area-specific data. We formulate novel consistency metrics to estimate a distribution over robot submap poses and to reject outlier hypotheses in a robust pose graph optimization step for accurate robot trajectory estimation. We demonstrate that our algorithm can localize a ground robot across a wide variety of environments, including an autonomous driving dataset, a park and campus area, and a wilderness camp, with an average optimized trajectory error of 2.4 m over 19 km of ground traversal.

</details>


### [235] [VOLT: Vision and Language Trajectory Segmentation for Faster-than-Demonstration Policies](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.06323)
*Robert Ramirez Sanchez,Daniel J. Evans,Dylan P. Losey,Siddarth Jain*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出VOLT方法，通过视觉-语言轨迹分割，识别演示中可加速和需精确操作的片段，选择性下采样加速数据，使机器人能比演示更快执行任务，同时保持任务性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 实际应用中机器人需要比人类演示更快的执行速度，但现有方法对演示数据均匀下采样会导致关键操作（如精细操作）因加速而失败，需要一种能区分可加速与需精确操作片段的方法。

Method: 提出VOLT（Vision-and-Language Trajectory Segmentation），基于视觉和语言线索对视频演示进行轨迹分割，识别需要慢速精确操作片段，仅对剩余可加速片段进行下采样，生成加速后的轨迹数据，再用于标准模仿学习方法（如扩散策略）。

Result: 实验表明VOLT优于均匀下采样等基线方法，分割质量至关重要——基线方法常错误判断可加速区域，导致策略过于谨慎或不可靠；VOLT在提速的同时保持良好任务性能。

Conclusion: VOLT通过上下文感知的轨迹分割，有效实现了机器人超演示速度执行任务，验证了选择性加速相比均匀加速的优势。

Abstract: Humans often take longer to demonstrate a task than a robot would need to execute it. Rather than learning to replicate the demonstration at the same pace, many industrial and practical applications require robots to perform tasks as quickly as possible. In this paper, we investigate several hypotheses for learning policies that operate faster-than-demonstrations. Our experiments show that the most effective strategy is to downsample recorded demonstrations and train the robot's policy on this accelerated data. However, uniformly downsampling an entire trajectory can be problematic. Some parts of a task can be safely sped up (e.g., unconstrained motion), while others demand slower, more precise motion (e.g., object interactions or fine manipulation). To address this challenge, we introduce VOLT, a vision-and-language trajectory segmentation method that reasons over video demonstrations, and leverages contextual cues to determine when acceleration is appropriate and when careful precision is required. VOLT identifies segments where slow, deliberate motion is necessary, then selectively downsamples the remaining segments. The resulting reformatted trajectories can be used with standard imitation learning approaches, such as diffusion policies. Our results highlight that segmentation quality is critical -- baseline methods often misidentify when acceleration is possible, leading to overly cautious or unreliable policies. Compared to state-of-the-art alternatives, VOLT allows robots to execute tasks faster while maintaining strong performance.

</details>


### [236] [Waypoints Matter: A Systematic Study for Sampling-Based Trajectory Planning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.06366)
*Josep M. Barbera,Antonio Artuñedo,Jorge Villagra*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文系统研究了轨迹规划器中目标路径点（waypoint）的放置策略对规划器性能的影响。通过固定轨迹基元和候选数量，在449种配置和5张地图上对比均匀间距、RDP*和曲率条件分配三种策略，发现标称间距d_s是性能主导因素，均匀采样在良好调参下表现最佳，曲率感知策略仅在几何复杂道路上略有优势。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 路径点放置直接影响可行轨迹的存在性与质量，但其对规划器性能的影响尚未被充分探索。现有工作通常将路径点放置视为次要因素，本文将其提升为第一类设计变量进行系统性研究。

Method: 固定轨迹基元和候选预算不变，在449种配置和5张几何复杂度递增的CommonRoad地图上，系统对比三种路径点放置策略：均匀间距、增强型Ramer-Douglas-Peucker变体（RDP*）以及新型曲率条件分配策略。

Result: 标称间距d_s是性能主导因素，仅凭放置策略的不同即可导致规划器可靠性出现巨大差异。均匀采样在良好调参后达到或超越RDP*和曲率变体。曲率变体在几何复杂道路上略有优势，而RDP*从未优于均匀采样。

Conclusion: d_s应作为主导调参参数，几何感知策略仅保留用于曲率丰富的走廊场景，此时可行性是限制性因素。

Abstract: Real-time autonomous driving commonly relies on sampling-based trajectory planners that link candidate trajectories to target waypoints along the road centerline. The placement of these waypoints directly impacts both the existence and quality of feasible trajectories. Yet, its effect on planner performance remains largely unexplored. In this paper, we treat waypoint placement as a first-class design variable. We hold the trajectory primitive and candidate budget fixed, and systematically sweep three placement strategies (uniform spacing, an augmented Ramer-Douglas-Peucker variant (RDP*), and a novel curvature-conditioned allocation) across 449 configurations and five CommonRoad maps of increasing geometric complexity. Our results show that the nominal inter-waypoint spacing $d_s$ is the primary performance driver, with large differences in planner reliability attributed to placement alone. Uniform sampling at a well-tuned spacing matches or surpasses both RDP* and the centered curvature variant. The curvature variant offers a small but consistent advantage on geometrically complex roads under reliability-first and balanced weightings, while RDP* never outperforms uniform sampling. These findings suggest that $d_s$ should be treated as the dominant tuning parameter, with geometry-aware strategies reserved for curvature-rich corridors where feasibility is the limiting factor.

</details>


### [237] [Ensuring Interaction Safety in Multitask Exoskeleton Control: A Simulation-Trained Variable Impedance Framework](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.06370)
*Muyuan Ma,Houcheng Li,Haotian Zhai,Lijun Han,Xinpan Meng,Xiuze Xia,Long Cheng*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出了一种基于仿真训练的可变阻抗控制方法，通过PPO生成人体-外骨骼运动数据，训练双模态策略网络预测参考轨迹和可变阻抗增益，并利用李雅普诺夫稳定性理论约束刚度变化，实现了多任务安全外骨骼控制，实验证明能降低代谢成本。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 可穿戴外骨骼需要适应多样化任务的同时保证交互安全，现有方法难以兼顾这两方面挑战。

Method: 1) 建立基于仿真的人体-外骨骼运动数据生成流程，利用PPO合成肌肉激活信号，外骨骼直接补偿人体关节力矩；2) 训练双模态策略网络，融合语义指令与本体感知历史，预测参考轨迹和可变阻抗增益（支持九种运动任务）；3) 基于李雅普诺夫稳定性理论约束网络输出，限制刚度变化以保证耦合系统渐近稳定性。

Result: 在真实场景中，该方法相比标准基线降低了代谢成本。

Conclusion: 该框架实现了安全、多任务的外骨骼控制，具有可行性和有效性。

Abstract: Wearable exoskeletons can augment human phys ical capabilities during complex activities. However, ensuring adaptation across diverse tasks while guaranteeing interaction safety remains a critical challenge. To address this, a simulation trained variable impedance control approach with stability guarantees is proposed. First, a simulation-based human exoskeleton motion data generation pipeline is established, utilizing Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO) to synthesize human muscle activations while the exoskeleton provides direct compensation for human biological joint torques. Subsequently, the generated dataset is used to train a dual modality policy that fuses semantic instructions with proprioceptive history, enabling the prediction of reference trajectories and variable impedance gains for nine different motion tasks. To guarantee safety, the network outputs are constrained by a stability criterion derived from Lyapunov stability theory, which bounds stiffness variations to ensure the asymptotic stability of the coupled system. Experimental results indicate that the proposed framework reduces metabolic cost in real-world scenarios com pared with standard baseline methods. These findings suggest the feasibility of the proposed framework for safe, multitask exoskeleton control.

</details>


### [238] [RiskFlow: Fast and Faithful Safety-Critical Traffic Scenario Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.06423)
*Qi Lan,Yining Tang,Yu Shen,Yi Zhou,Yuhao Wei,Jie Li,Guofa Li*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: RiskFlow提出了一种基于动作空间传输的闭环安全关键多智能体交通生成框架，通过单次前向传递学习平均速度场将高斯动作序列转换为加速度和横摆角速度指令，避免了迭代去噪的计算开销和累积误差，在保持强对抗性的同时显著提升了真实感和推理效率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于扩散的交通场景生成方法在闭环生成中虽具有良好的可控性，但其迭代去噪过程计算开销大，且在长距离 rollout 中会累积采样和引导误差，导致抖动、异常加速、偏离道路等不真实的运动伪影。

Method: RiskFlow将未来轨迹生成建模为动作空间中的传输问题，学习有限区间上的平均速度场以单次前向传递将高斯动作序列映射为加速度和横摆角速度命令；使用JVP（Jacobian-Vector Product）目标实现高效稳定训练；测试时对生成动作施加输出空间引导以驱动关键智能体产生风险交互并正则化偏离道路行为，再通过车辆动力学重建物理可行的轨迹。

Result: 在nuScenes数据集上的tbsim闭环评估表明，RiskFlow在多智能体和长时域设置下实现了强对抗性与真实性的权衡，相比代表性基线方法持续提升真实性，同时保持具有竞争力的安全关键生成能力，并大幅减少推理时间。

Conclusion: RiskFlow通过将生成过程从迭代去噪转变为动作空间中的单次传输，有效解决了扩散模型在安全关键场景生成中的效率与累积误差问题，为实现高效、真实且可控的自动驾驶测试场景生成提供了新范式。

Abstract: Safety-critical traffic scenario generation is essential for evaluating autonomous driving systems under rare but high-risk interactions. Existing diffusion-based methods offer strong controllability in closed-loop generation, but their iterative denoising process is computationally expensive and may accumulate sampling and guidance errors over long rollouts, causing unrealistic motion artifacts such as jitter, abnormal acceleration, and off-road behavior. To address these issues, we propose RiskFlow, a closed-loop safety-critical multi-agent traffic generation framework that formulates future trajectory generation as transport in the action space. Instead of relying on iterative denoising, RiskFlow learns an average velocity field over a finite interval to transform Gaussian action sequences into future acceleration and yaw-rate commands with a single forward pass, using a JVP-based objective for efficient and stable training. At test time, RiskFlow applies output-space guidance to the generated actions, steering selected critical agents toward risky interactions while regularizing off-road behavior, and reconstructs physically feasible trajectories through vehicle dynamics. Experiments on nuScenes with tbsim closed-loop evaluation show that RiskFlow achieves a strong adversariality-realism trade-off across multi-agent and long-horizon settings. Compared with representative baselines, RiskFlow consistently improves realism while maintaining competitive safety-critical generation capability, and substantially reduces inference time for evaluation.

</details>


### [239] [Flow-based Policy Adaptation without Policy Updates](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.06461)
*Luzhe Sun,Jingtian Ji,Haoran Chen,Jiawei Zhou,Matthew R. Walter*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: GLOVES提出了一种基于流的动作适应方法，通过将非专家动作向专家动作分布迁移来校正次优、噪声或不一致的动作，并利用逆向流评估分数作为干预门控，仅对异常或分布外动作进行修正，从而在保持智能体意图的同时提升任务成功率，仅需少量专家演示即可实现轻量级的共享控制。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 利用预训练策略、基础模型或人类操作员的先验知识比从头学习机器人技能更高效，但这些智能体往往提供次优、噪声或与任务特定专家行为不一致的动作。因此需要一种方法能够校正非专家动作，同时保持原始智能体的意图，并在必要时才提供干预。

Method: 提出GLOVES，一种基于流的适应方法家族，通过将非专家动作向专家动作分布进行传输来校正动作。方法包括：（1）学习一个可逆的归一化流，将动作映射到专家分布；（2）利用逆向流评估分数作为干预门控信号，对与专家分布一致的动作不做修改，仅对异常或分布外动作进行校正；（3）仅需少量专家演示或可复用的成功技能片段进行训练，通过学习局部专家动作模式并在执行过程中拼接实现轻量级共享控制。

Result: GLOVES能够在保持原始智能体意图的同时提高任务成功率，通过选择性动作级适应而非完全自主控制来实现。逆向流评估分数作为自然的分值机制有效地区分了分布内和分布外动作，实现了仅对必要动作进行干预。

Conclusion: GLOVES提供了一种轻量级的共享控制模块，通过局部专家动作模式学习和执行时拼接，能够在不同任务和环境间实现鲁棒的动作适应，仅需有限的专家监督。

Abstract: Leveraging prior knowledge from pretrained policies, foundation models, or human operators offers an efficient alternative to learning robot skills from scratch. However, these agents often provide actions that are suboptimal, noisy, or misaligned with task-specific expert behavior. We propose GLOVES, a family of flow-based adaptation methods that correct non-expert actions by transporting them toward an expert action distribution. Rather than replacing agentic control with full autonomy, GLOVES performs selective action-level adaptation, improving task success while preserving agent intent. The learned flow also provides a natural in-distribution scoring mechanism through reverse flow evaluation. We use this signal as an intervention gate: actions that appear consistent with the expert distribution are passed through unchanged, while anomalous or out-of-distribution (OOD) actions are corrected. In this way, assistance is only provided when necessary. GLOVES requires only limited expert supervision, using a small number of demonstrations or reusable successful skill segments. By learning local expert action patterns and stitching them during execution, GLOVES provides a lightweight shared-control module for robust action adaptation across tasks and environments. Code and demos are available at ripl.github.io/GLOVES_web.

</details>


### [240] [TempoVLA: Learning Speed-Controllable Vision-Language-Action Policies](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.06491)
*Dong Jing,Jingchen Nie,Tianqi Zhang,Jiaqi Liu,Huaxiu Yao,Zhiwu Lu,Mingyu Ding*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: TempoVLA是一个通过显式速度条件控制机器人执行速度的单一VLA模型，结合可变速度轨迹增强（VSTA）和模型侧条件机制，实现灵活的双向速度调节，并能与大模型协同实现动态速度控制。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有VLA模型只能从训练演示中继承单一固定速度，加速方法（模型压缩、KV缓存复用、强化学习）仅将策略从一个固定速度迁移到另一个，几乎未探索减速控制。

Method: 提出TempoVLA，包含(1)数据侧VSTA：通过合并或拆分动作重新定时演示到任意目标速度，同时保持运动语义；(2)模型侧条件机制：将速度条件显式输入策略网络。

Result: VSTA能以可忽略的运动误差达到请求速度；仿真和真实实验表明TempoVLA实现双向灵活速度控制；VSTA通过更好的数据利用提升了默认1×性能；与大模型协同实现动态速度控制。

Conclusion: 动作幅度本身就控制着机器人移动速度，通过显式速度条件可实现可控的执行速度；动态速度控制能有效应对低风险快速通过和高风险减速精确操作的需求。

Abstract: Robot manipulation alternates between low-risk transit phases that call for fast execution and high-risk contact stages that demand slow, precise motion. Yet existing Vision-Language-Action models (VLAs) only inherit a single fixed speed from training demonstrations. Prior efforts to accelerate VLAs through model compression, KV-cache reuse, or reinforcement learning only shift the policy from one fixed speed to another, and leave deceleration almost unexplored. We observe that the magnitude of each predicted action already governs how fast the robot moves, opening a direct route to controllable execution speed. We turn this observation into TempoVLA, a single VLA whose execution speed is controlled by an explicit condition. TempoVLA combines two coupled components. (1) A data-side Variable-Speed Trajectory Augmentation (VSTA) that re-times demonstration to any target speed by merging or splitting actions while preserving its motion semantics. (2) A model-side conditioning mechanism that feeds the speed to the policy. Statistics show that VSTA reaches the requested speed with negligible motion error. Experiments in simulation and on real-world tasks demonstrate that TempoVLA achieves flexible speed control in both directions, while VSTA additionally boosts the default $1\times$ performance via better data utilization. Furthermore, by cooperating with a large multimodal model, TempoVLA realizes dynamic speed control, accelerating through low-risk phases and decelerating for high-risk ones.

</details>


### [241] [HANDOFF: Humanoid Agentic Task-Space Whole-Body Control via Distilled Complementary Teachers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.06493)
*Lizhi Yang,Junheng Li,Nehar Poddar,Yiling Hou,Gio Huh,Robert Griffin,Georgia Gkioxari,Aaron Ames*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: HANDOFF是一个基于紧凑显式接口的人形机器人全身控制器，通过多教师KL蒸馏和混合专家架构整合运动跟踪、行走和跌倒恢复三种技能，在Unitree G1上实现了SOTA的速度跟踪和最大鲁棒操作工作空间，并支持自然语言驱动的零样本任务执行。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有全身控制器需要稠密的运动学或空间参考信号，而任务规划器难以从任务语义中合成这些信号。为此，需要一种紧凑、直观且表达能力强的接口来桥接任务规划和全身控制。

Method: 提出HANDOFF框架：1) 设计紧凑显式的接口作为任务规划与控制的中间表示；2) 使用上下文条件门控机制的多教师KL蒸馏，将三个专家教师（全身运动跟踪+安全过滤数据、行走、跌倒恢复）的知识蒸馏到一个混合专家学生模型中。

Result: 在Unitree G1上，HANDOFF匹配了SOTA的速度跟踪性能，实现了最大的鲁棒操作工作空间之一；通过VLM驱动的智能体规划器实现了多个自然语言驱动的任务执行，无需任务特定数据或控制器微调。

Conclusion: 所提出的紧凑接口和蒸馏框架能够有效结合多种专家技能，使人形机器人能够在无额外训练的情况下直接执行自然语言指令所描述的操作任务，具有良好的通用性和泛化能力。

Abstract: For a humanoid robot to be deployed in the real world, the choice of command space (i.e., the interface between task planning and whole-body control) is crucial. Existing whole-body controllers typically demand dense kinematic or spatial references that planners struggle to synthesize from task semantics. We instead propose a compact, explicit interface that is intuitive, general, modular, and expressive enough for diverse manipulation skills. To this end, we introduce HANDOFF, a single humanoid whole-body controller that follows this interface and is distilled via multi-teacher KL distillation under a context-conditioned gating scheme into a mixture-of-experts student from three complementary specialists: whole-body motion tracking with safety-filtered data, locomotion, and fall-recovery. On the Unitree G1, HANDOFF matches state-of-the-art velocity tracking and offers one of the largest robust manipulation workspaces. We further demonstrate hardware feasibility through multiple natural-language-driven task roll-outs, powered by a VLM-driven agentic planner with no task-specific data or controller fine-tuning.

</details>


### [242] [Is Diversity All You Need for Scalable Robotic Manipulation?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2507.06219)
*Modi Shi,Li Chen,Jin Chen,Yuxiang Lu,Chiming Liu,Guanghui Ren,Ping Luo,Di Huang,Maoqing Yao,Hongyang Li*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文研究了机器人操作中数据多样性的三个维度（任务、本体、专家）对策略学习的影响，发现任务多样性最关键、多本体预训练并非必需、专家多样性会干扰学习，并提出了基于速度解耦的分布去偏方法GO-1-Pro，性能提升15%相当于使用2.5倍预训练数据。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 数据缩放策略在NLP和CV领域已取得显著成功，但在机器人操作领域有效的数据缩放原则尚未被充分理解，现有直觉"越多样越好"的局限性需要被系统性地审视和挑战。

Method: 通过在不同机器人平台上进行大量实验，系统研究了任务多样性、本体多样性、专家多样性三个维度的作用；基于专家多样性中速度多模态性作为关键混淆因素的发现，提出了分布去偏方法以缓解速度模糊性。

Result: (1)任务多样性比单任务演示数量更关键，能促进从预训练任务到新下游场景的迁移；(2)多本体预训练数据对跨本体迁移是可选的，高质量单本体数据微调效果更好；(3)专家多样性会干扰策略学习，速度多模态性是关键因素；提出的GO-1-Pro方法获得15%性能提升，相当于2.5倍预训练数据的效果。

Conclusion: 这些发现提供了机器人操作数据集有效缩放的新视角和实用指导，挑战了"越多样越好"的直觉，为未来机器人学习中的数据策略设计提供了重要参考。

Abstract: Data scaling has driven remarkable success in foundation models for Natural Language Processing (NLP) and Computer Vision (CV), yet the principles of effective data scaling in robotic manipulation remain insufficiently understood. In this work, we investigate the nuanced role of data diversity in robot learning by examining three critical dimensions-task (what to do), embodiment (which robot to use), and expert (who demonstrates)-challenging the conventional intuition of "more diverse is better". Throughout extensive experiments on various robot platforms, we reveal that (1) task diversity proves more critical than per-task demonstration quantity, benefiting transfer from diverse pre-training tasks to novel downstream scenarios; (2) multi-embodiment pre-training data is optional for cross-embodiment transfer-models trained on high-quality single-embodiment data can efficiently transfer to different platforms, showing more desirable scaling property during fine-tuning than multi-embodiment pre-trained models; and (3) expert diversity, arising from individual operational preferences and stochastic variations in human demonstrations, can be confounding to policy learning, with velocity multimodality emerging as a key contributing factor. Based on this insight, we propose a distribution debiasing method to mitigate velocity ambiguity, the yielding GO-1-Pro achieves substantial performance gains of 15%, equivalent to using 2.5 times pre-training data. Collectively, these findings provide new perspectives and offer practical guidance on how to scale robotic manipulation datasets effectively.

</details>


### [243] [PHUMA: Physically Reliable Humanoid Locomotion Dataset](https://arxiv.org/abs/2510.26236)
*Kyungmin Lee,Sibeen Kim,Youngdo Lee,Minho Park,Hyunseung Kim,Dongyoon Hwang,Donghu Kim,Hojoon Lee,Jaegul Choo*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出PHUMA，一个物理可靠的人形运动数据集，通过物理感知筛选和物理约束重定向的两阶段流程，将运动捕捉数据和大规模互联网视频整合为73小时的可靠语料。在该数据集上训练的策略在运动跟踪基准上优于AMASS和Humanoid-X，并能零样本迁移到真实Unitree G1机器人。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有运动模仿方法依赖高质量但稀缺昂贵的运动捕捉数据集（如AMASS），限制了可扩展性和多样性。虽有人试图用互联网视频扩展数据量（如Humanoid-X），但这类数据存在漂浮、穿透、脚滑等物理伪影，阻碍了稳定模仿。

Method: 两阶段流程：第一阶段物理感知筛选（physics-aware curation），过滤存在物理伪影的视频数据；第二阶段物理约束重定向（physics-constrained retargeting），将筛选后的数据重定向到人形机器人上，确保物理合理性。

Result: 在运动跟踪基准上，PHUMA训练的策略成功率高于AMASS和Humanoid-X训练的模型，并且成功零样本迁移到真实Unitree G1机器人上。

Conclusion: 通过物理感知的流程从互联网视频中构建物理可靠的运动数据集是可行且有效的，能够提升人形机器人运动模仿的稳定性和泛化能力。

Abstract: Motion imitation is a promising approach for humanoid locomotion, enabling agents to acquire humanlike behaviors. Existing methods typically rely on high-quality motion capture datasets such as AMASS, but these are scarce and expensive, limiting scalability and diversity. Recent studies attempt to scale data collection by converting large-scale internet videos, exemplified by Humanoid-X. However, they often suffer from physical artifacts such as floating, penetration, and foot skating, which hinder stable imitation. To address this, we introduce PHUMA, a Physically Reliable HUMAnoid locomotion dataset produced by a two-stage pipeline combining physics-aware curation and physics-constrained retargeting, aggregating both motion capture and internet video into a physically reliable, 73-hour corpus. On motion tracking benchmarks, PHUMA-trained policies achieve higher success rates than those trained on AMASS and Humanoid-X, and successfully transfer zero-shot to a real Unitree G1. The code is available at https://davian-robotics.github.io/PHUMA.

</details>


### [244] [EVE: A Generator-Verifier System for Generative Policies](https://arxiv.org/abs/2512.21430)
*Yusuf Ali,Gryphon Patlin,Karthik Kothuri,Jeremiah Coholich,Muhammad Zubair Irshad,Wuwei Liang,Zsolt Kira*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: EVE是一种无需额外训练的模块化框架，通过在预训练生成策略的基础上集成多个零样本VLM验证器，在测试时通过生成-验证交互提升机器人操作策略的性能和鲁棒性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基于扩散和流匹配的生成式视觉运动策略在分布偏移下性能退化严重，且缺乏有效的恢复能力；而语言模型中测试时计算扩展（如通过验证器进行候选解精炼）已显著提升推理能力。作者假设生成式策略可借鉴此类方法，利用零样本VLM验证器在推理阶段提升性能。

Method: EVE采用模块化生成器-验证器交互框架：冻结的基础策略作为生成器产生候选动作；多个零样本VLM验证器分别提出动作精炼建议；动作融合器通过分类器引导将聚合的验证器反馈融入动作去噪过程。系统设计了验证器间信息交互的接口策略。

Result: 在多种模拟和真实机器人任务及不同机器人形态上，EVE一致地提升了任务成功率，无需额外训练策略或验证器。消融实验隔离了验证器能力和动作融合策略的贡献。

Conclusion: EVE证明了测试时计算扩展对生成式机器人策略的有效性，提供了构建可扩展模块化生成器-验证器系统的实用指南，为无需额外训练的机器人策略性能提升提供了新范式。

Abstract: Visuomotor policies based on generative such as diffusion and flow-matching have shown strong performance for robotics applications but degrade under distribution shifts, demonstrating limited recovery capabilities without costly finetuning. In the language modeling domain, test-time compute scaling has revolutionized the reasoning capabilities of modern LLMs by enabling candidate solution refinement. These methods typically leverage foundation models as verification modules in a zero-shot manner to score candidate solutions. We hypothesize that generative policies can similarly benefit from additional inference-time compute that employs zero-shot VLM-based verifiers in a generation-verification framework. To this end, we introduce EVE: a modular, generator-verifier interaction framework that boosts the performance of pretrained generative policies at test time, with no additional training. EVE wraps a frozen base policy with multiple zero-shot, VLM-based verifier agents. Each verifier proposes action refinements to the base policy candidate actions, while an action incorporator uses classifier guidance to fuse aggregated verifier feedback into action denoising. We study design choices for generator-verifier information interfacing across a system of verifiers with distinct capabilities. Across diverse simulated and real robotic tasks and embodiments, EVE consistently improves success rates without additional policy or verifier training. Through extensive ablations, we isolate the contribution of verifier capabilities and action incorporator strategies, offering practical guidelines to build scalable, modular generator-verifier systems for embodied control.

</details>


### [245] [EgoHumanoid: Unlocking In-the-Wild Loco-Manipulation with Robot-Free Egocentric Demonstration](https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.10106)
*Modi Shi,Shijia Peng,Jin Chen,Haoran Jiang,Tianyu Li,Di Huang,Ping Luo,Hongyang Li,Li Chen*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: EgoHumanoid是首个利用丰富第一人称人类演示与少量机器人数据联合训练视觉-语言-动作策略的框架，使类人机器人能够在多样化真实环境中执行全身感知-操作任务。通过引入从硬件到数据的系统对齐流程（视图对齐+动作对齐），在未见环境中相比纯机器人基线提升51%性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 人类演示具有环境多样性和天然可扩展性，是遥操作的有效替代方案；但该范式在更具挑战性的类人机器人全身感知-操作问题上尚未被探索。

Method: 提出EgoHumanoid框架，核心是"人-到-类人"对齐流程：(1) 视图对齐——减少由相机高度和视角差异导致的视觉域差距；(2) 动作对齐——将人体运动映射到统一且运动学可行的类人机器人动作空间。设计了便携式人体数据采集系统和实用采集协议，并联合少量机器人数据进行共同训练。

Result: 真实世界实验表明，融入无机器人标记的第一人称数据相比纯机器人基线在未见环境中性能提升51%，验证了人类数据扩展的有效性。

Conclusion: 人类演示数据可显著提升类人机器人全身感知-操作能力，且该方法具有进一步扩展的潜力。

Abstract: Human demonstrations offer rich environmental diversity and scale naturally, making them an appealing alternative to robot teleoperation. While this paradigm has advanced robot-arm manipulation, its potential for the more challenging, data-hungry problem of humanoid loco-manipulation remains largely unexplored. We present EgoHumanoid, the first framework to co-train a vision-language-action policy using abundant egocentric human demonstrations together with a limited amount of robot data, enabling humanoids to perform loco-manipulation across diverse real-world environments. To bridge the embodiment gap between humans and robots, including discrepancies in physical morphology and viewpoint, we introduce a systematic alignment pipeline spanning from hardware design to data processing. A portable system for scalable human data collection is developed, and we establish practical collection protocols to improve transferability. At the core of our human-to-humanoid alignment pipeline lies two key components. The view alignment reduces visual domain discrepancies caused by camera height and perspective variation. The action alignment maps human motions into a unified, kinematically feasible action space for humanoid control. Extensive real-world experiments demonstrate that incorporating robot-free egocentric data significantly outperforms robot-only baselines by 51\%, particularly in unseen environments. Our analysis further reveals which behaviors transfer effectively and the potential for scaling human data.

</details>


### [246] [Beyond Imitation: Reinforcement Learning-Based Sim-Real Co-Training for VLA Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.12628)
*Liangzhi Shi,Shuaihang Chen,Feng Gao,Yinuo Chen,Kang Chen,Tonghe Zhang,Hongzhi Zang,Jiakai Zhou,Weinan Zhang,Chao Yu,Yu Wang*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出基于强化学习的仿真-真实联合训练框架RL-Co，通过两阶段方法（先SFT预热再RL微调+真实数据辅助损失）提升VLA策略在真实世界的成功率和泛化能力，在OpenVLA和π0.5上分别取得+24%和+20%的成功率提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有仿真-真实联合训练方法大多依赖监督微调（SFT），将仿真视为静态示范源，未能利用大规模闭环交互，导致真实世界增益和泛化能力有限。

Method: 两阶段框架：阶段一用混合真实与仿真示范进行SFT预热；阶段二在仿真环境中进行RL微调，同时添加针对真实数据的辅助监督损失以锚定策略、缓解灾难性遗忘。

Result: 在四个真实桌面操作任务上，使用OpenVLA和π0.5两种架构，RL-Co相比纯真实微调和SFT联合训练分别实现OpenVLA +24%、π0.5 +20%的成功率提升，并展现出更强的泛化能力和数据效率。

Conclusion: RL-Co为利用仿真增强真实机器人部署提供了一种实用且可扩展的路径，通过交互式仿真训练而非单纯静态示范来提升真实世界性能。

Abstract: Simulation offers a scalable and low-cost way to enrich vision-language-action (VLA) training, reducing reliance on expensive real-robot demonstrations. However, most sim-real co-training methods rely on supervised fine-tuning (SFT), which treats simulation as a static source of demonstrations and does not exploit large-scale closed-loop interaction. Consequently, real-world gains and generalization are often limited. In this paper, we propose an RL-based sim-real Co-training (RL-Co) framework that leverages interactive simulation while preserving real-world capabilities. Our method follows a generic two-stage design: we first warm-start the policy with SFT on a mixture of real and simulated demonstrations, then fine-tune it with reinforcement learning in simulation while adding an auxiliary supervised loss on real-world data to anchor the policy and mitigate catastrophic forgetting. We evaluate our framework on four real-world tabletop manipulation tasks using two representative VLA architectures, OpenVLA and $π_{0.5}$, and observe consistent improvements over real-only fine-tuning and SFT-based co-training, including +24% real-world success on OpenVLA and +20% on $π_{0.5}$. Beyond higher success rates, RL co-training yields stronger generalization to unseen task variations and substantially improved real-world data efficiency, providing a practical and scalable pathway for leveraging simulation to enhance real-robot deployment.

</details>


### [247] [HERO: Learning Humanoid End-Effector Control for Visual Whole-Body Open-Vocabulary Object Grasping](https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.16705)
*Runpei Dong,Ziyan Li,Arjun Gupta,Xialin He,Saurabh Gupta*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出HERO模块化系统，结合大视觉模型与模拟训练，通过残差感知的末端执行器跟踪策略实现任意日常物体的视觉定位操作，将跟踪误差降至2.44cm（优于此前方法5.5倍），并在多种真实环境中成功抓取各类物体。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有模仿学习和sim2real方法通过端到端学习同时处理场景理解与末端执行器控制，难以扩展。本文旨在结合大视觉模型（通用场景理解）和模拟训练（精确EE控制）的最佳工具，构建模块化且泛化能力强的视觉定位操作系统。

Method: 核心创新HERO：残差感知的末端执行器跟踪策略。包含三个组件：(a) 逆运动学将残差末端执行器目标转换为参考轨迹；(b) 学习型神经正向模型实现精确正向运动学；(c) 目标调整与重新规划。整体系统结合大视觉模型进行场景理解。

Result: 末端执行器跟踪误差降至2.44cm，比此前最强方法提升5.5倍。在办公室、咖啡馆等真实环境中，机器人成功抓取杯子、苹果、玩具等多种日常物体，抓取高度范围为43cm至92cm。

Conclusion: 模块化设计的有效性在系统级和端到端测试中得到验证，为人形机器人日常物体交互训练开辟了新途径。

Abstract: Visual loco-manipulation of arbitrary in-the-wild objects requires accurate end-effector (EE) control and a generalizable understanding of the scene from visual inputs (eg, RGB-D images). Existing imitation and sim2real methods jointly learn both these aspects via monolithic end-to-end learning and are thus hard to scale. In this work, we bring to bear the best tools for each of these problems -- large vision models for generalizable scene understanding and simulated training for accurate EE control -- leading to an overall modular loco-manipulation system that exhibits strong generalization. Our core technical innovation is HERO, an accurate residual-aware EE tracking policy made possible by combining classical robotics with machine learning. It uses a) inverse kinematics to convert residual end-effector targets into reference trajectories, b) a learned neural forward model for accurate forward kinematics, and c) goal adjustment and replanning. Together, these innovations reduce the end-effector tracking error to 2.44cm, outperforming the strongest prior method by 5.5x. Our overall system operates in diverse real-world environments, from offices to coffee shops, where the robot reliably grasps various everyday objects (eg, mugs, apples, toys) on surfaces ranging from 43cm to 92cm in height. Systematic modular and end-to-end tests demonstrate the effectiveness of our proposed design. We believe our advances open up new ways of training humanoids to interact with daily objects.

</details>


### [248] [ContactExplorer: Contact Coverage-Guided Exploration for General-Purpose Dexterous Manipulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.10971)
*Zixuan Liu,Ruoyi Qiao,Chenrui Tie,Xuanwei Liu,Yunfan Lou,Chongkai Gao,Zhixuan Xu,Lin Shao*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出ContactExplorer，一种基于接触模式探索的灵巧操作通用方法，通过维护接触计数器来奖励新颖接触模式并引导智能体探索未充分接触的区域，在多种灵巧操作任务中显著提升样本效率和成功率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有强化学习方法在Atari游戏、导航等领域成功应用中依赖状态或动力学的 novelty 信号，但在灵巧操作任务中，基于接触的 novelty 信号不稳定、距离 novelty 信号低效，且常需任务特定先验知识。需要一种通用的、不依赖任务先验的探索方法。

Method: 将接触表示为物体表面点与手部关键点的交集，通过学习的哈希码对离散化的物体状态进行条件化，维护接触计数器记录每个手指与不同物体区域的交互频率。基于计数器设计两种互补奖励：计数基础的接触覆盖奖励（促进新颖接触模式探索）和能量基础的到达奖励（引导智能体前往未充分探索的接触区域）。

Result: 在多种灵巧操作任务上的实验表明，ContactExplorer在样本效率和成功率上显著优于现有探索方法，并且学到的接触模式能够鲁棒地迁移到真实世界。

Conclusion: 基于接触模式的探索方法可以有效解决灵巧操作中的探索难题，证明接触模式本身作为探索信号具有通用性和可迁移性。

Abstract: Reinforcement learning has achieved remarkable success in domains such as Atari games, navigation, and locomotion, where exploration can often be guided by novelty over states or dynamics. In contrast, dexterous manipulation requires rich physical hand--object interactions, but existing methods often suffer from unstable contact-based novelty signals, inefficient distance novelty signals, or reliance on task-specific priors. We propose ContactExplorer, a general exploration method for dexterous manipulation tasks. ContactExplorer represents contact as the intersection between object surface points and hand keypoints, encouraging dexterous hands to discover diverse and novel contact patterns, namely which fingers contact which object regions. It maintains a contact counter conditioned on discretized object states obtained via learned hash codes, capturing how frequently each finger interacts with different object regions. This counter is leveraged in two complementary ways: (1) to assign a count-based contact coverage reward that promotes exploration of novel contact patterns, and (2) an energy-based reaching reward that guides the agent toward under-explored contact regions. We evaluate ContactExplorer on a diverse set of dexterous manipulation tasks. Experimental results show that ContactExplorer substantially improves sample efficiency and success rates over existing exploration methods, and that the contact patterns learned with ContactExplorer transfer robustly to the real world. Project page is https://contact-explorer.github.io.

</details>


### [249] [Enhancing Multi-Robot Exploration Using Probabilistic Frontier Prioritization with Dirichlet Process Gaussian Mixtures](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.03042)
*John Lewis Devassy,Meysam Basiri,Mário A. T. Figueiredo,Pedro U. Lima*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于狄利克雷过程高斯混合模型（DP-GMM）和概率化信息增益的增强方法，用于改进多智能体自主探索中的前沿优先级排序，在两种最先进算法上分别实现平均10%和14%的性能提升，并通过双无人机真实实验验证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多智能体自主探索在环境监测、搜救等应用中至关重要，但在通信约束下实现有效协调仍面临重大挑战，现有前沿探索算法在前沿优先级排序方面存在不足。

Method: 提出一种概率化的前沿优先级排序增强方法，利用狄利克雷过程高斯混合模型（DP-GMM）对前沿点进行聚类建模，并结合信息增益的概率化公式来评估每个前沿区域的探索价值，从而提升优先级排序质量。

Result: 在两种最先进的多智能体探索算法上集成所提增强方法，在不同环境复杂度、通信约束和团队规模下均有一致性性能提升，仿真实验中两种算法分别获得平均10%和14%的增益，双无人机真实实验进一步验证了效果。

Conclusion: 所提出的基于DP-GMM的概率化前沿优先级排序方法能有效提升多智能体自主探索效率，在不同条件下均表现鲁棒，且具有实际部署可行性。

Abstract: Multi-agent autonomous exploration is essential for applications such as environmental monitoring, search and rescue, and industrial-scale surveillance. However, effective coordination under communication constraints remains a significant challenge. Frontier exploration algorithms analyze the boundary between the known and unknown regions to determine the next-best view that maximizes exploratory gain. This article proposes an enhancement to existing frontier-based exploration algorithms by introducing a probabilistic approach to frontier prioritization. By leveraging Dirichlet process Gaussian mixture model (DP-GMM) and a probabilistic formulation of information gain, the method improves the quality of frontier prioritization. The proposed enhancement, integrated into two state-of-the-art multi-agent exploration algorithms, consistently improves performance across environments of varying clutter, communication constraints, and team sizes. Simulations showcase an average gain of $10\%$ and $14\%$ for the two algorithms across all combinations. Successful deployment in real-world experiments with a dual-drone system further corroborates these findings.

</details>


### [250] [Simulation of Adaptive Running with Flexible Sports Prosthesis using Reinforcement Learning of Hybrid-link System](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.08882)
*Yuta Shimane,Ko Yamamoto*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出了一种基于强化学习的混合连杆框架，用于模拟单侧胫骨截肢者的自适应跑步运动。该框架集成了分段常应变（PCS）模型以表示叶片弹簧式运动假肢的柔性，结合模仿学习和假肢动力学计算，在不同虚拟假肢刚度条件下模拟跑步运动，并分析代谢能耗（COT）。结果表明假肢刚度影响跑步动力学和性能，COT与先前研究一致，展示了在虚拟条件下进行仿真分析的潜力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 运动假肢的设计和选择通常依赖试错法，缺乏考虑人体运动与假肢变形之间相互作用的全身动力学分析。因此需要一种能够进行用户特定设计和选择的综合分析框架。

Method: 采用混合连杆系统，通过PCS模型表示假肢柔性，基于该系统的强化学习仿真方法生成单侧胫骨截肢者的全身动态运动，整合了基于运动捕捉数据的模仿学习与假肢动力学精确计算。

Result: 不同虚拟假肢刚度条件下跑步运动被成功模拟，假肢刚度变化影响跑步动力学和性能，代谢COT与先前研究报告值一致。

Conclusion: 所提出的方法展示了在不同于真实环境的虚拟条件下进行仿真和分析的潜力，可为用户特定的假肢设计和选择提供有价值的参考。

Abstract: This study proposes a reinforcement learning-based framework for adaptive running motion simulation in a unilateral transtibial amputee using a hybrid-link system that incorporates the flexibility of a leaf-spring-type sports prosthesis. The design and selection of sports prostheses typically rely on trial and error. A comprehensive whole-body dynamics analysis that accounts for interactions between human motion and prosthetic deformation can provide valuable insights for user-specific design and selection. The proposed hybrid-link system enables such analysis by integrating a Piece-wise Constant Strain (PCS) model to represent prosthetic flexibility. Based on this system, the simulation methodology generates whole-body dynamic motions of a unilateral transtibial amputee using a reinforcement learning approach. This framework integrates imitation learning based on motion capture data with accurate computation of prosthetic dynamics. Running motions are simulated under multiple virtual prosthetic stiffness conditions, and the corresponding metabolic cost of transport (COT) obtained from these simulations is analyzed. The results suggest that variations in prosthetic stiffness influence running dynamics and performance, and that COT is consistent with values reported in prior study. Our findings demonstrate the potential of the proposed approach for simulation and analysis under virtual conditions that differ from real-world conditions.

</details>


### [251] [From Kinematics to Dynamics: Learning to Refine Hybrid Plans for Physically Feasible Execution](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.12474)
*Lidor Erez,Shahaf S. Shperberg,Ayal Taitler*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种强化学习方法，用于优化混合规划器生成的一阶轨迹，使其满足二阶动力学约束，从而弥合规划与真实执行之间的差距。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 混合时序规划器通常使用线性（一阶）动力学建模运动，无法保证规划结果满足机器人真实的物理约束（如速度、加速度极限、时间窗等），导致即使确定了高层动作序列，生成动态可行轨迹仍是一个双层优化问题。

Method: 在连续空间中定义了一个显式包含解析二阶约束的马尔可夫决策过程（MDP），利用强化学习对混合规划器生成的一阶规划进行细化。

Result: 该方法能够可靠地恢复物理可行性，有效弥合规划器初始一阶轨迹与实际执行所需动力学之间的差距。

Conclusion: 强化学习可作为一种有效工具，桥接混合离散-连续规划中一阶近似与真实二阶动力学之间的鸿沟。

Abstract: In many robotic tasks, agents must traverse a sequence of spatial regions to complete a mission. Such problems are inherently mixed discrete-continuous: a high-level action sequence and a physically feasible continuous trajectory. The resulting trajectory and action sequence must also satisfy problem constraints such as deadlines, time windows, and velocity or acceleration limits. While hybrid temporal planners attempt to address this challenge, they typically model motion using linear (first-order) dynamics, which cannot guarantee that the resulting plan respects the robot's true physical constraints. Consequently, even when the high-level action sequence is fixed, producing a dynamically feasible trajectory becomes a bi-level optimization problem. We address this problem via reinforcement learning in continuous space. We define a Markov Decision Process that explicitly incorporates analytical second-order constraints and use it to refine first-order plans generated by a hybrid planner. Our results show that this approach can reliably recover physical feasibility and effectively bridge the gap between a planner's initial first-order trajectory and the dynamics required for real execution.

</details>


### [252] [Open-H-Embodiment: A Large-Scale Dataset for Enabling Foundation Models in Medical Robotics](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.21017)
*Open-H-Embodiment Consortium,:,Nigel Nelson,Juo-Tung Chen,Jesse Haworth,Xinhao Chen,Lukas Zbinden,Dianye Huang,Alaa Eldin Abdelaal,Alberto Arezzo,Ayberk Acar,Farshid Alambeigi,Carlo Alberto Ammirati,Yunke Ao,Pablo David Aranda Rodriguez,Soofiyan Atar,Mattia Ballo,Noah Barnes,Federica Barontini,Filip Binkiewicz,Peter Black,Sebastian Bodenstedt,Leonardo Borgioli,Nikola Budjak,Benjamin Calmé,Fabio Carrillo,Nicola Cavalcanti,Changwei Chen,Haoxin Chen,Sihang Chen,Qihan Chen,Zhongyu Chen,Ziyang Chen,Shing Shin Cheng,Meiqing Cheng,Min Cheng,Zih-Yun Sarah Chiu,Xiangyu Chu,Camilo Correa-Gallego,Giulio Dagnino,Anton Deguet,Jacob Delgado,Jonathan C. Duke Herrell,Zhouyang Hong,Andrew Howe,Junlei Hu,Zhaoyang Jacopo Hu,Ria Jain,Mohammad Rafiee Javazm,Howard Ji,Rui Ji,Jianmin Ji,Zhongliang Jiang,Dominic Jones,Jeffrey Jopling,Britton Jordan,Ran Ju,Michael Kam,Luoyao Kang,Fausto Kang,Siddhartha Kapuria,Peter Kazanzides,Sonika Kiehler,Ethan Kilmer,Ji Woong Kim,Przemysław Korzeniowski,Chandra Kuchi,Nithesh Kumar,Alan Kuntz,Federico Lavagno,Yu Chung Lee,Hao-Chih Lee,Hang Li,Zhen Li,Xiao Liang,Xinxin Lin,Jinsong Lin,Chang Liu,Fei Liu,Pei Liu,Yun-hui Liu,Wanli Liuchen,Eszter Lukács,Sareena Mann,Miles Mannas,Brett Marinelli,Sabina Martyniak,Francesco Marzola,Lorenzo Mazza,Xueyan Mei,Maria Clara Morais,Luigi Muratore,Chetan Reddy Narayanaswamy,Michał Naskręt,David Navarro-Alarcon,Cyrus Neary,Chi Kit Ng,Christopher Nguan,David Noonan,Ki Hwan Oh,Tom Christian Olesch,Allison M. Salcudean,Asmitha Sathya,Preethi Satish,Lalithkumar Seenivasan,Jiaqi Shao,Yiqing Shen,Yu Sheng,Lucy XiaoYang Shi,Zoe Soulé,Stefanie Speidel,Mingwu Su,Jianhao Su,Idris Sunmola,Kristóf Takács,Yunxi Tang,Patrick Thornycroft,Yu Tian,Jordan Thompson,Mehmet K. Yeung,Nural Yilmaz,Chim Ho Yin,Michael Yip,Rayan Younis,Chenhao Yu,Sayem Nazmuz Zaman,Milos Zefran,Han Zhang,Yuelin Zhang,Yidong Zhang,Yanyong Zhang,Xuyang Zhang,Yameng Zhang,Joyce Zhang,Ning Zhong,Peng Zhou,Haoying Zhou,Xiuli Zuo,Nassir Navab,Mahdi Azizian,Sean D. Huver,Axel Krieger*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文介绍了Open-H-Embodiment，这是迄今最大的开放医疗机器人视频与同步运动学数据集，涵盖50多家机构和多种机器人平台，并基于该数据集训练了两个基础模型：GR00T-H（首个开放视觉-语言-动作基础模型，在结构化缝合基准测试中实现25%任务完成率）和Cosmos-H-Surgical-Simulator（首个支持多本体手术模拟的动作条件世界模型）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有医疗机器人数据集规模小、单本体、开放共享少，限制了医疗机器人领域基础模型的发展，亟需大规模开放数据集以推动研究进步。

Method: 构建了包含50多家机构、多种机器人平台（CMR Versius、达芬奇、dVRK、Rob Surgical BiTrack、MIRA、Moon Surgical Maestro等）的大规模开放数据集，涵盖手术操作、机器人超声和内窥镜程序；在此基础上训练了GR00T-H（视觉-语言-动作模型）和Cosmos-H-Surgical-Simulator（动作条件世界模型）。

Result: GR00T-H在结构化缝合基准测试中达到25%的任务完成率（其他模型为0%），在29步体外缝合序列中平均成功率达64%；Cosmos-H-Surgical-Simulator首次实现单一检查点支持9种机器人平台的多本体手术模拟。

Conclusion: 开放的大规模医疗机器人数据收集可以作为研究社区的关键基础设施，推动机器人学习和世界建模等领域的进步。

Abstract: Autonomous medical robots hold promise to improve patient outcomes, reduce provider workload, democratize access to care, and enable superhuman precision. However, autonomous medical robotics has been limited by a fundamental data problem: existing medical robotic datasets are small, single-embodiment, and rarely shared openly, restricting the development of foundation models that the field needs to advance. We introduce Open-H-Embodiment, the largest open dataset of medical robotic video with synchronized kinematics to date, spanning more than 50 institutions and multiple robotic platforms including the CMR Versius, Intuitive Surgical's da Vinci, da Vinci Research Kit (dVRK), Rob Surgical BiTrack, Virtual Incision's MIRA, Moon Surgical Maestro, and a variety of custom systems, spanning surgical manipulation, robotic ultrasound, and endoscopy procedures. We demonstrate the research enabled by this dataset through two foundation models. GR00T-H is the first open foundation vision-language-action model for medical robotics, which is the only evaluated model to achieve full end-to-end task completion on a structured suturing benchmark (25% of trials vs. 0% for all others) and achieves 64% average success across a 29-step ex vivo suturing sequence. We also train Cosmos-H-Surgical-Simulator, the first action-conditioned world model to enable multi-embodiment surgical simulation from a single checkpoint, spanning nine robotic platforms and supporting in silico policy evaluation and synthetic data generation for the medical domain. These results suggest that open, large-scale medical robot data collection can serve as critical infrastructure for the research community, enabling advances in robot learning, world modeling, and beyond.

</details>


### [253] [Do We Really Need Immediate Resets? Rethinking Collision Handling for Efficient Robot Navigation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.02192)
*Shanze Wang,Xinming Zhang,Siwei Cheng,Xianghui Wang,Changwen Chen,Hailong Huang,Wei Zhang*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出多碰撞重置预算（MCB）框架，允许智能体在同一训练回合中多次尝试避障，而非单次碰撞即全局重置，从而提升深度强化学习导航的早期训练效率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统DRL导航框架中，每次碰撞都会立即触发全局环境重置并被惩罚为完全任务失败，这阻碍了智能体在早期训练阶段探索具有挑战性的障碍物配置，导致学习进度缓慢。

Method: 提出Multi-Collision reset Budget (MCB)框架，将局部碰撞终止与全局环境重置解耦，允许智能体在同一回合内重试困难的配置。

Result: 仿真实验表明MCB提高了早期学习效率，用更少的交互达到目标成功率水平，小碰撞预算产生最一致的收益。真实机器人平台实验验证了所学策略在杂乱环境中的可部署性。

Conclusion: MCB框架通过允许智能体在训练回合中多次尝试碰撞后继续学习，有效提升了深度强化学习导航的早期训练效率，并能在真实机器人上部署。

Abstract: Should a single collision necessarily terminate an entire navigation episode? In most deep reinforcement learning (DRL) frameworks for robot navigation, this remains the standard practice: every collision immediately triggers a global environment reset and is penalized as a complete task failure. While a collision during deployment naturally indicates task failure, applying the same treatment during training prevents the agent from exploring challenging obstacle configurations, which slows learning progress in the early training phase. In this work, we challenge this convention and propose a Multi-Collision reset Budget (MCB) framework that decouples local collision termination from global environment resets, allowing the agent to retry difficult configurations within the same episode. Simulation experiments show that MCB improves early-stage learning efficiency by reaching target success-rate levels with fewer interactions, with small collision budgets producing the most consistent gains. Real-world experiments on heterogeneous robot platforms further validate the deployability of the learned policies in cluttered environments.

</details>


### [254] [StereoPolicy: Improving Robotic Manipulation Policies via Stereo Perception](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.09989)
*Evans Han,Yunfan Jiang,Yingke Wang,Haoyue Xiao,Huang Huang,Jianwen Xie,Jiajun Wu,Li Fei-Fei,Ruohan Zhang*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出StereoPolicy，一种直接利用同步立体图像对进行几何推理的视运动策略学习框架，无需构建显式3D表示，通过立体Transformer融合左右特征，在仿真和真实机器人任务上优于RGB、RGB-D、点云等多模态基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 单目视觉缺乏深度信息，在杂乱或几何复杂场景中难以精确操作；显式深度图和点云在实际操作中往往带有噪声且脆弱。因此需要一种无需显式3D重建但能提升几何推理能力的视觉策略框架。

Method: StereoPolicy利用预训练2D视觉编码器分别处理同步立体图像对，通过基于交叉注意力的立体Transformer（Stereo Transformer）隐式融合左右特征，捕获空间对应和视差线索，并集成到扩散策略和预训练VLA策略中。

Result: 在三个仿真基准和七个真实机器人桌面及双臂移动操作任务上，StereoPolicy相较于RGB、RGB-D、点云和多视图基线均取得一致改进。

Conclusion: 立体视觉能够桥接2D预训练表示与3D几何理解，为机器人操作任务提供有效的几何推理能力。

Abstract: Recent advances in robot imitation learning have produced powerful visuomotor policies that manipulate diverse objects from visual inputs. However, monocular observations lack depth information, which is critical for precise manipulation in cluttered or geometrically complex scenes. Explicit depth maps and point clouds are often noisy and fragile in real-world manipulation. We introduce StereoPolicy, a visuomotor policy learning framework that directly leverages synchronized stereo image pairs to improve geometric reasoning without constructing explicit 3D representations. StereoPolicy processes each image with pretrained 2D vision encoders and fuses left-right features through a cross-attention-based Stereo Transformer, capturing spatial correspondence and disparity cues implicitly. The framework integrates with diffusion-based and pretrained vision-language-action (VLA) policies, delivering consistent improvements over RGB, RGB-D, point cloud, and multi-view baselines across three simulation benchmarks and seven real-robot tabletop and bimanual mobile manipulation tasks. Our results show that stereo vision bridges 2D pretrained representations and 3D geometric understanding for robotic manipulation.

</details>


### [255] [SEDualVLN: A Spatially-Enhanced Dual-System for Vision-Language Navigation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.17249)
*Jingzhi Huang,Junkai Huang,Wenxuan Song,Haoyang Yang,Hailong Huang,Haoang Li,Yi Wang*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出SEDualVLN，一种空间增强的双系统视觉语言导航框架，结合了端到端VLM策略（系统1，带全局和局部空间感知）和零样本MLLM模块（系统2，结合3D地图映射与路径图像规划），通过快慢协调机制实现导航，在VLN-CE基准上取得最先进性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有端到端VLN方法缺乏动态推理能力且难以处理长程导航，而零样本模块化方法空间定位能力有限且推理耗时。为弥补这一差距，作者提出融合两种范式的双系统框架。

Method: SEDualVLN包含两个系统：系统1是带有全局和局部空间增强的VLM模型，负责快速动作生成；系统2是结合映射模块的通用MLLM，利用实时3D地图的俯视图和渲染路径图像进行航点规划。两个系统通过快慢协调方式协作完成任务。

Result: 在VLN-CE基准测试上取得最先进性能，消融实验验证了各系统和模块的有效性。

Conclusion: 空间增强的双系统框架能有效结合端到端方法的快速推理和零样本方法的泛化能力，通过快慢协调机制提升VLN任务性能。

Abstract: Vision-Language Navigation (VLN) approaches have currently followed two primary paradigms: the end-to-end Vision-Language Model (VLM) policy fine-tuned on navigation trajectories to directly predict actions, and the zero-shot modular pipeline integrating pre-trained Multimodal Large Language Model (MLLM) for training-free generalization to unseen environments. However, end-to-end methods struggle with long-horizon navigation and lack dynamic reasoning, whereas zero-shot methods are constrained by limited spatial grounding for reliable planning and also require substantial reasoning time. To bridge this gap, we introduce SEDualVLN, a spatially-enhanced dual-system VLN framework. System 1 is a VLM model enhanced with both global and local spatial awareness, used for action generation. System 2 integrates a general MLLM with a mapping module, wherein the MLLM plans waypoints by leveraging top-down views of the real-time 3D map alongside streams of rendered path images. Both systems leverage different forms of spatial enhancement to cultivate the agent's sense of direction in VLN tasks. Ultimately, they cooperate to complete the navigation task through a fast-slow coordinated approach. SEDualVLN achieves state-of-the-art performance on VLN-CE benchmarks, and further ablation studies demonstrate the effectiveness of each system and module.

</details>


### [256] [Safety-Critical Adaptive Impedance Control via Nonsmooth Control Barrier Functions under State and Input Constraints](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.28367)
*Faisal Lawan,Xiaoran Han,Joaquin Carrasco,Barry Lennox,Xiaoxiao Cheng*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出了一种结合非光滑控制屏障函数（NCBF）、区间二型模糊逻辑系统（IT2-FLS）和二次规划安全滤波器的在线自适应阻抗控制框架，实现了在不确定性动力学下的人机交互安全与合规性，并通过复合Lyapunov分析证明了安全集的正向不变性和阻抗跟踪误差的一致最终有界性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 针对机器人操作器在人类-机器人交互和接触丰富任务中，由于不确定性、外部力和执行器限制导致的性能与安全问题，现有方法难以同时保证关节状态安全和合规交互。

Method: 采用基于二次规划的安全滤波器结合组合位置-速度非光滑控制屏障函数（NCBF），实现统一相对度一的关节位置与速度约束；使用区间二型模糊逻辑系统（IT2-FLS）在线补偿未知动力学；通过软约束与精确罚函数恢复处理执行器力矩限制；设计扰动观测器增强安全机制以抵御建模误差和外部交互力。

Result: 在7自由度机械臂上，面对严重参数不确定性和外部交互力/力矩的情况下，仿真验证了该方法能够满足安全约束并实现鲁棒的阻抗跟踪。

Conclusion: 通过复合Lyapunov分析，证明了安全集的正向不变性和阻抗跟踪误差的一致最终有界性，表明该框架在处理不确定性动力学和外部干扰时能有效保障安全和性能。

Abstract: Safe physical interaction is critical for deploying robotic manipulators in human-robot interaction and contact-rich tasks, where uncertainty, external forces, and actuator limitations can compromise both performance and safety. We propose an online adaptive impedance control framework that enforces joint-state safety while achieving compliant interaction under uncertain dynamics. The approach combines a quadratic-program-based safety filter with a novel composed position-velocity non-smooth control barrier function (NCBF), enabling joint position and velocity constraints to be enforced through a unified relative-degree-one barrier. Unknown dynamics are compensated online using an interval type-2 fuzzy logic system, while actuator torque limits are handled through soft constraints with exact penalty recovery of feasible solutions. A disturbance-observer-enhanced safety mechanism improves robustness against modelling errors and external interaction forces. Using composite Lyapunov analysis, we prove forward invariance of the safe set and the uniform ultimately boundedness of the impedance-tracking error. Simulations on a 7-DOF manipulator with severe parametric uncertainty and external interaction wrenches demonstrate safe constraint satisfaction and robust impedance tracking.

</details>


### [257] [Worth Remembering: Surprise-Gated Robot Episodic Memory](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.03787)
*Nicolas Gorlo,Derek K. Wise,Alberto Speranzon,Luca Carlone*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出基于贝叶斯惊讶（Bayesian surprise）的门控机制，用于机器人长期记忆中的选择性存储，通过V-JEPA-2潜在空间计算惊讶值，结合4D场景图空间记忆，在机器人问答任务上较现有方法提升≥12%，并在事件分割任务中以无监督因果方法超越有监督方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 通用型机器人需要将指令与过往经验关联，但存储所有历史事件不可行，因此需要选择性长期记忆机制，优先保留对未来任务高实用性的片段。

Method: 采用贝叶斯惊讶作为记忆形成门控机制，在V-JEPA-2提供的语义丰富且部署无关的潜在空间中计算惊讶值，以此选择性地存储高惊讶事件，并将门控情景记忆与4D场景图空间记忆相结合。

Result: 在机器人问答基准上，对时间、空间和二元问题的回答一致提升≥12%，超越了先前机器人记忆方法；在事件分割任务中，以无监督因果方法超越了有监督和非因果方法的性能。

Conclusion: 贝叶斯惊讶门控机制能有效选择高实用性记忆，提升机器人对时间、空间事件的推理能力，且无监督因果方法在事件分割中表现优于有监督方法。

Abstract: Robots solving generalist tasks need to be able to ground instructions in their past experience, since humans may refer to notable past events when giving a task (e.g., ``Take me to where the chemical spill happened yesterday''). Since memory limits make storing all past events infeasible, long-term robot memory must be selective, ideally retaining only those episodes with high utility for future tasks. However, future tasks are not typically given a priori for generalist robots. To select generically useful memories, we propose Bayesian surprise as a gating mechanism for memory formation. We present an approach to compute surprise in a semantically rich deployment-agnostic latent space provided by V-JEPA-2. Using our gated episodic memory to augment 4D scene graph-based spatial memory, we show a consistent improvement over state-of-the-art benchmarks in robot question answering, outperforming prior robot memory methods by $\geq12\%$ for temporal, spatial, and binary questions, and surpassing the performance of supervised and non-causal methods with an unsupervised causal method in event segmentation tasks.

</details>


### [258] [AgenticRL: Self-Refining Agentic Reinforcement Learning for Vision-Conditioned UAV Navigation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.03963)
*Roohan Ahmed Khan,Yasheerah Yaqoot,Muhammad Ahsan Mustafa,Dzmitry Tsetserukou*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出AgenticRL框架，利用多模态GPT智能体自动生成和优化无人机导航任务的奖励函数，通过闭环自改进流程提升策略性能，并在真实世界中实现91%的成功率和94%的仿真到真实迁移准确率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 深度强化学习在自主导航中依赖人工设计的奖励函数和反复手动调参，耗时且无法保证任务成功率，需要提高奖励设计与策略优化的自动化程度。

Method: 使用多模态GPT智能体解释任务信息和视觉场景，生成任务特定的奖励函数，通过PPO算法训练策略；智能体作为批评者评估训练策略并生成反馈，闭环优化奖励函数；推理时利用真实图像和自然语言自动识别场景并选择合适策略执行。

Result: 闭环优化使策略性能相比初始奖励提升71%；真实世界成功率达91%，仿真到真实迁移准确率为94%。

Conclusion: AgenticRL框架有效提升了无人机导航任务中奖励设计的自主性和策略性能，具备良好的仿真到真实迁移能力。

Abstract: Deep reinforcement learning has shown strong potential for enabling autonomous robots to learn complex navigational tasks. However, its practical use still depends heavily on human designed reward functions and repeated manual fine tuning, which is time consuming and does not guarantee high success in the desired task. This paper presents AgenticRL, agent guided reinforcement learning framework that increases autonomy in reward design, policy refinement, and real world deployment for unmanned aerial vehicles (UAV) navigation tasks. AgenticRL uses a multimodal generative pre-trained tansformer (GPT) agent to interpret task information and visual scene observations, generate task specific reward functions, train policies using Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO) algorithm, and then act as a critic by evaluating the trained policy through diagnosis packets to generate feedback. Based on this feedback, the agent identifies failure modes and refines the reward function in a closed loop self improvement process. To further leverage the multimodal GPT agent during inference, AgenticRL uses real world images and natural language task information to automatically identify the active scenario and select the appropriate trained policy for execution. The framework is evaluated on multiple navigational tasks, including gate traversal, obstacle avoidance, wall barrier crossing with landing, trajectory following, and motion behavior learning. Experimental results show that the closed loop refinement process improves policy behavior compared with initial rewards by 71%. We also demonstrate sim-to-real transfer of the proposed framework, achieving a real world success rate of 91% and a sim-to-real accuracy of 94%.

</details>


### [259] [OSCAR: Omni-Embodiment Action-Conditioned World Model for Robotics](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.04463)
*Zhuoyuan Wu,Jun Gao*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: OSCAR是一个精确的动作条件视频世界模型，通过大规模标准化数据流程和2D骨架渲染统一表征，在不同机器人本体上实现泛化，可用于机器人策略评估，并在虚拟评估与真实评估之间展现出显著相关性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有视频世界模型在机器人评估中面临三大挑战：训练数据场景多样性有限、动作跟随不精确、跨机器人本体的泛化能力差，制约了其在真实机器人评估中的应用。

Method: (1) 构建大规模标准化数据流程，对多种机器人和人眼数据集进行整理、过滤、去重，得到联合训练数据集；(2) 采用2D运动学骨架渲染作为统一的条件化表征，跨不同机械臂甚至人手进行泛化；(3) 在单张GH200 GPU上微调Cosmos-Predict2.5-2B模型。

Result: 相比现有基线（模型更大或需更多GPU），OSCAR在动作跟随、外观质量、运动一致性上取得显著提升。在RoboArena上的实验表明，OSCAR中的虚拟策略评估与真实世界评估之间存在显著相关性。

Conclusion: OSCAR为未来在虚拟生成世界纯评估机器人策略奠定了基础，展现了视频世界模型在机器人策略评估中的巨大潜力。

Abstract: We present OSCAR, a precise action-conditioned video world model that generalizes across different robot embodiments and enables robot policy evaluation. Existing video world models face three main challenges for real-world robot evaluation: limited scenario diversity in current robot training datasets, imprecise action following, and poor generalization across embodiments for broad adoption. We tackle these challenges from two perspectives. At its core is a large-scale standardized data pipeline that curates, filters, and deduplicates broad robotics and egocentric human datasets, yielding a clean joint-training dataset that spans diverse tasks, scenarios, actions, and robot embodiments. To condition the video model, we adopt 2D kinematic skeleton rendering as a unified conditioning representation that generalizes across different robot arms or even human hands. We finetune the Cosmos-Predict2.5-2B model on a single GH200 GPU. Our model achieves significant improvement on action following, appearance quality, and motion consistency, compared to existing baselines, which either have a much larger model size or require more GPUs. We further deploy OSCAR to evaluate robot policies from RoboArena. Extensive experiments demonstrate the significant correlation between our virtual policy evaluation in OSCAR and real-world evaluation, paving the way for the future where robot policies can be purely evaluated in virtual generated worlds.

</details>


### [260] [VISTA: Vision-Grounded and Physics-Validated Adaptation of UMI data for VLA Training](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.04708)
*Siyuan Yang,Linzheng Guo,Ouyang Lu,Zhaxizhuoma,Daoran Zhang,Xinmiao Wang,Ting Xiao,Fangzheng Yan,Zhijun Chen,Yan Ding,Chao Yu,Chenjia Bai,Xuelong Li*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: VISTA框架通过UMI-VQA数据集、物理验证流水线和两阶段联合训练，解决了UMI数据与VLA模型之间的视觉分布偏移和物理不可行动作两个关键不匹配问题，显著提升了机器人操作策略的性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: UMI数据用于训练大规模VLA模型时存在两个根本性挑战：（1）腕戴式鱼眼视图存在严重径向畸变和局部夹爪中心视角，与预训练VLM的分布不匹配；（2）人类采集的轨迹经常违反运动学限制、发生碰撞或超过控制器带宽，导致VLA策略学习到物理上不可行的动作。

Method: 提出VISTA框架，包含三个协同组件：（i）UMI-VQA——首个针对腕戴式鱼眼观测的大规模VQA数据集，通过辅助视觉-语言监督对齐VLM表征；（ii）物理验证流水线——对数据进行完整性预检查，并对每条有效轨迹的连续性、自碰撞风险和执行保真度进行评分；（iii）两阶段联合训练——在UMI-VQA上联合学习视觉-语言基础，同时在验证后的轨迹上学习动作预测。

Result: 实验表明：UMI-VQA能一致提升下游策略性能；物理验证分数对部署成功率有强预测性。在多种仿真和真实操作任务上，VISTA显著优于π₀.₅、LingBot-VLA和Wall-X等强基线。

Conclusion: VISTA框架有效弥合了UMI数据与VLA模型之间的双重鸿沟，并开源了物理验证流水线、UMI-VQA数据集、验证后的轨迹数据和预训练模型。

Abstract: Universal Manipulation Interface (UMI) enables scalable real-world robot data collection without hardware-specific teleoperation, yet leveraging UMI data to train large-scale Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models remains fundamentally challenging. We identify two critical mismatches: wrist-mounted fisheye views, with severe radial distortion and local gripper-centric perspectives, are out-of-distribution for pretrained VLMs; and human-collected trajectories frequently violate kinematic limits, incur collisions, or exceed controller bandwidth, teaching VLA policies physically infeasible actions. To address the challenges, we present VISTA, a framework that bridges this dual gap through three synergistic components. (i)~UMI-VQA, the first large-scale VQA dataset tailored to wrist-mounted fisheye observations, aligns VLM representations to the distorted visual regime via auxiliary vision-language supervision. (ii)~A systematic physical-validation pipeline performs a data-completeness pre-check and scores each valid trajectory for trajectory continuity, self-collision risk, and execution fidelity before it enters training. (iii)~A two-stage co-training recipe jointly learns vision-language grounding on UMI-VQA and action prediction on validated trajectories. Our experiments empirically show that incorporating UMI-VQA consistently improves downstream policy performance, and that physical-validation scores are strongly predictive of deployment success. On diverse simulation and real-world manipulation tasks, VISTA significantly outperforms strong baselines including $π_{0.5}$, LingBot-VLA, and Wall-X. We release the physical-validation pipeline, UMI-VQA, validated trajectory data, and the pre-trained model for the community.

</details>


### [261] [Ask-to-Clarify: Resolving Instruction Ambiguity through Multi-turn Dialogue](https://arxiv.org/abs/2509.15061)
*Xingyao Lin,Xinghao Zhu,Tianyi Lu,Sicheng Xie,Hui Zhang,Xipeng Qiu,Zuxuan Wu,Yu-Gang Jiang*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出Ask-to-Clarify框架，使具身智能体能够通过多轮对话澄清模糊指令，再端到端生成动作，从而从被动执行者转变为主动协作伙伴。该框架包含一个用于协作的VLM和一个用于动作生成的扩散模型，并采用两阶段知识隔离训练策略。在8项真实世界任务中，该框架超越了现有最先进的VLA方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前基于VLA的具身智能体大多采用单向执行模式：接收指令后直接执行，无法处理现实世界中常见的模糊指令，缺乏与人类进行反馈交互的能力。本文旨在创造真正的协作型智能体，使其能够主动沟通、协调并根据人类反馈调整行为，而非被动执行者。

Method: 提出Ask-to-Clarify框架，包含两个组件：(1) VLM用于多轮对话协作，解决指令歧义；(2) 扩散模型用于低层动作生成。引入连接模块，基于VLM输出为扩散模型生成条件，通过指令调整观察以构建可靠条件。采用两阶段知识隔离训练策略：先微调协作组件处理歧义对话数据，再在冻结协作组件的情况下集成并微调动作组件。推理时使用信号检测器作为路由器，在提问和行动之间切换。

Result: 在8项真实世界任务中评估，Ask-to-Clarify框架超越了现有最先进的VLA方法，验证了该框架和训练策略能够为协作型具身智能体提供可行路径。

Conclusion: Ask-to-Clarify框架通过引入多轮对话澄清机制和两阶段知识隔离训练策略，有效解决了具身智能体在面对模糊指令时的协作问题。实验结果表明，该方法为构建能够主动与人类交互的协作型具身智能体提供了可行方向。

Abstract: The ultimate goal of embodied agents is to create collaborators that can interact with humans, not mere executors that passively follow instructions. This requires agents to communicate, coordinate, and adapt their actions based on human feedback. Recently, advances in VLAs have offered a path toward this goal. However, most current VLA-based embodied agents operate in a one-way mode: they receive an instruction and execute it without feedback. This approach fails in real-world scenarios where instructions are often ambiguous. In this paper, we address this problem with the Ask-to-Clarify framework. Our framework first resolves ambiguous instructions by asking questions in a multi-turn dialogue. Then it generates low-level actions end-to-end. Specifically, the Ask-to-Clarify framework consists of two components, one VLM for collaboration and one diffusion for action. We also introduce a connection module that generates conditions for the diffusion based on the output of the VLM. This module adjusts the observation by instructions to create reliable conditions. We train our framework with a two-stage knowledge-insulation strategy. First, we fine-tune the collaboration component using ambiguity-solving dialogue data to handle ambiguity. Then, we integrate the action component while freezing the collaboration one. This preserves the interaction abilities while fine-tuning the diffusion to generate actions. The training strategy guarantees our framework can first ask questions, then generate actions. During inference, a signal detector functions as a router that helps our framework switch between asking questions and taking actions. We evaluate the Ask-to-Clarify framework in 8 real-world tasks, where it outperforms existing state-of-the-art VLAs. The results suggest that our proposed framework, along with the training strategy, provides a path toward collaborative embodied agents.

</details>


<div id='cs.LG'></div>

# cs.LG [[Back]](#toc)

### [262] [The Evaluation Blind Spot: A Stereological Theory of Benchmark Coverage for Large Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.05169)
*Jason Z Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一套立体测量学理论来刻画LLM基准测试的覆盖范围，证明了凸能力曲线之间的可见Hausdorff距离误差界，并在多个主流排行榜上验证了结构盲点主导了统计噪声。同时解决了Gardner的凸几何问题1.5，建立了C^2支撑函数的最优恢复极小极大速率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的LLM基准测试缺乏对覆盖范围的系统理论分析，无法量化评测盲区的大小及其对模型排名稳定性的影响。同时，凸几何中关于C^2支撑函数最优恢复速率的问题长期未解。

Method: （1）提出立体测量学理论框架，用有效维度d_eff和可见Hausdorff距离刻画基准覆盖，给出上下界；（2）在Open LLM v2、12基准扩展套件、LiveBench三个排行榜上实证估计d_eff；（3）用卡方投影模型和多种先验模拟排名互换率；（4）用次模贪心算法（Nemhauser (1-1/e)保证）寻找稳定核心基准集；（5）用反事实验证预测评测的可替代性；（6）通过最优恢复理论在S^(D-1)上解决Gardner问题1.5。

Result: 三个排行榜的有效维度d_eff在[2.86, 4.80]之间；结构盲点比第二名分数差距大两个数量级，是统计噪声的52-127倍；半分割互换率在[0.38,0.49]，92%试次中排名第一的模型发生交换；4个基准构成稳定核心，7/12即可覆盖90%，跨时间迁移保留93-97%；特征结构预测评测可替代性的rho=-0.69(p=0.013)和新信息性的rho=+0.38；解决了Gardner问题，得到最优速率Theta(R/(kappa m^(2/(D-1))))。

Conclusion: 当前LLM基准测试存在巨大的结构盲点，显著降低了排名的可靠性；通过次模覆盖方法可以高效选择稳定核心基准；凸几何中最优恢复问题的解决为高维评测几何提供了理论基础。

Abstract: We give a stereological theory of LLM benchmark coverage. For any suite with effective dimensionality d_eff, the visible Hausdorff distance between two convex capability profiles consistent with the same scores is bounded by epsilon + C R m^(-1/(d_eff-1)), with matching Lipschitz lower bound. Empirically, three independent leaderboards (Open LLM v2, an extended 12-benchmark suite, LiveBench) all have d_eff in [2.86, 4.80] on their competitive frontier; the structural blind spot exceeds the observed runner-up score gap by two orders of magnitude and dominates statistical noise by 52-127x. Under a chi-squared projection model, the isotropic prior is the optimistic case; across six hidden-capability priors and four ambient dimensions the simulated half-split swap rate of the top two models stays in [0.38, 0.49], and a 500-trial random visible/held-out split shows that 92% of trials swap the top-1 ranking with on average 2.83 of 5 top-5 models changing. A submodular greedy algorithm with the Nemhauser (1 - 1/e) guarantee finds a stable core of 4 benchmarks; 7 of 12 suffice for 90% coverage, and the trained subset transfers across temporal quarters with 93-97% retention. A counterfactual validation across 12 internal benchmarks and 27 Chatbot Arena categories confirms that the eigenstructure predicts which evaluations are irreplaceable (rho = -0.69, p = 0.013 for removal disruption) and which external evaluations bring new information (rho = +0.38). As a second, independent theoretical contribution, we resolve Gardner's Problem 1.5 (1995) for C^2 support functions, establishing the minimax rate Theta(R/(kappa m^(2/(D-1)))) in general dimension via optimal recovery theory on S^(D-1).

</details>


### [263] [ERRORQUAKE: Heavy-Tailed Error Severity Distributions in Open-Weight Large Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.05170)
*Jason Z Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出Errorquake-10k基准，通过连续严重性评分（0-4分）评估21个开源LLM的错误严重性分布，发现即使准确率匹配，各模型的错误严重性分布差异显著（85/210模型对置信区间不重叠），证明严重性分布与错误率在信息上非冗余，应作为独立指标报告。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统幻觉基准将所有错误等同对待（只统计错误数量），但"错误日期"和"编造的法庭裁决"严重性相差巨大。需要一种能区分错误严重性的评估方法，揭示准确率之外的重要信息。

Method: 构建Errorquake-10k基准（10,000个查询），使用连续0-4级严重性评分，覆盖8个领域和5个难度级别；拟合Gutenberg-Richter尾部斜率b作为严重性分布指标；通过3名评审者对519项的验证研究确保评分可靠性；提出非冗余性定理证明严重性分布与错误率的信息非冗余性。

Result: 85对模型在匹配准确率（|Δε|<0.05）下具有不重叠的95%置信区间；ICC(2,3)=0.85表明评分可靠；LLM评判与人工排名相关性ρ=0.89；严重性分布与错误率信息非冗余（I(b;model|ε)=1.56 bits，64.5%的b方差无法由ε解释）；低严重性错误71%为检索类，高严重性错误39%为编造类，且构成随模型规模显著变化（p<0.0001）。

Conclusion: 严重性分布包含错误率无法捕捉的判别信息，应作为生成式LLM评估的独立指标与准确率一并报告。

Abstract: At matched accuracy, open-weight LLMs differ substantially in the shape of their error severity distribution -- a difference invisible to the scalar error rate. Hallucination benchmarks report a single error count and treat all errors as equivalent, yet a wrong date and a fabricated court ruling differ by orders of magnitude. We introduce Errorquake-10k, a 10,000-query benchmark scoring each response on a continuous 0-4 severity scale across 8 domains and 5 difficulty tiers, and we fit per-model severity distributions for 21 open-weight models. For each model we estimate a severity distribution index (b, the Gutenberg-Richter upper-tail slope) with 95% bootstrap confidence intervals. Headline: across the 210 model pairs, 85 have disjoint 95% b confidence intervals at matched accuracy (|Delta epsilon| < 0.05) on human-consensus scoring, e.g. deepseek-v3.2 vs. ministral-14b at epsilon = 0.586 and Delta b = 0.47. A 519-item three-rater human validation study confirms measurement reliability (ICC(2,k=3) = 0.85), validates the LLM-judge ranking (rho = 0.89), and confirms the dense-model scaling correlation on human data (rho_s = -0.86). We prove a Non-Reducibility Theorem showing that severity profile and error rate are informationally non-redundant (I(b; model | epsilon) = 1.56 bits; 64.5% of cross-model b variance is unexplained by epsilon). A severity mechanism taxonomy (kappa = 0.83) reveals that error type shifts categorically with severity: low-severity errors are retrievals (71%); high-severity errors are fabrications (39%) -- and this composition differs by model size (p < 0.0001). Severity distribution should be reported alongside accuracy; it carries discriminative information that the error rate cannot.

</details>


### [264] [Staged Factorial Screening for Budget-Constrained Micro-Pretraining](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.05186)
*Felipe Chavarro Polania*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究了在预算受限的微预训练场景中，采用分阶段部分因子实验设计来稳定识别早期效应结构，并通过613次实验验证了该方法在小预算下识别高惩罚方向、在扩展预算下确认锚点、并在缩减空间内局部优化的有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在预算受限的微预训练中，往往需要在共享加速器上对大量候选方案进行筛选，然后再投入更大的搜索预算。如何在这种分阶段预算约束下稳定地识别早期效应结构，避免在无效方向上浪费计算资源，是本研究的主要动机。

Method: 采用分阶段部分因子实验设计（fractional-factorial workflow），在固定单GPU训练循环上进行613次实验，包含：2/5/10分钟的探索和验证筛选；5/10分钟的完整16条件种子重跑；种子锚点验证；同主机贪婪和随机基线；60分钟桥接包；以及跨主机（Windows A100和Linux L40S）的24小时锚点延续实验。

Result: 总批量、深度和宽度的惩罚效应在短预算下最大，随预算增加而减弱。在种子全屏系列中，D、A、B、C在5/10分钟经BH校正后仍保留非零估计，而E不显著。随机搜索在32条件空间中能到达强候选区域，但反复集中在同一低惩罚区且无法归因因子。60分钟桥接锚点均值最低，但无法分离工作流改进与更大桥接模型的容量优势。在12/24小时三锚点延续中，桥接锚点样本均值最低，非桥接顺序存在主机敏感性。

Conclusion: 提出有界方法建议：使用短设计屏幕识别高惩罚方向，通过重复运行确认有前景的锚点，在缩减空间内局部优化。证据支持在24小时内跨两主机的桥接中心推荐，但不支持硬件无关排序或通用超参数优化优越性。

Abstract: Budget-constrained micro-pretraining often requires triaging many candidate recipes on a shared accelerator before larger search budgets are spent. We study whether a staged fractional-factorial workflow can recover stable early effect structure in this setting. On a fixed autoresearch-derived single-GPU training loop, we run 613 experiments across pilot and follow-up screens at 2, 5, and 10 minutes; full 16-condition seeded reruns at 5 and 10 minutes; targeted seeded anchor checks; same-host greedy and matched-cost random baselines; a 60-minute bridge package; and bounded Windows A100 and Linux L40S anchor continuations through 24 hours. Main penalties from total batch, depth, and width are largest at short budgets and relax as budget increases. Within the predeclared seeded full-screen families, D, A, B, and C retain non-zero estimates at 5 and 10 minutes after within-budget Benjamini-Hochberg correction, while E does not. Random search can reach strong incumbents in this 32-condition space, but repeatedly in the same low-penalty region and without factor attribution. The 60-minute bridge anchor has the lowest mean, although that package does not separate workflow refinement from the larger bridge model's capacity advantage.
