Since the technique is plug-and-play, users share datasets and precomputed vectors to steer model activations. However, we show that a \emph{stealth data poisoning attack} silently compromises this pipeline. By substituting $4{-}6\%$ of tokens in the steering dataset, an attacker can silently align the resulting vector with an anti-refusal direction. This jailbreaks the target model while preserving the intended steering effect on benign prompts. Under this threat model, a malicious actor can distribute an apparently safe bundle containing texts, vectors, and weights, alongside an equivalence certificate that the end-user can verify. We test the attack on two open-weight model families and eight model-attribute combinations, observing that poisoned vectors reach an absolute attack success rate (ASR) of $20{-}55\%$, $+19\%$ to $+51\%$ over a clean reference. Finally, we find that a refusal-direction orthogonalization defense can recover ${\approx}82\%$ of the ASR gap without harming benign behavior.

</details>


### [338] [LLM Explainability with Counterfactual Chains and Causal Graphs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.05972)
*Nirit Nussbaum-Hoffer,Nitay Calderon,Liat Ein-Dor,Roi Reichart*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出一种四阶段方法，通过构建因果图来建模LLM内部推理过程，将模型感知和组织的高层概念透明化，并在疾病诊断、情感分析和LLM-as-a-judge任务上验证了其保真度和结构稳定性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有工作使用LLM恢复外部世界过程的因果图，而本文的目标是反过来用因果图建模LLM自身的推理过程，为利益相关者提供模型如何感知和组织高层概念以产生预测的透明视图。

Method: 四阶段方法：(1) 发现具有类别区分性、人类可解释的概念；(2) 将每个输入映射到LLM感知的概念状态；(3) 提出受MCMC启发的反事实增广过程，通过反事实链扩展稀疏的观测数据；(4) 使用σ-CG进行稳定的因果发现，生成信息丰富且可解释的因果图。

Result: 在三个LLM上、涵盖疾病诊断、情感分析和LLM-as-a-judge分类任务的实验中，学习到的因果图捕捉到了与LLM推理一致的、有意义的依赖关系。MCMC反事实增广在收敛性和下游效用方面表现良好。

Conclusion: 本文为LLM的概念级可解释性提供了基础，证明了因果图能够有效揭示LLM内部的高层概念组织与推理依赖关系。

Abstract: Causal graphs provide a high-level language for making mechanisms transparent. Recent work uses Large Language Models (LLMs) to recover causal graphs of external-world processes. Instead, in this paper, we use causal graphs to model LLM inference itself, providing stakeholders with a transparent view of how the model perceives and organizes high-level concepts to produce a prediction. We propose a four-phase method for constructing such graphs. Given a target LLM and a set of textual examples, our method discovers class-discriminative, human-interpretable concepts and maps each input to LLM-perceived concept states. We then introduce an MCMC-inspired counterfactual augmentation procedure that expands the sparse observational data through chains of counterfactuals. This enables stable causal discovery with $σ$-CG, yielding informative, interpretable graphs. We apply our method to three LLMs across disease diagnosis, sentiment analysis, and LLM-as-a-judge classification tasks. We evaluate the learned graphs for predictive fidelity and structural stability, and the MCMC-inspired augmentation for convergence and downstream utility. Our results show that the discovered causal graphs capture meaningful dependencies consistent with LLMs' reasoning. Together, this paper provides a foundation for concept-level explainability of LLMs.

</details>


### [339] [Compress-Distill: Reasoning Trace Compression for Efficient Knowledge Distillation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.05988)
*Maxime Griot,Paul Steven Scotti,Tanishq Mathew Abraham*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究对思维链推理轨迹进行后验压缩，在知识蒸馏前将教师轨迹压缩至原长的8.6-21.0%，可减少训练token至12-30%、加速训练2.0-7.6x、缩短推理输出3-19x，但原始轨迹保持最高下游准确率；压缩在准确率与效率间提供权衡，学生最多保留原始轨迹96%的准确率同时获得高达18x的token效率提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 推理模型产生长思维链轨迹，蒸馏成本高且鼓励学生输出冗长内容，因此研究在知识蒸馏前对轨迹进行后验压缩，以平衡准确率与效率。

Method: 使用两个教师模型（Qwen3.5-397B-A17B和gpt-oss-120B）生成约28.3万条正确轨迹，再用两个指令微调模型将轨迹压缩至原始字符长度的8.6-21.0%，进行48次主网格实验及7次截断消融实验。

Result: 压缩轨迹将训练token降至12-30%，训练速度提升2.0-7.6x，推理输出缩短3-19x。原始轨迹在所有规模和教师设置下保持最高准确率。模型压缩轨迹通常优于或匹配朴素截断，尤其是小规模学生模型，同时保持更短的推理输出。

Conclusion: 推理轨迹压缩提供准确率-效率的权衡而非免费改进：学生最多保留原始轨迹96%的准确率，同时获得高达18x的token效率提升；在0.8B规模下LoRA微调时，压缩轨迹缩小了与原始轨迹的差距但未超越。

Abstract: Reasoning models produce long chain-of-thought traces that are costly to distill and encourage verbose student outputs. We study post-hoc compression of such traces before knowledge distillation. Two teachers, Qwen3.5-397B-A17B and gpt-oss-120B, generate about 283k correct traces each; two instruction-tuned models then compress them to 8.6-21.0% of their original character length. Across a 48-run main grid plus seven Qwen-teacher truncation ablations, compressed traces reduce training tokens to 12-30% of raw, speed up training by 2.0-7.6x, and shorten inference outputs by 3-19x with smaller reductions under the shorter gpt-oss teacher. However, raw traces retain the highest downstream accuracy at every scale and for both teachers. A length-matched raw-trace truncation ablation shows that compression is not merely benefiting from a smaller token budget: model-compressed traces usually beat or match naive truncation, especially for smaller students, while maintaining shorter inference outputs. Overall, reasoning-trace compression offers an accuracy-efficiency trade-off rather than a free improvement: students retain up to 96% of raw-trace accuracy while gaining up to 18x higher per-token efficiency, and at the 0.8B scale under LoRA compressed traces narrow the raw-vs-compressed gap but do not exceed raw.

</details>


### [340] [HoT-SSM:Higher-order Temporal Knowledge Graph Reasoning with State Space Models for Health Care](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.05994)
*Thummaluru Siddartha Reddy,Vempalli Naga Sai Saketh,Yash Punjabi,Mahesh Chandran*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出HoT-SSM模型，通过超图建模高阶临床概念交互，并利用状态空间模型捕获长程时间依赖，在MIMIC-III/IV上实现SOTA性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有医学知识图谱方法仅能捕获临床概念间的成对关系，无法建模共现或语义相关概念间的高阶交互；同时缺乏显式的长程时间依赖建模机制，限制了死亡率预测等临床任务的表现。

Method: HoT-SSM为每次就诊构建超图（基于领域知识将语义相关概念分组为超边），保留就诊级临床上下文；提出动态超图状态空间模型，显式建模患者潜在状态随时间演化并保持长程信息。

Result: 在MIMIC-III和MIMIC-IV数据集上，相比当前最先进模型取得显著性能提升。

Conclusion: 联合建模高阶临床交互与长程时间依赖能有效提升临床预测与推理性能。

Abstract: Medical knowledge graphs (MKGs) infused with clinical knowledge have been increasingly used to model electronic health records (EHRs) to support interpretable predictions in healthcare domain. However, existing MKG-based approaches are limited in capturing pairwise relations between clinical concepts (e.g., conditions, procedures, and medications), and restricts their ability to model higher-order interactions among co-occurring or semantically related concepts. In addition, most representation learning methods that leverage MKGs either collapse temporal information across visits or lack an explicit mechanism for modeling long-range temporal dependencies, which is critical for clinical tasks such as mortality prediction. To mitigate these limitations, we propose HoT-SSM, a parameter efficient and higher-order temporal graph reasoning with state space models. For each visit, HoT-SSM constructs hypergraphs by grouping semantically related clinical concepts into hyperedges using domain knowledge, thereby preserving visit-level clinical context. Further, to model the temporal dynamics while learning the representations, we introduce a novel dynamic hypergraph-based state space model that explicitly captures patients latent state evolution over time while preserving long-range information. The learned representations are used for downstream clinical prediction and reasoning. Experiments on MIMIC-III and MIMIC-IV datasets shows significant performance improvement over the current state-of-the-art models, demonstrating the effectiveness of jointly modeling higher-order clinical interactions and long-range temporal dependencies.

</details>


### [341] [Diffusion Models for Adaptive Sequential Data Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.06007)
*Haoyang Cao,Minshuo Chen,Yinbin Han,Renyuan Xu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种序列前向-后向扩散框架（SeqFBD），用于生成适应性时间序列数据，通过逐步注入和移除噪声并基于历史条件确保适应性，引入新的分数匹配目标实现高效并行训练，在理论上给出了严谨的统计保证，并在ARMA、高斯过程等合成数据及投资组合构建任务上验证了有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 扩散模型在静态数据生成上取得了巨大成功，但直接扩展到序列数据时往往无法捕捉时间依赖性和信息结构；设计能够以适应性方式（即不提前泄露未来信息）生成序列数据的扩散模型仍是一个开放挑战。

Method: 提出序列前向-后向扩散框架：沿序列逐步注入噪声（前向过程）和去除噪声（反向过程），每一步反向生成时以已生成的历史序列为条件，确保适应性；引入新的分数匹配目标实现并行训练；使用ReLU网络作为具体实例进行理论分析。

Result: 在合成数据（ARMA模型、高斯过程）上验证了方法的有效性，并在均值-方差最优投资组合构建任务中展示了实际应用价值；理论上建立了分数近似、分数估计和分布估计的统计保证。

Conclusion: 提出的SeqFBD框架能够有效生成保持时间依赖结构且无信息泄露的适应性时间序列，兼具理论严谨性与实际效果，为时间序列扩散生成提供了新的解决方案。

Abstract: Generating realistic synthetic sequential data is critical in real-world applications across operations research, finance, healthcare, energy systems, and scientific computing, where time-indexed observations are used for prediction, simulation, risk assessment, and data-driven decision-making. While diffusion models have achieved remarkable success in generating static data, their direct extensions to sequential settings often fail to capture temporal dependence and information structure. Designing diffusion models that can simulate sequential data in an adapted manner, and hence without anticipation of future information, therefore remains an open challenge.
  In this work, we propose a sequential forward-backward diffusion framework for adapted time series generation. Our approach progressively injects and removes noise along the sequence, conditioning on the previously generated history to ensure adaptiveness. A novel score-matching objective is introduced for efficient parallel training. We derive rigorous statistical guarantees under a generic framework, then establish score approximation, score estimation, and distribution estimation results with ReLU networks serving as a concrete instance. Empirically, we validate our method on synthetic data, including ARMA models and Gaussian processes, and demonstrate its effectiveness in constructing mean-variance optimal portfolios.

</details>


### [342] [Adaptive Oscillatory-State Alignment for Time Series Forecasting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.06010)
*Zhangyao Song,Ziqiong Li,Xiangfei Qiu,Chao Zha,Yinfei Xu,Tao Guo*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出AOSNET框架，将周期性时序预测从固定模板匹配重构为自适应振荡状态对齐，通过Hilbert变换提取分析信号描述符，并利用描述符条件门控自适应对齐局部状态，在八个基准上达到SOTA或极具竞争力的精度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有周期性预测方法依赖预定义周期、全局频谱成分或固定可学习模板，但真实时序动力学极少严格周期，存在振幅调制、相位漂移和局部频率变化，固定模板与底层时序状态存在根本性失配。

Method: AOSNET使用Hilbert变换从观测序列和可学习全局振荡先验中提取解析信号描述符，通过描述符条件门控自适应对齐局部状态，选择性保留可靠观测并软纠正失配区域；先验作为柔性振荡参考而非刚性重复模板。

Result: 在八个基准数据集上达到SOTA或极具竞争力的预测精度，且推理速度快；受控合成实验表明，随着非平稳性加剧（振幅调制、相位漂移、局部频率变化），振荡状态对齐的优势持续增强。

Conclusion: AOSNET通过将固定模板匹配范式转变为自适应振荡状态对齐，有效解决了真实时序中非平稳周期性动力学建模问题，为非平稳周期预测提供了新思路。

Abstract: Long-term time series forecasting benefits from inductive biases that expose recurring temporal structure. Existing periodic forecasting methods typically model recurrence through predefined periods, global spectral components, or fixed learnable templates. However, real-world temporal dynamics are rarely rigidly periodic: oscillatory behavior often evolves through amplitude modulation, phase drift, and local frequency variation. Under these conditions, fixed-template periodic modeling can become fundamentally mismatched to the underlying temporal states. We propose AOSNET, a Hilbert-guided forecasting framework that reformulates periodic forecasting from fixed template matching to adaptive oscillatory-state alignment. AOSNET extracts analytic-signal descriptors from both the observed sequence and a learnable global oscillatory prior, then adaptively aligns local states through a descriptor-conditioned gate that selectively preserves reliable observations while softly correcting mismatched regions. The learned prior serves not as a rigid repeated template but as a flexible oscillatory reference interpreted through local state dynamics. Experiments on eight benchmarks demonstrate state-of-the-art or highly competitive accuracy with fast inference speed. Controlled synthetic studies isolating amplitude modulation, phase drift, and local frequency variation confirm that the advantage of oscillatory-state alignment consistently increases as non-stationarity intensifies.

</details>


### [343] [OPRD: On-Policy Representation Distillation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.06021)
*Shenzhi Yang,Guangcheng Zhu,Bowen Song,Haobo Wang,Mingxuan Xia,Xing Zheng,Yingfan Ma,Zhongqi Chen,Weiqiang Wang,Gang Chen*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出On-Policy Representation Distillation (OPRD)，通过在隐藏状态空间中对齐师生模型表示进行知识蒸馏，解决了传统on-policy蒸馏在输出空间存在的采样方差大、忽略中间表示等问题，在多个数学推理基准上超越输出空间方法，且训练速度提升1.44倍、内存减少54%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统on-policy蒸馏（OPD）仅在输出空间监督学生模型，存在两个局限：(1) 在大词表（如Qwen约15万token）上进行蒙特卡洛KL估计时，采样方差在整个训练过程中持续存在；(2) 将教师模型视为黑盒，丢弃了LM头之前所有中间隐藏状态的信息。

Method: 提出On-Policy Representation Distillation (OPRD)，在相同rollout上对齐学生和教师模型选定层的表示，完全绕过LM头，将蒸馏提升到隐藏状态空间。

Result: OPRD在AIME 2024/2025和AIMO上缩小了师生差距，而输出空间OPD基线在低于教师水平处停滞；OPRD训练速度比top-k OPD快1.44倍，内存使用减少54%。

Conclusion: OPRD从理论上消除了采样方差，提供了更丰富的逐层结构信息，在效率和效果上均优于传统输出空间蒸馏方法。

Abstract: On-policy distillation (OPD) supervises the student only in output space by matching next-token probabilities. This output-only paradigm has two limits: (1) sampling variance from Monte Carlo KL estimates over large vocabularies (e.g., Qwen's ~150k tokens) persists throughout training, and (2) it treats the teacher as a black-box, discarding all intermediate hidden states after the LM head. We propose On-Policy Representation Distillation (OPRD), which lifts distillation into hidden-state space by aligning student and teacher representations across selected layers on the same rollouts, bypassing the LM head entirely. Theoretically, OPRD eliminates sampling variance and provides richer per-layer structural information. Empirically, OPRD closes the student-teacher gap on AIME 2024/2025 and AIMO, while output-space OPD baselines plateau below the teacher. OPRD also trains 1.44x faster and uses 54% less memory than top-k OPD. Code: https://github.com/ShenzhiYang2000/OPRD.

</details>


### [344] [Catastrophic Forgetting as Accessibility Collapse: A Three-Level Framework for Knowledge Persistence in Continual Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.06032)
*Ayushman Trivedi,Bhavika Melwani*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出灾难性遗忘并非知识的彻底擦除，而是可访问性丧失。通过三层次框架（存储、表征、可访问性）和多种实验分析，发现线性探测保留约76%的表征信息，仅重训分类器可恢复75.7%的原始性能，表明大量任务相关信息在功能性遗忘后仍嵌入神经表征中。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 挑战传统观点——灾难性遗忘是先前知识的不可逆擦除，探索遗忘可能源于可访问性丧失而非表征破坏的替代视角。

Method: 建立存储-表征-可访问性三层次框架；在CIFAR-100序列分类任务上使用ResNet-18进行持续学习实验；采用检查点持久性分析、线性探测、表征几何分析、分类器重置恢复、逐层可恢复性实验等多种分析方法。

Result: 行为遗忘严重（准确率从54.8%降至0%），但线性探测保留约76%表征信息；仅重训最终分类器可恢复75.7%原始性能；早、中间层高度可恢复，后期层显著退化；保留知识以分布式高维表征形式存在。

Conclusion: 灾难性遗忘更适合表征为可访问性失败而非完整表征擦除，大量任务相关信息在功能性遗忘后仍嵌于神经表征中。

Abstract: Catastrophic forgetting is commonly interpreted as the irreversible erasure of previously acquired knowledge during sequential learning. In this work, we investigate an alternative perspective: that forgetting may arise not from complete destruction of task representations but from a loss of accessibility to preserved information. We introduce a three-level framework separating knowledge storage, representation, and accessibility, and evaluate each component through a series of continual-learning experiments on sequential CIFAR-100 classification using ResNet-18. Our analysis combines checkpoint persistence, linear probing, representation geometry, classifier-reset recovery, and layer-wise recoverability experiments. We observe complete behavioral forgetting of earlier tasks, with task accuracy collapsing from 54.8% to 0%, while linear probe performance retains approximately 76% of the original representational information. Furthermore, retraining only the final classifier restores 75.7% of the original task performance without modifying the backbone network. Layer-wise analysis reveals that early and intermediate layers preserve highly recoverable task information despite severe degradation at later stages. Projection-energy and principal-angle analyses indicate that retained knowledge persists as distributed high-dimensional representations rather than through preservation of a small dominant subspace. These findings suggest that catastrophic forgetting is better characterized as an accessibility failure than complete representational erasure, and that substantial task-relevant information remains embedded within neural representations even after functional forgetting has occurred.

</details>


### [345] [When Good Enough Is Optimal: Multiplication-Only Matrix Inversion Approximation for Quantized Gated DeltaNet](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.06034)
*Luoming Zhang,Yuwei Ren,Kui Zhang,Tian Liu,Lingjuan Ge,Denghao Li,Matthew Harper Langston,Yin Huang,Weiliang Will Zeng,Liang Zhang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 针对分块并行线性注意力中的矩阵求逆瓶颈，提出基于截断Neumann级数展开和并行残差校正的MatMul高效算法，在NPU上实现高达5倍核级加速，并支持低精度推理。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 分块并行线性注意力中矩阵求逆（如前向代入法）在NPU上并行度低、硬件利用率差，成为长上下文建模的主要瓶颈。

Method: 利用严格下三角矩阵的Neumann级数项快速衰减及逆矩阵对角集中特性，采用截断Neumann展开结合结构掩码和并行残差校正消除序列依赖；针对低比特INT场景，抑制矩阵幂运算导致的动态范围膨胀；根据块大小自适应调整近似阶数和残差步数以平衡效率与精度。

Result: 在Qwen3.5系列模型上实现最高5倍核级加速，解码层开销降低20%，浮点和低精度推理下均保持模型精度。

Conclusion: 所提方法为可扩展线性注意力提供了一种高效且硬件友好的解决方案，尤其适用于NPU上的长上下文建模。

Abstract: Matrix inversion in chunk-wise parallel linear attention is a major bottleneck for long-context modeling, particularly on NPUs, where forward-substitution-based methods exhibit limited parallelism and poor hardware utilization. We propose a fast, Matrix Multiplication (MatMul)-based algorithm tailored for strictly lower-triangular matrices arising in chunk-wise linear attention. Motivated by the rapid growth of Neumann-series terms and the diagonal concentration of the inverse matrix, we employ a truncated Neumann expansion with structural masking and parallel residual correction to eliminate sequential dependencies. We further extend our method to low-bits INT by mitigating the dynamic range expansion arising from repeated matrix power operations, and adapt the approximation order and residual step to the chunk size to minimize computational cost while preserving the model's accuracy. Experiments on Qwen3.5-family models demonstrate up to 5$\times$ kernel-level speedup and a 20% reduction in decode-layer overhead, while preserving accuracy under both floating-point and low-precision inference. Our method offers an efficient and hardware-friendly solution for scalable linear attention.

</details>


### [346] [Online KL-Regularized Reinforcement Learning with Function Approximation under Misspecification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.06053)
*Haoyang Hong,Zichen Wang,Quanquan Gu,Huazheng Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究了在模型误设定下，带KL正则化的上下文赌博机和情节强化学习问题，提出了KL误设定公式，并分析了基于回归的Gibbs策略更新算法，建立了包含显式误设定项的高概率KL遗憾界，将标准可实现KL正则化设定作为特例恢复。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有KL正则化上下文赌博机和强化学习的理论保证依赖于可实现性假设，无法推广到模型误设定的情况，而经典遗憾界在误设定下可能失效。本文旨在弥合这一差距。

Method: 提出了KL误设定公式用于上下文赌博机和情节强化学习；分析了基于回归的算法，采用Gibbs策略更新。

Result: 建立了高概率的KL遗憾界，其中包含显式的误设定项；该界在可实现设定下退化为标准KL正则化界。

Conclusion: 将KL正则化设定下可实现保证推广到了模型误设定的情形，提供了更通用的理论框架。

Abstract: We study KL-regularized contextual bandits and episodic reinforcement learning (RL) under general function approximation with model misspecification. Existing guarantees rely on realizability and therefore do not extend to misspecified models, where classical regret bounds may fail. This work introduces KL misspecification formulations for contextual bandits and episodic RL and analyzes regression-based algorithms with Gibbs policy updates. High-probability KL-regret guarantees with explicit misspecification terms are established, recovering the standard realizable KL-regularized setting as a special case.

</details>


### [347] [MDP-GRPO: Stabilized Group Relative Policy Optimization for Multi-Constraint Instruction Following](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.06058)
*Mohammad Mahdi Salmani-Zarchi,Zahra Rahimi,Heshaam Faili,Mohammad Javad Dousti*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 针对GRPO在离散低分散奖励下训练不稳定的问题，提出MDP-GRPO，通过多温度采样、双锚优势、前景理论塑形和非对称KL正则化四方面改进，在多约束指令跟随任务上提升严格约束满足率高达5.0%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 标准GRPO在离散、低分散奖励场景下不稳定，因为组内奖励分布常呈同质性，导致z-score组归一化出现低方差放大、均值中心盲区和零方差崩溃三种病理。

Method: 提出MDP-GRPO，包含：(1)多温度采样增加奖励分散度；(2)双锚优势在均匀组中恢复梯度并解决均值中心盲区；(3)基于Kahneman和Tversky的前景理论塑形来约束更新并惩罚违规；(4)非对称KL正则化。

Result: 在FollowBench、IFEval和多约束数据集上，MDP-GRPO在Llama-3.2-3B上严格约束满足率提升高达5.0%，支持小批量组稳定收敛，且在MMLU和ARC上保持通用能力。

Conclusion: MDP-GRPO有效解决了GRPO在离散低分散奖励下的训练不稳定问题，提升了多约束指令跟随性能，同时保持了模型的通用能力。

Abstract: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards is ideal for multi-constraint instruction following, yet standard group-relative policy optimization (GRPO) becomes unstable under discrete, low-dispersion rewards, where within-group reward distributions are frequently homogeneous. We identify and formalize three pathologies of z-score group normalization in this regime: low-variance amplification, mean-centering blindness, and zero-variance collapse. To address them, we propose MDP-GRPO, which stabilizes learning through (1) multi-temperature sampling to increase reward dispersion, (2) dual-anchor advantages to restore gradients in homogeneous groups and stop mean-centering blindness, (3) prospect-theoretic shaping to bound updates and penalize violations based on Kahneman and Tversky's theory, and (4) asymmetric KL regularization. Evaluated on FollowBench, IFEval, and a curated multi-constraint dataset, MDP-GRPO outperforms standard GRPO, improving strict constraint satisfaction by up to 5.0% on Llama-3.2-3B. Our method also enables stable convergence with small group sizes while preserving general capabilities on MMLU and ARC.

</details>


### [348] [On Advantage Estimates for Max@K Policy Gradients](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.06080)
*Shota Takashiro,Soichiro Nishimori,Paavo Parmas,Yongmin Kim,Kohsei Matsutani,Gouki Minegishi,Yusuke Iwasawa,Takeshi Kojima,Yutaka Matsuo*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究了基于可验证奖励的强化学习中，针对推理时目标（pass@K和max@K）的策略梯度估计器设计问题。通过基线设计和优势中心化分析，提出了一种Leave-Two-Out (L2O)基线方法，该方法在保持策略梯度无偏性的同时实现批次优势的精确中心化。由此得到的MaxPO方法具有高效的二次时间实现，并能自然地融入基于组的RL大模型后训练框架。本文还推导了max@K的规范有限批次优势，统一了现有优势估计器。实验验证了L2O基线能降低梯度方差并优于非中心化替代方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的基于可验证奖励的强化学习方法在推理模型后训练中使用稀疏结果奖励，导致探索困难。虽然可以直接优化pass@K和max@K等推理时目标，但现有策略梯度估计器使用不同的信号、基线和归一化方法，彼此之间的关系不清晰。本文旨在通过基线设计和优势中心化来理清并统一这些方法。

Method: 从领先方法的优势估计器出发，证明其策略梯度无偏但产生非中心化优势；提出Leave-Two-Out (L2O)基线，在保持策略梯度无偏性的同时实现批次优势精确中心化；由此得到的MaxPO方法具有O(n²)高效实现；进一步推导max@K的规范有限批次优势。

Result: L2O基线有效降低了梯度方差，在性能上优于非中心化的替代方法；MaxPO方法与其他方法的关系得到统一解释。

Conclusion: Leave-Two-Out基线是一种有效的优势中心化方法，能够在保持无偏性的同时降低方差，为基于组的RL后训练提供了统一的理论视角和实用的改进方案。

Abstract: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards is widely used for post-training reasoning models, but sparse outcome rewards make exploration difficult. A complementary approach is to optimize inference-time objectives such as pass@K and max@K directly, yet existing policy-gradient estimators for these objectives use different signals, baselines, and normalizations, making their relationships unclear. We study this issue through baseline design and advantage centering. Starting from the advantage estimator of a leading method in the field, we show that it is policy-gradient unbiased but yields a non-centered advantage. We then introduce a Leave-Two-Out baseline that preserves policy-gradient unbiasedness while making realized batch advantages exactly centered. The resulting method, MaxPO, has an efficient quadratic-time implementation and integrates naturally into group-based RL for LLM post-training. We further derive the canonical finite-batch advantage for max@K, providing a unified view of existing advantage estimators. Empirically, we verify that the L2O baseline reduces gradient variance and outperforms non-centered alternatives.

</details>


### [349] [OrderGrad: Optimizing Beyond the Mean with Order-Statistic Policy Gradient Estimation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.06096)
*Paavo Parmas,Yongmin Kim,Kohsei Matsutani,Shota Takashiro,Soichiro Nishimori,Takeshi Kojima,Yusuke Iwasawa,Yutaka Matsuo*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: OrderGrad 提出了一类基于排序统计量的梯度估计器，通过对奖励/成本进行加权排序（如 VaR、CVaR、中位数、top-m 等），实现风险厌恶、鲁棒和探索性学习，并支持似然比和重参数化两种梯度估计方式。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统的策略梯度方法优化期望回报，但许多实际应用关注回报的分布特性（如尾部风险、离群值鲁棒性、最佳K个发现），需要一种能够灵活适配不同排序统计目标的统一梯度估计方法。

Method: 提出 OrderGrad 家族，包含似然比和重参数化两类梯度估计器，用于优化有限样本的 L-统计量（加权排序统计量）。通过改变秩权重可恢复 VaR、CVaR、修剪均值、中位数、top-m/best-of-K 等目标。方法实现为简单的奖励变换，可集成到标准策略梯度或重参数化更新中。

Result: 给出了估计器的方差行为分析，并在大语言模型数学后训练等多种任务上进行了评估，验证了在均值优化与部署目标不匹配场景下的有效性。

Conclusion: OrderGrad 提供了一种统一、即插即用的方法，用于风险厌恶、鲁棒和探索性学习，代码已开源。

Abstract: Policy-gradient methods usually optimize expected return, but many real world applications care about distributional properties of returns: tail risk, outlier robustness, or best-of-K discovery. We introduce OrderGrad, a family of likelihood-ratio and reparameterization gradient estimators for order-statistic objectives. OrderGrad optimizes finite-sample L-statistics, i.e., weighted averages of sorted rewards or costs, recovering objectives such as VaR, CVaR, trimmed means, medians, and top-m/best-of-K criteria by changing only the rank weights. For any fixed sample size and rank-weight vector, OrderGrad provides an unbiased gradient estimator for the corresponding order-statistic objective. The method is implemented as a simple reward transformation that can then be used in an otherwise standard policy-gradient or reparameterized update. We study the resulting estimator's variance behavior and evaluate it on tasks where mean optimization is mismatched to the deployment objective, including LLM math post-training and other tasks. OrderGrad provides a unified, plug-and-play route to risk-averse, robust, and exploratory learning.
  Code: https://github.com/paavo5/ordergrad

</details>


### [350] [A Sliced-Wasserstein Framework on Correlation Matrices for EEG Decoding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.06104)
*Chen Hu,Rui Wang,Jiale Zhou,Jingjun Yi,Shaocheng Jin,Yidong Song,Yefeng Zheng*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出基于Pullback欧几里得度量的切片Wasserstein框架，在全秩相关矩阵流形上实例化两种相关切片Wasserstein散度（CorSW），并构建领域泛化框架用于脑电解码，在三个数据集上验证了其有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 协方差描述子对通道缩放敏感，而全秩相关矩阵作为尺度不变替代方案在脑电解码中潜力巨大，但缺乏合适的几何感知距离度量及领域泛化方法。

Method: 提出Pullback Euclidean Metric Sliced Wasserstein (PEMSW)通用框架，在全秩相关矩阵流形上基于Off-Log Metric (OLM)和Log-Scaled Metric (LSM)两种几何度量实例化CorSW散度，并基于CorSW构建领域泛化框架。

Result: 在三个EEG数据集上，所提方法在分布偏移下展现了更好的泛化性能，训练开销低且无需额外推理成本。

Conclusion: PEMSW框架及CorSW散度为脑电解码提供了有效的尺度不变度量与领域泛化方案，具有良好的实用性与扩展性。

Abstract: Electroencephalography (EEG) offers noninvasive, millisecond resolution recordings of neuronal activity and is widely used in neuroscience and healthcare. Many EEG decoding pipelines rely on covariance descriptors for their robustness to noise, but such representations are sensitive to channel-wise scaling. Recent studies have therefore advocated full-rank correlation matrices as a scale-invariant alternative for EEG decoding. In this paper, we propose a general framework for Sliced Wasserstein (SW) discrepancies on manifolds endowed with Pullback Euclidean Metrics (PEMs), termed Pullback Euclidean Metric Sliced Wasserstein (PEMSW). Within this framework, we instantiate two Correlation Sliced-Wasserstein (CorSW) discrepancies on the manifold of full-rank correlation matrices under two recently introduced correlation geometries, \textit{i.e.}, the Off-Log Metric (OLM) and Log-Scaled Metric (LSM). Building on CorSW, we further develop a domain generalization (DG) framework for EEG decoding. Experiments on three EEG datasets demonstrate improved generalization under distribution shifts, with low training overhead and no additional inference cost. The source code is available at https://github.com/ChenHu-ML/CorSW.

</details>


### [351] [Adaptive state-action abstractions via rate-distortion](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.06123)
*Fernando E. Rosas*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种动态调整强化学习抽象粒度（状态/动作分辨率）的原则：当学习误差与抽象误差相当时，即自动细化抽象。通过基于率失真理论的软状态-动作抽象和性能证书（分解值误差为贝尔曼残差+双模拟度量界）实现，并在表格环境中验证了在高度有损压缩下仍能获得近最优性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 强化学习缺乏如何在学习过程中动态调整抽象粒度的一般性原则。婴儿学步时先解决粗粒度问题（保持直立、够到照顾者），待粗粒度学习收益递减后才细化问题，本文旨在将这种自适应抽象细化机制形式化。

Method: 提出一个性能证书，将值误差分解为两项：由贝尔曼残差刻画的学习误差界，以及由双模拟度量（bisimulation metric）刻画的抽象误差界。当学习误差与抽象误差相当时触发抽象细化。采用基于率失真理论的软状态-动作抽象，沿状态轴和动作轴的分辨率可连续调节。

Result: 在多种表格设置中验证了该方法，表明即使在状态和动作信息高度有损压缩的条件下，仍能实现近最优性能。

Conclusion: 所提出的动态抽象细化原则和基于率失真的软抽象方法是有效的，能够在大幅压缩信息的同时保持学习性能，为强化学习中自适应抽象提供了一种理论驱动的解决方案。

Abstract: When learning to walk, infants seem to address a coarse version of the problem first - stay upright, reach the caregiver - and refine it only when further practice at that resolution stops paying off. Reinforcement learning offers multiple techniques for building simple versions of complex tasks, but lacks general principles for how to dynamically adjust the granularity of these abstractions during learning. This paper proposes one such principle: refine the abstraction as soon as the learning error within it becomes comparable to the error induced by the abstraction itself. Here, we investigate one way of formalising this principle via a performance certificate that decomposes value error into two terms: a learning error bound captured by a Bellman residual, and an abstraction error bound given by a bisimulation metric. The resulting switching strategy is implemented by soft state-action abstractions built from rate-distortion principles, whose resolution along state and action axes can be continuously adjusted. We validate this construction in a range of tabular settings, showing that near-optimal performance can be achieved under substantial lossy compression of state and action information.

</details>


### [352] [Tight list replicability bounds via a novel sphere covering theorem](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.06148)
*Ari Blondal,Hamed Hatami,Pooya Hatami,Chavdar Lalov,Sivan Tretiak*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文通过证明一个基于Borsuk-Ulam定理的拓扑球面覆盖定理，建立了列表可复现性中列表大小与精度参数之间的尖锐边界，并给出了VC类和大间隔半空间的最优列表大小。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 形式化机器学习中的可复现性问题，刻画列表可复现性框架下列表大小与假设类复杂度度量之间的精确关系。

Method: 基于Borsuk-Ulam定理证明了一个拓扑球面覆盖定理：若d-球面被开集覆盖且每个开集位于一个开半球内，则其中d+1个集合必有公共交集。利用该定理推导VC类和大间隔半空间的列表可复现性边界。

Result: 1) 得到VC类上列表大小与精度之间的尖锐边界；2) 证明了大间隔半空间在间隔不太大时最优列表大小等于环境维度d；3) 在极大间隔条件下，设计了可复现算法实现最小列表大小⌈d/2⌉+1。

Conclusion: 拓扑球面覆盖定理是分析列表可复现性的有力工具，为不同复杂度类提供了精确的列表大小下界，特别是在大间隔半空间问题上揭示了维度与列表大小的依赖关系。

Abstract: In recent years, list replicability has emerged as a framework for formalizing reproducibility in learning theory. A central question is how the required list size relates to the accuracy parameter and natural complexity measures of the hypothesis class.
  To achieve sharp bounds on list replicability, we prove a novel topological sphere covering theorem, derived from the Borsuk-Ulam theorem. Specifically, if the $d$-sphere is covered by open sets, each of which lies in an open hemisphere, then $d+1$ of these sets must have a common intersection. Using this result, we obtain a sharp bound on the relationship between list size and accuracy for VC classes. We also show that for large-margin half-spaces, provided the margin is not too large, the optimal list size equals the ambient dimension. However, when the margin is taken to be very large, we devise a replicable algorithm achieving the minimal list size of $\lceil d/2 \rceil + 1$.

</details>


### [353] [Trust-Aware Predictive Emissions Monitoring for Gas Turbine Fleets with Limited Labelled Data](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.06156)
*Rebecca Potts,Aiden Durrant,Rick Hackney,Georgios Leontidis*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出了一种信任感知的概率框架，用于在有限监督下实现燃气轮机舰队级NOx排放预测。该框架结合多头循环预测模型、置信度估计、集成不确定性量化、辅助特征预测、特征空间距离分析和运行范围诊断，生成可解释的逐样本信任分数，以指示未标注涡轮机上预测的可靠性。实验表明，置信度过滤可将MAE从0.202降至0.070（最高置信度10%的预测），且框架能有效响应分布偏移。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基于机器学习的预测性排放监测系统(PEMS)是直接排放测量的实用替代方案，但在仅有少量资产具有排放标签的情况下，跨燃气轮机舰队的部署面临挑战。需要一种能够在不完全监督下提供可靠预测并量化不确定性的框架。

Method: 提出信任感知概率框架，包含：(1)多头循环预测模型用于NOx预测；(2)置信度估计学习；(3)基于集成的模型不确定性量化；(4)辅助特征预测任务；(5)特征空间距离分析；(6)运行范围诊断。这些信号在有标签数据上校准，生成逐样本信任分数。

Result: 置信度过滤将MAE从全覆盖率下的0.202降低到最高置信度10%预测的0.070；未标注样本和分布外样本表现出更高的不确定性和更低的置信度，表明框架能有效响应分布偏移。

Conclusion: 所提出的信任框架能为未标注涡轮机上的排放预测提供可操作的可靠性信息，支持PEMS在工业舰队中更透明和可信赖的部署。

Abstract: Machine learning-based predictive emissions monitoring systems offer a practical alternative to direct emissions measurement, but their deployment across gas turbine fleets is challenging when emissions labels are available for only a small subset of assets. In this work, a trust-aware probabilistic framework is proposed for fleet-level gas turbine NOx prediction under limited labelled supervision. The framework combines a multi-head recurrent prediction model with learned confidence estimation, ensemble-based uncertainty quantification, auxiliary feature prediction, feature-space distance analysis, and operating-range diagnostics. These signals are calibrated on labelled data to produce interpretable per-sample trust scores, providing indicators of prediction reliability on unlabelled turbines, supporting the identification of predictions that should be treated with greater caution during fleet-level deployment. Confidence-based filtering reduces MAE from 0.202 at full coverage to 0.070 for the highest-confidence 10\% of predictions, demonstrating that confidence estimates are meaningfully related to prediction error. Unlabelled and out-of-distribution samples exhibit increased uncertainty and reduced confidence, indicating that the framework responds appropriately to distributional shift. The results show that the proposed trust framework provides actionable reliability information for emissions prediction on unlabelled turbines, supporting more transparent and trustworthy deployment of PEMS across industrial fleets.

</details>


### [354] [On the training of physics-informed neural operators for solving parametric partial differential equations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.06164)
*Nanxi Chen,Chuanjie Cui,Airong Chen,Sifan Wang,Rujin Ma*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文系统研究了物理信息神经算子（PINO）的训练方法，包括架构设计、优化器选择、损失平衡和采样策略，发现CViT架构表现最优，且PINN中的优化问题（如梯度冲突）在PINO中同样存在，物理信息训练可与纯数据驱动方法媲美甚至更优。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: PINO有望结合神经算子的跨实例泛化能力和物理信息学习的数据效率，但其高效鲁棒的训练方法尚不清晰，现有研究空白需要填补。

Method: 系统研究PINO训练流程的关键组件（架构、优化器、损失平衡、采样策略），在三种算子骨干（DeepONet、FNO、CViT）和五个参数化PDE系统上进行实验对比。

Result: CViT在所有基准测试中表现一致且稳定；PINN训练中的梯度冲突和因果违反等优化问题在PINO中自然存在；针对PINN的缓解算法在PINO中同样有效；精心设计的物理信息训练管道可匹配甚至超越纯数据驱动方法。

Conclusion: 研究提供了PINO训练优化挑战的系统实证理解，为高效鲁棒的物理信息算子学习提供了实用训练流程指导。

Abstract: Physics-informed neural operators (PINOs) aim to learn solution operators for partial differential equations by using the governing physics as supervision, rather than relying solely on paired input-output simulation data. By incorporating physical constraints into the training objective, PINOs combine the cross-instance generalization of neural operators with the data efficiency of physics-informed learning. Despite this promise, how to train PINOs efficiently and robustly remains less well-understood than the training of either data-driven neural operators or physics-informed neural networks (PINNs). To bridge this gap, we examine key components of the PINO training pipeline, including architecture design, optimizer choice, loss balancing, and collocation-point sampling strategy. We study three representative operator backbones, Deep Operator Network (DeepONet), Fourier Neural Operator (FNO), and Continuous Vision Transformer (CViT), across five diverse parametric PDE systems. Our results show that CViT provides consistently strong and stable performance across the considered benchmarks. Beyond architecture, we find that several optimization pathologies previously identified in PINN training naturally arise in PINOs, including gradient conflicts and causal violation. We also find that mitigation algorithms developed for PINNs remain effective in the PINO setting. We further compare physics-informed and data-driven training under different data regimes, revealing that a carefully designed physics-informed training pipeline can match, and in some cases, outperform purely data-driven neural operators. Taken together, these findings provide a systematic empirical understanding of the optimization challenges in PINO training and inform a practical pipeline for efficient and robust physics-informed operator learning. Code and data are available at https://github.com/NanxiiChen/PI-CViT.

</details>


### [355] [Learning to model pediatric asthma exacerbation from multiple risk factors: a case study in coastal Virginia](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.06174)
*Jonathan Colen,Eric Werner,Maryam Golbazi,Heather Richter,Diana McSpadden,Amy Quinn,Jocel Santos,Mary Jane Darling,Mary Margaret Gleason*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本研究对比了广义线性模型、神经网络和稀疏字典学习三种方法，用于预测美国弗吉尼亚州汉普顿路地区儿童哮喘急性发作，发现各模型在风险估计上具有一致性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 儿童哮喘急性发作受空气污染、气象和社区社会经济因素共同影响，在大型时空数据中需要分离多种因素的贡献，但现有方法在预测能力和可解释性之间难以兼顾。

Method: 收集2018-2023年空气污染、气象和社区机会数据后，以广义线性模型为基线、神经网络为高预测力目标，并开发基于稀疏字典学习的框架来识别简洁的非线性交互方程，在三种方法间进行对比。

Result: 三种模型在输入暴露变量对哮喘急性发作的相对风险估计上达成共识，稀疏字典学习在统计模型和深度学习之间提供了可解释的桥梁。

Conclusion: 该工作将统计模型与可解释机器学习模型联系起来，揭示了可能影响哮喘急性发作的协同交互作用，为未来指导弗吉尼亚沿海地区公共卫生干预措施提供了基础。

Abstract: Childhood asthma is a common illness exacerbated by air pollution as well as meteorological and neighborhood-level socioeconomic factors. Modeling asthma exacerbation (AE) in large spatiotemporal datasets requires disentangling impacts from multiple contributors. In this case study, we compared three techniques that balance predictive power with interpretability to predict AE in Hampton Roads, a coastal Virginia region comprising 7 cities and over 1.5 million people. After collating ambient air pollution measurements, weather data, and measures of neighborhood opportunity, we modeled zip code-level acute AE visits to a regional children's hospital and affiliated providers from 2018-2023. Generalized linear models (GLM) provided a baseline while neural networks (NN) served as a maximally predictive target. To bridge between statistical models and deep learning, we developed a framework based on sparse dictionary learning to identify and interpret parsimonious nonlinear interacting equations. After comparing each model's predictive performance, we estimated relative risks for AE due to input exposure variables and found consensus across frameworks. Our work links statistical and interpretable machine learning models to highlight possible synergistic interactions influencing AE, and may enable future studies to guide public health interventions in coastal Virginia.

</details>


### [356] [Learning to Route LLMs from Implicit Cost-Performance Preferences via Meta-Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.06178)
*Jiahao Zeng,Ming Tang,Ningning Ding*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出MetaRouter，一种基于元学习的个性化LLM路由框架，通过少量交互学习用户隐式偏好，在成本和性能之间实现最优平衡，在分布内和分布外任务上均优于强基线方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有LLM路由方法无法适应不同用户对成本-性能的个性化偏好，缺乏用户中心化的优化方案。

Method: 将用户偏好建模为上下文多臂老虎机中的不同任务，提出MetaRouter元学习框架，通过少量交互高效学习用户隐式偏好，实现个性化路由决策。

Result: MetaRouter在分布内和分布外任务上均优于强基线方法，且在学习用户偏好效率、对可路由LLM变化的鲁棒性以及多模型路由可扩展性方面表现优异。

Conclusion: MetaRouter有效解决了个性化LLM路由中用户偏好异质性的挑战，实现了用户中心化的成本-性能优化。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) present a trade-off between performance and cost, where more powerful models incur greater expense. LLM routing aims to mitigate expenses while maintaining performance by sending queries to the most suitable model. However, existing methods cannot perform well for different user cost-performance preferences. To address this gap, we introduce a novel perceptive LLM routing paradigm for personalized and user-centric cost-performance optimization, which efficiently learns users' implicit preferences through little interaction. To handle the challenge of heterogeneous user needs, we formulate preference profiles as a set of distinct tasks in contextual bandit and propose MetaRouter, a meta-learning framework designed for preference-aware LLM routing. Experimental results show that MetaRouter outperforms strong baselines on both in-distribution and out-of-distribution tasks. Furthermore, it exhibits high efficiency in learning user preferences, robustness to changes in the routable LLMs, and scalability to multi-model routing.

</details>


### [357] [A Machine Learning-Based Framework for Discovering Huntington's Disease Stages: Integrating Graph Representation Learning and clustering to Uncover Progression Dynamics in Longitudinal Enroll-HD Dataset](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.06196)
*Lubna M. Abu Zohair,Marta Vallejo,MD Azher Uddin,John R. Woodward,Hind Zantout*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于动态图表示学习的无监督框架，用于从纵向临床数据中识别亨廷顿舞蹈症的疾病阶段，在302名患者的队列中识别出4个具有临床意义的、统计上显著的疾病阶段。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有HD临床分期框架依赖预定义的临床测量阈值和专家决策，离散截断值可能掩盖有意义的阶段内变异，且容易受到评估者间差异的影响，尤其是在运动和功能评估方面。

Method: 基于动态图表示学习捕获患者内和患者间的纵向时序关系，使用K-means++聚类识别分组，通过迭代增加聚类数并进行稳定性分析以发现有意义的聚类。

Result: 在302名受试者（1,477次访视，每访视44个临床变量）的Enroll-HD队列中，使用四维潜在空间实现了稳健的聚类性能，通过聚类稳定性分析识别出4个有意义且统计上显著的疾病阶段。

Conclusion: 每个阶段对应明确的临床测量边界，与已有的临床分期方法相比重叠最小，表明该数据驱动方法能够更准确地反映疾病自然进展过程。

Abstract: Huntington's disease (HD) is a progressive brain disorder that gradually affects movement, cognitive function, and behavior. Identifying the stage of the disease accurately and consistently is important for understanding its course, grouping patients, personalized care, and discovering treatment. Existing clinical staging frameworks rely primarily on predefined clinical measurement thresholds and clinical expert decisions, yet these discrete cut-offs may obscure meaningful intra-stage variability and remain vulnerable to inter-rater differences, especially in motor and functional assessments. To address these limitations, we developed an unsupervised machine learning framework based on dynamic graph representation learning to capture temporal relationships within and across patients from longitudinal clinical measurements. Using the learned representations, we applied K-means++ clustering to identify well-separated groups. We then iteratively increased the number of clusters (k), using stability analysis to assess robustness and reveal additional meaningful clusters beyond the initial optimal solution. We applied the framework to 302 individuals from the Enroll-HD cohort (1,477 visits, 44 clinical variables per visit; 80% manifest participants), enabling data-driven discovery of HD stages reflecting natural clinical progression. Despite the limited cohort size, the proposed framework achieved robust clustering performance using a four-dimensional latent space, identifying four meaningful and statistically distinct disease stages through clustering stability analysis. Each stage corresponded to well-defined clinical measurement boundaries, with minimal overlap compared to previously established clinical staging methods.

</details>


### [358] [Non-Negative Matrix Factorization for Event Data](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.06205)
*Raphaël Romero*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出EventNMF，一种直接作用于连续时间事件数据的非负矩阵分解模型，通过泊松过程与B样条基对事件时间建模，避免传统分箱或平滑预处理带来的信息损失，并在合成与真实数据上验证了其有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有NMF方法处理连续时间事件数据时需先进行分箱或平滑预处理，这可能导致实体级异质性和细粒度时间特征被抹除，因此需要一种直接对原始事件时间建模的方法。

Method: 将每个实体的事件建模为泊松过程，其强度通过非负B样条基进行因子分解，通过简单估计过程恢复跨实体共享的可解释时间模板。

Result: 标准分箱计数方法可视为零次样条的特例；方法数学严谨、易于实现、计算高效；在合成潜在因子模型和多个真实数据集上验证了有效性。

Conclusion: EventNMF提供了一种直接从连续时间事件数据中学习可解释结构的原理性方法，避免了预处理带来的信息损失，并在多个领域展现出应用潜力。

Abstract: Continuous-time event data, in which entities emit instantaneous events over time, arises naturally across many domains such as neuroscience, seismology, and social networks. Non-negative matrix factorization (NMF) is a natural tool to uncover interpretable structure in such data, but it has so far only been applied after binning or smoothing the entity-level counting measures. This preprocessing step comes with the risk of erasing entity-level heterogeneities and fine-grained temporal features. In this paper, we introduce EventNMF, a continuous-time non-negative factorization model that operates directly on event times: each entity's events are modeled as a Poisson process whose intensity factorizes through a non-negative B-spline basis, and a simple estimation procedure recovers interpretable temporal templates shared across entities. The resulting method is mathematically principled, easy to implement, and computationally efficient. We further show that standard binned-count approaches arise as the special case of degree-zero splines, explore bias-variance tradeoffs and compare against existing methods on a synthetic latent factor model, and demonstrate the effectiveness of EventNMF on several real-world applications.

</details>


### [359] [Design a Reliable LLM-Integrated Interface for Mortality Forecasting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.06235)
*Thi Kim Ngan Nguyen*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一个集成大语言模型（LLM）的死亡率预测接口，通过将自然语言输入转化为结构化配置，在保持统计严谨性的同时提高了非专业用户的可访问性。系统基于CoMoMo包构建基线管道，采用滚动原点评估和MSE进行多步预测，实验表明LLM能在不牺牲可重复性、透明性和精算有效性的前提下增强可用性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 死亡率预测在精算和政策决策中至关重要，但技术复杂度高，非专业用户难以使用。现有工具缺乏用户友好的交互方式，限制了其广泛应用。

Method: 采用三阶段方法论：1）使用CoMoMo包实现基线预测管道并复现既有结果；2）扩展管道以支持滚动原点评估和MSE度量的多步预测；3）构建原型接口，利用本地LLM将用户的自然语言请求转化为确定性预测管道的结构化配置。

Result: LLM集成接口能够有效处理自然语言预测请求，在提高可用性的同时保持了预测的可重复性、透明性和精算有效性。

Conclusion: LLM可以作为受约束的编排层，在高风险分析工作流中增强可访问性而不牺牲统计严谨性，为精算领域的人机协作提供了可行方案。

Abstract: Mortality forecasting plays an important role in actuarial and policy decision-making, but its implementation remains technically complex and inaccessible to non-expert users. This project proposes a reliable large language model (LLM)-integrated interface that improves usability while maintaining statistical power. The LLM is designed as a constrained orchestration layer that translates natural-language inputs into structured configurations for a deterministic forecasting pipeline. A three-phase methodology is employed to ensure accuracy, usability, and transparency. First, a baseline pipeline is implemented using the CoMoMo package, reproducing established mortality forecasting results. Second, the pipeline is extended to generate multi-step forecasts using rolling-origin evaluation and mean squared error (MSE). Third, a prototype interface uses a local LLM to handle users' forecasting requests in plain language. The system demonstrates that LLMs can enhance accessibility without compromising reproducibility, transparency, or actuarial validity in high-stakes analytical workflows.

</details>


### [360] [Tracing the Oracle: Improving Diffusion Timestep Scheduling for 3D CT Reconstruction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.06236)
*Yujia Wu,Zhaoqiang Liu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出TrO框架，通过动态规划从密集采样轨迹中提取最优时间步调度，在极少采样步数（≤10步）下显著提升3D CT重建的保真度和计算效率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有扩散模型求解3D CT逆问题时，均匀时间步调度无法捕捉反向条件扩散SDE的非均匀演化，导致较大的截断误差，且推理计算开销巨大。

Method: 对少量样本进行密集采样数值积分轨迹作为参考"预言"（Oracle），利用动态规划全局最小化少步近似与预言之间的累积误差，从而提取最优的非均匀时间步调度。

Result: 在AAPM数据集上的多项3D CT重建任务中，结合SOTA方法DDS，TrO优化的时间步在≤10步的严格预算下显著优于现有启发式调度，兼顾了重建保真度和计算效率。

Conclusion: TrO作为一种即插即用的框架，通过数据驱动的最优时间步分配策略，有效解决了扩散模型在3D CT逆问题中的计算瓶颈与截断误差问题。

Abstract: Pretrained diffusion models demonstrate impressive potential in solving highly ill-posed 3D computed tomography (CT) inverse problems, while the inference process suffers from significant computational overhead. Furthermore, existing uniform timestep schedules fail to capture the non-uniform evolution of the reverse conditional diffusion stochastic differential equation, thereby introducing substantial truncation errors. To overcome this limitation, we propose Tracing the Oracle (TrO), a plug-and-play framework for improved timestep scheduling. Specifically, we treat densely sampled numerical integration trajectories on a few samples as the reference oracle. The optimized schedule is extracted by leveraging dynamic programming to globally minimize the cumulative error between the few-step approximation and the oracle. This mechanism precisely allocates the limited sampling steps to critical evolution stages that are highly susceptible to truncation errors. Our extensive experiments on the AAPM dataset across multiple 3D CT reconstruction tasks demonstrate that, when combined with the state-of-the-art 3D CT reconstruction method DDS, our optimized timesteps significantly improve reconstruction fidelity and computational efficiency compared to existing heuristic schedules, especially under a strict budget of no more than 10 sampling steps.

</details>


### [361] [Generative Criticality in Large Language Model Temperature Scaling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.06238)
*Huajian Ruan,Jinyang Li,Xingyu Guo,Lingxiao Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出统计场框架，将LLM的token嵌入视为一维自旋链，通过改变softmax温度T观察到类似连续相变的临界现象：在特征温度T_c附近出现磁化率峰值、序参量突变、语义方向坍缩以及本征维度极小值，该现象在0.6B-32B规模的Qwen3模型和多种提示类别中保持稳健。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的LLM文本生成研究多从语言学或工程角度分析，缺乏从统计物理视角系统理解解码过程中token嵌入的集体行为与结构相变机制。

Method: 将token嵌入视为连续自旋变量，定义连通两点关联函数的磁化率和系综平均嵌入场的序参量；通过改变softmax温度T扫描临界区域；利用TwoNN方法估计本征维度作为独立验证手段。

Result: 在T_c附近观察到：(1) 磁化率出现尖锐峰值且呈幂律标度行为；(2) 序参量发生快速变化；(3) T_c以下嵌入坍缩到单一语义方向；(4) TwoNN本征维度在T_c附近达到最小值。该结果在Qwen3 0.6B-32B规模及多种提示类别中均稳健。

Conclusion: LLM文本生成在统计场框架下表现出类似连续相变的临界现象，但自回归生成的非平衡特性需进一步研究。该框架为探测LLM输出的集体统计结构提供了定量工具，并暗示解码策略与临界现象之间的潜在联系。

Abstract: We propose a statistical-field framework for text generated by large language models (LLMs), treating token embeddings as continuous spin variables on a one-dimensional chain. Defining a susceptibility from the connected two-point correlator and an order parameter from the ensemble-averaged embedding field, we vary the \texttt{softmax} temperature $T$ and observe a sharp susceptibility peak near a characteristic $T_c$ with power-law-like scaling, a concurrent rapid change in the order parameter, and a collapse onto a single semantic direction below $T_c$. The intrinsic dimension estimated by the two nearest neighbor (TwoNN) method independently corroborates these findings, reaching a minimum near $T_c$. Results are robust across model scales (Qwen3: 0.6B--32B) and prompt categories. While the phenomenology closely resembles a continuous phase transition, the non-equilibrium nature of autoregressive generation warrants further investigation. Our framework provides quantitative tools for probing the collective statistical structure of LLM outputs and suggests connections between decoding strategies and critical phenomena.

</details>


### [362] [Your GFlowNet Secretly Learns an Optimal Transport Plan](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.06272)
*Ian Maksimov,Nikita Morozov,Denis Belomestny,Sergey Samsonov*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文建立了非有环GFlowNet与最优传输（OT）之间的理论联系，证明最小流GFlowNet在固定初始流分布时其目标函数可简化为具有图诱导最短路径代价的Kantorovich OT问题，且学习到的策略编码了最优传输计划，采样轨迹可恢复最优耦合。实验验证了该方法与精确OT求解器的一致性，并展示了GFlowNet学习高质量传输计划的能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 建立非有环GFlowNet与最优传输之间的理论联系，将GFlowNet学习框架扩展到大规模图上的最优传输问题。

Method: 通过理论推导证明最小流GFlowNet在固定初始流分布时等价于Kantorovich OT问题，利用边流和神经参数化在大图上求解OT。

Result: 与精确OT求解器结果一致，能学习到高质量的传输计划。

Conclusion: GFlowNet框架可有效应用于大规模图上的最优传输问题，提供了一种新的求解范式。

Abstract: Generative Flow Networks (GFlowNets) are a framework for sampling structured objects via stochastic trajectories in a directed graph. In this work, we establish a theoretical connection between non-acyclic GFlowNets and optimal transport (OT). We show that fixing the initial flow distribution in a minimum-flow GFlowNet reduces its objective to a Kantorovich OT problem with graph-induced shortest path costs. At the optimum, the learned GFlowNet policy therefore encodes an optimal transport plan from the source distribution to the target distribution: we show that sampling trajectories from the minimum-flow GFlowNet recovers the corresponding optimal coupling. Our formulation enables applying the GFlowNet learning framework to OT problems on large graphs via edge flows and neural parameterization. Experiments confirm agreement with exact OT solvers and demonstrate that GFlowNets can learn high-quality transport plans.

</details>


### [363] [PAC-Bayesian Adversarially Robust Generalization for Message Passing Graph Neural Networks: A Sensitivity Analysis](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.06293)
*Ziling Liang,Xinping Yi,Qingsong Wen,Shi Jin*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文针对消息传递图神经网络(MPGNN)在对抗攻击下的鲁棒泛化问题，将敏感性感知的PAC-Bayesian框架从深度神经网络扩展到MPGNN，通过利用输出Jacobian矩阵的秩至多为K（K类图分类）这一特性，构造Jacobian对齐的敏感性矩阵，并使用各向异性高斯后验优化KL散度上界，推导出更紧的鲁棒泛化界，将主导维度因子从隐藏宽度依赖项减小到类别数K。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有图神经网络对抗鲁棒性分析依赖各向同性高斯后验和全参数空间权重扰动控制，无法捕捉异构参数敏感性，且受隐藏宽度依赖项限制导致泛化界不够紧。

Method: 1) 量化不同参数块对网络输出的敏感性，推导关于权重参数的输出Jacobian矩阵；2) 利用K类图分类中Jacobian矩阵秩至多为K的特性，构造Jacobian对齐的敏感性矩阵；3) 使用各向异性高斯后验及优化协方差，紧致上界KL散度；4) 精炼学习权重的谱范数依赖，将主导维度因子从隐藏宽度项缩减为类别数K。

Result: 得到了比现有方法更紧的MPGNN鲁棒泛化保证，主要改进在于将复杂度项从隐藏宽度依赖降低到类别数K依赖。

Conclusion: 该敏感性感知的PAC-Bayesian框架能够为MPGNN提供更紧的鲁棒泛化界，从而指导模型设计以增强对抗鲁棒性。

Abstract: Whilst the vulnerability of graph neural networks (GNNs) to adversarial attacks poses a critical threat to graph representation learning, the understanding of the robust generalization behavior remains a fundamental challenge in the adversarial setting. Recently, PAC-Bayesian margin-based generalization analysis substantially advances this line of research by providing a flexible and data-dependent analytical framework. However, existing robust analyses often rely on isotropic Gaussian posteriors and control weight perturbations in the full parameter space, which limits the ability to capture heterogeneous parameter sensitivity yet hinges on hidden-width-dependent complexity terms, resulting in not-tight-enough generalization bounds. In this paper, we extend a recently proposed sensitivity-aware PAC-Bayesian framework from deep neural networks to message passing GNNs (MPGNNs) and derive a tighter robust generalization bound in the adversarial setting. Specifically, we first quantify how sensitive the perturbations across different parameter blocks are to the network outputs by deriving the output Jacobians with respect to the weight parameters. Exploiting the fact that these Jacobian matrices have rank at most $K$ in $K$-class graph classification, we then construct Jacobian-aligned sensitivity matrices and use anisotropic Gaussian posteriors with optimized covariances to upper bound the KL divergence in a tight way. Notably, by refining the spectral-norm dependence on the learned weights and reducing the leading dimension factor from hidden-width-dependent terms to the number of classes $K$, our analysis yields much tighter robust generalization guarantees for MPGNNs, thereby guiding their designs to enhance adversarial robustness.

</details>


### [364] [Reactive Flux Matching: Mechanism Discovery and Adaptive Sampling of Rare Events](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.06295)
*Rishal Aggarwal,David Ryan Koes,Nicholas M. Boffi,Eric Vanden-Eijnden*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出Flux Matching框架，从反应轨迹数据中学习电流速度u(z)和标量势h(z)，分别用于识别主导反应路径和作为数据驱动反应坐标，无需动力学或稳态分布先验知识，在分子系统上验证有效。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 路径采样方法可生成连接亚稳态的反应轨迹系综，但从中提取机理洞察仍具挑战性。

Method: 从反应轨迹数据中学习电流速度u(z)（流线追踪主导反应路径）和标量势h(z)（加权Helmholtz-Hodge分解获得，作为反应坐标），两者最小化反应路径系综上的二次泛函，类似于生成建模中的flow matching损失，无需动力学或稳态分布知识。

Result: 该方法在分子系统上通过生成电流速度轨迹和速率常数计算得到验证，且在投影到非马尔可夫集体变量上时仍保持良好定义，其水平集可为增强采样方法提供自适应界面。

Conclusion: Flux Matching是一种无需先验动力学的数据驱动框架，能从反应轨迹中同时提取反应路径和反应坐标，且优于基于committor的方法，适用于增强采样。

Abstract: Path sampling methods generate ensembles of reactive trajectories connecting metastable states, but extracting mechanistic insight from these data remains nontrivial. We introduce Flux Matching, a framework that learns two complementary objects directly from reactive trajectory data: a current velocity $u(z)$, whose streamlines trace the dominant reaction pathways, and a scalar potential $h(z)$, obtained from a weighted Helmholtz-Hodge decomposition of the reactive current, that serves as a data-driven reaction coordinate. Both minimize quadratic functionals over the reactive path ensemble, analogous to the flow matching loss in generative modeling, and require no knowledge of the underlying dynamics or stationary distribution. Unlike committor-based methods, $u$ and $h$ remain well-defined under projection onto non-Markovian collective variables, and their level sets in turn provide adaptive interfaces for improved sampling with enhanced sampling methods. Flux Matching is validated through the generation of current velocity trajectories and rate constant calculations on molecular systems.

</details>


### [365] [Tangram: Unlocking Non-Uniform KV Cache for Efficient Multi-turn LLM Serving](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.06302)
*Hyungmin Kim,Minsoo Kim,Hongseok Kim,Jungwook Choi*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: Tangram是一个针对非均匀KV缓存优化的LLM服务系统，通过确定性预算分配、头组页面管理和提前负载均衡三项技术，在不损失模型精度的情况下，将吞吐量提升高达2.6倍。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有LLM服务系统中，多轮对话场景下KV缓存线性增长带来严重的GPU显存和带宽压力。非均匀压缩虽能根据每个KV缓存的重要性保留更多信息，但由此带来的缓存异构性引发了内存碎片化、调度复杂度和内核利用率下降等系统效率问题。

Method: (1) 确定性预算分配：基于每个注意力头的固有模式分配静态内存占用，消除动态调度开销和预填充阻塞；(2) 头组页面组织：将具有相似保留需求的注意力头聚类，用独立的向量化页表管理，最大化物理内存回收；(3) 提前负载均衡：利用静态预算配置确保GPU均匀利用，避免运行时开销。

Result: 相比现有基线系统，Tangram在完全保持模型精度的前提下，吞吐量提升最高达2.6倍。

Conclusion: 通过系统层面的协同优化，Tangram使非均匀KV缓存在实际LLM服务场景中变得高效可行，解决了异构性带来的系统瓶颈。

Abstract: Multi-turn Large Language Model (LLM) serving is critical for consistent user experiences, yet the linear growth of the Key-Value (KV) cache imposes significant pressure on GPU memory and bandwidth. Non-uniform KV compression effectively preserves more information by considering the individual importance of each KV cache. However, such KV cache heterogeneity introduces various systemic challenges - including memory fragmentation, scheduling complexities, and diminished kernel utilization - which collectively lead to significant inefficiencies in existing LLM serving systems.
  To overcome these challenges, we present Tangram, a novel serving system designed to make Non-uniform KV caches practical. Tangram addresses systemic inefficiencies through three core techniques: (1) Deterministic Budget Allocation assigns a static memory footprint to each head based on its intrinsic pattern, entirely eliminating dynamic scheduling overhead and prefill stalls; (2) Head Group Page clusters attention heads with similar retention demands and manages them with independent, vectorized page tables, thereby maximizing physical memory reclamation; and (3) Ahead-of-Time (AOT) Load Balancing leverages static budget profiles to ensure uniform GPU utilization without runtime overhead. Experimental results show that Tangram improves throughput by up to 2.6x compared to existing baselines, while fully preserving model accuracy. Our implementation is publicly available at https://github.com/aiha-lab/TANGRAM.

</details>


### [366] [Plug-and-Play Guidance for Discrete Diffusion Models via Gradient-Informed Logit Correction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.06303)
*Hongkun Dou,Zike Chen,Fengji Li,Hongjue Li,Yue Deng*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出GILC框架，利用预训练去噪网络作为变分代理，通过雅可比自由机制直接校正干净预测logits，实现对离散扩散模型的高效可控生成，无需额外训练或重训，在DNA、蛋白质序列和分子生成任务上达到SOTA性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有离散扩散模型的可控生成方法存在计算开销大或需要重训练的问题，且高维离散空间中的梯度不稳定性导致引导信号估计困难。

Method: 提出GILC框架，利用预训练去噪网络作为变分代理来估计引导信号；引入无雅可比机制直接校正干净预测logits，避免高维离散空间的梯度不稳定问题；支持可微和不可微奖励函数。

Result: 在DNA、蛋白质序列和分子生成任务上达到SOTA性能，且无需额外训练，通常优于微调方法。

Conclusion: GILC是一种即插即用的高效离散扩散模型可控生成框架，通过logits校正实现稳定引导，性能优异且无需重训练。

Abstract: Controllable generation with discrete diffusion models is often hindered by high computational overhead or the need for retraining. In this paper, we present \underline{\textbf{G}}radient-\underline{\textbf{I}}nformed \underline{\textbf{L}}ogit \underline{\textbf{C}}orrection (\textbf{GILC}), a plug-and-play framework that efficiently estimates guidance signals by repurposing the pretrained denoising network as a variational proxy. To circumvent the gradient instability inherent in high-dimensional discrete spaces, we introduce a Jacobian-free mechanism that directly corrects the clean prediction logits, facilitating stable and effective guidance. Our method accommodates both differentiable and non-differentiable reward functions. Extensive experiments across DNA, protein sequence, and molecular generation tasks demonstrate that GILC achieves state-of-the-art performance without additional training, frequently outperforming fine-tuning approaches.

</details>


### [367] [Learning What to Forget: Improving LLM Unlearning via Learned Token-Level Importance](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.06320)
*Gizem Yüce,Giorgos Nikolaou,Nicolas Flammarion*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出ATWU框架，通过保留目标冲突准则联合学习token权重和模型参数，在无需外部监督的情况下实现自回归语言模型中token级别的精准遗忘，取得了最优的遗忘-保留权衡。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有机器遗忘方法未考虑遗忘样本中不同token的相关性差异，依赖辅助模型、启发式规则或外部标注来估计token重要性，缺乏无监督且高效的token级遗忘权重学习机制。

Method: 将遗忘token权重与模型参数建模为联合优化问题，基于保留目标冲突准则定义token的遗忘特异性；提出ATWU框架，使用轻量级线性评分器基于隐藏状态学习token权重，并与模型参数交替更新。

Result: 在TOFU和RWKU基准上，ATWU实现了最优的遗忘-保留权衡，超越样本级方法、概率加权启发式和辅助模型方法；学习到的token权重与真实遗忘区域高度对齐。

Conclusion: 保留目标冲突是识别语言模型应遗忘内容的有效准则，可实现无监督的token级遗忘特异性学习，且计算开销极低。

Abstract: Machine unlearning aims to remove targeted knowledge from a trained model while preserving its general capabilities. For autoregressive language models, not all tokens in a forget sample are equally relevant to forgetting. Existing approaches either ignore this heterogeneity or rely on auxiliary models, heuristics, or external annotations to estimate each token's relevance for forgetting. We instead characterize it through the interaction with the retain objective: a token is forget-specific to the extent that minimizing the forget loss on that token does not conflict with retain optimality. We formalize this perspective as a joint optimization problem over the model parameters and the token weights and show that, under a natural separation condition, the resulting objective recovers the oracle forget-specific token support. Motivated by this formulation, we introduce Alternating Token-Weighted Unlearning (ATWU), a lightweight framework that jointly learns token forget-specificity and model parameters during unlearning using a simple linear scorer over the hidden states, without external token level supervision. Across TOFU and RWKU, ATWU achieves state of the art forget-retain trade-offs, outperforming sample-level methods, probability-based token weighting heuristics, and auxiliary-model-based approaches. Moreover, the learned scores align substantially better with ground truth forget-specific spans, indicating that ATWU identifies semantically meaningful token level forgetting signals. Overall, our results suggest that retain conflict provides an effective criterion for identifying what language models should forget, enabling unsupervised learning of token level forget-specificity directly from model representations with minimal computational overhead.

</details>


### [368] [PAMF: Prior-Aware Multimodal Fusion for Incomplete Time Series Data](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.06328)
*Ziwen Kan,Wugeng Zheng,Tianlong Chen,Song Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出了PAMF框架，通过先验感知的流匹配和权重共享，显式处理多模态时间序列中的两种缺失模式（模态内缺失和模态级缺失），并将插补与下游预测任务耦合，在多个医疗基准上取得最优性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有方法通常通过掩码或缺失嵌入隐式表示缺失数据，缺乏对实例特定缺失信息的学习；多数方法仅针对一种缺失模式设计；现有插补方法忽视不同缺失模式的结构先验差异，且插补过程与下游任务隔离，无法引导插补生成更具信息量的表征。

Method: 提出PAMF框架：1）使用类型特定的先验初始化流匹配源状态，区分两种缺失类型（模态内缺失和模态级缺失）；2）通过架构匹配的编码器和权重共享，将插补与分类任务连接，使任务相关表征传递到插补过程。

Result: 在多个多模态医疗时间序列基准上，PAMF在多样化的数据集和缺失设置下，相比现有基线方法实现了最强的整体下游任务性能。

Conclusion: 显式建模不同缺失模式的结构先验，并通过流匹配耦合插补与下游任务，能有效提升多模态时间序列在下游任务中的表现。

Abstract: In healthcare, multimodal time series tasks often operate on incomplete observations in practice, for example when ECG segments are lost because electrodes detach or an entire respiratory channel is unavailable during overnight monitoring. Such missingness typically appears in two structurally distinct patterns: within-modality missing, where values are absent within an otherwise observed modality, and modality-level missing, where an entire modality is unavailable. Existing methods typically represent unobserved data implicitly through masks or missing embeddings, without learning instance-specific missing information, and most are designed for only one missingness pattern. A natural approach is to explicitly estimate the missing data; however, existing imputation methods treat missingness uniformly despite their different structural priors, and the imputation process is often isolated from downstream tasks, preventing downstream tasks from guiding imputation toward more informative representations. To address these limitations, we present PAMF, a multimodal time-series framework that explicitly handles different missingness patterns while coupling imputation with downstream prediction through prior-aware flow matching and weight sharing. Specifically, the method initializes the flow-matching source state with type-specific priors to distinguish two missing types. It further connects imputation and classification through architecturally matched encoders with weight sharing, transferring task-relevant representations into the imputation process. Experiments on multiple multimodal healthcare time-series benchmarks show that the proposed method achieves the strongest overall downstream performance across diverse datasets and missing settings compared with existing baselines.

</details>


### [369] [Efficient Mean Curvature Computation on High-Dimensional Data Manifolds](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.06329)
*Alexandre L. M. Levada*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了两种互补方法，将高维数据集局部平均曲率计算的每点复杂度从O(m⁴)降至O(k²m + kmp²)，实现了50-300倍加速，且精度损失可忽略不计。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 高维数据集中各点的局部平均曲率估计是几何感知机器学习（如MCBP方法）的关键，但基于k近邻局部形状算子的朴素实现需要构造矩阵H，其迹形式导致每点O(m⁴)的计算成本，使得该方法在特征维度超过数十时难以应用。

Method: 1) 利用协方差矩阵特征向量的正交性和迹算子的循环性，推导出精确代数恒等式，消除矩阵H，将每点成本降至特征分解后的O(m²)；2) 针对局部协方差矩阵秩最多为k-1的特点，用k×m中心化数据矩阵的截断SVD替代完全特征分解（O(k²m)），并基于Haar测度下零空间特征向量外积的期望值推导其贡献的解析近似。最终总成本为O(k²m + kmp²)，其中p=k-1。

Result: 在真实数据集上，相比原始实现实现了50-300倍加速，且使用快速估计器替代原始版本时精度损失可忽略不计。

Conclusion: 该方法提供了可扩展的、数据驱动的局部曲率估计，使曲率成为从经典到现代深度学习管道中广泛机器学习任务的实用几何特征。

Abstract: Estimating local mean curvature at each point of a high-dimensional dataset is a key ingredient of geometry-aware machine learning algorithms, such as the Mean Curvature Boundary Points (MCBP) method. The naive implementation of this computation, based on a local shape operator approximated from k-nearest neighbor patches, involves an explicit construction of a matrix $H$ whose trace form yields an $O(m^4)$ cost per point, rendering the approach intractable for datasets with more than a few dozen features. This paper introduces two complementary contributions that together reduce this cost by several orders of magnitude. The first contribution is an exact algebraic identity. This identity, derived from the orthogonality of the eigenvectors of the covariance matrix and the cyclicity of the trace operator, eliminates $H$ entirely and reduces the per-point cost to $O(m^2)$ after the eigendecomposition. The second contribution addresses the remaining $O(m^3)$ bottleneck of the full eigendecomposition. Since the local covariance matrix has rank at most $k-1 \ll m$, we replace it with a truncated SVD of the $k \times m$ centered data matrix, an $O(k^2 m)$ operation, and derive an analytical approximation for the contribution of the null-space eigenvectors based on the expected value of their outer product under the Haar measure. The resulting estimator has total cost $O(k^2 m + k m p^2)$, where $p = k-1$. Experiments on real-world datasets confirm speedups of 50 to 300 times relative to the original implementation, with negligible loss when the fast estimator is used to replace the original version. By providing a scalable and data-driven estimate of local curvature, the proposed method establishes curvature as a practical geometric feature for a broad range of machine learning tasks, from classical to modern deep learning pipelines.

</details>


### [370] [Subspace-Aware Sparse Autoencoders for Effective Mechanistic Interpretability](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.06333)
*Seyed Arshan Dalili,Mehrdad Mahdavi*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文指出现有稀疏自编码器(SAE)假设每个潜在特征为一维向量，这与语言模型中特征固有的多维结构不匹配，导致特征分裂问题。作者从几何和优化角度证明了这种分裂的必然性，并提出子空间感知稀疏自编码器(SASA)，通过学习子空间解码器、块稀疏门控和核范数正则化来保留特征的多维结构，在GPT-2和Mistral-7B上减少了特征分裂，提升了可解释性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有SAE将每个潜在特征建模为单一解码器方向，隐含了特征是一维的假设，但与语言模型中特征的多维结构不匹配，导致特征分裂和虚假的多义性。

Method: 从几何角度证明：重建内在维度d_i≥2的特征到误差ε需要指数级数量的单方向解码器；从优化角度证明：存在从真实d_i维基到更低L1正则化SAE风险的连续路径。提出SASA：用学习到的子空间替代单向量解码器，通过Top-s组门控实现块稀疏，并利用核范数正则化自适应调整每个组的有效秩。

Result: 在GPT-2和Mistral-7B上，SASA减少了特征分裂和吸收现象，提高了单义性和可解释性，在约一半的token预算下达到或超过了标准SAE的性能。

Conclusion: 单方向解码器的特征一维假设是SAE特征分裂的根源，SASA通过子空间解码器保留了特征的多维几何结构，将样本复杂度从指数级降为多项式级，为机制可解释性提供了更忠实的方法。

Abstract: Sparse Autoencoders (SAEs) are widely used for mechanistic interpretability in large language models, yet their formulation assigns each latent feature a single decoder direction, implicitly assuming features to be one-dimensional. We show that this assumption mismatches with the multi-dimensional structure of model features, provably inducing feature splitting through two distinct mechanisms. Geometrically, reconstructing a feature of intrinsic dimension $d_i \ge 2$ to error $\varepsilon$ with single-direction decoders forces a number of atoms that is exponential in $d_i$. From an end-to-end optimization perspective, this splitting is not merely possible but actively preferred. We prove that there exists a continuous path from the true $d_i$-dimensional basis to a strictly lower risk of the $\ell_1$-regularized SAE objective, whose descent directions drive any trained dictionary into that exponential regime. A single coherent feature is therefore fragmented across many near-collinear latents, producing spurious multiplicity and obscuring the intrinsic geometry. Motivated by this, we introduce Subspace-Aware Sparse Autoencoders (SASA), which replace single-vector decoders with learned decoder subspaces, enforce block sparsity via Top-$s$ group gating, and adapt each group's effective rank with a nuclear-norm regularizer. We then show that once the block size satisfies $r \ge d_i$, a single group not only can represent the entire feature slice but is the global minimizer of the SASA objective. This consolidation yields a sample complexity polynomial in $d_i$ rather than exponential -- a decisive advantage given that every training activation costs an LLM forward pass. Empirically, on GPT-2 and Mistral-7B, SASA reduces feature splitting and absorption, improves monosemanticity and interpretability, and matches or exceeds standard SAEs while training on roughly half the token budget.

</details>


### [371] [Quantifying the Privacy of Counterfactuals by Leveraging Membership Inference Attacks Against Synthetic Data](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.06334)
*Maryam Babaei,Yingke Wang,Hadrien Lautraite,Heber H. Arcolezi,Ulrich Aivodji,Sebastien Gambs*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文证明反事实解释与合成数据类似，可被攻击者利用进行隐私攻击。研究发现，针对合成数据的成员推理攻击可有效应用于反事实解释，且仅凭反事实本身（无需访问原模型）即可成功实施成员推理攻击，揭示了发布反事实解释的隐私风险。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 反事实解释常用于高风险决策领域解释模型，但可能被攻击者利用进行隐私攻击。作者类比反事实解释与合成数据的相似性，探究针对合成数据的隐私攻击能否迁移至反事实解释。

Method: 将针对合成数据的成员推理攻击应用于多种类型的反事实解释，并设计仅需反事实集合（无需模型访问权限）的成员推理攻击方法。

Result: 针对合成数据的成员推理攻击能有效攻击反事实解释；且无需访问原始模型，仅凭反事实集合即可成功实施成员推理攻击。

Conclusion: 模型开发者在发布反事实解释时应更加谨慎，否则可能导致隐私泄露。

Abstract: Counterfactuals are typically used in high-stakes decision areas to explain a machine learning model by showing how changes to the user profiles result in the desired outcome. However, explaining the model's decisions through counterfactuals can also be exploited by an adversary to conduct privacy attacks against the model or its training data. Drawing on the analogy that counterfactuals provide realistic substitutes for real training data, similar to synthetic data, we demonstrate in this paper how it is possible to successfully perform privacy attacks on counterfactuals by drawing on the attacks developed against synthetic data. More precisely, we investigate the effectiveness of the membership inference attacks designed for synthetic data on various types of counterfactuals. Additionally, while existing membership inference attacks against counterfactuals usually require to be able to query the model, we show how it is possible to perform successful membership inference attacks using only a set of counterfactuals, with no access to the model from which they are generated. Our results demonstrate that model developers should be more cautious when releasing counterfactuals to various users, as it can lead to a privacy breach.

</details>


### [372] [Bridging Domain Expertise and Generalization for Performance Estimation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.06335)
*Shuxuan Li,Zhilin Zhao,Quyu Kong,Wei-Shi Zheng*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出FRAP方法，通过融合基础模型与外部基础模型的互补优势，在分布偏移场景下构建更可靠的性能估计指标，显著优于现有方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有方法仅依赖给定模型输出，当分布偏移时模型偏差被放大，导致输出与真实性能相关性减弱，需要更可靠的替代标签来估计模型在无标签测试集上的表现。

Method: FRAP利用外部基础模型与基础模型的互补优势：先通过温度缩放校准对齐两模型的预测分布以最小化散度，再基于置信度加权融合得到精炼参考分布，最后计算基础模型预测与该参考分布的一致性作为性能估计。

Result: 在多种数据集和架构上的大量实验表明，FRAP在分布偏移场景下相较于代表性性能估计方法取得了一致且显著的改进。

Conclusion: 融合基础模型的鲁棒性与基础模型的领域专长能构建更可靠的性能代理指标，有效解决分布偏移下的模型行为预测问题。

Abstract: Performance estimation under distribution shift aims to predict how a model behaves on an unlabeled test set whose distribution differs from the training data, a scenario that requires reliable indicators that can faithfully reflect model behavior without ground-truth labels. Existing approaches rely solely on the outputs of the given model whose biases are amplified once the distribution shifts, weakening the correlation with the true performance. Motivated by this limitation, we propose Fused Reference Alignment Prediction (FRAP), which leverages the complementary strengths of an external foundation model and the base model to construct a more reliable surrogate of the ground-truth labels. FRAP aligns the prediction distribution of the foundation model with that of the base model by applying temperature-scaled calibration that minimizes their divergence. The aligned predictions are fused through confidence-based weighting into a refined reference distribution that integrates robustness from the foundation model and domain-specific expertise from the base model, and performance estimation is obtained by measuring how closely the base model predictions agree with this reference. Extensive experiments across diverse datasets and architectures show that FRAP provides consistent and substantial improvements over representative performance-estimation methods under distribution shift.

</details>


### [373] [Equivariant Neural Belief Propagation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.06344)
*Zehua Cheng,Wei Dai,Jiahao Sun*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出等变神经信念传播(ENBP)框架，通过等变高斯混合消息和秩2精度矩阵实现SE(3)对称性下的概率推理，在分子构象生成和机器人推理任务上达到SOTA性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有等变网络只能输出标量和向量，无法生成各向异性不确定性所需的秩2精度张量；单分量消息会崩溃多模态能量景观为物理无意义的平均值。

Method: 提出了ENBP因子图框架，消息为等变高斯混合模型，其充分统计量在SE(3)下精确变换；通过等变外积合成秩2精度矩阵，经可微谱分解处理，通过贪心KL散度混合约简保持可计算性且与SE(3)交换。

Result: 在GEOM-QM9和GEOM-Drugs上达到98.9%构象覆盖率，0.090Å误差，亚秒级延迟（比扩散基线快100倍以上）；在多体机器人推理中，标准Loopy BP在15+智能体时发散，ENBP收敛且碰撞率接近零，等变误差达机器精度（~10⁻⁷ vs 10⁻¹）。

Conclusion: ENBP通过等变高斯混合消息和秩2精度张量，成功解决了SE(3)对称性下概率推理的各向异性不确定性和多模态问题，在分子构象和机器人推理任务上显著优于现有方法。

Abstract: Probabilistic inference over spatially embedded variables requires beliefs that respect $SE(3)$ symmetry, yet existing equivariant networks produce only scalars and vectors -- not the rank-2 precision tensors needed for anisotropic uncertainty, and single-component messages collapse multi-modal energy landscapes to physically meaningless averages. We introduce Equivariant Neural Belief Propagation (ENBP), a factor-graph framework whose messages are equivariant Gaussian mixture models with sufficient statistics that transform exactly under $SE(3)$. Rank-2 precision matrices are synthesised via equivariant outer products, ingested through differentiable spectral decomposition, and kept tractable by a greedy KL-based mixture reduction that provably commutes with $SE(3)$. On GEOM-QM9 and GEOM-Drugs, ENBP achieves 98.9% conformational coverage at 0.090 $\mathring{A}$ error with sub-second latency -- over $100\times$ faster than diffusion baselines at higher accuracy. On multi-body robotic inference, vanilla loopy BP diverges at 15+ agents while ENBP converges with near-zero collision rates and machine-precision equivariance error (${\sim}10^{-7}$ vs.\ $10^{-1}$ for augmented baselines).

</details>


### [374] [Performance Evaluation of GraphCast for Medium-Range Weather Forecasting over Brazil](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.06348)
*Wolfgang R. Rowell,Lucas S. Kupssinskü*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本研究评估了GraphCast与ECMWF IFS HRES在巴西四个气候亚区的预报表现，发现GraphCast在冬季中程（2-7天）对南巴西快速传播的斜压系统表现不佳，但延伸期因平滑混沌小尺度变率而占优；夏季则能准确捕捉大尺度水汽输送，同时抑制高频对流变率对确定性预报的负面影响。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 尽管MLWP模型在全球尺度展现出显著技能，但在全球南方（尤其是巴西这种复杂高对流环境）的区域基准评估仍然稀缺，其实际效能未经验证。

Method: 采用可扩展云原生流水线和WeatherBench-X框架，以IFS分析为真值，选取四个季节性窗口，评估T850、Q850、Z500等对流层变量，对比GraphCast与IFS HRES的统计指标。

Result: 冬季中程（2-7天）GraphCast在Z500上对南巴西快速斜压系统表现劣于IFS；延伸期因平滑混沌变率而占优。夏季湿季GraphCast准确捕捉大尺度水汽输送，同时抑制高频对流变率对确定性预报的降质。

Conclusion: 为巴西建立了MLWP模型区域基准，明确了特定物理边界条件，为未来针对热带/副热带区域的模型"热带化"优化提供了指导方向。

Abstract: The paradigm of global weather forecasting is rapidly shifting with the emergence of Machine Learning Weather Prediction models (MLWP). While these data-driven architectures demonstrate remarkable global skill, regional benchmarks in the Global South remain scarce, leaving their efficacy in complex, highly convective environments largely unverified. This study evaluates the performance of GraphCast operational against the deterministic ECMWF IFS HRES as baseline across four distinct Brazilian climatic sub-regions. Utilizing a scalable, cloud-native pipeline and the WeatherBench-X framework for benchmarking weather models, we assess selected tropospheric variables ($T_{850}$, $Q_{850}$, $Z_{500}$) over four selected seasonal windows, employing the operational IFS analysis as the ground truth to calculate the statistical metrics for both models. Results reveal a regime-dependent skill profile. During the austral winter, GraphCast underperforms in the medium range (lead days 2-7) for $Z_{500}$ when resolving fast-propagating baroclinic systems over southern Brazil, but regains an advantage in the extended range, where its inherent smoothing of chaotic small-scale variability becomes beneficial under deterministic skill metrics. Conversely, during the austral summer wet season, GraphCast accurately captures large-scale moisture transport while intrinsically dampening the high-frequency convective variability that degrades deterministic NWP temperature forecasts. These findings establish a baseline for Brazil and define the specific physical boundaries that will guide future ``tropicalization'' efforts, aiming to optimize these foundational AI models for regional resilience.

</details>


### [375] [Maximising the Set-Piece Return: Optimising Football Corner Tactics with Graph Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.06353)
*Sean Groom,Michael Groom,Francisco Belo,Axl Rice,Liam Anderson,Victor-Alexandru Darvariu,Shuo Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于图强化学习的角球战术优化方法，通过调整进攻球员位置和速度来最大化首射概率，在3000多个英超角球数据上优于传统优化方法，实现了从历史模仿向奖励驱动的战术发现转变。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有足球战术分析方法局限于刻画历史动作或分析师指定的反事实场景，缺乏发现新的、可泛化的球员配置和策略的能力。

Method: 将角球战术优化形式化为一个决策问题，构建图结构的强化学习架构，训练中心策略调整进攻球员的位置和速度以最大化首射概率，该策略能泛化到任意初始球员位置。
