Result: 在超过3,000个英超角球数据上评估，该方法在匹配推理预算下显著优于基线优化技术。

Conclusion: 图强化学习能够将定位球分析从历史评估和模仿转向奖励驱动的战术发现。

Abstract: Machine learning is increasingly employed for the evaluation of football tactics. However, existing approaches focus on characterising historical actions or analyst-specified counterfactual scenarios. In this work, we seek to go beyond the imitation of historically observed patterns towards discovering new generalisable player configurations and strategies. To tackle this, we focus on optimising corner kick routines, and formulate a decision-making problem in which a central policy makes adjustments to attacking player positions and velocities to maximise first contact shot probability. Unlike classic optimisation that solves for isolated setups, we contribute a reinforcement learning architecture operating on graph-structured data that yields a general policy for adjusting arbitrary starting player positions. Evaluated on over 3,000 Premier League corners, our approach strongly outperforms baseline optimisation techniques under matched inference budgets. Our results suggest that graph reinforcement learning can shift set-piece analysis from historical evaluation and imitation towards reward-driven tactical discovery.

</details>


### [376] [End-to-End Subgraph Detection with GraphDETR](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.06364)
*Dexiong Chen,Till Hendrik Schulz,Karsten Borgwardt*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: GraphDETR 是一种基于深度学习的子图检测框架，将子图检测建模为集合预测问题，采用图神经网络编码目标图，并用 Transformer 解码器与可学习查询向量联合预测所有模式出现位置，通过端到端二分匹配训练，支持精确与近似匹配，在最多1000节点的图中可检测50节点的模式，在ChEMBL分子功能团检测中AP100达91.2。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 子图检测（子图同构）是NP完全问题，传统组合方法只能处理小规模模式或中等规模图，难以扩展到大图和近似匹配场景。

Method: GraphDETR将子图检测视为集合预测问题，使用GNN编码目标图，采用固定数量的可学习查询向量，通过Transformer解码器联合预测所有模式出现位置，训练采用端到端二分匹配损失。

Result: 可检测50节点模式（分子结构、环、团、模糊模式）在1000节点目标图中；在ChEMBL分子功能团检测上AP100达91.2。

Conclusion: GraphDETR有效解决了子图检测的扩展性问题，支持精确与近似匹配，在分子功能团检测等实际任务中表现优异。

Abstract: Subgraph detection seeks to identify whether and where instances of query patterns occur within a larger graph. This problem is fundamental across scientific domains and is closely related to subgraph isomorphism, which is NP-complete, limiting combinatorial approaches to small patterns or moderately sized graphs. We introduce GraphDETR, a deep learning framework that formulates subgraph detection as a set prediction problem, analogous to DETR in object detection. GraphDETR encodes the target graph with a graph neural network, and employs a fixed set of learnable query vectors, decoded via a transformer decoder, to predict all pattern occurrences jointly in a single forward pass. This is enabled by training the model end-to-end with bipartite matching. Unlike traditional combinatorial methods that only solve exact structural matching, GraphDETR naturally extends to approximate matching, enabling detection beyond exact pattern correspondence. Empirically, we show that GraphDETR can detect diverse patterns, such as molecular structures, cycles, cliques, and fuzzy patterns of up to 50 nodes, in target graphs with up to 1000 nodes. We further evaluate on molecular functional group detection over the ChEMBL dataset, where GraphDETR predicts the complete set of functional groups per molecule, achieving a strong performance of $\text{AP}_{100} = 91.2$.

</details>


### [377] [In-Context Multiple Instance Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.06458)
*Alexander Möllers,Marvin Sextro,Julius Hense,Gabriel Dernbach,Klaus-Robert Müller*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于感知器架构的上下文学习器，通过在合成数据上预训练，能够在极少标注样本下解决多实例学习任务，无需梯度更新，在12个基准测试中超越需要任务特定训练的监督基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有MIL算法在低标签样本场景下表现不佳：灵活模型容易过拟合，刚性模型难以适应任务需求。

Method: 采用感知器架构的上下文学习器，在合成数据上预训练；设计多种合成数据生成器捕获互补归纳偏置；推理时单次前向传播完成分类，无需梯度更新。

Result: 在12个MIL基准测试中达到最佳平均性能，超越需要任务特定训练的监督基线。

Conclusion: 混合合成数据生成器的预训练策略能有效继承各生成器的优势，实现低标签样本下的强泛化能力。

Abstract: Multiple Instance Learning (MIL) addresses problems where supervision is available at the level of bags of instances and has been successfully applied in fields ranging from computational pathology to satellite imagery. Nevertheless, existing algorithms struggle in the low-label regime that characterizes many real-world applications. Flexible models overfit and rigid ones fail to adapt to the task at hand. We show that pretraining an in-context learner with a Perceiver-style architecture on synthetic data yields a model that can solve new tasks from a handful of labeled bags. At inference time, classification happens in a single forward pass and requires no gradient updates. We propose and investigate different synthetic data generators for bag-structured data and find that they capture complementary inductive biases. A model pretrained on a mixture of these generators inherits their per-task strengths and achieves the best average performance across twelve MIL benchmarks, outperforming supervised baselines that require task-specific training.

</details>


### [378] [Learned Response-Field Inertia Operator for HEC-RAS 2D Water-Surface Elevation Prediction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.06385)
*Edward Holmberg,Elias Ioup,Md Meftahul Ferdaus,Mahdi Abdelguerfi,Julian Simeonov*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种跨数据集评估方法，用于HEC-RAS 2D中基于学习原生单元替代模型进行与求解器一致的水面高程预测。引入了无外力项、基于增量的学习替代模型LRFIO，该模型从已求解的HEC-RAS轨迹中校准惯性响应算子，并通过封闭形式原生单元滚动部署。评估涵盖四个不同基准测试，LRFIO表现出自适应学习复杂度，最大验证遗憾为4.30%，部署滚动时间在0.003至0.242秒之间，比HEC-RAS实现约2.75×10^4倍的加速。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于网格重映射的替代模型存在重映射误差和信息访问混杂问题，无法直接在原始非均匀计算单元上进行求解器一致的水面高程预测。目的是开发一种无需重映射、可直接在原生单元上运行且与求解器一致性更强的替代模型。

Method: 提出Learned Response-Field Inertia Operator (LRFIO)，一种无外力、基于增量的学习替代模型。从已求解的HEC-RAS 2D轨迹中校准惯性响应算子，通过封闭形式的原生单元滚动部署。评估采用从持久性到全局校准惯性再到分段响应场惯性的"基例优先"响应层次，并将分割、残差校正和神经化惯性作为可学习建模选择。

Result: 在四个不同HEC-RAS 2D基准上，LRFIO为不同领域保留了不同响应结构，最大验证遗憾为4.30%。部署滚动时间0.003-0.242秒，Beaver Bayou实测对比估计加速比约为2.75×10^4倍（按地平归一化）。

Conclusion: 当前原生单元增量是强求解器条件化的预测支架，只有在经验证据证明合理时，才应保留额外的响应场、神经或空间复杂度。

Abstract: This article presents a cross-dataset evaluation of learned native-cell surrogate models for solver-consistent water-surface elevation (WSE) prediction in HEC-RAS 2D. To avoid raster remapping error and information-access confounding, surrogates are evaluated directly on the original nonuniform computational cells under an explicit policy that separates static project inputs, current hydraulic state, project-input forcing, calibration-derived quantities, and future solver-output targets. We introduce the Learned Response-Field Inertia Operator (LRFIO), a no-forcing, increment-based learned surrogate that calibrates an inertial response operator from solved HEC-RAS trajectories and deploys the retained operator through closed-form native-cell rollout. LRFIO evaluates a base-case-first response hierarchy consisting of persistence, global calibrated inertia, and segmented response-field inertia. Segmentation, residual correction, and neuralized inertia are treated as learnable modeling choices, with added complexity retained only when validation evidence justifies its cost. Evaluated across four diverse HEC-RAS 2D benchmarks, LRFIO retains different response structures for different domains, demonstrating adaptive learned complexity. The selector audit shows controlled complexity with a maximum validation regret of 4.30%. During deployment, retained rollout times range from 0.003 s to 0.242 s, and the Beaver Bayou measured-solve comparison gives an estimated 2.75 x 10^4 horizon-normalized speedup over HEC-RAS. These results indicate that the current native-cell increment is a strong solver-conditioned predictive scaffold and that added response-field, neural, or spatial complexity should be retained only when empirically justified.

</details>


### [379] [Proper Scoring Rules for Right-Censored Survival Data](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.06393)
*Jef Jonkers,Glenn Van Wallendael,Luc Duchateau,Sofie Van Hoecke*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种针对右删失生存数据的通用评分框架：通过将预测分布映射到观测数据分布上，再应用标准评分规则，从而衍生出删失版的CRPS、Brier分数、能量分数等，并证明了边际化评分在条件独立删失下是恰当的。实验表明该方法能正确排序真实预测分布，而依赖预测的加权评分可能出现排序反转。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统概率评分规则（如CRPS、Brier分数等）在右删失数据中无法直接应用，因为事件时间仅被部分观测。现有方法缺乏一个统一、严格的理论框架来定义和证明删失场景下评分规则的恰当性（properness）。

Method: 核心思想是将预测分布通过删失机制进行映射，得到观测数据上的诱导分布，然后在该诱导分布上应用原始评分规则。具体分为两类：(1) 固定删失时间下的局部化评分；(2) 随机删失或仅部分观测删失时间时的边际化评分。以此框架统一了删失似然、IPCW加权准则，并衍生出删失版CRPS、pinball损失、Brier分数、能量分数等。同时提出"删失回归（censored engression）"作为多变量右删失生存建模的样本学习目标。

Result: (1) 边际化评分在条件独立删失下是恰当的（proper），在可识别区域上是严格恰当的。(2) 实验表明该方法在所有删失机制下均能正确排序真实预测分布，而依赖预测的加权评分（plug-in weighted scores）可能出现排序反转。(3) 删失回归显著优于直接在删失结果上训练的简单方法。

Conclusion: 该框架为右删失生存数据的概率预测评估提供了一套理论严谨、统一且实用的评分工具，同时拓展到多变量场景下的学习方法，具有广泛的应用前景。

Abstract: Proper scoring rules provide a rigorous theoretical basis for the training and evaluation of probabilistic forecasts. However, in the presence of right censoring, the event time is only partially observed, rendering conventional scoring rules inapplicable in their standard form. We propose a framework for proper scoring of right-censored survival outcomes based on a simple idea: first, map the predictive distribution through the censoring mechanism, then apply the underlying proper score on the induced observed-data law. This yields localized scores for fixed censoring times and marginalized scores when the censoring time is random or only partially observed. The resulting construction recovers familiar right-censored likelihood and IPCW-type criteria within a coherent framework, while also yielding right-censored versions of the CRPS, pinball loss, Brier score, and energy score. We show that the marginalized score is proper under conditional independent censoring and strictly proper on the identifiable region. The same principle also leads to censored engression, a sample-based learning objective for multivariate right-censored survival modeling. In experiments, our scores correctly rank the oracle forecast across several censoring regimes, whereas forecast-dependent plug-in weighted scores can exhibit ranking reversals. Censored engression likewise substantially improves over naive training on censored outcomes.

</details>


### [380] [The Post-GCN Decade Revisited: Curvature-Stratified Evaluation of Relational Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.06397)
*Shuo Wang,Xiangyu Wang,Quanxin Wang,Bailin Wu,Bokui Wang,Shunyang Huang,Boyan Deng,Haonan Liu,Ruiyi Fang,Zhenxiang Xu,Boyu Wang,Zhao Kang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出曲率分层评估框架，揭示关系学习模型性能本质上依赖于数据集的几何结构（曲率），传统聚合排行榜存在系统性偏差，并发现模型排名在不同曲率区间内高度稳定但跨区间显著变化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统关系学习评估依赖跨异质数据集的聚合排行榜，隐含假设均匀底层结构，导致系统性偏差——掩盖几何依赖的性能差异并误导关于模型泛化的结论。

Method: 提出曲率分层评估框架，将数据集按曲率分为正曲率、负曲率和近零曲率三个区间，在14个数据集上评估18个代表性模型（GCNs、GFMs、表格学习方法）。

Result: 模型排名在每个曲率区间内高度稳定，但跨区间显著变化；GFMs在某些曲率区间相比几何对齐的GNNs存在收益递减。

Conclusion: 关系学习性能本质上是几何依赖的而非通用可迁移的，应采用几何感知的评估协议替代标准聚合基准。

Abstract: Current evaluation practices in relational learning rely heavily on flat leaderboards that average performance across heterogeneous datasets, implicitly assuming a uniform underlying structure. We show that this assumption introduces systematic bias: it obscures geometry-dependent performance variations and can lead to misleading conclusions about model generalization. In this work, we identify intrinsic geometry as a key latent factor governing model effectiveness. We demonstrate that conventional aggregated metrics mask critical performance trade-offs that only become visible when datasets are stratified by their geometric properties. To address this issue, we introduce a curvature-stratified evaluation framework that partitions datasets into positive, negative, and near-zero curvature regimes. Our benchmark evaluates 18 representative models including Graph Convolutional Networks (GCNs), Graph Foundation Models (GFMs), and tabular learning methods across 14 datasets. We find that model rankings are highly stable within each curvature regime but shift significantly across regimes, indicating that performance is fundamentally geometry-dependent rather than universally transferable. Notably, we identify regimes where GFMs offer diminishing returns compared to geometry-aligned GNNs. Based on these findings, we propose a geometry-aware evaluation protocol that yields more reliable and interpretable comparisons than standard aggregated benchmarks. We release all code, curvature-stratified dataset splits, and evaluation tools to support reproducible and rigorous assessment of future relational learning methods. Code and datasets are provided in our project homepage: https://sirbabbage.github.io/CurvBench_HOME/.

</details>


### [381] [Double Preconditioning (DoPr): Optimization for Test-Time Performance, not Validation Loss](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.06418)
*Thomas T. Zhang,Alok Shah,Yifei Zhang,Vincent Zhang,Nikolai Matni,Max Simchowitz*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出一种名为双预处理（DoPr）的优化范式，结合梯度预处理和激活预处理，专门解决深度学习中因训练与部署目标不一致导致的测试时反馈（TTF）问题，实验表明该方法能在不显著改善验证损失的情况下提升下游任务性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 深度学习中许多应用（如自回归语言建模、流式生成模型、机器人策略学习）在训练时使用单步预测损失，但部署时需沿自身预测滚动执行，导致训练/验证损失与下游指标（如任务成功率、生成质量）之间存在严重失配（即测试时反馈TTF现象），且随任务长度增长而加剧。现有研究多从数据筛选、架构设计和目标函数设计角度缓解该问题，本文提出从优化这一新维度来缓解误差累积。

Method: 提出双预处理（DoPr）优化范式，将梯度预处理（如Adam、Muon中的方法）与激活预处理（如KFAC中的方法）相结合。具体而言，DoPr同时进行梯度方向的预处理和激活方向的预处理，以针对TTF场景下的误差传播特性进行优化。

Result: 在多种TTF场景下，DoPr作为即插即用干预手段，有效提升了下游模型性能。值得注意的是，这些测试时性能的提升并不总是伴随着验证损失的改善，揭示了当前以单步监督目标评估模型的局限性。

Conclusion: 优化方法可作为缓解测试时反馈问题的新设计维度；双预处理（DoPr）有效提升了TTF场景的下游性能；验证损失与下游指标的不一致表明需要重新思考如何正确评估以单步监督目标训练的模型。

Abstract: Many modern applications of deep learning involve training a neural network via a one-step prediction loss (e.g., $L^2$ regression, cross-entropy), but deploy the network by rolling out along its own predictions. Key examples include autoregressive language modeling, flow-based generative modeling, and robot policy learning. It is well-documented that these settings induce a phenomenon we call test-time feedback (TTF): the mismatch between the training/validation loss and downstream metrics of interest, such as task success rate and generation quality, which grows with task length. While data curation, architecture, and objective design have been proposed to combat train-test shift in TTF settings, this paper proposes optimization as a new design axis to mitigate error accumulation. Specifically, we introduce a new optimization paradigm called double-preconditioning (DoPr) uniquely tailored to the challenges of TTF. DoPr combines gradient-wise preconditioning, as in Adam and Muon, with activation-wise preconditioning (AP), such as in KFAC. We show that the addition of AP yields a drop-in intervention for increasing downstream model performance across a range of TTF settings. Interestingly, these gains in test-time performance do not consistently accompany improvements in validation loss, opening new questions about how to properly evaluate models trained with one-step supervised objectives.

</details>


### [382] [Causal Atlases from Entropic Inference: Bayesian Networks beyond Optimal DAGs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.06440)
*Hazhir Aliahmadi,Irina Babayan,Greg van Anders*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出基于熵推断的方法生成因果图谱集，以量化数据中固有的因果结构模糊性，并证明传统优化方法得到的DAG可能包含因果伪影。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统贝叶斯网络构建方法依赖优化策略，但底层数据可能允许多条因果链，优化方法难以忠实反映数据中的因果变异性，需要更忠实于数据的因果表示框架。

Method: 在2节点和20节点线性结构方程模型的模拟噪声数据上，采样最大熵图集合，通过熵基推断生成与数据一致的合理因果图谱集，量化因果关系的结构模糊性。

Result: 最大熵图集合能够量化因果关系的固有结构歧义性；"优化"后的DAG中包含的因果伪影在同等精度的拓扑结构中并不一致。

Conclusion: 基于熵推断的方法能生成与数据一致的多个因果映射，为因果关系中固有变异性提供更忠实的表示框架，优于传统优化方法。

Abstract: Data-driven causal relationship identification is pertinent to advancing understanding of complex systems both within and beyond science. Bayesian networks offer a probabilistic method for modelling generic causal relationships via directed acyclic graphs (DAGs). However, typical techniques for constructing Bayesian networks rely on optimization, which can be ill-suited for learning causal relationships because the underlying data may admit multiple chains of causation. More data-faithful representations of causal relationships would provide frameworks for constructing multiple causal maps that are consistent with the variability that is inherent in underlying data. Here, we show that entropy-based inference generates atlases of plausible causal relationships that are consistent with underlying data. On simulated noisy data of 2- and 20-node linear structural equation models, we sample a maximum-entropy ensemble of graphs that allow us to quantify the inherent structural ambiguity in underlying causal relationships. Our method shows that "optimized" DAGs can contain causal artifacts are not consistent across equivalently accurate topologies.

</details>


### [383] [Event Detection for Parameter-to-KPI Dependency Learning for AI-RAN](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.06459)
*Christie Djidjev,Nicholas Kaminski*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文针对AI-RAN/O-RAN架构中多AI驱动控制功能相互干扰的问题，提出了一种将连续遥测数据转换为二元事件指示器的显著性检测方法，并构建了合成闭环流量生成器来验证依赖恢复管线的有效性。实验表明该方法能在信号与背景噪声充分分离时可靠恢复潜在依赖结构，其中阈值校准是影响事件检测质量的关键因素。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 下一代无线网络中多个AI驱动的控制功能同时运行时会相互干扰，而现有方法难以从原始网络数据中检测这些交互。缺乏一个可靠、可解释的依赖结构来捕捉控制参数何时主动影响网络性能结果。

Method: 将连续遥测轨迹转换为二元事件指示器的问题形式化为显著性检测问题；引入带有植入潜在依赖关系的合成闭环流量生成器作为受控评估环境；构建基于机器学习的依赖恢复管线。

Result: 当信号与背景噪声充分分离时，所提管线能够可靠地恢复潜在依赖结构；阈值校准被确定为控制事件检测质量的关键因素。

Conclusion: 这项工作为自适应AI-RAN控制系统的可解释依赖学习奠定了 foundational 基础，是实现依赖结构学习所需的事件检测步骤的关键进展。

Abstract: Next-generation wireless networks are expected to rely on multiple concurrent AI-driven control functions that optimize different network objectives simultaneously, particularly in AI-integrated and open radio access network architectures such as AI Radio Access Network (AI-RAN) and Open Radio Access Network (O-RAN). When these functions interact, they can interfere with one another in ways that are difficult to detect from raw network data alone. A key missing piece for managing such interactions is a reliable, interpretable dependency structure that captures which control parameters are actively influencing which network performance outcomes at any given time. This paper focuses on the event-detection step needed to support such dependency learning by converting noisy continuous telemetry into binary indicators of parameter activity and KPI response. The central difficulty is that not every fluctuation in the data reflects a genuine control interaction, so the method must distinguish real parameter-outcome relationships from background variation. Because real AI-RAN traffic traces with known parameter-KPI ground truth are difficult to obtain, we introduce a synthetic closed-loop traffic generator with planted latent dependencies. We use this controlled telemetry to evaluate a machine-learning-based dependency recovery pipeline that formulates the conversion of continuous traces into binary event indicators as a significance-detection problem. Experimental evaluation shows that the proposed pipeline reliably recovers the latent dependency structure from noisy continuous traces when the signal is sufficiently separated from background variation, while highlighting threshold calibration as the key factor controlling event-detection quality. These results constitute a foundational step toward interpretable dependency learning for adaptive AI-RAN control systems.

</details>


### [384] [PC Layer: Polynomial Weight Preconditioning for Improving LLM Pre-Training](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.06470)
*Senmiao Wang,Tiantian Fang,Haoran Zhang,Yushun Zhang,Kunxiang Zhao,Alex Schwing,Ruoyu Sun*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出了一种预条件（PC）层，通过多项式预条件器对权重矩阵进行参数化，确保LLM训练中权重条件的稳定。PC模块通过低阶多项式预条件重塑权重矩阵的奇异值谱，训练后可合并回原始架构，不增加推理开销。在Llama-1B预训练中，PC层在AdamW和Muon优化器下均优于标准Transformer。理论上证明了均匀约束各层奇异值能确保梯度下降在深层线性网络中几何收敛到全局最小值。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM训练中权重矩阵的条件数不稳定会导致优化困难，现有方法缺乏对权重条件的显式控制，本文旨在通过预条件技术稳定训练过程。

Method: 提出预条件（PC）层，利用低阶多项式预条件器重塑权重矩阵的奇异值谱，训练后可将预条件权重合并回原始架构，无推理开销。

Result: 在Llama-1B预训练中，PC层在AdamW和Muon优化器下均优于标准Transformer。理论证明均匀约束各层奇异值可保证深层线性网络的几何收敛。

Conclusion: PC层是一种有效的权重参数化方法，能稳定训练条件数，提升LLM训练性能，且无推理开销。

Abstract: We propose a preconditioning (PC) layer, a weight parameterization via polynomial preconditioner that ensures stable weight conditioning throughout LLM training. The PC module reshapes the singular-value spectrum of weight matrices via low-degree polynomial preconditioning. After training, the preconditioned weights can be merged back into the original architecture, incurring no inference overhead. We demonstrate the advantage of the proposed PC layer over standard transformers in Llama-1B pre-training, for both the AdamW and Muon optimizers. Theoretically, we justify this spectrum-control principle by proving that uniformly bounding each layer's singular values ensures geometric convergence of gradient descent to global minima, for certain deep linear networks. Our code is available at https://github.com/Empath-aln/PC-layer.

</details>


### [385] [RREDCoT: Segment-Level Reward Redistribution for Reasoning Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.06475)
*Mykyta Ielanskyi,Kajetan Schweighofer,Lukas Aichberger,Sepp Hochreiter*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: RREDCoT通过模型自身近似最优奖励再分配，解决GRPO等强化学习方法在思维链训练中因延迟奖励导致的高方差问题，相比蒙特卡洛采样更高效。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: GRPO等强化学习方法在思维链推理中面临延迟奖励问题（仅能在完整CoT后分配奖励），而蒙特卡洛方法的高方差限制了训练效率；现有蒙特卡洛采样虽能提供无偏中间状态值估计，但其计算开销使其不适用于长上下文细粒度信用分配。

Method: 提出RREDCoT，利用模型自身（无需额外生成）近似最优奖励再分配函数；通过分割思维链轨迹并估计状态值，将延迟奖励重新分配给CoT中关键片段。

Result: 相比蒙特卡洛采样和多种归因方法，RREDCoT在信用分配效率上更优；分析了CoT轨迹分割粒度与状态值估计方法对再分配效果的影响。

Conclusion: RREDCoT为思维链训练中的延迟奖励问题提供了一种低计算开销的奖励再分配方案，通过自蒸馏方式实现高效信用分配。

Abstract: Recent advancements in reasoning language models have been driven by Reinforcement Learning (RL) fine-tuning. Most often, these rely on the Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) algorithm or modifications thereof to steer the models to produce Chain-of-Thought (CoT) traces. The final answer can only be verified, and the reward assigned, after the CoT trace is complete, making it a delayed reward problem. GRPO and its modifications correspond to Monte Carlo methods in standard RL, which are known to suffer from high variance. A possible solution to this problem is the redistribution of rewards through credit assignment, where segments of the CoT trace that are important for arriving at the desirable solution are emphasized by assigning a higher reward. While Monte Carlo sampling can be used to provide an unbiased estimate of intermediate state values, its computational overhead makes it unsuitable for train-time credit assignment in long contexts at high granularity. We introduce RREDCoT (Reward REDistribution for Chain of Thoughts), which utilizes the model itself to approximate the optimal reward redistribution without additional generation. We investigate the advantages of our method compared to MC sampling and several attribution methods. We further analyze several aspects relevant to the construction of the redistribution such as segmentation of CoT traces and state value estimation.

</details>


### [386] [Pretraining Recurrent Networks without Recurrence](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.06479)
*Akarsh Kumar,Phillip Isola*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出监督记忆训练（SMT），通过将RNN训练转化为一步记忆转换标签的监督学习，避免循环信用分配，实现时间并行训练和O(1)梯度路径，在语言建模等任务上优于BPTT。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 标准BPTT存在时间顺序限制导致的并行性差和长程依赖学习中的梯度消失/爆炸问题，需要一种更好的RNN训练方法。

Method: SMT方法：1) 用Transformer编码器基于预测状态目标学习记忆标签(m_t, x_{t+1}) → m_{t+1}，仅保留预测未来所需的过去信息；2) 将记忆更新与记忆内容解耦，实现时间并行训练；3) 无需展开RNN，任意两token间梯度路径长度为稳定的O(1)。

Result: 在语言建模和像素序列建模等预训练任务中，SMT训练的多种RNN架构优于BPTT，能更好地捕获长程依赖并实现并行训练。

Conclusion: SMT有望解锁能够构建过去经验的时间抽象的大规模模型。

Abstract: Training recurrent neural networks (RNNs) requires assigning credit across long sequences of computations. Standard backpropagation through time (BPTT) addresses this problem poorly: it is sequential in time, limiting parallelism, and suffers from vanishing or exploding gradients, making long-range associations difficult to learn. We propose Supervised Memory Training (SMT), a method for training nonlinear RNNs that sidesteps recurrent credit propagation entirely by reducing RNN training to supervised learning on one-step memory transition labels $(m_t, x_{t+1}) \rightarrow m_{t+1}$. SMT acquires these memory labels by training a Transformer-based encoder on a predictive state objective--retaining only information from the past necessary to predict the future. By decoupling what to remember from how to update memory, SMT enables time-parallel RNN training with a stable $O(1)$ length gradient path between any two tokens--without ever unrolling the RNN. We find that SMT outperforms BPTT when pretraining various RNN architectures on tasks like language modeling and pixel sequence modeling. SMT enables nonlinear RNNs to better capture long-range dependencies and train in parallel, potentially unlocking the scaling of models that build temporal abstractions of past experience.

</details>


### [387] [Regret Minimization with Adaptive Opponents in Repeated Games](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.06486)
*Mingyang Liu,Asuman Ozdaglar,Tiancheng Yu,Kaiqing Zhang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种面向自适应对手的重复博弈新 regret 指标——重复策略遗憾（RP-Regret），该指标能衡量玩家在对手基于历史调整策略时的反事实推理损失。作者识别了实现亚线性 RP-Regret 的必要条件，并针对其非凸性提出了三种优化算法（基于优化 oracle、凸线性化代理、直接优化），证明了当所有玩家最小化该 regret 时可学习子博弈完美均衡，实验表明该方法能在 Stag-Hunt 等博弈中实现更高合作效用。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 标准外部遗憾（external regret）无法捕捉自适应对手（能根据历史响应）的博弈场景中玩家的反事实推理需求，现有遗憾定义在重复博弈场景中存在约束过强或比较器较弱的问题，需要一种更贴合重复博弈本质的 regret 指标来刻画玩家在对手自适应时的理性行为。

Method: (1) 定义 RP-Regret 为 realized utility 与 best-in-hindsight utility 之差，其中所有玩家都可基于历史响应；(2) 理论分析识别了亚线性 RP-Regret 的必要条件：比较器策略变异性限制及对手/比较器的记忆约束；(3) 提出三种算法：基于优化 oracle 的方法、最小化凸线性化代理 regret 的方法、对手策略缓慢变化时直接优化 RP-Regret 的方法；(4) 证明当所有玩家最小化 RP-Regret（或其线性化变体）时可学习子博弈完美均衡。

Result: 理论结果表明在识别出的必要条件下可实现亚线性 RP-Regret；当所有玩家运行所提算法时，重复博弈的某些子博弈完美均衡可以被学习；实验显示在 Stag-Hunt 博弈中最小化该 regret 能引导出更高合作效用和更优均衡。

Conclusion: RP-Regret 为自适应对手环境下的重复博弈提供了更合适的性能度量，其非凸性可通过所提算法有效处理，为学习重复博弈中的合作性均衡开辟了新途径。

Abstract: In this paper, we study regret minimization in repeated games with \emph{adaptive} opponents who can respond based on histories of play. The standard metric of \emph{external regret} in online learning is known to fail to capture such adaptivity. To account for players' counterfactual reasoning, we introduce {\tt Repeated Policy Regret (RP-Regret)}, a game-theoretic metric that measures the difference between the \emph{realized} and the \emph{best-in-hindsight} accumulated utility when all players can \emph{respond} to the history of play. Compared to existing regret notions in this setting, ours is native to repeated game playing, enabling stronger comparators and opponents with fewer constraints, while maintaining the possibility of finding better equilibria when all players minimize it. We first identify necessary conditions for obtaining {\tt RP-Regret} sublinear in time, on the variation of the player's comparator strategies in the regret definition and on the memories of both the comparator and opponents' strategies. We then study additional conditions and provable algorithms to minimize {\tt RP-Regret}, which is by definition \emph{non-convex} in the strategy space. To address this challenge, we propose three algorithms: (i) one based on an optimization oracle, as assumed in some prior work in online non-convex learning; (ii) one that minimizes a convex and \emph{linearized} surrogate of {\tt RP-Regret} at each iteration; (iii) one that directly minimizes {\tt RP-Regret} when opponents change strategies slowly. Furthermore, when all players can run algorithms to minimize the {\tt RP-Regret} (or its linearized variant), certain subgame perfect equilibria of the repeated game can be learned. We also provide experiments showing that minimizing our regret notions can lead to more cooperative solutions with higher utility in games such as Stag-Hunt.

</details>


### [388] [TailLoR: Protecting Principal Components in Parameter-Efficient Continual Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.06494)
*Marius Dragoi,Ioana Pintilie,Alexandra Dragomir,Antonio Barbalau,Florin Brad*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: TailLoR利用预训练权重的奇异基作为固定参考框架，通过对奇异值矩阵施加低秩更新，并引入软频谱惩罚来抑制主导奇异方向上的更新，从而在持续学习中实现参数高效微调。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基于谱分解的参数高效微调方法在持续学习中取得了进展，但现有方法在减少任务间干扰和利用灵活的长尾频谱坐标进行细粒度适应方面仍有改进空间。

Method: 利用预训练权重的奇异基U和V作为固定参考框架，学习对奇异值矩阵的低秩更新。同时引入软频谱惩罚，抑制与主导奇异方向对齐的更新，将细粒度适应路由到高度灵活的长尾频谱坐标中。

Result: 通过软频谱惩罚减少了任务间干扰，同时将细粒度适应引导至长尾频谱坐标，提升了持续学习性能。

Conclusion: TailLoR通过在奇异值矩阵上进行低秩更新并引入频谱惩罚，有效平衡了参数效率和任务间干扰问题，为持续学习中的谱分解微调方法提供了新思路。

Abstract: Parameter-efficient finetuning methods based on spectral decomposition have enabled progress in Continual Learning. In this paper we introduce TailLoR, which utilizes the singular bases U and V of the pre-trained weights as a fixed reference frame to learn a low-rank update applied to the singular value matrix. A soft spectral penalty discourages updates aligned with dominant singular directions, reducing interference while routing fine-grained adaptation into the highly flexible, long-tail spectral coordinates.

</details>


### [389] [Semi-Offline Reinforcement Learning for Optimized Text Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2306.09712)
*Changyu Chen,Xiting Wang,Yiqiao Jin,Victor Ye Dong,Li Dong,Jie Cao,Yi Liu,Rui Yan*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出半离线强化学习（Semi-offline RL）这一新范式，实现从离线到在线设置的平滑过渡，平衡探索能力与训练成本，并给出优化成本、渐近误差和过拟合误差边界方面的最优RL设置，实验表明该方法高效且性能优于或媲美现有方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在线RL探索环境耗时严重，离线RL则牺牲了探索能力，现有方法难以兼顾效率与性能，亟需一种能平衡探索能力与训练成本的RL范式。

Method: 提出半离线RL范式，实现从离线到在线的平滑过渡；基于此范式推导出在优化成本、渐近误差和过拟合误差边界意义上的最优RL设置。

Result: 半离线方法高效且性能优于或媲美现有最先进方法。

Conclusion: 半离线RL作为一种新范式，为不同RL设置提供了理论比较基础，并在平衡效率与性能方面具有优势。

Abstract: In reinforcement learning (RL), there are two major settings for interacting with the environment: online and offline. Online methods explore the environment at significant time cost, and offline methods efficiently obtain reward signals by sacrificing exploration capability. We propose semi-offline RL, a novel paradigm that smoothly transits from offline to online settings, balances exploration capability and training cost, and provides a theoretical foundation for comparing different RL settings. Based on the semi-offline formulation, we present the RL setting that is optimal in terms of optimization cost, asymptotic error, and overfitting error bound. Extensive experiments show that our semi-offline approach is efficient and yields comparable or often better performance compared with state-of-the-art methods.

</details>


### [390] [Uncovering Model Processing Strategies with Non-Negative Per-Example Fisher Factorization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2310.04649)
*Michael Matena,Colin Raffel*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: NPEFF是一种可解释性方法，通过对每个样本的Fisher矩阵进行非负分解，学习出表示模型处理策略的秩1半正定成分，并可用于选择性扰动、分析遗忘副作用和研究上下文学习，优于梯度聚类和稀疏自编码器等基线方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 揭示模型生成预测时所使用的策略，提升深度神经网络的可解释性。

Method: 提出NPEFF（Non-Negative Per-Example Fisher Factorization）方法，对每个样本的Fisher矩阵进行分解，使用一种新颖的分解算法学习一组由秩1半正定矩阵表示的成分。

Result: 通过人类评估和自动分析，证明NPEFF成分对应多种语言模型和文本处理任务中的模型处理策略；可从NPEFF成分构建参数扰动，选择性破坏特定成分的作用；可用于分析和缓解遗忘的副作用；可用于研究上下文学习；性能优于梯度聚类和基于稀疏自编码器的字典学习等基线方法。

Conclusion: NPEFF是一种有效的可解释性工具，能够识别模型的处理策略，并提供操作这些策略的手段（如选择性扰动），在多个应用场景中展现出优势。

Abstract: We introduce NPEFF (Non-Negative Per-Example Fisher Factorization), an interpretability method that aims to uncover strategies used by a model to generate its predictions. NPEFF decomposes per-example Fisher matrices using a novel decomposition algorithm that learns a set of components represented by learned rank-1 positive semi-definite matrices. Through a combination of human evaluation and automated analysis, we demonstrate that these NPEFF components correspond to model processing strategies for a variety of language models and text processing tasks. We further show how to construct parameter perturbations from NPEFF components to selectively disrupt a given component's role in the model's processing. Along with conducting extensive ablation studies, we include experiments to show how NPEFF can be used to analyze and mitigate collateral effects of unlearning and use NPEFF to study in-context learning. Furthermore, we demonstrate the advantages of NPEFF over baselines such as gradient clustering and using sparse autoencoders for dictionary learning over model activations. We release the code used in this work.

</details>


### [391] [Exploration via linearly perturbed loss minimisation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2311.07565)
*David Janz,Shuai Liu,Alex Ayoub,Csaba Szepesvári*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出EVILL，一种通过线性损失扰动进行结构化随机赌博机探索的方法。对于广义线性赌博机，EVILL简化为扰动历史探索（PHE），并解释了随机奖励扰动何时及为何有效。EVILL引入了数据依赖的扰动，在理论和实践中匹配汤普森采样风格参数扰动方法的性能，且在广义线性赌博机之外的场景中仍保持高效。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有PHE类方法的随机奖励扰动机制在何种条件下有效缺乏清晰解释，且PHE在广义线性赌博机之外的场景可能产生不一致估计导致线性遗憾。作者旨在提出一种更通用的探索方法，既能解释PHE的有效性，又能克服其局限性。

Method: EVILL通过求解线性扰动的正则化负对数似然函数的最小化来实现随机探索。对于广义线性赌博机，该方法退化为在随机扰动奖励上训练（即PHE）。同时，EVILL引入数据依赖的扰动项，这是先前PHE方法所不具备的。

Result: EVILL在理论上和实践上均匹配汤普森采样风格参数扰动方法的性能。在广义线性赌博机之外的例子中，PHE导致不一致估计和线性遗憾，而EVILL仍表现良好。EVILL实现简洁，仅需几行代码。

Conclusion: EVILL为结构化随机赌博机问题提供了一种通用且高效的随机探索方法，统一并推广了PHE类方法，同时克服了其局限性，实现了与参数扰动方法相当的性能。

Abstract: We introduce exploration via linear loss perturbations (EVILL), a randomised exploration method for structured stochastic bandit problems that works by solving for the minimiser of a linearly perturbed regularised negative log-likelihood function. We show that, for the case of generalised linear bandits, EVILL reduces to perturbed history exploration (PHE), a method where exploration is done by training on randomly perturbed rewards. In doing so, we provide a simple and clean explanation of when and why random reward perturbations give rise to good bandit algorithms. We propose data-dependent perturbations not present in previous PHE-type methods that allow EVILL to match the performance of Thompson-sampling-style parameter-perturbation methods, both in theory and in practice. Moreover, we show an example outside generalised linear bandits where PHE leads to inconsistent estimates, and thus linear regret, while EVILL remains performant. Like PHE, EVILL can be implemented in just a few lines of code.

</details>


### [392] [Separation Power of Equivariant Neural Networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2406.08966)
*Marco Pacini,Xiaowen Dong,Bruno Lepri,Gabriele Santin*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文系统分析了等变神经网络（如卷积网络和置换不变网络）的分离能力，即模型区分不同输入的能力。研究给出了架构无法区分输入的完整特征刻画，并揭示了超参数和架构选择（激活函数、深度、宽度、表示类型）对分离能力的影响规律。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 分离能力是衡量模型表达力的重要指标，理解分离能力是获得细粒度普适性结果的必要条件。本文旨在填补等变神经网络分离能力理论分析的空白，系统研究架构选择如何影响模型区分不同输入的能力。

Method: 通过理论推导，首先给出给定架构下模型无法区分输入的完整特征刻画；然后在此基础上系统分析激活函数、深度、隐层宽度、表示类型等超参数和架构选择对分离能力的影响。

Result: 1) 所有非多项式激活函数（包括ReLU和sigmoid）在表达力上等价，达到最大分离能力；2) 深度提升分离能力存在阈值，超过后无进一步提升；3) 向隐层表示添加不变特征不影响分离能力；4) 隐层表示的块分解影响分离能力，最小分量形成分离能力层次结构，可用于比较不同模型的分离能力。

Conclusion: 本文为等变神经网络的分离能力提供了完整的理论刻画，揭示了架构选择与表达力之间的精确关系，为理解和比较不同等变架构的表达力提供了理论基础。

Abstract: The separation power of a machine learning model refers to its ability to distinguish between different inputs and is often used as a proxy for its expressivity. Indeed, knowing the separation power of a family of models is a necessary condition to obtain fine-grained universality results. In this paper, we analyze the separation power of equivariant neural networks, such as convolutional and permutation-invariant networks. We first present a complete characterization of inputs indistinguishable by models derived by a given architecture. From this results, we derive how separability is influenced by hyperparameters and architectural choices-such as activation functions, depth, hidden layer width, and representation types. Notably, all non-polynomial activations, including ReLU and sigmoid, are equivalent in expressivity and reach maximum separation power. Depth improves separation power up to a threshold, after which further increases have no effect. Adding invariant features to hidden representations does not impact separation power. Finally, block decomposition of hidden representations affects separability, with minimal components forming a hierarchy in separation power that provides a straightforward method for comparing the separation power of models.

</details>


### [393] [FATE: Focal-modulated Attention Encoder for Multivariate Time-series Forecasting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2408.11336)
*Tajamul Ashraf,Janibul Bashir*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出FATE（Focal Modulated Attention Encoder），一种基于张量化焦点调制机制的新型Transformer架构，用于多变量时间序列预测，在七个真实世界数据集上持续超越现有最先进方法，并具备可解释性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 气候变化是21世纪最紧迫的全球挑战之一，准确的气象预测对监测和缓解策略至关重要。现有数据驱动模型（如CNN、RNN和基于注意力的Transformer）在处理序列依赖性和并行化方面存在局限，尤其在长时序、多变量气象数据集上表现不佳。

Method: 提出FATE架构，核心是张量化焦点调制（tensorized focal modulation）机制，显式捕捉时间序列数据中的时空相关性。此外，设计了两种调制分数，通过突出影响预测的关键环境特征来提供可解释性。

Result: 在ETTh1、ETTm2、Traffic、Weather5k、USA-Canada、Europe和LargeST等七个多样化的真实世界数据集上进行基准测试，FATE在所有数据集上持续优于所有最先进方法。消融实验表明FATE具有良好的泛化能力。

Conclusion: FATE架构在多变量时间序列预测任务中显著优于现有方法，其张量化焦点调制机制有效捕捉了时空相关性，同时调制分数提供了有价值的可解释性，在更广泛的多变量时间序列预测任务中也具有良好的泛化性能。

Abstract: Climate change stands as one of the most pressing global challenges of the twenty-first century, with far-reaching consequences such as rising sea levels, melting glaciers, and increasingly extreme weather patterns. Accurate forecasting is critical for monitoring these phenomena and supporting mitigation strategies. While recent data-driven models for time-series forecasting, including CNNs, RNNs, and attention-based transformers, have shown promise, they often struggle with sequential dependencies and limited parallelization, especially in long-horizon, multivariate meteorological datasets. In this work, we present Focal Modulated Attention Encoder (FATE), a novel transformer architecture designed for reliable multivariate time-series forecasting. Unlike conventional models, FATE introduces a tensorized focal modulation mechanism that explicitly captures spatiotemporal correlations in time-series data. We further propose two modulation scores that offer interpretability by highlighting critical environmental features influencing predictions. We benchmark FATE across seven diverse real-world datasets, including ETTh1, ETTm2, Traffic, Weather5k, USA-Canada, Europe, and LargeST datasets, and show that it consistently outperforms all state-of-the-art methods, including temperature datasets. Our ablation studies also demonstrate that FATE generalizes well to broader multivariate time-series forecasting tasks.

</details>


### [394] [Inverse Entropic Optimal Transport Solves Semi-supervised Learning via Data Likelihood Maximization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2410.02628)
*Mikhail Persiianov,Arip Asadulaev,Nikita Andreev,Nikita Starodubcev,Dmitry Baranchuk,Anastasis Kratsios,Evgeny Burnaev,Alexander Korotin*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出EBiEOT框架，通过数据似然最大化技术同时使用配对数据和非配对数据来学习条件分布，并建立了与逆熵最优传输的联系，实现了端到端的学习算法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在机器学习中，学习条件分布通常需要配对数据，但获取配对数据（如域翻译任务）往往困难且昂贵。现有半监督方法多依赖启发式策略，缺乏统一的理论框架。

Method: 提出EBiEOT范式，利用数据似然最大化技术无缝整合配对数据与非配对数据；建立与逆熵最优传输的理论联系，借助计算OT的进展设计端到端学习算法。

Result: 理论证明了通用逼近性质，即能以任意小误差恢复真实条件分布；实验验证了该方法能有效同时利用配对和非配对数据学习条件分布。

Conclusion: EBiEOT为半监督条件分布学习提供了统一的理论框架和高效算法，弥合了配对与非配对数据之间的鸿沟，并在理论上保证了逼近能力。

Abstract: Learning conditional distributions $π^*(\cdot|x)$ is a central problem in machine learning, which is typically approached via supervised methods with paired data $(x,y) \sim π^*$. However, acquiring paired data samples is often challenging, especially in problems such as domain translation. This necessitates the development of $\textit{semi-supervised}$ models that utilize both limited paired data and additional unpaired i.i.d. samples $x \sim π^*_x$ and $y \sim π^*_y$ from the marginal distributions. The usage of such combined data is complex and often relies on heuristic approaches. To tackle this issue, we propose a new learning paradigm called $\textbf{EBiEOT}$ that integrates both paired and unpaired data seamlessly using data likelihood maximization techniques. We demonstrate that our approach also connects intriguingly with inverse entropic optimal transport (OT). This finding allows us to apply recent advances in computational OT to establish an $\textit{end-to-end}$ learning algorithm to get $π^*(\cdot|x)$. In addition, we derive the universal approximation property, demonstrating that our approach can theoretically recover true conditional distributions with arbitrarily small error. Finally, we demonstrate through empirical tests that our method effectively learns conditional distributions using paired and unpaired data simultaneously. The code of $\texttt{EBiEOT}$ is available at https://github.com/MuXauJl11110/EBiEOT.

</details>


### [395] [Comprehensive and Reliable Feature Attribution for Diverse Modalities and Models via Frequency-Domain Insights](https://arxiv.org/abs/2411.18343)
*Zechen Liu,Feiyang Zhang,Wei Song,Xiang Li,Wei Wei*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出FreqX，一种结合信号处理与信息论的可解释性方法，可同时提供归因信息和概念信息，计算速度比同类方法快10倍以上，用于解决个性化联邦学习中的非独立同分布、异构设备、公平性缺失和贡献度不明确等问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 个性化联邦学习面临非独立同分布数据、异构设备、缺乏公平性及贡献度不明确等挑战，亟需可解释的深度学习模型来应对这些问题，但现有可解释性方法无法同时满足低计算成本、隐私保护和详细信息的需求。

Method: 提出FreqX方法，引入信号处理和信息论技术，设计一种新的可解释性方法，其解释结果同时包含归因信息和概念信息。

Result: FreqX的解释结果同时包含归因信息和概念信息，且运行速度至少比包含概念信息的基线方法快10倍。

Conclusion: FreqX作为一种新颖的可解释性方法，能够满足PFL对低计算成本、隐私保护和详细信息的需求，有效解决PFL面临的多个挑战。

Abstract: Personalized Federal learning(PFL) allows clients to cooperatively train a personalized model without disclosing their private dataset. However, PFL suffers from Non-IID, heterogeneous devices, lack of fairness, and unclear contribution which urgently need the interpretability of deep learning model to overcome these challenges. These challenges proposed new demands for interpretability. Low cost, privacy, and detailed information. There is no current interpretability method satisfying them. In this paper, we propose a novel interpretability method \emph{FreqX} by introducing Signal Processing and Information Theory. Our experiments show that the explanation results of FreqX contain both attribution information and concept information. FreqX runs at least 10 times faster than the baselines which contain concept information.

</details>


### [396] [Scalable Temporal Anomaly Causality Discovery in Large Systems: Achieving Computational Efficiency with Binary Anomaly Flag Data](https://arxiv.org/abs/2412.11800)
*Mulugeta Weldezgina Asres,Christian Walter Omlin,The CMS-HCAL Collaboration*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出AnomalyCD方法，用于从时间序列二元报警标志数据中高效、准确地发现异常因果图，在CERN CMS实验读出箱系统和IT监控系统数据集上验证了计算开销的大幅降低和精度的适度提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有因果图模型学习方法在大规模实时系统中计算负担重，且难以处理二元异常数据的状态转移含义和数据稀疏特性，亟需一种高效准确的异常因果发现方法。

Method: 提出AnomalyCD方法，包含异常数据感知因果检验、稀疏数据与先验链接压缩、边剪枝调整等策略，从时间序列二元标志数据中生成图因果模型。

Result: 在CERN CMS读出箱系统传感器数据集和IT监控公开数据集上，AnomalyCD显著降低了计算开销，并在二元异常数据集上适度提升了因果图精度。

Conclusion: AnomalyCD有效解决了大规模系统中二元异常数据的因果发现难题，兼顾了计算效率与因果图准确性，适用于实时监控场景。

Abstract: Extracting anomaly causality facilitates diagnostics once monitoring systems detect system faults. Identifying anomaly causes in large systems involves investigating a broader set of monitoring variables across multiple subsystems. However, learning graphical causal models (GCMs) comes with a significant computational burden that restrains the applicability of most existing methods in real-time and large-scale deployments. In addition, modern monitoring applications for large systems often generate large amounts of binary alarm flags, and the distinct characteristics of binary anomaly data -- the meaning of state transition and data sparsity -- challenge existing causality learning mechanisms. This study proposes an anomaly causal discovery approach (AnomalyCD), addressing the accuracy and computational challenges of generating GCMs from temporal binary flag datasets. The AnomalyCD presents several strategies, such as anomaly data-aware causality testing, sparse data and prior link compression, and edge pruning adjustment approaches. We validate the performance of the approach on two datasets: monitoring sensor data from the readout-box system of the Compact Muon Solenoid experiment at CERN, and a public dataset from an information technology monitoring system. The results on temporal GCMs demonstrate a considerable reduction of computation overhead and a moderate enhancement of accuracy on the binary anomaly datasets. Code: https://github.com/muleina/AnomalyCD .

</details>


### [397] [Advances in Temporal Point Processes: Bayesian, Neural, and LLM Approaches](https://arxiv.org/abs/2501.14291)
*Feng Zhou,Quyu Kong,Jie Qiao,Cheng Wan,Yixuan Zhang,Ruichu Cai*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文全面综述了时间点过程（TPP）从贝叶斯、深度学习和大型语言模型三个视角的最新研究进展，涵盖基础概念、模型设计、参数估计方法、经典应用领域及未来挑战与方向。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 时间点过程（TPP）在连续时间事件序列建模中具有重要价值，传统统计模型历史悠久且应用广泛，而深度学习和LLM的兴起为TPP带来了新的灵活性和表达力。本文旨在系统梳理三个视角下的最新研究成果，为该领域提供综合性参考。

Method: 从贝叶斯方法、深度学习方法和大语言模型方法三个角度展开综述：首先回顾TPP基本概念，然后分别讨论三种框架下的模型设计与参数估计技术，最后回顾经典应用领域并指出未来研究方向。

Result: 系统总结了贝叶斯TPP、神经TPP和基于LLM的TPP三类方法在模型设计和参数估计上的进展，并对TPP在多个领域的经典应用进行了梳理。

Conclusion: TPP研究正朝着更灵活、更强大的方向发展，深度学习及LLM的引入显著提升了建模能力，但仍面临可解释性、计算效率等挑战，未来有广阔的研究空间。

Abstract: Temporal point processes (TPPs) are stochastic process models used to characterize event sequences occurring in continuous time. Traditional statistical TPPs have a long-standing history, with numerous models proposed and successfully applied across diverse domains. In recent years, advances in deep learning have spurred the development of neural TPPs, enabling greater flexibility and expressiveness in capturing complex temporal dynamics. The emergence of large language models (LLMs) has further sparked excitement, offering new possibilities for modeling and analyzing event sequences by leveraging their rich contextual understanding. This survey presents a comprehensive review of recent research on TPPs from three perspectives: Bayesian, deep learning, and LLM approaches. We begin with a review of the fundamental concepts of TPPs, followed by an in-depth discussion of model design and parameter estimation techniques in these three frameworks. We also revisit classic application areas of TPPs to highlight their practical relevance. Finally, we outline challenges and promising directions for future research.

</details>


### [398] [Reformulating Neural Operators in $d+1$ Dimensions for Embedding Evolution](https://arxiv.org/abs/2505.11766)
*Haoze Song,Zhihao Li,Xiaobo Zhang,Zecheng Gan,Zhilu Lai,Wei Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种辅助函数维度，以算子形式建模嵌入演化，将神经算子（NO）框架重构成d+1维空间，通过傅里叶算子联合作用于物理域和辅助域，实现基础多样化的辅助演化模块，替代了计算昂贵的嵌入缩放设计。在从1D热方程到3D瑞利-泰勒不稳定性等十多个基准测试中，该方法取得了最低的相对L2误差，并验证了其在预算控制、混合分辨率训练、超分辨率推理以及零样本时间泛化方面的优势。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 神经算子（NO）在学习函数空间映射方面表现优异，但现有研究多聚焦于物理域上的核参数化，而提升嵌入（lifted embeddings）的演化机制尚未被充分探索。当前模型往往依赖计算昂贵的嵌入缩放设计来提升逼近性能，亟需一种更高效的替代方案。

Method: 引入一个辅助函数维度，将嵌入演化建模为算子形式，从而将NO管道重构成d+1维空间。在此框架下，采用傅里叶算子联合作用于物理域和辅助域，构建一个基础多样化的辅助演化模块，替代暴力嵌入缩放。同时，系统研究了提升与恢复算子的多种设计选择对预测性能的影响。

Result: 在超过十个从1D热方程到高度非线性的3D瑞利-泰勒不稳定性等基准测试中，该模型一致取得了最低的相对L2误差。优势体现在：(1) 预算控制对比中优于缩放基线和消融基线；(2) 混合分辨率训练与超分辨率推理下的鲁棒性；(3) 对未见时间域的零样本泛化能力。

Conclusion: 所提出的d+1维辅助演化模块是暴力嵌入缩放的有效替代方案，在多个维度（精度、鲁棒性、泛化性）均表现出显著优势，为神经算子的嵌入演化设计提供了新范式。

Abstract: Neural Operators (NOs) are powerful architectures for learning mappings between function spaces. While most advances focus on refining kernel parameterizations over the $d$-dimensional physical domain, the evolution of lifted embeddings remains underexplored, which often drives models toward computationally expensive embedding-scaling designs to improve approximation.
  In this paper, we introduce an auxiliary function dimension that models embedding evolution in operator form, thereby reformulating the NO pipeline in $d+1$ dimensions. We instantiate this framework via Fourier-based operators acting jointly on the physical and auxiliary domains, yielding a basis-diversified auxiliary evolution module as an alternative to brute-force embedding scaling. Across more than ten increasingly challenging benchmarks, ranging from the 1D heat equation to the highly nonlinear 3D Rayleigh-Taylor instability, our model consistently achieves the lowest relative $L_2$ error among the evaluated baselines. Crucially, this advantage is empirically supported by (1) controlled budget-aware comparisons against scaled and ablated baselines; (2) robustness under mixed-resolution training and super-resolution inference; and (3) zero-shot generalization to unseen temporal regimes. In addition, we present a broader set of design choices for lifting and recovery operators, demonstrating their impact on our model's predictive performance.

</details>


### [399] [HOPSE: Scalable Higher-Order Positional and Structural Encoder for Combinatorial Representations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2505.15405)
*Guillermo Bernárdez,Marco Montagna,Louis Van Langendonck,Martin Carrasco,Amirreza Akbari,Louisa Cornelis,Mathilde Papillon,Pere Barlet-Ros,Nina Miolane,Lev Telyatnikov*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出HOPSE框架，通过Hasse图分解实现无消息传递的高阶拓扑表示学习，在保持表达能力的同时实现线性可扩展性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于高阶消息传递的拓扑深度学习方法面临严重的可扩展性挑战，其通过组合结构传播消息的复杂度过高，限制了在大规模系统中的应用。

Method: 提出HOPSE框架，摒弃消息传递层，利用Hasse图分解在任意高阶域上推导高效且富有表达力的编码，实现线性缩放并保持置换等变性。

Result: 在分子和拓扑基准测试中，HOPSE匹配或超越了现有最先进方法的性能，同时持续实现相对于HOMP模型的加速。

Conclusion: HOPSE为可扩展的拓扑深度学习开辟了新路径，在保持高阶表达力的同时有效解决了可扩展性瓶颈。

Abstract: While Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) have proven highly effective at modeling relational data, pairwise connections cannot fully capture multi-way relationships naturally present in complex real-world systems. In response to this, Topological Deep Learning (TDL) leverages more general combinatorial representations--such as simplicial or cellular complexes--to accommodate higher-order interactions. Existing TDL methods often extend GNNs through Higher-Order Message Passing (HOMP), but face critical scalability challenges due to the steep complexity overhead of propagating messages through combinatorial structures. To overcome this limitation, we propose HOPSE (Higher-Order Positional and Structural Encoder), a framework free of message passing layers that uses Hasse graph decompositions to derive efficient and expressive encodings over arbitrary higher-order domains. Notably, HOPSE scales linearly with the size of combinatorial representations while preserving the expressive power and permutation equivariance of the HOMP approaches. Experiments on molecular and topological benchmarks show that it matches or surpasses state-of-the-art performance while consistently achieving speedups over HOMP-based models, opening a new path for scalable TDL. The code is available at https://github.com/geometric-intelligence/topobench.git.

</details>


### [400] [Cluster-Aware Causal Mixer for Online Anomaly Detection in Multivariate Time Series](https://arxiv.org/abs/2506.00188)
*Md Mahmuddun Nabi Murad,Yasin Yilmaz*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出了一种基于聚类感知因果混合器（Cluster-Aware Causal Mixer）的多元时间序列异常检测方法，通过通道聚类、因果混合器和序列异常评分机制，在六个公开数据集上取得了优异性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有MLP混合器模型在处理时间序列时无法保持时间因果性，且多元时间序列中通道间存在多样化的相关性，重构序列中的虚假相关会导致噪声表示和异常检测精度下降；此外，忽略时间连续性的异常评分方法会误导序列检测。

Method: 1) 将通道按相关性聚类，每个聚类使用专用嵌入层；2) 引入因果混合器（Causal Mixer）在保持时间因果性的同时整合信息；3) 设计序列异常评分方法，随时间累积证据并细化异常边界；4) 模型以在线方式运行，适用于实时检测。

Result: 在六个公开基准数据集上的实验评估表明，所提方法 consistently 实现了更优的异常检测性能。

Conclusion: 提出的聚类感知因果混合器有效解决了时间因果性缺失、虚假相关干扰和异常评分不连续等问题，在多变量时间序列异常检测任务中具有明显优势。

Abstract: Early and accurate detection of anomalies in time-series data is critical due to the substantial risks associated with false or missed detections. While MLP-based mixer models have shown promise in time-series analysis, they do not maintain temporal causality during data processing. Moreover, real-world multivariate time series often contain numerous channels with diverse inter-channel correlations. Spurious correlations in the reconstructed time series lead to noisy representations, resulting in inaccurate anomaly detection. In addition, anomaly scoring methods that ignore temporal continuity can mislead sequential detection. To address these challenges, we propose a cluster-aware causal mixer for multivariate time-series anomaly detection. Channels are grouped into clusters based on their correlations, and each cluster is embedded through a dedicated embedding layer. A causal mixer is introduced to integrate information while maintaining temporal causality. We further develop a sequential anomaly-scoring method that accumulates evidence over time and refines anomaly boundaries. Our proposed model operates in an online fashion, making it suitable for real-time time-series anomaly detection. Experimental evaluations across six public benchmark datasets demonstrate that the proposed approach consistently achieves superior performance.

</details>


### [401] [GenFT: A Generative Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning Method for Pretrained Foundation Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2506.11042)
*Guangning Xu,Baoquan Zhang,Michael. K. Ng*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出生成式参数高效微调（GenFT），通过以预训练权重W0为条件的确定性权重生成器产生任务特定更新，利用非线性行/列变换和共享-特定分解来提取W0中的结构信息，在NLP和CV基准上取得有竞争力的性能，并在LLaMA-7B上验证了可行性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有PEFT方法学习任务更新ΔW时大多与预训练权重W0独立，或仅通过初始化/简单重参数化利用W0，未能充分挖掘W0中编码的结构信息。

Method: GenFT采用以W0为条件的确定性权重生成器：1) 对W0执行行/列变换及非线性激活以提取结构化模式；2) 引入共享-特定分解以平衡跨层信息复用与逐层特异性。

Result: 在NLP和CV多个基准上取得有竞争力或更优的平均性能，并在LLaMA-7B上进行了生成模型可行性的初步研究。

Conclusion: GenFT是一种简单且参数高效的PEFT方法，能更充分利用W0的结构信息，在多种任务上表现优异，代码已开源。

Abstract: Parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT) has emerged as a resource-efficient strategy for adapting Pretrained Foundation Models (PFMs) by learning a small number of task-specific updates $ΔW$. Existing methods often learn $ΔW$ largely independently of pretrained weights $W_0$, or exploit $W_0$ mainly through initialization or simple reparameterization. To further leverage the structural information encoded in $W_0$, we propose Generative Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning (GenFT), a $W_0$-conditioned PEFT method that uses a deterministic weight generator to produce task-specific updates. Specifically, GenFT performs row and column transformations with nonlinear activations to extract structured patterns from $W_0$, and introduces a shared-specific decomposition to balance cross-layer information reuse and layer-specific flexibility. GenFT is simple and parameter-efficient, achieving competitive or better average performance across NLP and CV benchmarks. We further provide a pilot study on LLaMA-7B to examine its feasibility for generative models. The code is available at GitHub https://github.com/xuguangning1218/GenFT.

</details>


### [402] [Robust Causal Discovery in Real-World Time Series with Power-Laws](https://arxiv.org/abs/2507.12257)
*Matteo Tusoni,Giuseppe Masi,Andrea Coletta,Aldo Glielmo,Viviana Arrigoni,Novella Bartolini*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于幂律频谱特征提取的鲁棒因果发现方法，通过利用真实时间序列中普遍存在的幂律分布特性增强真实因果信号，在合成基准和真实数据集上优于现有方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有因果发现算法对噪声高度敏感，容易产生虚假因果推断，而真实时间序列数据中噪声普遍存在，亟需一种鲁棒的因果发现方法。

Method: 观察到真实时间序列的频谱遵循幂律分布（源于自组织行为），基于此提取幂律频谱特征来增强真实因果信号，构建鲁棒的因果发现方法。

Result: 在合成基准数据和具有已知因果结构的真实数据集上，该方法一致优于现有最先进方法，展现出鲁棒性和实用性。

Conclusion: 利用幂律频谱特征能有效抑制噪声干扰，提升因果发现的鲁棒性，具有广泛的实际应用价值（金融、经济、神经科学、气候科学等）。

Abstract: Exploring causal relationships in stochastic time series is a challenging yet crucial task with a vast range of applications, including finance, economics, neuroscience, and climate science. Many algorithms for Causal Discovery (CD) have been proposed; however, they often exhibit a high sensitivity to noise, resulting in spurious causal inferences in real data. In this paper, we observe that the frequency spectra of many real-world time series follow a power-law distribution, notably due to an inherent self-organizing behavior. Leveraging this insight, we build a robust CD method based on the extraction of power-law spectral features that amplify genuine causal signals. Our method consistently outperforms state-of-the-art alternatives on both synthetic benchmarks and real-world datasets with known causal structures, demonstrating its robustness and practical relevance.

</details>


### [403] [Learning What Matters: Probabilistic Task Selection via Mutual Information for Model Finetuning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2507.12612)
*Prateek Chanda,Saral Sureka,Parth Pratim Chatterjee,Krishnateja Killamsetty,Nikhil Shivakumar Nayak,Ganesh Ramakrishnan*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出TaskPGM框架，基于能量模型学习连续任务混合分布，通过马尔可夫随机场建模任务间关系，在有限预算下优化混合策略以平衡覆盖度与冗余度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 监督微调中固定混合策略（均匀或按规模采样）忽略任务间交互，导致迁移效果差且算力浪费在冗余源上。

Method: 构建以任务为节点的马尔可夫随机场，一元势函数捕获单任务效用，二元势函数通过单任务微调模型的预测分布计算行为散度（如JS散度、点互信息）编码任务间关系，优化目标函数得到连续任务混合分布。

Result: 在LLaMA-7B、Qwen2-7B及BIG-Bench Hard评测上，TaskPGM优于标准混合策略；证明目标集函数在预算约束下满足弱子模性，离散选择变体具有近似保证。

Conclusion: TaskPGM能有效学习任务混合策略，提升微调性能，并提供可解释的任务交互结构。

Abstract: Supervised fine-tuning performance for large language models depends strongly on how training budget is distributed across a heterogeneous set of tasks. In practice, mixtures are often fixed using simple heuristics (e.g., uniform or size-proportional sampling) that ignore task interactions, which can hurt transfer and waste budget on redundant sources. We introduce TaskPGM, a framework for learning continuous task mixtures via an energy-based model over tasks. Tasks form the nodes of a Markov random field: unary potentials capture per-task utility, and pairwise potentials encode inter-task relationships using behavioral divergences computed from predictive distributions of single-task fine-tuned models (e.g., Jensen--Shannon divergence and pointwise mutual information). Optimizing this objective yields mixtures that balance coverage against redundancy. We show that the resulting set function is weakly submodular under budget constraints, enabling approximation guarantees for discrete selection variants. Across multiple model families (LLaMA-7B, Qwen2-7B) and evaluation suites (BIG-Bench Hard), TaskPGM improves over standard mixing strategies and provides interpretable structure over task interactions.

</details>


### [404] [In-Training Defenses against Emergent Misalignment in Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2508.06249)
*David Kaczér,Magnus Jørgenvåg,Clemens Vetter,Esha Afzal,Robin Haselhorst,Lucie Flek,Florian Mai*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文首次系统研究针对微调中涌现的错位（EM）问题的训练中防护措施，评估了五种正则化干预方法在API微调场景下的效果，发现基于困惑度差距选择穿插数据的方法整体表现最佳。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 微调虽能让对齐的大语言模型适应新领域，但近期研究表明会出现"涌现错位"（EM）现象——即使是在小规模领域特定微调中，也可能诱发出远超出目标域的有害行为。在模型权重被API隐藏的情况下，攻击者仍能通过微调接口意外获得广泛错位的模型，且难以仅从微调数据中检测。因此需要研究实用的训练中防护措施。

Method: 研究了五种训练正则化干预方法：(i) 向安全参考模型的KL散度正则化；(ii) 特征空间中的ℓ2距离；(iii) 使用邪恶人格向量进行预防性引导；(iv) 穿插通用指令微调数据集中的训练样本；(v) 接种提示。并通过对齐模型与错位模型之间的困惑度差距来选择穿插数据。

Result: 基于困惑度差距选择穿插数据的方法在各项指标上整体表现最佳，能够平衡防止广泛错位、允许窄域错位（良性任务所需）、在良性任务上良好学习以及保持模型连贯性这四个目标。

Conclusion: 为通过API提供微调服务的提供商提供了实用的训练中防护策略，尤其推荐使用困惑度差距驱动的数据穿插方法作为应对EM的有效手段。

Abstract: Fine-tuning lets practitioners repurpose aligned large language models (LLMs) for new domains, yet recent work reveals emergent misalignment (EM): Even a small, domain-specific fine-tune can induce harmful behaviors far outside the target domain. Even in the case where model weights are hidden behind a fine-tuning API, this gives attackers inadvertent access to a broadly misaligned model in a way that can be hard to detect from the fine-tuning data alone. We present the first systematic study of in-training safeguards against EM that are practical for providers who expose fine-tuning via an API: We evaluate whether they a) prevent broad misalignment, b) allow narrow misalignment, c) learn well on benign tasks, and d) remain coherent. We investigate five training regularization interventions: (i) KL-divergence regularization toward a safe reference model, (ii) $\ell_2$ distance in feature space, (iii) preventive steering with an evil persona vector, (iv) interleaving training examples from a general instruct-tuning dataset and (v) inoculation prompting. We demonstrate that selecting interleaving data by the perplexity gap between aligned and misaligned models yields the best results overall.

</details>


### [405] [Towards Label-Noise Resistant Learning via Optimal Brain Damage Masking](https://arxiv.org/abs/2508.09697)
*Xinlei Zhang,Fan Liu,Chuanyi Zhang,Fan Cheng,Qian Li,Yuhui Zheng*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出基于最优脑损伤（OBD）理论的选择性边缘掩码（SEM）机制，通过自适应裁剪全连接层中的冗余连接来阻断噪声梯度传播，有效提升模型对标签噪声的鲁棒性，在合成与真实基准上均优于现有方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有噪声鲁棒方法主要集中在鲁棒损失函数和样本选择上，对动态架构自适应的探索较少。性能退化源于噪声梯度的反向传播，而最终分类层是误差传播的主要网关。

Method: 基于OBD理论，识别并掩码低激活边（引起损失扰动的冗余连接），提出选择性边缘掩码（SEM）机制作为即插即用组件，可自适应保留最关键的连接进行信息传播，同时抑制噪声梯度误差。

Result: 在合成和真实世界基准上的大量评估表明，所提出的OBD驱动方法一致优于现有最先进方法，且可无缝集成到鲁棒损失函数和样本选择等现有噪声鲁棒方法中。

Conclusion: 通过结构性拦截分类器层中冗余连接的噪声梯度传播，能有效提升模型对标签噪声的鲁棒性，OBD理论为此提供了理论支撑。

Abstract: Noisy labels are inevitable in real-world scenarios. Due to the strong capacity of deep neural networks to memorize corrupted labels, these noisy labels cause significant performance degradation. Existing noise-robust methods have mainly focused on robust loss functions and sample selection, with comparatively limited exploration of dynamic architectural adaptation. In this paper, we rethink the role of model connectivity in the presence of label noise. Intuitively, performance degradation caused by noisy labels stems from the backpropagation of noisy gradients. Since the final classifier layer acts as the primary gateway for this error propagation, directly discarding redundant connections within the classifier can structurally intercept noisy gradients at the root. Consequently, to identify these redundant connections, we leverage the seminal Optimal Brain Damage (OBD) theory from model compression, which posits that parameters causing negligible loss perturbation can be safely removed without impairing performance. Guided by this principle, we reveal that masking low-activation edges maintains the network's normal fitting capacity while effectively reducing the risk of backpropagating noisy gradients. To bridge this theoretical insight with practical training, we propose a novel Selective Edge Masking (SEM) mechanism for the widely-adopted fully connected (FC) layer to enhance model robustness against noisy labels. It can adaptively preserve only the most critical edges for information propagation while suppressing gradient errors caused by noisy labels. As a plug-and-play component, SEM can be seamlessly integrated into various noise-robust methods, including robust loss functions and sample selection. Extensive evaluations on both synthetic and real-world benchmarks demonstrate that our OBD-driven approach consistently outperforms state-of-the-art methods.

</details>


### [406] [Concept-SAE: A Controllable and Invertible Concept Interface for Sparse Autoencoders](https://arxiv.org/abs/2509.22015)
*Jianrong Ding,Muxi Chen,Chenchen Zhao,Qiang Xu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出Concept-SAE框架，通过在标准稀疏自编码器中引入正交分解的概念令牌（Concept Tokens）与自由令牌（Free Tokens），实现对用户定义概念的可控、忠实且空间可定位的探测与诊断。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 标准SAE虽能被动发现模型特征，但难以系统评估或分析用户明确关心的概念，缺乏可控的接口来探测、评估和诊断特定概念。

Method: 将激活子空间分解为两个正交分量：概念令牌（通过概念存在性和空间定位的双重监督与外部语义对齐）和自由令牌（类似标准SAE捕获剩余信息），实现混合解耦策略。

Result: Concept-SAE生成高保真、良好空间定位且强解耦的概念表示，在接口质量上优于替代方案；通过对抗样本检测、反事实编辑控制和对抗扰动稳定性三项诊断评估验证了其实用性。

Conclusion: Concept-SAE为标准SAE提供了可靠机制，用于评估、探测和诊断用户定义的概念。

Abstract: Standard Sparse Autoencoders (SAEs) excel at discovering a dictionary of a model's learned features, providing a powerful lens for passive feature discovery. However, this passive nature makes it difficult to systematically evaluate or analyze concepts that users explicitly care about. We introduce Concept-SAE, a framework that augments SAEs with a structured and controllable interface for probing user-defined concepts. Concept-SAE decomposes an activation subspace into two orthogonal components: Concept Tokens, which are aligned to externally specified semantics through dual supervision on both concept existence and spatial localization, and Free Tokens, which operate like standard SAEs to capture all remaining information. This hybrid disentanglement strategy ensures that Concept Tokens are faithful, spatially grounded, and cleanly separated from the residual subspace while preserving the ability of SAEs for open-ended concept discovery. We conduct extensive experiments demonstrating that Concept-SAE yields high-fidelity, well-localized, and strongly disentangled concept representations, outperforming alternatives in interface quality. Finally, we validate the utility of this conceptual interface through three diagnostic evaluations: a detection test on classifying adversarial image samples, a controllability test focusing on controlled counterfactual editing and a stability test using adversarial perturbations. Together, these results show that Concept-SAE equips SAEs with a reliable mechanism for evaluating, probing, and diagnosing user-defined concepts.

</details>


### [407] [Scaling Laws and Spectra of Shallow Neural Networks in the Feature Learning Regime](https://arxiv.org/abs/2509.24882)
*Leonardo Defilippis,Yizhou Xu,Julius Girardin,Emanuele Troiani,Vittorio Erba,Lenka Zdeborová,Bruno Loureiro,Florent Krzakala*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文在特征学习机制下，系统分析了二次和对角神经网络的缩放定律，通过与矩阵压缩感知和LASSO的联系，推导出超额风险随样本复杂度和权重衰减变化的完整相图，揭示了不同缩放区域间的交叉和平台行为，并从第一性原理验证了权重谱中幂律尾与泛化性能之间的经验关联。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 神经缩放定律是深度学习近期进展的核心，但其理论基础仍主要局限于线性模型。本文旨在将理论理解拓展到更复杂的非线性神经网络（二次和对角网络），填补特征学习机制下缩放定律的理论空白。

Method: 利用与矩阵压缩感知和LASSO的关联，对二次和对角神经网络在特征学习机制下的缩放行为进行系统分析，推导超额风险关于样本复杂度和权重衰减的缩放指数相图。

Result: 刻画了不同缩放指数区域间的交叉（crossover）和平台（plateau）行为，这些现象与经验神经缩放文献中广泛报道的现象一致；建立了缩放区域与训练后网络权重谱性质之间的精确联系。

Conclusion: 从第一性原理为最近关于权重谱中幂律尾与网络泛化性能之间关联的实证观察提供了理论验证。

Abstract: Neural scaling laws underlie many of the recent advances in deep learning, yet their theoretical understanding remains largely confined to linear models. In this work, we present a systematic analysis of scaling laws for quadratic and diagonal neural networks in the feature learning regime. Leveraging connections with matrix compressed sensing and LASSO, we derive a detailed phase diagram for the scaling exponents of the excess risk as a function of sample complexity and weight decay. This analysis uncovers crossovers between distinct scaling regimes and plateau behaviors, mirroring phenomena widely reported in the empirical neural scaling literature. Furthermore, we establish a precise link between these regimes and the spectral properties of the trained network weights, which we characterize in detail. As a consequence, we provide a theoretical validation of recent empirical observations connecting the emergence of power-law tails in the weight spectrum with network generalization performance, yielding an interpretation from first principles.

</details>


### [408] [Expand Neurons, Not Parameters](https://arxiv.org/abs/2510.04500)
*Linghao Kong,Inimai Subramanian,Yonadav Shavit,Micah Adler,Dan Alistarh,Nir Shavit*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 在不增加非零参数数量的前提下增加网络宽度（神经元数量）可以提升性能，其机制是减少神经元间的多语义干扰（polysemanticity interference），且该效应在干扰强度大时尤为显著，并在多种现代网络架构中得到验证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 探索在不增加非零参数数量的情况下，通过增加神经元数量来提升网络性能的可能性，并揭示其背后的可解释性机制。

Method: 在符号布尔任务中，将每个神经元拆分为更稀疏的子神经元，分别采用基于子句知识的系统拆分和随机拆分；随后将这一思想迁移到CLIP嵌入分类器、卷积神经网络和深层多层网络中，在保持非零参数数量不变的情况下增加网络宽度。

Result: 系统拆分和随机拆分均降低了多语义性指标并提高了任务准确率；宽度增加带来的性能提升在干扰（多语义负载）较高时最为显著；在多种现实网络架构中，保持非零参数不变、增加宽度一致地提升了准确率。

Conclusion: 研究识别了一种基于可解释性的机制——利用网络宽度对抗叠加（superposition）现象，在不增加非零参数的情况下提升性能，该方法与现代加速器中非零参数的内存移动瓶颈高度契合。

Abstract: This work demonstrates how increasing the number of neurons in a network without increasing its total number of non-zero parameters improves performance. We show that this gain corresponds with a decrease in interference between multiple features that would otherwise share the same neurons. On symbolic Boolean tasks, splitting each neuron into sparser sub-neurons with knowledge of the clauses systematically reduces polysemanticity metrics and yields higher task accuracy. Notably, even random splits of neuron weights approximate these gains, indicating that reduced collisions, not precise assignment, are a primary driver. Consistent with the superposition hypothesis, the benefits of this framework grow with increasing interference: when polysemantic load is high, accuracy improvements are the largest. Transferring these insights to more realistic models, including classifiers over CLIP embeddings, convolutional neural networks, and deeper multilayer networks, we find that widening networks while maintaining a constant non-zero parameter count consistently increases accuracy. These results identify an interpretability-grounded mechanism to leverage width against superposition, improving performance without increasing the number of non-zero parameters. Such a direction is well matched to modern accelerators, where memory movement of non-zero parameters, rather than raw compute, is often a dominant bottleneck.

</details>


### [409] [Blade: A Derivative-free Bayesian Inversion Method using Diffusion Priors](https://arxiv.org/abs/2510.10968)
*Hongkai Zheng,Austin Wang,Zihui Wu,Zhengyu Huang,Ricardo Baptista,Yisong Yue*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: Blade是一种基于扩散模型先验的导数自由贝叶斯反演方法，通过交互粒子集成生成准确且校准良好的后验分布，在理论上证明了收敛性和稳定性，在非线性流体动力学实验中优于现有方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的导数自由贝叶斯反演方法在高维非线性问题上要么将后验坍缩为点估计，要么返回过度自信的不确定性估计，因此需要一种既能处理复杂正向模型又能在高维非线性问题上产生准确且校准良好的后验分布的方法。

Method: Blade方法结合了扩散模型作为数据驱动先验，并通过交互粒子的集成来生成后验样本；仅通过正向评估（即导数自由）查询正向模型，无需微分。

Result: 在非线性流体动力学实验中，Blade在CRPS、spread-skill ratio和秩直方图等指标上均产生优于现有导数自由方法的校准良好的后验样本；随着迭代次数和粒子数量的增加，准确性和校准性持续提升。

Conclusion: Blade在理论上具有收敛性和稳定性保证（在正向模型近似和先验得分估计误差下），实验上也验证了其性能随迭代和粒子数增加而提升，是一种有效的导数自由贝叶斯反演方法。

Abstract: Derivative-free Bayesian inversion arises in science and engineering applications, particularly when forward model is costly or infeasible to differentiate through. Existing derivative-free methods collapse the posterior to a point estimate or return severely over-confident uncertainty on high-dimensional, nonlinear problems. We introduce Blade, which produces accurate and well-calibrated posteriors using an ensemble of interacting particles. Blade leverages diffusion models as data-driven priors, and only queries the forward model through forward evaluations (i.e., derivative-free). Theoretically, we show the convergence and stability of Blade under forward model approximation and prior score estimation error. Empirically, on nonlinear fluid dynamics, Blade produces well-calibrated posterior samples that existing derivative-free methods cannot, as measured by CRPS, the spread-skill ratio, and the rank histogram. Its accuracy and calibration improve consistently with more iterations and particles, backed by our convergence and stability analysis and empirical experiments.

</details>


### [410] [PF$Δ$: A Benchmark Dataset for Power Flow under Load, Generation, and Topology Variations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2510.22048)
*Ana K. Rivera,Anvita Bhagavathula,Alvaro Carbonero,Priya Donti*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出PFΔ基准数据集，包含859,800个潮流计算实例，覆盖六种系统规模、三种故障场景（N, N-1, N-2）及接近稳态电压稳定极限的难解情况，系统评估了传统求解器与GNN方法，指出当前方法的不足与未来研究方向。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 实时电网操作中的潮流计算（如 contingency analysis 和 topology optimization）存在计算瓶颈，且可再生能源与极端天气带来的不确定性要求能够在多样场景下准确高效地模拟，现有ML方法缺乏系统性的真实世界变异性基准评估。

Method: 构建PFΔ基准数据集，包含859,800个已求解的潮流实例，涵盖六种母线系统规模、三种故障场景（N, N-1, N-2）以及接近稳态电压稳定极限的难解案例；系统评估传统求解器与GNN方法在数据集上的表现。

Result: PFΔ数据集包含859,800个实例，覆盖六种系统规模和三种故障类型；传统求解器与GNN方法在数据集上存在明显性能短板，尤其在接近电压稳定极限的难解场景中表现不足。

Conclusion: PFΔ为潮流计算方法提供了涵盖真实世界变异的系统评估基准，揭示了现有方法的关键瓶颈，并为未来研究指明了开放问题。

Abstract: Power flow (PF) calculations are the backbone of real-time grid operations, across workflows such as contingency analysis (where repeated PF evaluations assess grid security under outages) and topology optimization (which involves PF-based searches over combinatorially large action spaces). Running these calculations at operational timescales or across large evaluation spaces remains a major computational bottleneck. Additionally, growing uncertainty in power system operations from the integration of renewables and climate-induced extreme weather also calls for tools that can accurately and efficiently simulate a wide range of scenarios and operating conditions. Machine learning methods offer a potential speedup over traditional solvers, but their performance has not been systematically assessed on benchmarks that capture real-world variability. This paper introduces PF$Δ$, a benchmark dataset for power flow that captures diverse variations in load, generation, and topology. PF$Δ$ contains 859,800 solved power flow instances spanning six different bus system sizes, capturing three types of contingency scenarios (N , N -1, and N -2), and including close-to-infeasible cases near steady-state voltage stability limits. We evaluate traditional solvers and GNN-based methods, highlighting key areas where existing approaches struggle, and identifying open problems for future research. Our dataset is available at https://huggingface.co/datasets/pfdelta/pfdelta/tree/main and our code with data generation scripts and model implementations is at https://github.com/MOSSLab-MIT/pfdelta.

</details>


### [411] [Selective Sinkhorn Routing for Improved Sparse Mixture of Experts](https://arxiv.org/abs/2511.08972)
*Duc Anh Nguyen,Huu Binh Ta,Nhuan Le Duc,Tan Minh Nguyen,Toan Tran*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出Selective Sinkhorn Routing (SSR)，一种轻量级最优传输路由机制，在无需辅助平衡损失的情况下，通过带约束的最优传输实现稀疏MoE模型中更均衡有效的token到专家分配，在语言建模和图像分类任务上提升了训练效率、准确率和鲁棒性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有SMoE方法依赖辅助目标（如负载均衡损失、z-loss）或额外可训练组件（如噪声门控）来鼓励专家多样性，但这些技术引入目标不对齐、增加模型复杂度或带来大量训练开销（尤其在Sinkhorn路由方法中）。

Method: 将token到专家的分配重新建模为带约束的最优传输问题，通过约束确保专家利用率平衡；提出Selective Sinkhorn Routing (SSR)，一种轻量级路由机制，直接从传输映射中导出门控分数，替代复杂的辅助损失，同时保留灵活的专家选择。

Result: 在语言建模和图像分类实验上，SSR相比现有方法提升了训练效率、准确率以及对输入损坏的鲁棒性。

Conclusion: 即使是最小量的基于最优传输的路由，也能在没有辅助平衡损失的情况下提升SMoE性能，SSR实现了更均衡有效的token到专家分配。

Abstract: Sparse Mixture-of-Experts (SMoE) models are scalable and computationally efficient, enabling large increases in model capacity with limited inference overhead. Existing SMoE methods often depend on auxiliary objectives, such as load-balancing loss and z-loss, or additional trainable components such as noisy gating. While these techniques encourage expert diversity, they can introduce objective misalignment, increase model complexity, or incur substantial training overhead, especially in Sinkhorn-based routing methods. In this paper, we revisit the token-to-expert assignment as an optimal transport problem. We add constraints to ensure balanced expert utilization. We show that even minimal optimal transport-based routing improves SMoE performance without requiring auxiliary balancing losses. Unlike prior approaches, our method derives gating scores directly from the transport map, leading to more balanced and effective token-to-expert assignments. Building on this insight, we introduce Selective Sinkhorn Routing (SSR), a lightweight routing mechanism that replaces complex auxiliary losses with efficient Sinkhorn-based routing while preserving flexible expert selection. Experiments on language modeling and image classification show that SSR improves training efficiency, accuracy, and robustness to input corruption.

</details>


### [412] [MSTN: A Lightweight and Fast Model for General TimeSeries Analysis](https://arxiv.org/abs/2511.20577)
*Sumit S Shevtekar,Chandresh K Maurya*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出多尺度时序网络(MSTN)，一种基于早期时序聚合(ETA)原则的混合神经网络架构，通过多尺度卷积编码器、序列建模模块和自门控融合阶段三个互补组件，有效应对真实世界时间序列中的非平稳性、非线性动力学和多尺度行为，在21/27个数据集上达到SOTA性能，且参数量少、推理速度快。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有时序建模架构通常采用固定的、单一尺度的结构先验（如基于分块的token化、预定义的感受野或冻结的骨干编码器），这会过度正则化时序动态，限制了模型对突发的、高幅度事件的适应能力。真实世界的时间序列往往表现出强非平稳性、复杂非线性动力学以及跨多个时间尺度的行为（从快速局部波动到缓慢演变的长期趋势），亟需一种能灵活捕捉多尺度时序模式的架构。

Method: MSTN包含三个互补组件：(i) 多尺度卷积编码器：捕捉精细的局部结构；(ii) 序列建模模块：通过循环或注意力机制学习长程依赖；(iii) 自门控融合阶段：结合squeeze-excitation和单密集层动态重加权并融合多尺度表示。核心创新在于早期时序聚合(ETA)原则，使得下游模块在O(1)时间内运行，编码器保持O(L²)(Transformer)或O(L)(BiLSTM)复杂度。

Result: 在涵盖插补、长期预测、分类和跨数据集泛化的广泛基准测试中，MSTN在27个数据集中的21个上取得最优结果。MSTN-BiLSTM约0.40M参数，MSTN-Transformer约1.06M参数，推理时间<1秒（通常在毫秒级），适合低延迟、资源受限的部署场景。

Conclusion: MSTN通过ETA原则实现了多尺度时序建模的灵活性与计算效率的统一，特别适合处理跨时间尺度的复杂时序数据，在多种时序任务上均表现优异，且具备轻量化和低延迟的优势。

Abstract: Real-world time series often exhibit strong non-stationarity, complex nonlinear dynamics, and behavior expressed across multiple temporal scales, from rapid local fluctuations to slow-evolving long-range trends. However, many contemporary architectures impose rigid, fixed-scale structural priors such as patch-based tokenization, predefined receptive fields, or frozen backbone encoders - which can over-regularize temporal dynamics and limit adaptability to abrupt high-magnitude events. To handle this, we introduce the Multi-scale Temporal Network (MSTN), a hybrid neural architecture grounded in an Early Temporal Aggregation principle. MSTN integrates three complementary components: (i) a multi-scale convolutional encoder that captures fine-grained local structure; (ii) a sequence modeling module that learns long-range dependencies through either recurrent or attention-based mechanisms; and (iii) a self-gated fusion stage incorporating squeeze-excitation and a single dense layer to dynamically reweight and fuse multi-scale representations. ETA ensures downstream modules operate in O(1) time, while the encoder retains O(L^2) (Transformer) or O(L) (BiLSTM). This design enables MSTN to flexibly model temporal patterns spanning milliseconds to extended horizons, while avoiding the computational burden typically associated with long-context models. Across extensive benchmarks covering imputation, long-term forecasting, classification, and cross-dataset generalization, MSTN achieves state-of-the-art performance, establishing new best results on 21 of 27 datasets, while remaining lightweight (~0.40M params for MSTN-BiLSTM and ~1.06M for MSTN-Transformer) and suitable for low-latency inference (<1 sec, often in milliseconds), resource-constrained deployment.

</details>


### [413] [Masks Can Be Distracting: On Context Comprehension in Diffusion Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2511.21338)
*Julianna Piskorz,Cristina Pinneri,Alvaro Correia,Motasem Alfarra,Risheek Garrepalli,Christos Louizos*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文发现掩码扩散语言模型（MDLMs）存在两个关键局限：1）尽管训练目标和注意力机制更全局化，但仍表现出强局部性偏差，对输入中相关信息的位置高度敏感；2）生成所需的大量掩码标记会作为干扰项显著降低上下文理解能力。作者提出了一种掩码无关的损失函数，通过微调有效缓解了掩码的干扰效应，提升了MDLMs的鲁棒性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 探究MDLMs的上下文理解能力，揭示其潜在局限性，并为构建更强的扩散式语言模型提供可操作的见解。

Method: 通过系统性消融实验分析MDLMs的局部性偏差和掩码干扰效应，提出掩码无关损失函数（mask-agnostic loss），使预测对附加掩码数量保持不变性。

Result: MDLMs表现出与ARLMs类似的局部性偏差，且附加掩码显著干扰上下文理解；所提掩码无关损失函数能有效缓解掩码的干扰效应，提升模型鲁棒性。

Conclusion: 当前MDLM训练范式存在关键局限性，掩码无关损失函数为构建上下文理解能力更强的扩散语言模型提供了可行方向。

Abstract: Masked Diffusion Language Models (MDLMs) have recently emerged as a promising alternative to Autoregressive Language Models (ARLMs), leveraging a denoising objective that, in principle, should enable more uniform context utilisation. In this work, we examine the context comprehension abilities of MDLMs and uncover two key limitations.
