We instantiate this paradigm with the Neural Theorizer (NEO), a probabilistic neural model that induces latent programs as a learned Language of Thought and executes them through a shared transition model. In NEO, a theory is represented as an executable, compositional program whose learned primitives can be systematically recombined to explain novel phenomena. Experiments show that this formulation enables explanation-driven generalization, allowing observations to be understood in terms of the programs that generate them.

</details>


### [452] [Query-efficient model evaluation using cached responses](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.07096)
*Hayden Helm,Ben Johnson,Carey Priebe*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出基于数据核视角空间（DKPS）的方法，利用已缓存模型响应来减少评估新模型所需的查询数量，在保持预测精度的同时大幅降低查询预算。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有评估框架需要对所有查询生成并评估响应，成本高昂；而实践中常缓存了历史模型响应，可以借此减少查询量，实现高效的新模型评估。

Method: 基于数据核视角空间（DKPS）量化黑盒模型之间的关系，利用缓存响应预测新模型在基准上的表现；同时提出离线查询选择方法以最大化参考模型的拟合优度。

Result: 理论上证明了DKPS方法在特定条件下具有查询高效性；实验表明在保持相同平均绝对误差的情况下，DKPS方法显著降低了查询预算。

Conclusion: DKPS方法能有效利用缓存模型响应来减少评估新模型所需的查询数量，且离线查询选择策略比随机选择能进一步提升预测准确度。

Abstract: Evaluating a new model on an existing benchmark is often necessary to understand its behavior before deployment. For modern evaluation frameworks, generating and evaluating a response for all queries can be prohibitively expensive. In practice, responses from previously-evaluated models are often cached -- creating a potential opportunity to use this additional information to decrease the number of queries required to accurately evaluate a new model. In this paper, we introduce an approach for predicting benchmark performance that leverages cached model responses based on the Data Kernel Perspective Space (DKPS), a method for quantifying the relationship between models in the black-box setting. Theoretically, we show that DKPS-based methods are query-efficient under certain conditions. Empirically, we demonstrate that DKPS-based methods achieve the same mean absolute error as baselines with a substantially decreased query budget. We conclude by proposing an offline method for selecting a set of queries that maximizes the goodness-of-fit on reference models, improving prediction accuracy over random query selection.

</details>


### [453] [SHRED: Retain-Set-Free Unlearning via Self-Distillation with Logit Demotion](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.07482)
*Zizhao Hu,Ameya Godbole,Johnny Tian-Zheng Wei,Mohammad Rostami,Jesse Thomason,Robin Jia*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: SHRED是一种无需保留集的大语言模型机器遗忘方法，通过识别并仅处理遗忘实例中高信息量（低概率）的token来实现遗忘与模型效用的帕累托最优平衡。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有LLM遗忘方法依赖保留集（retain set）来防止模型效用退化，这引入了额外的数据依赖，增加了部署复杂性。本文旨在消除这一依赖，实现无需保留集的高效遗忘。

Method: 两阶段方法：(1) 选择阶段：对遗忘集实例进行前向传播，收集逐token自回归概率，选择概率最低（信息量最高）的token作为遗忘位置，其余位置作为良性锚点；(2) 训练阶段：构建修改后的KL目标，在遗忘位置降低记忆token的logit，在良性位置保留原始分布，通过单一的上层KL自蒸馏目标同时驱动遗忘和效用保持。

Result: 在四个标准遗忘基准上，SHRED建立了新的帕累托最优权衡，超越依赖保留集的方法；对重新学习攻击和成员推理攻击具有鲁棒性；在多次顺序遗忘后仍能保持稳定效用。

Conclusion: SHRED通过利用不同token携带记忆信息的不等性，成功实现了无需保留集的LLM遗忘，在遗忘效果和模型效用之间取得了更优的平衡。

Abstract: Machine unlearning for large language models (LLMs) aims to selectively remove memorized content such as private data, copyrighted text, or hazardous knowledge, without costly full retraining. Most existing methods require a retain set of curated examples to prevent catastrophic degradation of general model utility, creating an extra data dependency that complicates deployment. We propose SHRED (Self-distillation via High-surprisal-only Retain-set-free Entropy Demotion), a retain-set-free unlearning method built on a key insight: not all tokens within a forget set instance carry memorized information equally. High-information tokens concentrate the model's memorized knowledge, while low-information tokens reflect general language competence. SHRED operates in two stages. (1) Selection: We perform a forward pass on a forget set instance, collect per-token autoregressive probabilities, and select the bottom (lowest probability, highest Shannon information) as forget positions; the remaining positions are retained as benign anchors. (2) Training: We construct modified KL targets that demote the memorized token's logit at forget positions while preserving the original distribution at benign positions. The model is then trained via a single top KL self-distillation objective that simultaneously drives forgetting and utility preservation. We evaluate SHRED across four standard unlearning benchmarks and demonstrate that it establishes a new Pareto-optimal trade-off between forget efficacy and model utility, outperforming retain-set-dependent methods. Our analysis shows that SHRED is robust against relearning attacks and membership-inference attacks, and it maintains stable utility even after many sequential unlearning runs.

</details>


### [454] [Path-Coupled Bellman Flows for Distributional Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.08253)
*Boyang Xu,Qing Zou,Siqin Yang,Hao Yan*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出Path-Coupled Bellman Flows (PCBF)，一种基于流匹配的连续时间分布强化学习方法，通过源一致的Bellman耦合路径来学习回报分布，解决了边界不匹配和高方差自举问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的分布强化学习方法存在局限性：有限支撑或分位数方法依赖投影，基于流的方法在流源处存在边界不匹配问题，且当前噪声与后继噪声独立时会出现高方差自举。

Method: PCBF通过共享基噪声耦合当前流和后继流，采用λ参数化的控制变量目标：λ=0时恢复无偏样本Bellman目标，λ>0时以可控偏差换取方差降低。流路径从t=0的基础先验出发，在t=1到达Bellman目标，中间时刻保持与后继流的路径仿射关系。

Result: 在解析MRP、OGBench和D4RL上的实验表明，PCBF在分布保真度和训练稳定性上有所提升，离线RL性能具有竞争力。

Conclusion: PCBF通过路径耦合和可控偏差-方差权衡，有效改进了连续时间分布强化学习方法的稳定性和准确性。

Abstract: Distributional reinforcement learning (DRL) models the full return distribution, but existing finite-support or quantile-based methods rely on projections, while recent flow-based approaches can suffer from \emph{boundary mismatch} at the flow source or from \emph{high-variance} bootstrapping when current and successor noises are independent. We propose Path-Coupled Bellman Flows (PCBF), a continuous-time DRL method that learns return distributions with flow matching using \textbf{source-consistent Bellman-coupled paths}: the current path starts from the required base prior at $t{=}0$, reaches the Bellman target at $t{=}1$, and maintains a pathwise affine relation to the successor flow at intermediate times (without requiring time-$t$ marginals to satisfy a distributional Bellman fixed point for all $t$). PCBF couples current and successor return flows through shared base noise and uses a $λ$-parameterized control-variate target: $λ{=}0$ recovers an unbiased sample Bellman target, while $λ{>}0$ trades controlled bias for variance reduction. Experiments on analytically tractable MRPs, OGBench, and D4RL show improved distributional fidelity and training stability, and competitive offline RL performance.

</details>


### [455] [When Attention Beats Fourier: Multi-Scale Transformers for PDE Solving on Irregular Domains](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.08318)
*Brandon Yee,Pairie Koh,Jack Rodriguez,Mihir Tekal*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出多尺度注意力变换器（MSAT）用于求解偏微分方程，在复杂几何问题上相比FNO提升3.7倍精度且推理速度比Mamba-NO快3553倍，并揭示了物理正则化的归纳偏差权衡边界与架构选择的理论依据。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 研究深度学习模型求解PDE时的架构选择问题，明确基于注意力的Transformer架构与傅里叶域神经算子之间的性能对比及适用条件。

Method: 提出MSAT架构，将时空解历史编码为token序列，通过复合监督目标（可选物理信息正则化）进行端到端训练。在PINNacle基准套件的5个问题上，与9种基线方法（PINNs、FNO、DeepONet、GNOT、Mamba-NO等）使用相同训练/测试划分进行对比评估。

Result: MSAT在复杂几何问题Heat2D-CG上达到SOTA（L²_rel=0.0101），比FNO提升3.7倍；总推理时间34秒，而Mamba-NO需120,812秒（快约3553倍）。消融实验表明物理正则化在扩散主导问题上降低测试误差，但在混沌和回流问题中损害泛化能力。

Conclusion: 建立了以域边界复杂度κ为函数的逼近误差界，为架构选择提供了理论指导原则，并直接刻画了先验误配边界。

Abstract: We study the problem of \emph{architecture selection} for deep learning models trained to solve partial differential equations (PDEs), asking when transformer-based architectures with learned attention outperform Fourier-domain neural operators. We introduce the \textbf{Multi-Scale Attention Transformer} (\msat{}), a deep learning architecture that encodes spatiotemporal solution histories as token sequences and trains end-to-end via a composite supervised objective with optional physics-informed regularization terms. We conduct a comprehensive empirical evaluation against nine baselines -- including physics-informed neural networks (PINNs), neural operators (FNO, DeepONet, GNOT), and state-space models (Mamba-NO) -- across five benchmark problems from the PINNacle suite, using identical train/test splits and reference data for all methods. \msat{} achieves state-of-the-art generalization on complex geometry problems ($L^2_\mathrm{rel} = 0.0101$ on Heat2D-CG, a $3.7\times$ improvement over FNO) at $34\,\mathrm{s}$ total inference vs.\ $120{,}812\,\mathrm{s}$ for Mamba-NO. Ablation studies over the physics regularization component reveal a precise inductive bias tradeoff: physics priors reduce test error on diffusion-dominated problems but degrade generalization on chaotic and recirculating-flow regimes, directly characterizing the prior misspecification boundary. Approximation error bounds as a function of domain boundary complexity $κ$ provide a theoretical basis for these empirical findings and a principled rule for architecture selection.

</details>


### [456] [Surrogate Neural Architecture Codesign Package (SNAC-Pack)](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.16138)
*Jason Weitz,Dmitri Demler,Benjamin Hawks,Aaron Wang,Nhan Tran,Javier Duarte*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: SNAC-Pack 是一个开源 AutoML 框架，用于硬件感知的神经架构协同设计与端到端 FPGA 部署。它结合多目标搜索（Optuna + NSGA-II）、硬件代理模型、量化感知训练与剪枝，以及 hls4ml 综合，在无需手动调参的情况下自动发现紧凑架构。在喷注分类和超导量子比特读出两个任务上，该方法在匹配或提升任务指标的同时显著降低 FPGA 资源利用率，并将设计空间探索从数月缩短至数小时。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 NAS 方法通常只优化准确率，或依赖与硬件成本相关性差的代理指标（如 BOPs），尤其对于 FPGA 部署——其代价由 LUT、DSP、FF、BRAM 和延迟等多维预算共同决定——这一差距尤为突出。因此需要一种能够直接联合优化任务指标与 FPGA 硬件成本的多目标自动化框架。

Method: 1) 多目标全局搜索：使用 Optuna 和 NSGA-II 进行搜索，试验记录存入共享 SQLite 存储，支持多节点并行；2) 硬件代理模型：输出每轮试验的资源与延迟估计，避免实际综合带来的高昂开销；3) 局部搜索/压缩：量化感知训练（QAT）与迭代幅度剪枝联合进行；4) 综合部署：通过 hls4ml 将最终模型综合为 FPGA 固件；5) 用户接口：YAML 配置文件与可选的智能前端，无需修改框架即可迁移至新数据集。

Result: 在大强子对撞机喷注分类和超导量子比特读出两个任务上，SNAC-Pack 发现的紧凑架构在任务指标上匹配或超越强基线，同时减少了 FPGA 资源利用。在量子比特读出任务中，设计空间探索从数月的人工调参缩短至数小时的自动搜索。

Conclusion: SNAC-Pack 证明了硬件感知的神经架构协同设计能够有效弥合 NAS 与 FPGA 部署之间的差距，在保持甚至提升任务性能的同时大幅降低硬件成本和人工调参负担。

Abstract: Neural architecture search (NAS) is a powerful approach for automating model design, but existing methods often optimize for accuracy alone or rely on proxy metrics such as bit operations (BOPs) that correlate poorly with hardware cost. This gap is particularly large for FPGA deployment, where cost is dominated by a multi-dimensional budget of lookup tables, DSPs, flip-flops, BRAM, and latency. We present the Surrogate Neural Architecture Codesign Package (SNAC-Pack), an open-source AutoML framework for hardware-aware neural architecture codesign and end-to-end FPGA deployment. SNAC-Pack runs a multi-objective global search with Optuna and NSGA-II, loading trials to a shared SQLite store that enables parallel workers across compute nodes. A hardware surrogate model outputs per-trial resource and latency estimates, avoiding the synthesis cost that would otherwise dominate the search loop. A local search stage then applies quantization-aware training (QAT) together with iterative magnitude pruning in a combined compression loop, after which the final model is synthesized to FPGA firmware via the hls4ml Python library. A YAML configuration and an optional agentic frontend let users run the pipeline on new datasets without modifying the framework. We demonstrate SNAC-Pack on jet classification at the Large Hadron Collider and superconducting qubit readout, discovering compact architectures that match or exceed strong baselines on the task metric while reducing FPGA resource utilization and, in the qubit readout case, reducing the design space exploration process from months of manual fine-tuning to hours of automated search.

</details>


### [457] [Exact Linear Attention](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.18848)
*Weinuo Ou*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出Exact Linear Attention (ELA)，通过核函数的精确分解实现线性复杂度注意力，并解决梯度爆炸和token注意力稀释问题；同时提出Hyper-Link、Memory Lobe和基于路由分数的MoE偏置三项工程创新；实验表明ELA在解码速度和KV缓存上显著优于全注意力，并扩展至视觉模型YOLO-LAT实现高效推理。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 线性注意力虽能降低计算复杂度，但存在两大关键局限：梯度爆炸和token注意力稀释（注意力稀释问题），且现有方法存在近似误差。本文旨在通过精确分解核函数实现无近似误差的线性注意力，并解决上述问题。

Method: (1) 核心机制：利用核函数的精确分解性质实现线性复杂度注意力，通过核约束保证非负性、可区分性和几何可解释性；提出Hadamard Exp核、Summation Squared Euclidean Distance核和Subtraction Squared Euclidean Distance核。(2) 工程创新：Hyper-Link结构替代残差连接缓解梯度退化；基于双向线性注意力的Memory Lobe模块捕获跨层"变换流"实现定性记忆和隐式强化学习范式；基于路由分数的MoE偏置机制提升可解释性和语义对齐。

Result: ELA相比全注意力实现高达6倍解码加速和75%KV缓存内存减少，同时保持相当或更优的训练性能。记忆模块加速收敛并增强泛化。扩展到视觉模型YOLO-LAT实现最高4.3倍GPU推理加速和7.9倍参数缩减，同时保持有竞争力的检测精度。

Conclusion: Exact Linear Attention在保持训练性能的前提下显著提升推理效率，其线性复杂度机制适用于超长序列和高效视觉任务，展示了广泛的适用性。

Abstract: This paper introduces Exact Linear Attention (ELA), a mechanism that achieves linear computational complexity for Transformer attention by exploiting the exact decomposition property of kernel functions, thereby eliminating approximation error. We identify and address two key limitations of prior linear attention -- gradient explosion and token attention dilution -- by imposing kernel constraints that ensure non-negativity, discriminability, and geometric interpretability. Several kernel functions are proposed, including the Hadamard Exp Kernel, Summation Squared Euclidean Distance Kernel, and Subtraction Squared Euclidean Distance Kernel, each tailored for specific attention behaviors.
  Beyond the core attention formulation, the paper presents three engineering innovations: (1) a Hyper-Link structure that replaces traditional residual connections to mitigate gradient degradation; (2) a Memory Lobe module based on bidirectional linear attention, which captures "transformation flow" across layers to implement qualitative memory and an implicit reinforcement learning paradigm; and (3) a routing-score-based bias mechanism for Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) to improve interpretability and semantic alignment.
  Experimental results demonstrate that ELA achieves up to 6x faster decoding speed and 75% reduction in KV cache memory usage compared to full attention, while maintaining comparable or superior training performance. The proposed memory module accelerates convergence and enhances generalization. Furthermore, we extend the linear attention principle to vision models, yielding YOLO-LAT, which attains up to 4.3x GPU inference speedup and 7.9x parameter reduction with competitive detection accuracy. These results underline the broad applicability of exact linear attention for scaling Transformer models to ultra-long sequences and efficient visual tasks.

</details>


### [458] [Toto 2.0: Time Series Forecasting Enters the Scaling Era](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.20119)
*Emaad Khwaja,Chris Lettieri,Gerald Woo,Eden Belouadah,Marc Cenac,Guillaume Jarry,Enguerrand Paquin,Xunyi Zhao,Viktoriya Zhukov,Othmane Abou-Amal,Chenghao Liu,Ameet Talwalkar,David Asker*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文展示了时间序列基础模型的扩展规律：从4M到2.5B参数规模下，单一训练配方即可持续提升预测质量。发布了Toto 2.0系列五个开源权重预测模型，在BOOM、GIFT-Eval和TIME三个基准上取得新SOTA，并详细介绍了架构、训练配方、数据及u-muP超参数迁移管线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 验证时间序列基础模型是否具备扩展性（scaling law），即参数规模增大时预测质量是否持续提升，并发布开源模型推动领域发展。

Method: 采用单一训练配方在4M到2.5B参数范围内训练模型系列；使用u-muP超参数迁移管线实现跨规模超参数共享；模型架构、训练数据和配方经过精心设计。

Result: Toto 2.0系列在三个基准（BOOM、GIFT-Eval、TIME）上均达到最新最优水平；验证了时间序列基础模型的scaling law。

Conclusion: 时间序列基础模型具有显著的扩展性，Toto 2.0为开源时间序列预测设立了新标杆，所有检查点以Apache 2.0协议开源。

Abstract: We show that time series foundation models scale: a single training recipe produces reliable forecast-quality improvements from 4M to 2.5B parameters. We release Toto 2.0, a family of five open-weights forecasting models trained under this recipe. The Toto 2.0 family sets a new state of the art on three forecasting benchmarks: BOOM, our observability benchmark; GIFT-Eval, the standard general-purpose benchmark; and the recent contamination-resistant TIME benchmark. This report describes our experimental results and details the design decisions behind Toto 2.0: its architecture and training recipe, training data, and the u-muP hyperparameter transfer pipeline. All five base checkpoints are released under Apache 2.0.

</details>


### [459] [Reflex: Reinforcement Learning with Reflection Symmetry Exploitation in State-Based Continuous Control](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.23415)
*Shuai Zhen,Yifan Zhang,Yuling Wang,Yanhua Yu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出Reflex范式，通过将反射对称性（轴向反射和双边反射）融入策略学习，显著提升基于状态连续控制任务的样本效率，并在PPO和SAC算法上取得优于标准基线的性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 强化学习长期面临样本效率低下的问题，现有利用群不变性马尔可夫决策过程的工作主要集中在基于图像的RL和旋转对称性（如SO(2)），而基于状态的RL和反射对称性尚未被充分探索。

Method: 形式化定义了两种反射类型（轴向反射和双边反射）及其对应变换，在理论分析对称性保持的最优值函数和策略的基础上，通过原则性的对称性正则化机制将反射对称性融入策略学习，并与PPO和SAC算法无缝集成。

Result: 在OpenAI Gym和DeepMind Control基准测试中，Reflex在标准基线上展现出更优的性能，同时提高了样本效率。

Conclusion: 反射对称性可有效提升基于状态连续控制任务的样本效率，Reflex范式能同时适用于同策略和异策略RL算法，具有较好的通用性。

Abstract: Reinforcement learning has long struggled with poor sample efficiency. One promising approach to mitigate this problem is leveraging group-invariant Markov Decision Processes ($G$-invariant MDPs). Existing works in this direction have primarily focused on image-based RL and rotational symmetry such as $\mathrm{SO(2)}$, leaving state-based RL and reflection symmetry largely underexplored. In this work, we focus on state-based continuous control tasks and exploit reflection symmetry by introducing Reflex, a paradigm that seamlessly integrates with both on-policy and off-policy RL algorithms. We formalize two types of reflection-axial reflection and bilateral reflection, and characterize their corresponding transformations. Building on a theoretical analysis of symmetry-preserving optimal value functions and policies, Reflex integrates reflection symmetry into policy learning through principled symmetry regularization mechanisms. We integrate Reflex with PPO and SAC, and evaluate it on a suite of OpenAI Gym and DeepMind Control benchmarks, demonstrating superior performance over standard baselines while improving sample efficiency. Our code is available at https://github.com/TonyStark042/Reflex.

</details>


### [460] [Class-Dependent Hybrid Data Augmentation for Multiclass Migraine Classification under Severe Class Imbalance](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.23453)
*Elvin Somón,Miguel A. Gutiérrez-Naranjo*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文针对偏头痛分类研究中的方法学缺陷（数据泄露和指标偏差）进行修正，提出了三类改进：临床驱动的亚型合并、基于样本量的混合增强策略、以及保真度不对称概念下的比例约束增长方法。在400名患者七类亚型数据集上，修正后基线F1为0.71，提出的框架在八种分类器上平均F1达0.862，最优结果0.914（FT-Transformer+比例增强），表明临床驱动的类别聚合贡献了主要提升，框架的核心贡献在于提升跨分类器的平均鲁棒性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 既往偏头痛分类研究存在数据泄露和指标偏差的方法学缺陷，导致性能估计膨胀。需要纠正这些问题并引入更合理的分类和数据增强策略以提升模型可靠性和临床适用性。

Method: (i) 基于ICHD-3 §1.2.3对两个偏瘫亚型进行临床驱动的类别聚合；(ii) 依赖类样本量的混合增强策略，按类别样本量分配生成方法；(iii) 提出保真度不对称概念，采用比例约束增长替代完全类别平衡。两阶段协议下对400名患者七类亚型采用分层5折交叉验证。

Result: 修正后macro-F1基线为0.71。所提框架在八种分类器上平均macro-F1为0.862，优于高斯Copula（0.836）、CTGAN（0.815）和无增强基线（0.801），FT-Transformer在比例增强下达到峰值0.914。

Conclusion: 临床驱动的类别聚合贡献了主要的绝对提升，框架的核心可测量贡献在于提升跨分类器的平均鲁棒性，问题公式化（problem formulation）起主导作用。

Abstract: We conducted a reproducibility-oriented re-evaluation of prior migraine classification studies, correcting for data leakage and metric bias. We then introduced (i) a clinically motivated aggregation of two hemiplegic subtypes following ICHD-3 §1.2.3, (ii) a class-dependent hybrid augmentation strategy that assigns generation methods based on per-class sample size, and (iii) the concept of fidelity asymmetry, motivating proportionally constrained growth as an alternative to full class balance. Experiments were performed on a dataset of 400 patients across seven migraine subtypes under a two-stage protocol, including the six-class configuration described above. Models were evaluated using stratified 5-fold cross-validation with macro-averaged F1 as the primary metric.
  Correcting methodological flaws reduces previously inflated performance estimates, with the corrected macro-F1 baseline standing at 0.71. The proposed framework consistently outperformed individual augmenters in macro-F1 averaged across the eight evaluated classifiers (0.862 vs. 0.836 for Gaussian Copula, 0.815 for CTGAN, and 0.801 for the no-augmentation baseline), and achieved its peak result of 0.914 with FT-Transformer under proportional augmentation. The no-augmentation FT-Transformer baseline (0.896) shows that, at the per-classifier ceiling, clinically motivated class aggregation accounts for most of the absolute improvement; the framework's principal measurable contribution is the gain in average robustness across classifiers, highlighting the dominant role of problem formulation.

</details>


### [461] [Spectral Probe-Circuits: A Three-Step Recipe for Identifying Attention-Head Circuits in Pretrained Transformers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.24059)
*Yongzhong Xu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种三步法来识别预训练Transformer中的注意力头电路：基于谱信号的头部排序、任务模式筛选、分组消融验证。该方法在51M到1B参数范围内跨多种架构和预训练流程得到验证，发现2-6个头的归纳电路在所有模型中因果必要，且谱信号无需监督即可预测电路结构。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有方法依赖标签或归因梯度来识别注意力头电路，缺乏一种通用、无监督且可跨模型规模和架构迁移的电路识别方法。

Method: 三步法：(1) 每头注意力输出的时间积分参与比作为谱信号，无需标签或归因梯度即可对头部排序；(2) 任务模式筛选，将通用指标转化为任务特定的候选电路；(3) 分组消融与匹配随机对照完成因果验证。

Result: 在8倍参数范围（51M-1B活跃/7B总量）、两种架构家族（密集、混合专家）、四种预训练流程上验证。2-6头的归纳电路在所有模型中因果必要，消融后合成归纳top-1下降94-100%。谱信号在6个独立种子的51M探测模型上均能预测种子特定电路。Pythia系列（124M-410M）中可识别的特化计算头部比例守恒在17-19%，而归纳电路保持3-11头，呈亚线性增长。

Conclusion: 该方法是一种通用的、可迁移的注意力头电路识别方法论，为后续研究预训练过程中的发育轨迹和组合任务电路提供了基础框架。

Abstract: We present a three-step recipe for identifying attention-head circuits in pretrained transformers. A per-head spectral signal -- the time-integrated participation ratio of each head's attention output -- ranks heads doing sustained content-dependent computation without labels or attribution gradients. A task-pattern screen filters this general indicator into a task-specific candidate circuit, and group ablation against a matched-random control completes the causal claim. We validate across an 8x parameter range (51M to 1B-active / 7B-total), two architecture families (dense, mixture-of-experts), and four pretraining pipelines. The recipe ports: a 2-6 head induction circuit is causally necessary in every model tested, with a 94-100% drop in synthetic-induction top-1 after ablation. The spectral signal is predictive without supervision: on six independent seeds of a 51M-parameter probe model, the same computation identifies the seed-specific circuit on each seed. The fraction of heads doing identifiable specialized computation is conserved at 17-19% across the Pythia family (124M to 410M), while specific induction circuits stay 3-11 heads -- sublinear in total head count. This paper is the methodology anchor of a three-paper program; companion papers extend the recipe to developmental trajectories during pretraining and to composed-task circuits where pattern selectivity decouples from task-causal structure.

</details>


### [462] [Extreme Region Policy Distillation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.25582)
*Changyu Chen,Xiting Wang,Rui Yan*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出极端区域策略蒸馏（ERPD）两阶段框架，通过解耦样本效率与KL效率，先进行弱约束的离策略优化充分提取训练信号，再在信任区域约束下将这些信号蒸馏回基础策略，在数学推理任务上验证了有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大语言模型的强化学习面临样本效率与渐近性能之间的根本性权衡：严格在策略方法在单次更新后丢弃轨迹，而离策略复用引入分布偏移，现有信任区域技术主要通过保守优化来缓解，但往往未能充分利用丰富的训练信号。

Method: 两阶段框架：第一阶段在固定数据上执行弱约束的离策略优化，最大化提取训练信号；第二阶段将这些信号在信任区域约束下蒸馏回基础策略，过滤有害漂移同时保留有用信号。支持强教师和弱教师两种场景。

Result: 在数学推理任务上，ERPD在强基础模型因在策略训练陷入平台期时仍能取得增益；在弱教师场景下也能提供可靠的改进。蒸馏后的策略以显著更小的KL散度达到相当或更好的性能。

Conclusion: 第一阶段的大部分KL散度消耗在了不必要的漂移而非真正改进上；ERPD通过解耦样本效率与KL效率，有效解决了强化学习中的权衡问题。

Abstract: Reinforcement learning for large language models faces a fundamental trade-off between sample efficiency and asymptotic performance: strictly on-policy methods discard trajectories after a single update, while off-policy reuse introduces distribution mismatch that existing trust-region techniques mitigate primarily by enforcing conservative optimization, often leaving rich training signals underutilized. To investigate this, we perform extensive off-policy updates on fixed data. Our experiments reveal that aggressive multi-step optimization brings rapid initial gains, but excessive updates cause trajectory probabilities to deviate and entropy to collapse, with performance plateauing early. Tightening KL constraints merely lowers the ceiling without resolving the degradation. This motivates Extreme Region Policy Distillation (ERPD), a two-stage framework that decouples sample efficiency from KL efficiency. The first stage performs weakly constrained off-policy optimization on fixed data to maximally extract training signals. The resulting policy provides token-level supervision. In the second stage, we distill these signals into the base policy under trust-region constraints, filtering harmful drift while preserving useful signals. The distilled policy achieves comparable or better performance with substantially smaller KL divergence, indicating that much of the first-stage divergence was spent on unnecessary drift rather than genuine improvement. Crucially, ERPD accommodates both strong and weak teachers: when aggressive optimization yields no stronger policy, even degenerate teachers provide effective supervision via alternative signal construction strategies. We validate ERPD on mathematical reasoning, showing gains for strong base models where on-policy training plateaus, and reliable improvements with weak teachers.

</details>


### [463] [Detectability in Diversity: Improved Canary Crafting for Privacy Auditing in One Run](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.27292)
*Mathieu Dagréou,Aurélien Bellet*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出一种结合影响函数和双层优化的金丝雀数据高效构建方法，用于单轮运行隐私审计，在降低计算成本的同时获得更强的隐私泄露估计。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有单轮审计方法中，金丝雀数据点之间的干扰导致隐私泄露估计弱于多轮方法，亟需一种能同时提高金丝雀可检测性并减少相互干扰的优化方法。

Method: 提出结合基于影响函数的贪心初始化与双层优化方法：贪心初始化选取高影响力候选点，双层优化在最大化成员推断可区分性的同时促进嵌入空间多样性，采用计算高效的双层优化算法求解。

Result: 实验表明该方法在更低的计算成本下，获得了比现有金丝雀构建方法更强的隐私泄露估计。

Conclusion: 通过优化金丝雀的检测性和降低干扰性，可有效提升单轮隐私审计的估计效果，为高效隐私审计提供了新思路。

Abstract: Privacy auditing aims to empirically assess privacy leakage in machine learning models using membership inference attacks (MIAs), and to derive lower bounds on differential privacy (DP) parameters. Recent one-run auditing methods address the high cost of standard approaches by relying on a single training run with multiple "canary" points whose inclusion or exclusion must be detected by the auditor. In this work, we study the problem of efficiently crafting canaries for one-run privacy auditing. Motivated by recent theoretical insights suggesting that interference between canaries contributes to weaker leakage estimates compared to multi-run methods, we propose to optimize canaries to be both highly detectable and minimally interfering. Our approach combines a greedy initialization based on influence functions with a bilevel optimization procedure that maximizes distinguishability while promoting diversity in embedding space, enabling the use of computationally efficient bilevel algorithms. Experiments show that our method achieves stronger privacy leakage estimates at a lower computational cost than existing canary crafting approaches.

</details>


### [464] [Filter, Then Reweight: Rethinking Optimization Granularity in On-Policy Distillation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.02684)
*Yuying Li,Leqi Zheng,Yongzi Yu,Wenrui Zhou,Xuchang Zhong,Xing Hu,Jing Jin,Hangjie Yuan,Tao Feng*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出FiRe-OPD方法，通过先过滤低质量轨迹再对保留轨迹中的token进行软加权，在轨迹和token两个粒度上联合调整蒸馏监督信号，实现更细粒度的在线策略蒸馏优化，在多种设置下均取得显著提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 近年在线策略蒸馏（OPD）方法从全程KL监督转向选择性训练范式，越来越关注选择哪些轨迹、哪些token以及哪些监督信号。受此趋势启发，作者重新思考OPD的优化粒度，旨在实现更精细的蒸馏优化。

Method: 提出FiRe-OPD方法：1) 首先过滤（Filter）轨迹，移除低质量rollout样本；2) 然后在保留的轨迹内对token进行软加权（Reweight），强调信息量大的token。区别于硬token选择，软加权机制可减少信息损失并提升优化稳定性。

Result: 在强到弱、单教师、多教师三种设置下验证有效性，超越近期token级OPD方法：强到弱设置下AIME 2024 +6.25，多教师设置下Miner +18.81。

Conclusion: FiRe-OPD通过轨迹过滤和token软加权的联合策略，实现了更细粒度的OPD优化，在多种蒸馏场景下均优于现有方法。

Abstract: On-Policy distillation (OPD) in large language models is shifting from full-trace KL supervision toward more selective training paradigms. Recent OPD methods increasingly focus on selecting which trajectories to learn from, which tokens are most informative, and which supervision signals are most reliable. Motivated by this trend, we rethink optimization granularity of OPD and propose \fireicon\ FiRe-OPD (Filter, then Reweight), which jointly adjusts supervision signals at both trajectory and token levels. In details, FiRe-OPD first filters trajectories to remove low-quality rollout samples, and then applies soft reweighting within the retained trajectories to emphasize informative tokens. Compared with hard token selection, FiRe-OPD leverages a soft-weighting mechanism to effectively mitigate information loss and enhance optimization stability, thereby achieving finer-grained OPD optimization. We validate the effectiveness of FiRe-OPD across strong-to-weak, single-teacher, and multi-teacher settings, and demonstrate its superiority over recent token-level OPD methods ( (e.g., +6.25 on AIME 2024 in strong-to-weak, +18.81 on Miner in multi-teacher). Our code is available at https://github.com/YuYingLi0/FiRe-OPD.

</details>


### [465] [ASymPO: Asymmetric-Scale Policy Optimization for Asynchronous LLM Post-Training Without Behavior Information](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.03070)
*Zehua Liu,Yuxuan Yao,Xiaojin Fu,Tao Zhong,Mingxuan Yuan*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出AsymPO方法，通过当前策略的负对数概率归一化解码异步组相对RL中陈旧响应的分布漂移问题，无需行为策略概率即可实现零和平衡。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 异步强化学习在语言模型后训练中通过解耦响应生成与策略优化提升吞吐量，但陈旧响应会导致分布漂移。现有行为校正方法依赖行为策略概率（如重要性比率、裁剪），需要令牌级对齐、版本一致且数值稳定的行为对数概率，增加了系统复杂度。

Method: 提出Asymmetric-Scale Policy Optimization (ASymPO)，通过当前平均令牌负对数概率对每个响应的令牌损失进行归一化；同时引入Scaled Policy Optimization (SPO)作为固定负缩放基线。两种方法均仅使用当前策略概率。

Result: 识别了规模失衡失效模式：当陈旧响应在当前策略下评估时，正负损失项出现在不同的负对数概率尺度上，导致零和优势不再意味着平衡的损失贡献。ASymPO恢复了响应级零和平衡并保留了非零学习信号。

Conclusion: ASymPO无需行为策略概率即可稳定异步组相对RL，在异步数学推理后训练中验证了仅基于当前策略的目标函数的有效性。

Abstract: Asynchronous reinforcement learning can improve language-model post-training throughput by decoupling response generation from policy optimization, but stale responses introduce distribution drift. Standard behavior-corrected methods control this drift with behavior-policy probabilities, importance ratios, or clipping, which requires token-aligned, versioned, and numerically consistent behavior log-probabilities across rollout and learner systems. We ask whether asynchronous group-relative RL can instead be stabilized using only current-policy probabilities. We identify a scale-imbalance failure mode: when stale responses are evaluated under the current policy, positive and negative loss terms can appear at different negative log-probability scales, so zero-sum advantages no longer imply balanced loss contributions. We propose Asymmetric-Scale Policy Optimization (ASymPO), which normalizes each response's token loss by its current average token negative log-probability. ASymPO requires no behavior-policy probabilities, restores response-level zero-sum balance, and preserves a nonzero learning signal. We also introduce Scaled Policy Optimization (SPO), a fixed negative-scaling baseline, and evaluate both current-policy-only objectives in asynchronous mathematical reasoning post-training.

</details>


### [466] [Do Transformers Need Three Projections? Systematic Study of QKV Variants](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.04032)
*Ali Kayyam,Anusha Madan Gopal,M Anthony Lewis*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文系统研究了注意力机制中QKV三个投影的共享约束，发现Q-K=V（共享键-值投影）在多种任务上表现与标准QKV相当或更优，在语言建模中可减少50% KV缓存且仅损失3.1%困惑度，与GQA/MQA结合可实现高达96.9%的缓存缩减，适合边缘设备部署。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: QKV注意力公式中三个投影的各自贡献以及省略某些投影的影响尚不明确，作者希望系统性地探究投影共享对Transformer性能的影响。

Method: 系统评估三种投影共享约束：a) Q-K=V（共享键-值），b) Q=K-V（共享查询-键），c) Q=K=V（单一投影）。针对对称注意力问题引入2D位置编码实现非对称注意力。在合成任务、视觉任务（MNIST、CIFAR、TinyImageNet、异常检测）和语言建模（300M和1.2B参数模型，100亿token）上进行实验。

Result: Q-K=V变体在多种任务上表现与标准QKV相当或更优；语言建模中Q-K=V实现50% KV缓存缩减，仅3.1%困惑度下降；与GQA-4结合达87.5%缓存缩减，与MQA结合达96.9%；Q=K-V和Q=K=V因破坏注意力方向性而性能下降。

Conclusion: 投影共享是注意力机制中一种未充分探索的权重绑定方式，Q-K=V能在几乎不损失质量的前提下显著降低推理内存开销，尤其适合边缘部署。键和值可以共享相似的表征空间，而注意力在低秩状态下运行是Q-K=V有效的关键原因。

Abstract: Transformers have become the standard solution for various AI tasks, with the query, key, and value (QKV) attention formulation playing a central role. However, the individual contribution of these three projections and the impact of omitting some remain poorly understood. We systematically evaluate three projection sharing constraints: a) Q-K=V (shared key-value), b) Q=K-V (shared query-key), and c) Q=K=V (single projection). The last two variants produce symmetric attention maps; to address this, we also explore asymmetric attention via 2D positional encodings. Through experiments spanning synthetic tasks, vision (MNIST, CIFAR, TinyImageNet, anomaly), and language modeling (300M and 1.2B parameter models on 10B tokens), we discovered that our transformers perform on par or occasionally better than the QKV transformer. In language modeling, Q-K=V projection sharing achieves 50% KV cache reduction with only 3.1% perplexity degradation. Crucially, projection sharing is complementary to head sharing (GQA/MQA): combining Q-K=V with GQA-4 yields 87.5% cache reduction, while Q-K=V + MQA achieves 96.9%, enabling practical on-device inference. We show that Q-K=V preserves quality because keys and values can occupy similar representational spaces and attention operates in a low-rank regime, whereas Q=K-V breaks attention directionality. Our results systematically characterize projection sharing as an underexplored instance of weight tying in attention, with direct, quantifiable inference memory benefits, particularly valuable for edge deployment. The code is publicly available at https://github.com/Brainchip-Inc/Do-Transformers-Need-3-Projections

</details>


### [467] [Policy Gradient for Continuous-Time Robust Markov Decision Processes](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.04335)
*Tanya Veeravalli,David M. Bossens,Atsushi Nitanda*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究了连续时间鲁棒马尔可夫决策过程（RMDP）中的策略梯度算法，提出了双循环优化器和均值场优化器，分别实现了线性收敛和$\tilde{\mathcal{O}}(\frac{1}{K})$的oracle收敛率，并在样本复杂度上取得了$\tilde{\mathcal{O}}(\frac{1}{ε^2})$和$\tilde{\mathcal{O}}(\frac{N^2}ε)$的结果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统RMDP基于离散时间动力学，而连续时间RMDP中的策略梯度算法尚未被充分探索。本文旨在将策略梯度方法扩展到连续时间RMDP框架下，并设计高效优化算法。

Method: 利用路径导数和伴随方法推导策略梯度和对抗梯度（针对随机微分方程和常微分方程）；提出双循环优化器（oracle设置下线性收敛）和均值场优化器（分布优化，$\tilde{\mathcal{O}}(\frac{1}{K})$收敛）；在无折扣总成本MDP框架下开发了新的分析工具。

Result: 双循环优化器：oracle设置下线性收敛，样本设置下$\tilde{\mathcal{O}}(\frac{1}{ε^2})$样本复杂度；均值场优化器：oracle收敛率$\tilde{\mathcal{O}}(\frac{1}{K})$，$N$粒子近似下样本复杂度$\tilde{\mathcal{O}}(\frac{N^2}ε)$。

Conclusion: 连续时间策略梯度算法在神经ODE动力学的连续时间RMDP上有效性得到验证，为连续时间鲁棒强化学习提供了理论保证和实用算法。

Abstract: The framework of robust Markov decision processes (RMDPs) allows the design of reinforcement learning agents that satisfy performance guarantees under worst-case transition dynamics. Traditional RMDPs consider discrete-time dynamics and recently, sample-efficient policy gradient algorithms have been considered in this context. This paper investigates policy gradient algorithms within a continuous-time RMDP framework. Policy gradients and adversarial gradients are derived using pathwise and adjoint-based formulas for stochastic and ordinary differential equations. We propose double-loop optimisers to obtain linear convergence in the oracle-based setting and an $\tilde{\mathcal{O}}(\frac{1}{ε^2})$ sample complexity in the sample-based setting in an analysis which also derives novel tools for the framework of undiscounted total cost MDPs. Additionally, we propose mean-field optimisers as distributional optimisers with an $\tilde{\mathcal{O}}(\frac{1}{K})$ oracle-based convergence rate and an $\tilde{\mathcal{O}}(\frac{N^2}ε)$ sample complexity under $N$-particle approximation. The effectiveness of continuous-time policy gradient algorithms is confirmed for both optimisers on continuous-time RMDPs with neural ordinary differential equation dynamics.

</details>


### [468] [LimiX-2M: Mitigating Low-Rank Collapse and Attention Bottlenecks in Tabular Foundation Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.04485)
*Yuanrui Wang,Xingxuan Zhang,Han Yu,Mingchao Hao,Gang Ren,Hao Yuan,Li Mao,Yunjia Zhang,Chun Yuan,Peng Cui*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出RaBEL（将标量扩展为紧凑的局部RBF特征）和重新排序的双向块S->N->F（先聚合跨样本上下文再混合特征并使用注意力池化），构建了仅2M参数的LimiX-2M模型，在表格基准上超越更大规模的TabPFN-v2和TabICL，同时降低训练和推理成本。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有表格基础模型（TFMs）虽然性能可与树集成方法媲美，但计算效率低下：标准仿射标量分词器通过单一维度注入特征值变化，特征ID/位置信号无法增加特征内部值自由度，导致早期层值敏感性弱且存在冗余隐藏状态。

Method: 提出统一的tokenize-and-route框架：1) RaBEL——将每个标量扩展为紧凑的局部RBF特征（可选指数门控），改善条件数和浅层有效秩；2) 重新排序的双向块S->N->F——先跨样本上下文聚合（S），再进行特征混合（N），最后使用注意力池化（F），使计算与读出对齐。

Result: 2M参数的LimiX-2M在广泛使用的表格基准上优于更大的TabPFN-v2和TabICL基线，同时降低了训练和推理成本。

Conclusion: 值感知分词和读出对齐路由是改善TFMs精度-效率权衡的关键杠杆。

Abstract: Tabular foundation models (TFMs) increasingly rival tree ensembles, but their performance is often compute-inefficient: with standard affine scalar tokenization, each feature injects value variation through an essentially one-dimensional channel, and feature IDs/positional signals cannot increase within-feature value degrees of freedom, yielding weak early-layer value sensitivity and redundant hidden states. We present a unified tokenize-and-route framework for strong TFMs: RaBEL expands each scalar into compact localized RBF features (optionally exponent-gated) to improve conditioning and shallow-layer effective rank, while a reordered bidirectional block S->N->F aligns computation with the readout by aggregating cross-sample context before feature mixing and using attention pooling. Together, these changes yield LimiX-2M, a 2M-parameter model that outperforms larger TabPFN-v2 and TabICL baselines on widely used tabular benchmarks while reducing training and inference costs. These results highlight value-aware tokenization and readout-aligned routing as key levers for improving the accuracy--efficiency trade-off in TFMs. Model checkpoints and inference code are available at https://github.com/limix-ldm-ai/LimiX.

</details>


### [469] [Rollout-Level Advantage-Prioritized Experience Replay for GRPO](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.04560)
*Gyeongtae Yoo,Sanghyeok Park,Soohyuk Jang,Ik-hwan Kim,Sungroh Yoon*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种用于GRPO的轨迹级回放缓冲区（Rollout-level Replay Buffer），通过年龄驱逐机制控制数据过时、新鲜锚定组合保持近策略特性、以及按优势大小优先回放，显著提升了推理LLM后训练中的样本效率和性能，在多个数学基准上超越GRPO和朴素回放基线，且增益随模型规模增大而增长。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基于可验证奖励的GRPO强化学习后训练推理LLM存在样本效率低下的问题：每次采样仅用于单次梯度更新即被丢弃。朴素回放因LLM策略每步梯度漂移剧烈，存储的轨迹迅速过时，反而会导致训练不稳定。

Method: 提出轨迹级回放缓冲区：1) 存储和采样单个轨迹而非整组；2) 通过年龄驱逐（age eviction）移除超过tau_max步的过时轨迹；3) 采用新鲜锚定组合（fresh-anchored composition），每个batch保留当前策略的新鲜轨迹，再从缓冲区中额外拼接回放轨迹；4) 按每条轨迹的优势函数绝对值优先回放，并回收优势大的轨迹。

Result: 在Qwen3-Base三种规模和五个数学基准上，该方法全面超越GRPO和朴素回放基线。增益随模型规模增长：在4B规模下五个基准平均提升+4.35个百分点；AES指标（联合衡量准确率和token效率）上相较GRPO提升最大，达+0.579。

Conclusion: 轨迹级回放缓冲区能有效解决GRPO样本效率低下的问题，通过合理的过时控制和优先回放策略，在多个规模和基准上取得一致且显著的性能提升，为推理LLM后训练提供了一种高效的新范式。

Abstract: Reinforcement learning from verifiable rewards with GRPO is a standard approach for post-training reasoning LLMs. It remains sample inefficient. Each rollout is used for a single gradient update and then discarded. Naive replay is not well suited in this setting because LLM policies drift quickly per gradient step. Stored rollouts therefore become stale and can destabilize training. We propose a rollout-level replay buffer for GRPO that stores and samples individual rollouts rather than whole groups. The buffer bounds staleness through age eviction. Any rollout older than tau_max training steps is removed. The buffer also preserves on-policy data via fresh-anchored composition. Each batch keeps its fresh on-policy rollouts and then concatenates replay rollouts drawn separately from the buffer. We prioritize replay by per-rollout advantage magnitude and recycle individual rollouts whose advantages are large. Across three Qwen3-Base scales on five math benchmarks, our method outperforms GRPO and naive replay baselines. Gains are positive at every scale and grow with model size. The largest gain is +4.35 pp on the five-benchmark average at 4B. Under an AES metric that jointly measures accuracy and token efficiency, the efficiency margin over GRPO is again largest at 4B, at +0.579.

</details>


### [470] [Learning Long Range Spatio-Temporal Representations over Continuous Time Dynamic Graphs with State Space Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.04672)
*Ayushman Raghuvanshi,Thummaluru Siddartha Reddy,Sundeep Prabhakar Chepuri,Mahesh Chandran*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出CTDG-SSM，一种基于状态空间建模的连续时间动态图框架，通过CTT-HiPPO算子联合编码时间动态和图结构，在长时序和空间推理任务上达到SOTA。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有连续时间动态图方法局限于捕获一跳或局部时间邻域，无法有效进行长程信息传播和多跳全局结构模式的学习。

Method: 从第一性原理推导出参数高效的状态空间建模框架。首先提出CTT-HiPPO，通过拉普拉斯矩阵的多项式投影经典HiPPO解，得到拓扑感知的记忆更新；然后等价转化为CTDG-SSM状态空间形式；最后采用零阶保持法获得计算高效的离散形式。

Result: 在动态链接预测、动态节点分类和序列分类基准上达到SOTA，尤其对需要长时序和空间推理的数据集取得显著性能提升。

Conclusion: CTDG-SSM通过状态空间建模有效解决了CTDG中的长程信息传播问题，联合建模时间动态与图结构是关键创新。

Abstract: Continuous-time dynamic graphs (CTDGs) provide a richer framework to capture fine-grained temporal patterns in evolving relational data. Long-range information propagation is a key challenge while learning representations, wherein it is important to retain and update information over long temporal horizons. Existing approaches restrict models to capture one-hop or local temporal neighborhoods and fail to capture multi-hop or global structural patterns. To mitigate this, we derive a parameter-efficient state-space modeling framework for continuous-time dynamic graphs (CTDG-SSM) from first principles. We first introduce continuous-time Topology-Aware higher order polynomial projection operator (CTT-HiPPO), a novel memory-based reformulation of HiPPO to jointly encode temporal dynamics and graph structure. The solution from CTT-HiPPO is obtained by projecting the classical HiPPO solution through a polynomial of the Laplacian matrix, yielding topology-aware memory updates that admit an equivalent state-space formulation for CTDGs (CTDG-SSM). Then a computationally efficient discrete formulation is obtained using the zero-order hold approach for model implementation.
  Across benchmarks on dynamic link prediction, dynamic node classification, and sequence classification, CTDG-SSM achieves state-of-the-art performance. Notably, it achieves large performance gains on datasets that require long range temporal (LRT) and spatial reasoning.

</details>


### [471] [UniFair: A unified fair clustering approach based on separation and compactness](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.04777)
*Antonia Karra,Vasiliki Papanikou,Georgios Vardakas,Evaggelia Pitoura,Aristidis Likas*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出UniFair统一框架，联合优化分离公平性（使受保护群体远离决策边界）和社会公平性（减少组内聚类成本差异），通过梯度优化和深度聚类扩展，在表格和图像数据集上以少量聚类损失换取公平性提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 标准聚类目标（如k-means）可能对不同人口统计群体产生不公平对待，而现有公平聚类方法通常只优化单一公平性概念，忽略了聚类成本与决策边界几何间的相互作用。

Method: 提出UniFair框架，联合优化分离公平性和社会公平性；开发基于梯度的优化过程用于分离公平和统一的k-means目标；通过自编码器潜在空间强制执行相同标准，扩展到深度聚类。

Result: 在表格和图像数据集上，UniFair减少了边界相关和成本相关的群体差异，仅带来少量聚类损失增加。

Conclusion: 统一优化多种公平性指标是可行的，能够在保持聚类质量的同时有效减少群体间差异。

Abstract: Clustering is increasingly used to support high-impact decisions, yet standard objectives such as k-means can produce clusterings that treat demographic groups unequally. Existing fair clustering methods typically optimize a single notion of fairness and often overlook how clustering costs interact with the geometry of the induced decision boundaries. We propose UniFair, a unified framework that jointly optimizes separation fairness and social fairness. Separation fairness encourages protected groups to lie farther from the induced decision boundaries, while social fairness reduces disparities in within-cluster distortion by penalizing group-wise clustering costs. We develop gradient-based optimization procedures for separation-fair and unified k-means objectives, and extend them to deep clustering by enforcing the same criteria in the latent space of an autoencoder. Experiments on tabular and image datasets show that UniFair reduces both boundary-related and cost-based group disparities with only a modest increase in clustering loss.

</details>


### [472] [The Right Measure for Physics-Constrained Generation: A Co-Area Correction for Posterior-Consistent PDE Inverse Problems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.04804)
*Jian Xu,Delu Zeng,John Paisley,Qibin Zhao*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文揭示了在PDE逆问题中，将生成模型（扩散/流匹配）作为硬约束（投影/引导）进行后验采样时，会因Borel-Kolmogorov悖论而采样到错误的分布，遗漏了关键的co-area（Fixman）Jacobian因子，导致后验误差最高可达采样噪声底的20倍。作者提出CoCoS方法，通过考虑度量感知的约束采样来修正这一偏差。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有方法广泛采用"硬约束+生成先验"的方式求解PDE逆问题，并将其结果作为贝叶斯后验进行不确定性量化。然而，将生成模型条件约束在测度零流形上是本质歧义的（Borel-Kolmogorov悖论），物理上正确的解需要包含co-area Jacobian因子，而现有投影/引导方法忽略了该因子，导致采样分布错误。作者旨在揭示、量化并修正这一偏差。

Method: 首先从理论上证明硬约束条件化在零测度流形上的歧义性，阐明小残差噪声极限下co-area Jacobian因子[det(JJ^T)]^{-1/2}的必要性；随后在受控问题上与i.i.d.真实后验对比，量化投影法（如PCFM）和引导法的偏差程度；最后提出CoCoS（度量感知约束采样器），通过显式纳入该Jacobian因子来校正后验分布。

Result: 省略co-area因子会导致后验误差高达采样噪声底的20倍；最小位移投影（如PCFM）偏差为噪声底的9倍；简单的标量重加权无法修复该偏差。CoCoS方法能够匹配到金标准后验，误差仅受限于采样噪声。

Conclusion: "满足物理约束"并不等同于"采样后验分布"。不确定性感知的科学推理需要正确的度量校正，CoCoS为这一目标提供了原则性的解决方案。

Abstract: Generative models -- diffusion and flow matching -- are increasingly used to solve partial differential equation (PDE) inverse problems, enforcing the governing physics as a \emph{hard constraint} (via projection or guidance) and reporting the resulting samples as a Bayesian posterior with calibrated uncertainty. We show that this widely adopted recipe samples the wrong distribution. Conditioning a generative prior on a hard PDE constraint is conditioning on a measure-zero manifold -- an operation that is intrinsically ambiguous (the Borel--Kolmogorov paradox) and whose physically correct resolution, the small-residual-noise limit, carries a co-area (Fixman) Jacobian factor $[det(JJ^{\top})]^{-1/2}$ that projection- and guidance-based methods silently omit. We make the bias precise, show that it grows with the heterogeneity of the constraint sensitivity, and validate it on controlled problems against an \emph{i.i.d.} ground-truth arbiter. The omitted factor is not a second-order detail: removing it inflates the posterior error to $20\times$ the sampling-noise floor; minimal-displacement projection (as in PCFM) is biased at $9\times$ the floor; and a naive scalar reweighting does not fix it. We introduce \textbf{CoCoS}, a measure-aware constrained sampler that targets the correct co-area posterior, and show that it matches the gold-standard posterior to within sampling noise. Our results imply that ``satisfying the physics'' is not the same as ``sampling the posterior,'' and give a principled correction for uncertainty-aware scientific inference.

</details>


<div id='cs.SI'></div>

# cs.SI [[Back]](#toc)

### [473] [Annotation of Positive vs Negative User Interactions for Social Sign Prediction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.06425)
*Biancamaria Bombino,Chiara Boldrini,Andrea Passarella,Marco Conti*

Main category: cs.SI

TL;DR: 本文提出利用大语言模型（LLM）在零样本设置下，通过识别互动层面的人际关系信号（个人表扬和个人攻击）来推断社交关系的正负符号，解决了传统情感分析将内容情感与关系性质混为一谈的系统性偏差问题。在四个模型和三种提示设计上的实验表明，零样本LLM能有效建立关系标注基线，其中攻击检测对提示和模型选择更鲁棒，而表扬检测则更敏感。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有社交关系符号推断方法依赖情感分析对个体互动打标签，但情感分析捕捉的是讨论内容的情绪色彩，而非人际交换关系本身的性质，这种混淆会导致系统性误分类。因此需要更直接的关系信号识别方法。

Method: 利用LLM在零样本设置下识别互动层面的人际关系信号——个人表扬（积极关系）和个人攻击（消极关系），作为正负社交关系的更直接指标。在四个模型（Qwen2.5:7b、Gemma2:9b、GPT-4o、GPT-5.4-mini）和三种复杂度递增的提示设计上，使用两个人工标注数据集（约298和340条文本）进行评估。

Result: 零样本LLM在两项任务上均取得良好分类性能，无需任务特定训练数据即可建立实用的关系标注基线。攻击检测对提示设计和模型选择较为鲁棒，而表扬检测对两者都更敏感，反映出积极关系姿态具有更大的主观性。

Conclusion: 这些发现为将基于LLM的关系标注集成到社交关系符号预测流程中奠定了基础。

Abstract: Inferring the sign of social relationships from online interactions is a fundamental challenge in social network analysis. Existing approaches typically rely on sentiment analysis to label individual interactions as positive or negative, then aggregate these labels to assign a sign to the relationship. However, sentiment analysis captures the valence of the content being discussed rather than the nature of the relational exchange itself, a conflation that can lead to systematic misclassification. In this paper, we propose a methodology that addresses this limitation by leveraging Large Language Models (LLMs) in a zero-shot setting to identify interaction-level relational signals (specifically, personal praise and personal attacks directed at the interlocutor) as more direct indicators of positive and negative social ties. We evaluate four models spanning open-weight and proprietary architectures (Qwen2.5:7b, Gemma2:9b, GPT-4o, GPT-5.4-mini) across three prompt designs of increasing complexity, on two human-annotated datasets of approximately 298 and 340 texts respectively. Results show that zero-shot LLMs achieve good classification performance on both tasks without any task-specific training data, establishing a practical baseline for relational annotation. Performance differs across tasks: attack detection is robust to prompt design and model choice, while praise detection is more sensitive to both, reflecting the greater subjectivity of positive relational gestures. These findings lay the groundwork for integrating LLM-based relational annotation into sign prediction pipelines.

</details>


### [474] [Federating Governance: How Community Rules Scale with Mastodon Instances](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.05069)
*Rasika Muralidharan,Yong-Yeol Ahn,Bao Tran Truong*

Main category: cs.SI

TL;DR: 本研究分析Mastodon实例的社区规则，发现治理优先级在不同规模实例间高度一致，主要关注骚扰、仇恨言论和非法内容等问题性内容。社区规模是规则发展的强预测因子：大型实例规则更广泛、主题更多样，但可读性和语言多样性较低。外部联邦交互影响有限。社区规模对去中心化社交媒体的自我治理施加了基础性约束，其扩展模式与Reddit等中心化平台相似。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 去中心化社交媒体平台（如Mastodon、Bluesky）的兴起凸显了扩展自我治理和审核的挑战。随着社区增长，它们面临越来越复杂的治理结构需求，但由于审核主要由志愿者驱动，关于社区规则和审核实践应如何随规模演变的正式指导有限。本研究旨在填补这一空白。

Method: 通过分析不同规模Mastodon实例的社区规则，对规则进行分类以识别关键治理优先级，并研究规则形式化程度与社区规模、外部联邦交互之间的关系。

Result: 治理优先级在不同规模实例间高度一致，主要针对问题性内容。小型社区关注更窄的主题集，大型服务器覆盖更广泛主题。社区规模强预测规则发展：规模越大，规则越广泛、主题越多样，但可读性和语言多样性降低。外部联邦交互主要与更广的规则范围相关，对多样性和形式影响有限。

Conclusion: 内部规模压力而非网络层面动态主导去中心化社交媒体的治理。社区规模对自我治理施加了超越平台架构的基础性约束，Mastodon的扩展模式与Reddit等中心化平台相似。

Abstract: The rise of decentralized social media platforms like Mastodon and Bluesky highlights the challenge of scaling self-governance and moderation. As communities grow, they face new issues that demand increasingly complex governance structures. However, as moderation is mainly volunteer-driven, there is limited formal guidance on how community rules and moderation practices should evolve with growth. This study investigates how moderation scale with Mastodon instances by analyzing community rules across servers of varying sizes. We categorize these rules to identify key governance priorities and find that these priorities are remarkably consistent across instance sizes: rules addressing problematic content, such as harassment, hate speech, and illegal content, dominate regardless of scale. While smaller communities focus on narrower sets of topics, larger servers maintain a more balanced coverage of a broad range of topics. Our analysis of rule formalization reveals that community size strongly predicts rule development. As instances grow, their rules become more extensive and topically diverse, but also exhibit lower readability and linguistic diversity. In contrast, external federation interactions have a limited role, mainly associated with a broader scope of rules without substantially affecting their diversity or form. These findings highlight the relative influence of internal versus external factors, suggesting that local scaling pressures outweigh network-level dynamics in decentralized social media governance. The scaling pattern observed on Mastodon resemble those previously identified on centralized platforms such as Reddit, suggesting that community size imposes fundamental constraints on self-governance that transcend platform architectures

</details>
